name: G FUEL!
description: Grants various effects based on the amount of G FUEL! obtained. Only appears on certain Daily Challenges or with an easter egg seed.

effects.text: A can of G FUEL! is available at the start of every floor. Floors affected by will give two cans.
effects.raw: A can of G FUEL! is available at the start of every floor. Floors affected by {{Cu|Labyrinth}} will give two cans.

effects.text: Some of G FUEL!'s effects depend on how many copies of the item Isaac has:
effects.raw: Some of G FUEL!'s effects depend on how many copies of the item Isaac has:

children.text: Replaces Isaac's tears with various "guns".
children.raw: Replaces Isaac's tears with various "guns".

children.text: The first can simply increases damage, tears, and shot speed without replacing tears.
children.raw: The first can simply increases damage, tears, and shot speed without replacing tears.

children.text: The second can replaces Isaac's tears with bullets.
children.raw: The second can replaces Isaac's tears with bullets.

children.text: The third can changes the firing pattern into two accurate, rapid-fire streams of bullets. Changes Isaac's stats similarly to Soy Milk.
children.raw: The third can changes the firing pattern into two accurate, rapid-fire streams of bullets. Changes Isaac's stats similarly to {{I|Soy Milk}}.

children.text: The fourth can changes the attack into a buckshot shotgun, shooting a large spread of pellets which bounce on impact with obstacles.
children.raw: The fourth can changes the attack into a buckshot shotgun, shooting a large spread of pellets which bounce on impact with obstacles.

children.text: The fifth can changes the attack into a slug shotgun, shooting a single high damage projectile that bounces on impact with obstacles.
children.raw: The fifth can changes the attack into a slug shotgun, shooting a single high damage projectile that bounces on impact with obstacles.

children.text: The sixth can changes the attack into a minigun, rapidly shooting bullets with low accuracy. This also pushes Isaac back depending on the firing speed.
children.raw: The sixth can changes the attack into a minigun, rapidly shooting bullets with low accuracy. This also pushes Isaac back depending on the firing speed.

children.text: The seventh can changes the attack into a rocket launcher, shooting explosive rockets that detonate on impact.
children.raw: The seventh can changes the attack into a rocket launcher, shooting explosive rockets that detonate on impact.

children.text: The eighth can onwards gives Isaac a random weapon from the ones listed above.
children.raw: The eighth can onwards gives Isaac a random weapon from the ones listed above.

children.text: The ninth can onwards adds random tear effects to bullets.
children.raw: The ninth can onwards adds random tear effects to bullets.

children.text: Starting with the second copy, speeds up the game every time it's picked up.
children.raw: Starting with the second copy, speeds up the game every time it's picked up.

children.text: Starting with the fourth copy, non-boss enemies have a chance to multiply, with further copies increasing the number of enemies.
children.raw: Starting with the fourth copy, non-boss enemies have a chance to multiply, with further copies increasing the number of enemies.

children.text: Each copy increases the amount of screen shake caused by gunfire and enemy explosions.
children.raw: Each copy increases the amount of screen shake caused by gunfire and enemy explosions.

effects.text: Grants +0.2 Speed. Ignores the speed cap. Collecting other speed up items will also break the cap.
effects.raw: Grants +0.2 [[Speed]]. Ignores the speed cap. Collecting other speed up items will also break the cap.

children.text: Unlike other items that change speed, G FUEL causes one of Jacob and Esau characters to move faster than the other.
children.raw: Unlike other items that change speed, G FUEL causes one of {{c|Jacob and Esau}} characters to move faster than the other.

effects.text: All explosion sprites are replaced with stock explosion footage. Certain bosses have special explosion animations.
effects.raw: All explosion sprites are replaced with stock explosion footage. Certain bosses have special explosion animations.

effects.text: All enemies explode on death. These explosions do not deal damage and do not destroy objects.
effects.raw: All enemies explode on death. These explosions do not deal damage and do not destroy objects.

effects.text: All consumable spawn animations will be accompanied by explosion sprites as well.
effects.raw: All consumable spawn animations will be accompanied by explosion sprites as well.

effects.text: Enemies grant far more score on death than usual, and the amount is displayed when they die.
effects.raw: Enemies grant far more [[Daily Challenges#Score|score]] on death than usual, and the amount is displayed when they die.

effects.text: All water and blood in rooms is replaced with a light blue liquid (presumably G Fuel).
effects.raw: All water and blood in rooms is replaced with a light blue liquid (presumably G Fuel).

effects.text: Pressing the "drop" button plays an airhorn sound effect.
effects.raw: Pressing the "drop" button plays an airhorn sound effect.

effects.text: Most "special floor tiles" are replaced with special G Fuel floor tiles.
effects.raw: Most "special floor tiles" are replaced with special G Fuel floor tiles.

effects.raw: Replaces Isaac's nightmares during floor transition with G Fuel-themed versions.

name: 9 Volt
description: Reduces the charge of any activated item by 1. Any 1 charge items instead have timed recharges.

effects.text: Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.
effects.raw: Fully charges the currently held active item upon 9 Volt's first pickup.

effects.text: If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.
effects.raw: If the current active item has a recharge time of more than 1 bar, then it will grant 1 bar of charge whenever the item is activated.

effects.text: If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.
effects.raw: If the current active item has a recharge time of 1 bar, then it will change the item to have a timed recharge of 15 seconds. The recharging of the item only triggers so long as there are enemies present in the room in any fashion. Empty rooms do not cause recharging to start.

effects.text: If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.
effects.raw: {{dlc|a+}} If the current activated item already has a timed recharge, 9 Volt makes it start at half charge when used, effectively halving the time to recharge and allowing quicker reuse.

synergies.text: 3-bar items: Quadruple rooms and L-shaped rooms give 2 bars after clearing them, allowing one free use of the item in those rooms if the gauge is full upon entering them. It can also be used at the beginning of a Boss Challenge Room to get the full charges back after beating both bosses.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|a+}} '''3-bar items''': Quadruple rooms and L-shaped rooms give 2 bars after clearing them, allowing one free use of the item in those rooms if the gauge is full upon entering them. It can also be used at the beginning of a Boss Challenge Room to get the full charges back after beating both bosses.

name: Dead Bird
description: After Isaac takes damage, spawns a flying familiar that chases enemies for the current room, dealing ~4 damage per second. As long as Isaac's HP is at one half heart ( no matter the type of heart), Dead Bird will remain active between rooms.

effects.text: Taking damage summons a bird familiar that chases enemies for the remainder of the current room, dealing 2 damage per tick (~4.3 damage per second).
effects.raw: Taking damage summons a bird [[familiar]] that chases enemies for the remainder of the current [[Rooms|room]], dealing 2 damage per tick (~4.3 damage per second).

children.text: As long as Isaac's HP is at one half heart ( no matter the type of heart), Dead Bird will remain active between rooms. Upon entering a new floor, Dead Bird will be inactive, and a hit must be taken to activate it again.

interactions.raw: {{I|Sacrificial Altar}}: The familiar can only be sacrificed while it is active.

name: Brimstone
description: Tears are replaced with a blood laser beam that pierces through all enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period.

effects.text: Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is piercing and spectral, dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.
effects.raw: Isaac's tears are replaced with a charged blood laser beam. The beam is [[piercing]] and [[spectral]], dealing damage to all enemies and ignoring all obstacles in its path.

children.text: The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.
children.raw: The laser deals damage equal to Isaac's damage and deals damage each tick.

children.text: These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.
children.raw: These ticks occur every 1/15th of a second (once every 4 frames). However, after the first damage tick, there is an additional pause for ~0.12 seconds (7 frames). Damage ticks work normally after that.

children.text: Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).
children.raw: {{Dlc|r}}Brimstone ticks 9 times over the course of ~0.63 seconds (38 frames).

children.text: \text{Charge Time (s)} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate}}
children.raw: <math>\text{Charge Time (s)} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay)}) \approx \frac{1}{\text{Fire Rate}}</math>

children.text: Starting from 15.00 fire rate, the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.
children.raw: {{Dlc|r}}Starting from 15.00 [[fire rate]], the beam can last indefinitely as long as the fire key is held, and higher fire rate results in higher damage and larger scale.

children.text: \text{Damage per Tick} = \frac{6 \times \text{Damage}}{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} = \frac{\text{Damage} \times \text{Fire Rate}}{5}
children.raw: <math>\text{Damage per Tick} = \frac{6 \times \text{Damage}}{\text{Tear Delay} + 1} = \frac{\text{Damage} \times \text{Fire Rate}}{5}</math>

effects.text: Tears down: Fire Rate ÷ 3.
effects.raw: [[Tears]] down: {{Dlc|nr}} Tear Delay × 3 / {{Dlc|r}} Fire Rate ÷ 3.

effects.text: Counts towards the Leviathan transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Leviathan}}

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider: Fires a spread of 2/3/4 Brimstone beams.
synergies.raw: {{I|20/20|a}} / {{I|The Inner Eye}} / {{I|Mutant Spider}}: Fires a spread of 2/3/4 Brimstone beams.

children.text: Despite the fire rate penalty caused by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, the overall DPS increase is more significant compared to 20/20. However, if combined, 20/20 negates the fire rate penalty of the aforementioned items, which results in enormous damage output.
children.raw: Despite the fire rate penalty caused by The Inner Eye and Mutant Spider, the overall DPS increase is more significant compared to 20/20. {{Dlc|r}}However, if combined, 20/20 negates the fire rate penalty of the aforementioned items, which results in enormous damage output.

The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls. The beam will also gain random worm trinket effects.
synergies.raw: {{I|Almond Milk}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge. The beam lasts indefinitely as long as the fire key is held. The beam can change its direction while being fired, and can be aimed in any direction with joystick controls. The beam will also gain random worm trinket effects.

children.raw: Increasing the tears stat will increase the damage and width of Brimstone as well.

children.text: Damage per Tick = (Damage × Fire Rate) ÷ 5
children.raw: Damage per Tick = (Damage × Fire Rate) ÷ 5

synergies.raw: {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}}: Picking up Brimstone with him will give him the regular version.

synergies.text: The bonus applies randomly on every tick of the beam, including the insta-kill ability from Euthanasia.
synergies.raw: {{Dlc|r}}The bonus applies randomly on every tick of the beam, including the insta-kill ability from Euthanasia.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: An orb of energy expands, then shrinks while firing the beam after a delay. The orb still hurts enemies if they touch it. Isaac can start charging a new shot immediately after releasing the fire key without canceling the first shot, effectively allowing for a faster firing rate. It makes it harder to hit enemies with Azazel as the beam does not increase in range. Size and damage of the beams no longer scales with fire rate, nor is it possible to sustain a perpetual beam at above 15 fire rate.
synergies.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: An orb of energy expands, then shrinks while firing the beam after a delay. The orb still hurts enemies if they touch it. Isaac can start charging a new shot immediately after releasing the fire key without canceling the first shot, effectively allowing for a faster firing rate. It makes it harder to hit enemies with {{C|Azazel}} as the beam does not increase in range. {{Dlc|r}}Size and damage of the beams no longer scales with fire rate, nor is it possible to sustain a perpetual beam at above 15 fire rate.

name: Epic Fetus
description: Instead of tears, firing creates a crosshair which can be moved freely. A missile is dropped in the location after 1.5 seconds, exploding for high damage.

effects.text: Isaac's tears are replaced with guided missiles. Pressing the fire buttons spawns a crosshair that can be moved freely, dropping a missile on its position from above 1.5 seconds later.

children.raw: Missiles deal 20 times Isaac's damage.

children.raw: Tears that bounce off of enemies bounce in random directions, whereas tears that bounce off of walls and other objects bounce directly back.

children.raw: When tears bounce from enemies, they become able to hit the same enemy again should they bounce off of another enemy or obstacle.

children.raw: {{dlc|a+}} {{C|Azazel}}'s Brimstone no longer becomes a full length laser after bouncing, and instead bounce as a regular mini-Brimstone.

synergies.raw: {{i|The Parasite}}: Tears will bounce off of walls without splitting, but split and bounce when hitting enemies. The split tears and the original one will bounce off everything.

synergies.raw: {{i|Pop!}}: Significantly increases the uptime of tears, since they are not limited by range and each tear will bounce off of each other. Continuously firing tears will eventually create a positive feedback loop, as the tears will keep bouncing faster and faster while not dropping to the floor.

Given some time and enough tears, this can kill even final bosses such as Hush and Delirium quickly.
children.raw: '''Pop!''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Extremely powerful combination; Lump of Coal's tear size increase will make it much easier for tears to bounce off of each other, while they increase in damage very rapidly. children.text: Hemoptysis + BFFS!: The curse causes the beam's damage to be increased to 13 damage per tick.
children.raw: Hemoptysis + {{i|BFFS!}}: The curse causes the beam's damage to be increased to 13 damage per tick.

synergies.text: King Baby / Marked: While firing, Brimstone will be charged automatically and fired immediately upon full charge, the beam will now target the nearest enemy/crosshair.
synergies.raw: {{I|King Baby}} / {{I|Marked}}: While firing, Brimstone will be charged automatically and fired immediately upon full charge, the beam will now target the nearest enemy/crosshair.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: When used with a laser attack (such as Brimstone), Lil Brimstone will not automatically fire as it would with Marked.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: When used with a laser attack (such as {{i|Brimstone}}), Lil Brimstone will not automatically fire as it would with {{i|Marked}}.

name: Isaac's Heart
description: Isaac himself is now immune to all damage, and a heart familiar follows him. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt. The heart charges up as Isaac shoots, firing 8 blood shots, knocking back enemies, and leaving a puddle of creep when released.

effects.text: Isaac's body becomes immune to all damage from enemies and the environment. This does not include interactable objects such as s and s.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Isaac's body becomes immune to all damage from enemies and the environment. This does not include interactable objects such as {{m|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{M|Devil Beggar}}s.

effects.text: A heart familiar appears and closely follows Isaac. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt.
effects.raw: A heart [[familiar]] appears and closely follows Isaac. If the heart is hurt, Isaac is hurt.

effects.text: The heart tries to position itself in the opposite direction of where Isaac is shooting.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} The heart tries to position itself in the opposite direction of where Isaac is shooting.

effects.text: The heart charges up as Isaac fires. At full charge, upon releasing the fire button, it knocks back nearby enemies and tears, creates a small puddle of red creep on the ground, and releases blood shots in 8 directions that deal 8 damage.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} The heart charges up as Isaac fires. At full charge, upon releasing the fire button, it knocks back nearby enemies and tears, creates a small puddle of red [[creep]] on the ground, and releases blood shots in 8 directions that deal 8 damage.

effects.text: Enemies pushed into walls or obstacles by the knockback blast take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Enemies pushed into walls or [[obstacles]] by the knockback blast take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage.

effects.text: Enemies that come in contact with Isaac take 2x Isaac's current damage per tick or 4x Isaac's damage per second.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Enemies that come in contact with Isaac take 2x Isaac's current damage per tick or 4x Isaac's damage per second.

synergies.text: 120 Volt/Monstrance: These items become much safer to use offensively as they are centered around Isaac's body which no longer takes damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|120 Volt}}/{{i|Monstrance}}: These items become much safer to use offensively as they are centered around Isaac's body which no longer takes damage.

synergies.text: Box of Friends: Box of Friends does not duplicate the heart, making it safe to use.
synergies.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: Box of Friends does not duplicate the heart, making it safe to use.

synergies.text: Works as normal except for the fact that the damage to the heart must be blocked to spawn the 4 beams.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} Works as normal except for the fact that the damage to the heart must be blocked to spawn the 4 beams.

synergies.text: Duct Tape: Makes dodging significantly easier.
synergies.raw: {{t|Duct Tape}}: Makes dodging significantly easier.

synergies.text: E. Coli: Isaac can turn enemies into poop without taking damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|E. Coli}}: Isaac can turn enemies into poop without taking damage.

synergies.text: Holy Mantle: The shield effect carries over to the heart.
synergies.raw: {{i|Holy Mantle}}: The shield effect carries over to the heart.

synergies.text: Gigante Bean: Makes the heart much easier to defend as it increases the knockback amount and radius of the heart when fully charged and the heart makes farting noises when it shoots.
synergies.raw: {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Makes the heart much easier to defend as it increases the knockback amount and radius of the heart when fully charged and the heart makes farting noises when it shoots.

synergies.text: Items granting invulnerability or a shield: The invincibility carries over to the heart.
synergies.raw: Items granting [[invulnerability]] or a [[shield]]: The invincibility carries over to the heart.

children.text: Due to the contact damage, Gnawed Leaf allows Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Due to the contact damage, {{i|Gnawed Leaf}} allows Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.

synergies.text: Kamikaze!: As long as the heart is away from the blast radius, no damage is taken. The character must be at high enough speed for this.
synergies.raw: {{i|Kamikaze!}}: As long as the heart is away from the blast radius, no damage is taken. The character must be at high enough speed for this.

synergies.text: Pyromaniac / Host Hat: Explosion immunity carries over to the heart.
synergies.raw: {{i|Pyromaniac}} / {{i|Host Hat}}: Explosion immunity carries over to the heart.

children.text: The heart must be in range of explosion for Pyromaniac to heal Isaac.
children.raw: The heart must be in range of explosion for Pyromaniac to heal Isaac.

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar now doesn't remove Isaac's Heart.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} Sacrificial Altar now doesn't remove Isaac's Heart.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss: Isaac can poison enemies by contact without taking damage, allowing for free black hearts.
synergies.raw: {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}: Isaac can poison enemies by contact without taking damage, allowing for free black hearts.

interactions.text: Aries: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.
interactions.raw: {{i|Aries|r}}: The invulnerability does not extend to the heart.

interactions.text: Baby-Bender: The heart's tears do not gain homing.
interactions.raw: {{T|Baby-Bender}}: The heart's tears do not gain homing.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Fires additional shots in random directions, and leaves larger puddles of creep.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!|dlc=r}}: Fires additional shots in random directions, and leaves larger puddles of creep.

interactions.text: Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Dry Baby can constantly block it from tears.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Dry Baby can constantly block it from tears.

interactions.text: Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Farting Baby can constantly block it from tears.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Isaac's Heart no longer follows Isaac in a way where Farting Baby can constantly block it from tears.

interactions.text: A Pound of Flesh: Consumables can no longer be picked up in Shops.
interactions.raw: {{I|A Pound of Flesh}}: Consumables can no longer be picked up in Shops.

interactions.text: The Soul: Isaac's body repels projectiles, but Isaac's Heart doesn't.
interactions.raw: {{i|The Soul}}: Isaac's body repels projectiles, but Isaac's Heart doesn't.

interactions.text: Tainted Forgotten: The heart follows Tainted Soul.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The heart follows Tainted Soul.

name: Lil Haunt
description: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 4 damage per second and inflicting fear.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that chases down enemies, dealing 2 damage per tick (4 damage per second) and inflicting fear.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that chases down enemies, dealing 2 damage per tick (4 damage per second) and inflicting [[fear]].

effects.text: The familiar has an exceptionally higher detection range than most other familiars that chase down enemies.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} The familiar has an exceptionally higher detection range than most other familiars that chase down enemies.

name: Dark Bum
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every 1½ Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will give a reward.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Red Hearts. For every one-and-a-half Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will generate one of the following:
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac around and collects {{E|Red Heart}}s. For every one-and-a-half Red Hearts collected, Dark Bum will generate one of the following:

children.text: A single Black Heart.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} A single {{E|Black Heart}}.

children.text: A hostile Spider.
children.raw: A hostile {{E|Spider}}.

children.text: A friendly Blue Spider.
children.raw: A friendly [[Blue Spider]].

children.text: A random pill, card, or rune. {| class="wikitable" |+ Loot Table !Pickup !Chance |- |Black Heart |40% |- |Card or Rune |20% |- |Pill |20% |- |Blue Spider |10% |- |Spider |10% |}
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} A random [[pill]], [[Cards and Runes|card, or rune]]. {| class="wikitable" |+{{dlc|r}} Loot Table !Pickup !Chance |- |{{E|Black Heart}} |40% |- |[[Cards and Runes|Card or Rune]] |20% |- |[[Pills|Pill]] |20% |- |[[Familiar#Blue Spiders|Blue Spider]] |10% |- |{{E|Spider}} |10% |}

effects.text: Counts towards the Super Bum transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Super Bum}}

synergies.text: Humbleing Bundle / Equality!: Most Red Heart drops will become Double Red Heart drops. This counts as two full Red Hearts for Dark Bum, essentially doubling the value of it.
synergies.raw: {{i|Humbleing Bundle}} / {{t|Equality!|a+nr+}}: Most Red Heart drops will become Double Red Heart drops. This counts as two full Red Hearts for Dark Bum, essentially doubling the value of it.

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect, but familiar is bigger.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect, but familiar is bigger.

interactions.text: Dark Bum / Cambion Conception: Each Dark Bum tracks the collected hearts separately.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dark Bum}} / {{i|Cambion Conception}}: Each Dark Bum tracks the collected hearts separately.

interactions.text: King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|King Baby}} / {{t|RC Remote}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Options?: If one of the options is a Red Heart variant, Dark Bum may collect it, making the other option disappear.
interactions.raw: {{i|Options?}}: If one of the options is a Red Heart variant, Dark Bum may collect it, making the other option disappear.

name: Big Fan
description: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 30 damage per second to enemies. Reduces the speed other orbitals rotate at.

effects.text: Spawns a large, slow-moving orbital familiar that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.
effects.raw: Spawns a large, slow-moving [[orbital familiar]] that blocks enemy shots and deals 2 damage per tick (~8.57 damage per second) on contact.

effects.text: Reduces the rotation speed of all of Isaac's orbitals.
effects.raw: Reduces the rotation speed of all of Isaac's orbitals. {{dlc|na+}} This excludes Pretty Flies.

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Big Fan becomes visually larger and deals more damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind|dlc=r}}: Big Fan becomes visually larger and deals more damage.

synergies.text: Guillotine: Reduces the head's rotation speed, making it easier to aim.
synergies.raw: {{i|Guillotine}}: Reduces the head's rotation speed, making it easier to aim.

interactions.text: Friendship Necklace: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{t|Friendship Necklace}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Guardian Angel: Overrides Guardian Angel's speed boost. If Guardian Angel was obtained first, it will retain its own increased speed. If Big Fan was obtained first, Guardian Angel will be slower.
interactions.raw: {{i|Guardian Angel}}: Overrides Guardian Angel's speed boost. If Guardian Angel was obtained first, it will retain its own increased speed. If Big Fan was obtained first, Guardian Angel will be slower.

interactions.text: Psy Fly: Rotates slower, but moves at full speed while blocking incoming projectiles.
interactions.raw: {{i|Psy Fly}}: Rotates slower, but moves at full speed while blocking incoming projectiles.

name: Sissy Longlegs
description: Spawns a familiar that wanders randomly, occasionally spawning Blue Spiders. Briefly charms enemies on contact.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that wanders around the room and occasionally spawns friendly Blue Spiders.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that wanders around the room and occasionally spawns friendly [[Familiar#Blue Spiders|Blue Spider]]s.

children.text: Blue Spiders are spawned once every 10-15 seconds, as long as there are enemies in the room.
children.raw: Blue Spiders are spawned once every 10-15 seconds, as long as there are enemies in the room.

children.text: Only up to 5 Blue Spiders can be spawned at a time.
children.raw: Only up to 5 Blue Spiders can be spawned at a time.

effects.text: Charms enemies briefly on contact.
effects.raw: {{Dlc|r}} [[Charm]]s enemies briefly on contact.

effects.text: Counts towards the Spider Baby transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Spawn delay is decreased to 7-11 seconds.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}} / {{i|Hive Mind}}: Spawn delay is decreased to 7-11 seconds.

synergies.text: Mom's Wig: The maximum number of Blue Spiders is increased to 10.
synergies.raw: {{i|Mom's Wig}}: The maximum number of Blue Spiders is increased to 10.

name: Punching Bag
description: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that wanders randomly. Enemies will attack the Mulligan if it's closer.

effects.text: Spawns a Mulligan familiar that walks around the room and acts as a decoy for monsters.
effects.raw: Spawns a {{E|Mulligan}} [[familiar]] that walks around the [[room]] and acts as a decoy for [[monsters]].

effects.text: If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.
effects.raw: If the monsters are closer to the decoy than Isaac, they will attack the decoy.

effects.text: Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Homing shots from enemies will always be attracted to the decoy if they are closer to it than Isaac.

effects.text: Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.
effects.raw: {{dlc|nar+}} Punching Bag will also block enemy shots.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Adds another Punching Bag. This may cause enemies to become unpredictable, so use with caution.
interactions.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: Adds another Punching Bag. This may cause enemies to become unpredictable, so use with caution.

children.text: If the Punching Bag has died, it can be forced to respawn with a double upon using the Box of Friends.
children.raw: If the Punching Bag has died, it can be forced to respawn with a double upon using the Box of Friends.

name: How to Jump
description: Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving, allowing travel over obstacles and enemies.

effects.text: Upon use, Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving. The distance of the jump depends on how fast Isaac was moving and for how long he was holding the button when the item was activated. Jumping allows Isaac to travel over obstacles such as rocks and pits.
effects.raw: Upon use, Isaac jumps in the direction he is currently moving. The distance of the jump depends on how fast Isaac was moving and for how long he was holding the button when the item was activated. Jumping allows Isaac to travel over [[obstacles]] such as rocks and pits.

effects.text: While mid-jump, enemies, projectiles, Bombs, and spikes cannot damage Isaac. Isaac cannot interact with pickups or Chest mid-jump.
effects.raw: While mid-jump, [[Monsters|enemies]], projectiles, {{e|Bomb}}s, and [[spikes]] cannot damage Isaac. Isaac cannot interact with [[pickups]] or {{E|Chest||chests}} mid-jump.

effects.text: Counts towards the Bookworm transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}

synergies.text: Broken Remote: Isaac can teleport indefinitely, but the jump will instantly be cancelled by the teleport.
synergies.raw: {{T|Broken Remote}}: Isaac can teleport indefinitely, but the jump will instantly be cancelled by the teleport.

synergies.text: Panic Button: Makes Isaac immune to contact and projectile damage while moving.
synergies.raw: {{T|Panic Button}}: Makes Isaac immune to contact and projectile damage while moving.

synergies.text: Familiars that orbit Isaac (such as Sacrificial Dagger, Sworn Protector, etc.) can damage enemies when Isaac jumps over them. However, items that activate on contact (e. g. Serpent's Kiss, Midas' Touch, etc.) cannot trigger during jumps.
synergies.raw: Familiars that orbit Isaac (such as {{i|Sacrificial Dagger}}, {{i|Sworn Protector}}, etc.) can damage enemies when Isaac jumps over them. However, items that activate on contact (e. g. {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}, {{i|Midas' Touch}}, etc.) cannot trigger during jumps.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Void: If this item is activated by Void, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: If this item is activated by {{i|Void}}, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.

name: D100
description: Activates the combined effects of D4, The D6, and D20. Activates the combined effects of D1, D4, The D6, D7, D8, D10, D12, and D20.

effects.text: Rerolls all passive items on Isaac (like the D4).
effects.raw: Rerolls all passive items on Isaac (like the {{i|D4}}).

effects.text: Rerolls all pedestal items in the room (like The D6).
effects.raw: Rerolls all pedestal items in the [[room]] (like {{i|The D6}}).

effects.text: Rerolls all pickups in the room (like the D20).
effects.raw: Rerolls all pickups in the room (like the {{i|D20}}).

effects.text: Restarts the room and respawns all enemies (like the D7).
effects.raw: Restarts the room and respawns all enemies (like the {{i|D7}}).

effects.text: Rerolls Isaac's damage, tears, range and speed (like the D8).
effects.raw: Rerolls Isaac's [[damage]], [[tears]], [[range]] and [[speed]] (like the {{i|D8}}).

effects.text: Rerolls all enemies in the room into weaker ones (like the D10).
effects.raw: Rerolls all enemies in the room into weaker ones (like the {{i|D10}}).

children.text: Doesn't go into effect in rooms the D7 works in.
children.raw: Doesn't go into effect in rooms the {{i|D7}} works in.

effects.text: Rerolls all rocks in the room (like the D12).
effects.raw: Rerolls all rocks in the room (like the {{i|D12}}).

effects.text: Duplicates 1 random pickup in the current room (like the D1).
effects.raw: Duplicates 1 random pickup in the current room (like the {{i|D1}}).

children.text: The pickup is rerolled by the D20 before being duplicated, essentially just granting a random extra pickup.
children.raw: The pickup is rerolled by the {{i|D20}} before being duplicated, essentially just granting a random extra pickup.

name: D4
description: Rerolls all of Isaac's passive items.

effects.text: Upon use, rerolls each of Isaac's passive items into new ones.
effects.raw: Upon use, rerolls each of Isaac's [[passive item]]s into new ones.

children.text: The new items will be drawn from the item pool where the original item was acquired.
children.raw: {{dlc|a+}} The new items will be drawn from the item pool where the original item was acquired.

children.text: If health upgrade items are removed by a reroll, the health they granted is subtracted.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} If health upgrade items are removed by a reroll, the health they granted is subtracted.

synergies.text: Abyss: Locusts created by Abyss are not rerolled.
synergies.raw: {{i|Abyss}}: Locusts created by Abyss are not rerolled.

name: D10
description: Rerolls all monsters in the room. Replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters.

effects.text: Upon use, replaces all monsters in the room with weaker monsters. Each monster type has a specific weaker monster it will transform into. If the monster is already at its weakest level, it usually transforms it into a background critter or kills it outright.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Upon use, replaces all [[monster]]s in the [[room]] with weaker monsters. Each monster type has a specific weaker monster it will transform into. If the monster is already at its weakest level, it usually transforms it into a background critter or kills it outright.

children.text: Some enemies can be transformed into obstacles or pickups instead.
children.raw: Some enemies can be transformed into obstacles or pickups instead.

children.text: Transforming an enemy with a D10 does not necessarily make it objectively easier to kill. For example, Globin gets transformed into Clotty, which although has less health, may be harder to fight due to the tears it fires. Other prominent examples include Evis transforming into Double Vis, Holy Eye transforming into Eye, and Wall Creep transforming into Big Spider.
children.raw: Transforming an enemy with a D10 does not necessarily make it objectively easier to kill. For example, {{e|Globin}} gets transformed into {{e|Clotty}}, which although has less health, may be harder to fight due to the tears it fires. Other prominent examples include {{e|Evis}} transforming into {{e|Double Vis}}, {{e|Holy Eye}} transforming into {{e|Eye}}, and {{e|Wall Creep}} transforming into {{e|Big Spider}}. {{Clear}} <!--This is here to give the tables max width for better visibility-->

synergies.text: Car Battery: Weakens affected enemies twice.
synergies.raw: {{I|Car Battery|r}}: Weakens affected enemies twice.

name: Blank Card
description: Copies the effect of the card or rune currently held by Isaac. Copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. The recharge time is based on the power of the card.

effects.text: Upon use, copies the effect of the card currently held by Isaac. Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Upon use, copies the effect of the [[card]] currently held by Isaac. Blank Card's recharge time changes upon use, depending on the card Isaac was holding when he used it.

synergies.text: Butter!: As Blank Card is dropped upon usage, the recharge time for it is reset to 4, allowing to use more expensive cards much more frequently.
synergies.raw: {{t|Butter!}}: As Blank Card is dropped upon usage, the recharge time for it is reset to 4, allowing to use more expensive cards much more frequently.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Uses the card twice. For example, if used with the Two of Hearts/Diamonds/etc. cards it will quadruple whatever amount Isaac has.
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Uses the card twice. For example, if used with the Two of Hearts/Diamonds/etc. cards it will quadruple whatever amount Isaac has.

synergies.text: Tarot Cloth: Invokes the extra effect when used.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: Invokes the extra effect when used.

children.text: Only certain cards gain the Tarot Cloth effect with Blank Card.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Only certain cards gain the Tarot Cloth effect with Blank Card.

children.text: Car Battery + Tarot Cloth: The effect of the active card is quadrupled.
children.raw: '''Car Battery''' + '''Tarot Cloth''': The effect of the active card is quadrupled.

children.text: Only certain Tarot Cloth effects will be doubled again.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Only certain Tarot Cloth effects will be doubled again.

synergies.text: 2 of Diamonds + Restock or in Greed mode:
synergies.raw: {{p|2 of Diamonds|a}} + {{i|Restock|n}} or in [[Greed mode]]:

children.text: This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as Restock now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it. Having 12 coins will very slowly allow Isaac to obtain 99 coins, however.
children.raw: This cannot be repeated infinitely outside of Greed Mode, as '''Restock''' now increases the price of a shop slot each time something is purchased from it. Having 12 coins will very slowly allow Isaac to obtain 99 coins, however.

children.text: Deep Pockets allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained.
children.raw: {{i|Deep Pockets}} allows this to once again be repeated infinitely, as the price will cap at 99 coins, while up to 999 coins can be obtained.

synergies.text: ? Card: Teleports Isaac to the room. This will consume both the Blank Card and the ? Card.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card}}: Teleports Isaac to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room. This will consume both the Blank Card and the ? Card.

children.text: An exception is when they are used on Chest, Dark Room, The Void, Ultra Greed, Mausoleum/Gehenna II leading to Ascent, Corpse II, or Home floors. Using them here consumes both the Blank Card and the ? Card, spawning an I AM ERROR Shopkeeper.
children.raw: An exception is when they are used on {{s|Chest}}, {{s|Dark Room}}, {{s|The Void}}, {{E|Ultra Greed|dlc=x}}, {{S|Mausoleum}}/{{S|Gehenna}} II leading to [[Ascent]], {{s|Corpse}} II, or {{s|Home}} floors. Using them here consumes both the Blank Card and the ? Card, spawning an I AM ERROR {{E|Shopkeeper}}.

interactions.text: Little Baggy: All cards are replaced by pills, rendering Blank Card useless unless Isaac also has Starter Deck.
interactions.raw: {{i|Little Baggy}}: All cards are replaced by pills, rendering Blank Card useless unless Isaac also has {{i|Starter Deck}}.

interactions.text: Wild Card: Does nothing if used through Blank Card. Wild Card can, however, copy the last card used through Blank Card.
interactions.raw: {{p|Wild Card}}: Does nothing if used through Blank Card. Wild Card can, however, copy the last card used through Blank Card.

name: Book of Secrets
description: Gives the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor. If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead. Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with in the room.

effects.text: Randomly grants the effect of Treasure Map, The Compass, or Blue Map for the duration of the current floor.
effects.raw: Randomly grants the effect of {{i|Treasure Map}}, {{i|The Compass}}, or {{i|Blue Map}} for the duration of the current [[floor]].

children.text: If all effects are active, X-Ray Vision is provided for the floor instead.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} If all effects are active,  {{i|X-Ray Vision}} is provided for the floor instead.

effects.text: Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.
effects.raw: Repeated activations will continue to add the other items' effects.

children.text: Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Book of Secrets cannot give mapping effects that Isaac already has (whether from a previous activation or through possessing the equivalent item). After all effects have been given, further activations do nothing.

effects.text: Highlights any Tinted Rocks and rocks with in the room.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Highlights any [[Tinted Rock]]s and rocks with {{R|Crawl Space}} in the room.

effects.text: Counts towards the Bookworm transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}

synergies.text: Car Battery:
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}:

children.text: Gives 2 different mapping effects and extends the duration of the glow effect applied onto special rocks.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Gives 2 different mapping effects and extends the duration of the glow effect applied onto special rocks.

synergies.text: The Mind: Immediately gives the X-Ray Vision effect for the floor upon use.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Mind|r}}: Immediately gives the {{i|X-Ray Vision}} effect for the floor upon use.

name: Box of Spiders
description: Spawns 1-4 / 4-8 Blue Spiders where Isaac is standing.

effects.text: Spawns 4-8 Blue Spiders.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Spawns 4-8 [[Blue Spider]]s.

name: Dead Eye
description: Isaac's damage increases each time an enemy is hit. Damage is reset upon missing a shot.

effects.text: Isaac's damage increases for each successive tear hit on enemies.
effects.raw: Isaac's [[damage]] increases for each successive tear hit on enemies.

children.raw: The multiplier increases by 0.25x for each hit, going up to a maximum of 2x after 4 successive hits.

children.text: If a tear misses and hits nothing (wall/floor), there is a chance for the multiplier to be reset back to 1.
children.raw: If a tear misses and hits nothing (wall/floor), there is a chance for the multiplier to be reset back to 1.

children.text: The chance is 20% for the first miss, 33% for the second miss, and 50% for the third miss and beyond.
children.raw: The chance is 20% for the first miss, 33% for the second miss, and 50% for the third miss and beyond.

name: Restock
description: Causes s to instantly restock their items when they are bought. Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

effects.text: Upon purchasing an item from the , a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.
effects.raw: Upon purchasing an item from the {{R|Shop}}, a new purchasable item is added to the store's inventory.

children.text: Collectibles created correspond to the shop's item pool.
children.raw: [[Collectible]]s created correspond to the [[Shop (Item Pool)|shop's item pool]].

effects.text: Outside of Greed Mode, the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Outside of [[Greed Mode]], the restocked item's cost is increased after each purchase.

children.text: For items, the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.
children.raw: For [[items]], the price increase is 2 coins times the number of purchases. For example, an item starting at 15 cents would next be +2 to 17, then +4 to 21, +6 to 27, etc. The cost follows the formula 15+n(n+1) with n being the number of times restock has triggered.

children.text: For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2
children.raw: For everything else, the price increase is 1 coin times the number of purchases. For example, a heart starting at 3 cents would be +1 to 4, +2 to 6, +3 to 9 etc. This follows the formula (original price)+(n(n+1))/2

children.text: The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through Steam Sale: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.
children.raw: The increase is not affected by discounts occurring naturally or through {{i|Steam Sale}}: costs will increase at the same rate, though the base price is still discounted. Once the item's cost goes over what it would naturally be, the price is no longer highlighted red.

children.text: The maximum price is 99 cents.
children.raw: The maximum price is 99 cents.

effects.text: If the Friendly Ball does not capture an enemy, it will simply disappear after a couple seconds being on the ground. The next throw will work the same.
effects.raw: If the Friendly Ball does not capture an enemy, it will simply disappear after a couple seconds being on the ground. The next throw will work the same.

synergies.text: The Battery: Walking over a captured enemy will double charge the ball. This allows Isaac the ability to release a captured enemy and catch a new one in the same room double charging the ball to release and capture more enemies. Attempting to catch a new enemy while the old one is in the process of spawning will result in the ball phasing through the new enemy and wasting the charge.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Battery|r}}: Walking over a captured enemy will double charge the ball. This allows Isaac the ability to release a captured enemy and catch a new one in the same room double charging the ball to release and capture more enemies. Attempting to catch a new enemy while the old one is in the process of spawning will result in the ball phasing through the new enemy and wasting the charge.

synergies.text: Blood Puppy: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.

synergies.text: {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a wisp, all on the middle ring, whenever a friendly enemy dies. Depending on the enemy that dies, the wisp may have a different effect:
synergies.raw: {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Spawns a wisp, all on the middle ring, whenever a [[friendly]] enemy dies. Depending on the enemy that dies, the wisp may have a different effect:

children.text: Normal: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they wouldn't spawn any of the other variants listed below.
children.raw: Normal: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they wouldn't spawn any of the other variants listed below.

children.text: Homing: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they were psychic or had homing shots in some way. Wisps' tears are homing.
children.raw: Homing: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they were psychic or had homing shots in some way. Wisps' tears are [[homing]].

children.text: Explosive: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they created explosions in some way. Wisps' tears have a 33% chance to explode. Explosive tears deal no extra damage.
children.raw: Explosive: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they created explosions in some way. Wisps' tears have a 33% chance to explode. Explosive tears deal no extra damage.

children.text: Brimstone: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they fired lasers in some way. Wisps fire Brimstone lasers. The laser does not need to be charged to be fired, and can tick up to 8 times for a total of 20 damage.}}
children.raw: Brimstone: Enemies captured by Friendly Ball spawn this wisp when they die if they fired lasers in some way. Wisps fire {{I|Brimstone}} lasers. The laser does not need to be charged to be fired, and can tick up to 8 times for a total of 20 damage.}}

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
interactions.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

interactions.text: Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.
interactions.raw: {{i|Broken Modem}}: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Eraser: If the ball captures an enemy and then another enemy of the same type is erased the next use of Friendly Ball will release a puff of pink smoke wasting the effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eraser}}: If the ball captures an enemy and then another enemy of the same type is erased the next use of Friendly Ball will release a puff of pink smoke wasting the effect.

interactions.text: Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.
interactions.raw: {{I|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{I|Purgatory}} / {{i|Vade Retro}}: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.

interactions.text: Hive Mind: No effect on captured flies or spiders.
interactions.raw: {{i|Hive Mind}}: No effect on captured flies or spiders.

interactions.text: Skatole or Bursting Sack: Friendly Fly/Spider enemies will be unable to shoot, slowed down, and/or reverted to a weaker form, hindering this item's effectiveness on those enemies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Skatole}} or {{i|Bursting Sack}}: Friendly Fly/Spider enemies will be unable to shoot, slowed down, and/or reverted to a weaker form, hindering this item's effectiveness on those enemies.

interactions.text: Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or higher.
interactions.raw: {{t|Tick}}: [[Friendly]] enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or higher.

interactions.text: Void: Walking over a thrown Friendly Ball that captured an enemy will not recharge Void.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void|r}}: Walking over a thrown Friendly Ball that captured an enemy will not recharge Void.

interactions.text: Glowing Hourglass: Will duplicate friendly enemies if used in the same room multiple times.
interactions.raw: {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: Will duplicate friendly enemies if used in the same room multiple times.

name: Tear Detonator
description: Splits all of Isaac's tears that are currently in the air into 6 tears that fire in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.

effects.text: Once activated, all tears in the air split into 6 more tears in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.
effects.raw: Once activated, all tears in the air split into 6 more tears in all directions, which retain their damage and shot speed.

children.text: Luck-based effects from items such as Tough Love or Holy Light are applied individually to each tear.
children.raw: Luck-based effects from items such as {{i|Tough Love}} or {{i|Holy Light}} are applied individually to each tear.

synergies.text: Akeldama: Will bust tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Akeldama}}: Will bust tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Tears that are split by the prism can be split again by Tear Detonator.
synergies.raw: {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Tears that are split by the prism can be split again by Tear Detonator.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: All tears currently floating in the air will be multiplied, resulting in a massive amount of tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: All tears currently floating in the air will be multiplied, resulting in a massive amount of tears.

synergies.text: Bethany/Tainted Bethany: Bethany can use Tear Detonator multiple times in rapid succession at the cost of one Soul/Blood Charge per use, allowing for a huge area of effect that wipes out most rooms.
synergies.raw: {{C|Bethany}}/{{C|Tainted Bethany}}: Bethany can use Tear Detonator multiple times in rapid succession at the cost of one Soul/Blood Charge per use, allowing for a huge area of effect that wipes out most rooms.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Splits tears twice, creating 36 tears for every tear currently airborne.
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Splits tears twice, creating 36 tears for every tear currently airborne.

children.text: The Battery: Allows for multiple uses, creating tear counts in the hundreds.
children.raw: {{i|The Battery}}: Allows for multiple uses, creating tear counts in the hundreds.

synergies.text: Circle of Protection / Metal Plate: Reflected tears can be split.
synergies.raw: {{i|Circle of Protection}} / {{i|Metal Plate}}: Reflected tears can be split.

synergies.text: Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body/The Parasite: Tears that are split can split again into burst tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: Tears that are split can split again into burst tears.

synergies.text: Eye of the Occult: Split tears form a circle around the original tear's position, and can be controlled as normal.
synergies.raw: {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: Split tears form a circle around the original tear's position, and can be controlled as normal.

synergies.text: Haemolacria: Splits tears into 6 Haemolacria tears that burst into split tears. If split tears are burst, all of them will split into 6 Haemolacria tears creating an enormous amount of tears when the main tear splits again.
synergies.raw: {{i|Haemolacria}}: Splits tears into 6 Haemolacria tears that burst into split tears. If split tears are burst, all of them will split into 6 Haemolacria tears creating an enormous amount of tears when the main tear splits again.

synergies.text: Hushy: All 8 projectiles shot by Hushy will split and become Isaac's tears, gaining their effects.
synergies.raw: {{i|Hushy|r+}}: All 8 projectiles shot by Hushy will split and become Isaac's tears, gaining their effects.

synergies.text: Ipecac: All tears will split into 6 explosive tears, making it very powerful (but also dangerous unless Isaac has Host Hat or Pyromaniac).
synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: All tears will split into 6 explosive tears, making it very powerful (but also dangerous unless Isaac has {{i|Host Hat|n}} or {{i|Pyromaniac}}).

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: Similar to the Haemolacria synergy, if the main tear splits, 6 tears will spawn that can be fed. However, if burst tears are split, all burst tears will split into 6 tears resulting in an enormous amount of tears that are likely to feed each other.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Similar to the Haemolacria synergy, if the main tear splits, 6 tears will spawn that can be fed. However, if burst tears are split, all burst tears will split into 6 tears resulting in an enormous amount of tears that are likely to feed each other.

synergies.text: Lead Pencil: Each of the tears explodes into 6 smaller tears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lead Pencil}}: Each of the tears explodes into 6 smaller tears.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: The tear explodes into six smaller tears, then reappears next to the player.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear explodes into six smaller tears, then reappears next to the player.

synergies.text: My Reflection: The shrapnel tears will curve back to the location of the original detonated tear.
synergies.raw: {{i|My Reflection}}: The shrapnel tears will curve back to the location of the original detonated tear.

synergies.text: Sad Bombs: Bomb tears are multiplied.
synergies.raw: {{i|Sad Bombs}}: Bomb tears are multiplied.

synergies.text: Saturnus: Orbiting tears can be split, including enemy tears caught in the orbit.
synergies.raw: {{i|Saturnus}}: Orbiting tears can be split, including enemy tears caught in the orbit.

synergies.text: Shooting familiars: Shooting familiars' tears explode into Isaac's tears, with his actual damage and effects.
synergies.raw: [[Shooting familiar]]s: Shooting familiars' tears explode into Isaac's tears, with his actual damage and effects.

synergies.text: Technology Zero: Tears generated by Tear Detonator can be connected with electric charges.
synergies.raw: {{I|Technology Zero}}: Tears generated by Tear Detonator can be connected with electric charges.

children.text: Technology Zero + Mucormycosis / Sinus Infection: Spores/Boogers generated by Tear Detonator can be connected with electric charges.
children.raw: '''Technology Zero''' + {{I|Mucormycosis}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: Spores/Boogers generated by Tear Detonator can be connected with electric charges.

synergies.text: Tiny Planet: Tears split, and then orbit around where the tear was originally from, three spinning clockwise, three counterclockwise.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tears split, and then orbit around where the tear was originally from, three spinning clockwise, three counterclockwise.

synergies.text: Trisagion: Tears split into six beams.
synergies.raw: {{i|Trisagion}}: Tears split into six beams.

synergies.text: Uranus: Tears shot out from frozen enemies when they are destroyed can be split.
synergies.raw: {{i|Uranus}}: Tears shot out from frozen enemies when they are destroyed can be split.

synergies.text: Urn of Souls: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.
synergies.raw: {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.

interactions.text: C Section: Fetuses split into normal tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|C Section}}: Fetuses split into normal tears.

interactions.text: Split tears always deal Isaac's damage.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Split tears always deal Isaac's damage.

interactions.text: Explosivo: Tears that are stuck to enemies will not deal explosion damage; tears released by it may be sticky tears that immediately stick back onto the enemy.
interactions.raw: {{i|Explosivo}}: Tears that are stuck to enemies will not deal explosion damage; tears released by it may be sticky tears that immediately stick back onto the enemy.

name: Lil Gurdy
description: A Gurdy Jr. familiar that charges up while Isaac is firing, bouncing around the room when released and dealing contact damage based on its speed.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that can be launched in the direction that Isaac is firing after a short charge-up period.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that can be launched in the direction that Isaac is firing after a short charge-up period.

children.text: No longer deals damage per tick, instead deals a fix amount of damage depending on charge level, at lowest being ~5 and at max being ~20.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} No longer deals damage per tick, instead deals a fix amount of damage depending on charge level, at lowest being ~5 and at max being ~20.

effects.text: It bounces off walls multiple times, much like Gurdy Jr.
effects.raw: It bounces off walls multiple times, much like {{E|Gurdy Jr.}}

children.text: It will also bounce off enemies.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} It will also bounce off enemies.

name: Bumbo
description: Spawns a beggar familiar which picks up any nearby coins, leveling up after collecting several coins. At level 2, Bumbo gains a body. At level 3, it begins to fire tears. At level 4, Bumbo follows enemies and gains contact damage.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby coins. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected. :: 30px|link= Level 1 (0-5 coins): Bumbo just collects coins to level up. :: 30px|link= Level 2 (6-11 coins): Bumbo occasionally drops a pickup, trinket, chest or pedestal item after a room clear. :: 30px|link= Level 3 (12-23 coins): Bumbo now fires tears that deal 3.5 damage in the same direction Isaac does. Bumbo's tears have a chance to drop a coin if they hit an enemy. :: 30px|link= Level 4 (24+ coins): Bumbo no longer fires tears and instead chases enemies slowly and deals contact damage (2.5 per tick, or 10.7 per second). Bumbo will occasionally drop Bombs while chasing enemies or coins.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] which follows Isaac and picks up any nearby [[coin]]s. Bumbo changes level based on the amount of coins it's collected. :: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 1.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 1 (0-5 coins):''' Bumbo just collects coins to level up. :: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 2.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 2 (6-11 coins):''' Bumbo occasionally drops a [[pickup]], [[trinket]], [[chest]] or pedestal item after a room clear. :: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 3.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 3 (12-23 coins):''' Bumbo now fires tears that deal 3.5 damage in the same direction Isaac does. Bumbo's tears have a chance to drop a coin if they hit an enemy. :: [[file:Collectible Bumbo level 4.png|30px|link=]] '''Level 4 (24+ coins):''' Bumbo no longer fires tears and instead chases enemies slowly and deals contact damage (2.5 per tick, or {{dlc|nr}}37.5 per second/{{dlc|r}}10.7 per second). Bumbo will occasionally drop {{e|Bomb}}s while chasing enemies or coins.

effects.text: After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to Bum Friend.
effects.raw: After reaching level 4, Bumbo will continue to collect coins, and can drop a pickup, trinket, or chest for each coin it collects, similar to {{i|Bum Friend}}.

children.text: Bumbo can also drop items from the current room's Item Pool.
children.raw: Bumbo can also drop items from the current room's [[Item Pool]].

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles both the contact and shot damage, when applicable.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles both the contact and shot damage, when applicable.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.
interactions.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: Will spawn a level 1 Bumbo regardless of the original Bumbo's current level.

interactions.text: Keeper: Not recommended, as the coins Bumbo collects could have been used to heal Keeper.
interactions.raw: {{C|Keeper}}: Not recommended, as the coins Bumbo collects could have been used to heal Keeper.

interactions.text: Tainted Keeper: Due to the large influx of coins spawned, it's technically possible to sustain Bumbo while also maintaining a good level of wealth and health.
interactions.raw: {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Due to the large influx of coins spawned, it's technically possible to sustain Bumbo while also maintaining a good level of wealth and health.

name: D12
description: Re-rolls all Rocks and Metal Blocks in the current room into other random obstacles. Re-rolls most types of obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.

effects.text: Re-rolls obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.
effects.raw: Re-rolls obstacles in the current room into other random obstacles.

effects.text: Obstacles can reroll into: Rocks, Tinted rocks, Cobwebs, Chapter-specific obstacles (Urns, Mushrooms, Skulls, and Polyps), Metal Blocks, Trap doors, s, TNT, White Poop, Fool's Gold Rocks, Reward Plates and Killswitches.
effects.raw: Obstacles can reroll into: [[Rock]]s, [[Tinted rock]]s, [[Cobweb]]s, Chapter-specific obstacles ([[Urn]]s, [[Mushroom]]s, [[Skull]]s, and [[Polyp]]s), [[Metal Block]]s, Trap doors, {{r|Crawl Space}}s, {{E|TNT}}, {{E|White Poop}},  [[Fool's Gold]] Rocks, {{E|Reward Plate}}s and {{E|Killswitch}}es.

effects.text: Rerolled obstacles will only reroll into another one in this group: Poops, Retractable Spikes, Normal and Red Fire Places, both types of TNT, and Cobwebs.
effects.raw: Rerolled obstacles will only reroll into another one in this group: {{e|Poop}}s, [[Retractable Spikes]], Normal and Red {{e|Fire Place}}s, both types of {{E|TNT}}, and [[Cobweb]]s.

children.text: Rerolled obstacles can also reroll into Reward Plates and Killswitches, but will not reroll any further. They can not roll into Trap doors or s.
children.raw: Rerolled obstacles can also reroll into {{E|Reward Plate}}s and {{E|Killswitch}}es, but will not reroll any further. They can not roll into Trap doors or {{r|Crawl Space}}s.

synergies.text: Lucky Rock, Meconium, Petrified Poop, and Stud Finder can provide extra value in conjunction with their associated obstacles.
synergies.raw: {{t|Lucky Rock}}, {{t|Meconium}}, {{t|Petrified Poop}}, and {{t|Stud Finder}} can provide extra value in conjunction with their associated obstacles.

synergies.text: Leo / Mega Mush / Notched Axe / Pyro / Stompy / Sulfuric Acid / Terra / Thunder Thighs can provide Isaac a way to destroy the re-rolled obstacles.
synergies.raw: {{i|Leo}} / {{i|Mega Mush}} / {{i|Notched Axe}} / {{i|Pyro}} / {{tf|Stompy}} / {{i|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{i|Terra}} / {{i|Thunder Thighs}} can provide Isaac a way to destroy the re-rolled obstacles.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Re-rolls have a higher chance of entering the looping pool and creating obstacles that can't reroll (Reward Plates, Killswitches, Trap doors and s)
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{i|Car Battery}}: Re-rolls have a higher chance of entering the looping pool and creating obstacles that can't reroll ({{E|Reward Plate}}s, {{E|Killswitch}}es, Trap doors and {{r|Crawl Space}}s)

synergies.text: XVI - The Tower? / A Card Against Humanity: Created obstacles can be rerolled into more useful objects such as Rainbow Poop or Golden Poop. Rocks created from XVI - The Tower? will have a larger pool to pick from.
synergies.raw: {{p|XVI - The Tower?}} / {{p|A Card Against Humanity}}: Created obstacles can be rerolled into more useful objects such as {{E|Rainbow Poop}} or {{E|Golden Poop}}. Rocks created from {{p|XVI - The Tower?}} will have a larger pool to pick from.

name: Censer
description: Spawns a familiar which creates a circular aura that slows down enemies and enemy shots inside.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar projecting a circular aura that slows enemies and enemy shots within its radius and for a short period once they exit.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] projecting a circular aura that [[slow]]s enemies and enemy shots within its radius and for a short period once they exit.

synergies.text: 2Spooky / Venus: The slowing aura mitigates the delay between fast enemies that charge Isaac and the status effect, making it much harder for Isaac to take contact damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|2Spooky}} / {{i|Venus}}: The slowing aura mitigates the delay between fast enemies that charge Isaac and the [[status effect]], making it much harder for Isaac to take contact damage.

synergies.text: Bot Fly / Psy Fly: The slowing aura allows these items to deal with the incoming projectiles more reliably.
synergies.raw: {{i|Bot Fly}} / {{i|Psy Fly}}: The slowing aura allows these items to deal with the incoming projectiles more reliably.

synergies.text: The Soul: The slowing aura allows incoming enemies and shots to be more reliably deflected.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Soul}}: The slowing aura allows incoming enemies and shots to be more reliably deflected.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The aura does not slow things from further away despite increased visual size.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: The aura does not slow things from further away despite increased visual size.

interactions.text: Montezuma's Revenge: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.
interactions.raw: {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}}: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.

name: Key Bum
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and collects Keys for himself, giving random Chests in return.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects Keys, dropping random Chests in return.
effects.raw: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and collects {{e|Key}}s, dropping random {{E|Chest}}s in return.

children.text: Spawns almost exclusively Chests, Red Chests, and Locked Chests, with a very slim chance to spawn another type of chest or a Grab Bag.
children.raw: Spawns almost exclusively {{e|Chest}}s, {{e|Red Chest}}s, and {{e|Locked Chest}}s, with a very slim chance to spawn another type of chest or a {{e|Grab Bag}}.

effects.text: Counts towards the Super Bum transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Super Bum}}

synergies.text: BFFS!: Familiar is bigger and drops chests more often.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Familiar is bigger and drops chests more often.

synergies.text: Flat Penny: Chests frequently contain pennies, which have a chance of spawning more keys for Key Bum to pick up, possibly lead to a loop.
synergies.raw: {{T|Flat Penny}}: Chests frequently contain pennies, which have a chance of spawning more keys for Key Bum to pick up, possibly lead to a loop.

synergies.text: King Baby / RC Remote: No effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|King Baby}} / {{t|RC Remote}}: No effect.

synergies.text: Gilded Key / The Left Hand: Works as expected.
synergies.raw: {{T|Gilded Key}} / {{T|The Left Hand}}: Works as expected.

synergies.text: Guppy's Eye: Allows Isaac to choose which Locked Chests are worth opening and which to pass, thus saving keys. Great for min-maxing.
synergies.raw: {{I|Guppy's Eye}}: Allows Isaac to choose which Locked Chests are worth opening and which to pass, thus saving keys. Great for min-maxing.

name: Rune Bag
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random rune after clearing enough rooms.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that drops a random rune after clearing enough rooms.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops a random [[Cards and Runes|rune]] after clearing enough rooms.

children.text: Runes are dropped alternating every 7 or 8 rooms.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Runes are dropped alternating every 7 or 8 rooms.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The drop rate is improved to every 4-5 rooms.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: The drop rate is improved to every 4-5 rooms.

children.text: The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} The drop rate is improved to every 6 rooms.

name: Seraphim
description: Spawns an angel familiar who follows Isaac and fires homing tears which deal 10 damage and have 75% shot speed.

effects.text: Spawns an angel familiar who follows Isaac and fires homing tears similar to Sacred Heart, which deal 10 damage at 75% shot speed.
effects.raw: Spawns an angel [[familiar]] who follows Isaac and fires [[Tear Effects#Effects|homing tears]] similar to {{i|Sacred Heart}}, which deal 10 damage at 75% shot speed.

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Conjoined|dlc=r}}

effects.text: Counts towards the Seraphim transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Seraphim|dlc=r+}}

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar: This familiar will also reward 2 Black Hearts when sacrificed.
synergies.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: This familiar will also reward 2 {{e|Black Heart}}s when sacrificed.

name: Betrayal
description: Charms all enemies in the room when Isaac takes damage. Enemies are able to damage each other. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.

effects.text: It won't trigger if there are less than 2 enemies in the room.
effects.raw: {{dlc|a+}} It won't trigger if there are less than 2 enemies in the room.

effects.text: Enemies are able to damage each other with projectiles. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Enemies are able to damage each other with projectiles. If an enemy is damaged by another enemy, they will attack that enemy instead of Isaac.

name: Zodiac
description: Gives Isaac a random zodiac item effect that changes every floor.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a random Zodiac item effect that changes each floor.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a random [[Signs of the Zodiac|Zodiac item]] effect that changes each floor.

name: Serpent's Kiss
description: Tears have a chance to apply a poison effect to enemies. Isaac poisons enemies on contact. Poisoned enemies have a chance to drop a Black Heart when killed.

effects.text: Grants a 15% chance to fire poison tears, each tick dealing damage equal to Isaac's.
effects.raw: Grants a 15% chance to fire [[poison|poison tears]], each tick dealing damage equal to Isaac's.

children.text: Poison from the shots will tick 2 times.
children.raw: Poison from the shots will tick 2 times.

effects.text: Inflicts poison on enemies who make contact with Isaac.
effects.raw: Inflicts [[poison]] on enemies who make contact with Isaac.

children.text: Contact poison will tick 6 times.
children.raw: Contact poison will tick 6 times.

effects.text: Enemies that make contact with Isaac have a 20% chance to drop a Black Heart. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Enemies that make contact with Isaac have a 20% chance to drop a {{e|Black Heart}}. Enemies can still drop black hearts after the poison has worn off.

synergies.text: Bombs no longer grant black hearts but poison bombs leave a poison cloud similar to Bob's Curse.
synergies.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Bombs no longer grant black hearts but poison bombs leave a poison cloud similar to {{i|Bob's Curse}}.

synergies.text: Gnawed Leaf: Standing still allows for safe kills and possibly spawn infinite black hearts.

name: Tech X
description: Tears are replaced with laser rings that pierce through enemies and deal damage to enemies within them. Can be charged to increase the effectiveness of the ring.

effects.raw: Isaac's tears are replaced with ring-shaped lasers.

children.text: Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.
children.raw: Shots can be charged to increase the size of the rings.

children.text: The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.
children.raw: The rings deal damage 15 times per second. Only the outer circumference of the rings will deal damage.

children.text: Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.
children.raw: Rings pass through obstacles and enemies. Rings have infinite range and will travel until they hit a wall.

children.text: Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.
children.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Damage dealt is based on the amount charged, starting at around 25% Isaac's damage and approaches 100% at maximum charge.

children.text: \text{Charge Time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) \approx \frac{3}{\text{Fire Rate}}
children.raw: <math>\text{Charge Time} = \frac{1}{30}(Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) \approx \frac{3}{\text{Fire Rate}}</math>

children.text: \text{Max Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) - 10)
children.raw: <math>\text{Max Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1) - 10)</math>

children.text: \text{Min Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay}) + 1) - 10)
children.raw: <math>\text{Min Charge Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} \times (Roundup(\text{Tear Delay}) + 1) - 10)</math>

children.raw: At 30.00 fire rate or above (0 tear delay or lower), charging is no longer needed and fires 30 rings per second. Higher fire rate results in higher laser damage.

children.text: \text{Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} - 10)
children.raw: <math>\text{Damage per Tick} = \text{Damage} \times \frac{5}{4}(\text{Fire Rate} - 10)</math>
