children.raw: In Challenge 30: The Guardian, the spear does one times Isaac's [[damage]] per 2 frames and damage range increased by 7/13.

children.text: Instantly inflicts the fear effect on any boss it comes into contact with. This is subject to the boss's resistance.

synergies.text: Proptosis: Triples the damage. Has no penalty with range.
synergies.raw: {{I|Proptosis|r}}: Triples the damage. Has no penalty with range.

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect on size or damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect on size or damage.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sacrificial Altar}}: No effect.

name: Explosivo
description: Isaac's tears have a chance to stick to enemies and explode.

effects.text: Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.
effects.raw: Isaac's tears have a 25% chance to stick to enemies and explode a few seconds afterward, dealing 60 damage plus Isaac's tear damage.

synergies.text: Brimstone/The Ludovico Technique/Mom's Knife/Tech X: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}}{{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|The Ludovico Technique}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.

synergies.text: Cricket's Body: The explosion results in split Explosivo shots being generated. The split tears explode when they hit an enemy or the ground.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cricket's Body}}: The explosion results in split Explosivo shots being generated. {{dlc|nr}} If the target survives, they're likely to immediately stick again. {{dlc|r}} The split tears explode when they hit an enemy or the ground.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus: Dr. Fetus bombs may occasionally turn into Sticky Bombs, but don't spawn spiders or slowing white creep.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Dr. Fetus bombs may occasionally turn into {{i|Sticky Bombs}}, but don't spawn spiders or slowing white creep.

synergies.text: Fire Mind: Explosivo tears leave a flame behind after exploding.
synergies.raw: {{i|Fire Mind}}: Explosivo tears leave a flame behind after exploding.

synergies.text: Godhead: The tear keeps its damaging aura while attached to the enemy, the aura grows as the tear does until it explodes. The aura can damage only enemies other than the one the tear is stuck to, however.
synergies.raw: {{i|Godhead}}: The tear keeps its damaging aura while attached to the enemy, the aura grows as the tear does until it explodes. The aura can damage only enemies other than the one the tear is stuck to, however.

synergies.text: Haemolacria: Main tears and burst tears can have the Explosivo effect. If a main tear has the Explosivo effect, it will burst with its explosion, the burst tears dealing damage based off the explosion damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Haemolacria}}: Main tears and burst tears can have the Explosivo effect. If a main tear has the Explosivo effect, it will burst with its explosion, the burst tears dealing damage based off the explosion damage.

synergies.text: Ipecac: Sticky shots will explode even if they fall to the floor after the initial target dies.
synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Sticky shots will explode even if they fall to the floor after the initial target dies.

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: Explosivo tears can be fed and will burst into Explosivo tears; however, if normal tears are fed first, Explosivo fed to the normal tears will not give the tear the Explosivo effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Explosivo tears can be fed and will burst into Explosivo tears; however, if normal tears are fed first, Explosivo fed to the normal tears will not give the tear the Explosivo effect.

synergies.text: Lost Contact: Tears that stick to enemies can still block/be destroyed by enemy shots.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lost Contact}}: Tears that stick to enemies can still block/be destroyed by enemy shots.

children.text: Shielded Explosivo tears are no longer destroyed by shots while they're stuck to enemies. Up to the point that they explode, they block all enemy shots that come into contact with them, effectively cutting off an entire direction of attack (much like Dry/Fart Baby, but with a larger area of blockage and without forcing the player to waste time positioning). As such, this is an extremely powerful synergy between otherwise adequate items.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Shielded Explosivo tears are no longer destroyed by shots while they're stuck to enemies. Up to the point that they explode, they block all enemy shots that come into contact with them, effectively cutting off an entire direction of attack (much like Dry/Fart Baby, but with a larger area of blockage and without forcing the player to waste time positioning). As such, this is an extremely powerful synergy between otherwise adequate items.

synergies.text: Mr. Mega: Increases the damage bonus of Explosivo's explosions to 110.
synergies.raw: {{i|Mr. Mega}}: Increases the damage bonus of Explosivo's explosions to 110.

synergies.text: Mysterious Liquid: Leaves a pool of green creep on the floor.
synergies.raw: {{i|Mysterious Liquid}}: Leaves a pool of green creep on the floor.

synergies.text: Parasitoid: Egg sacs that trigger the explosion will leave a larger pool of slowing creep.
synergies.raw: {{I|Parasitoid}}: Egg sacs that trigger the explosion will leave a larger pool of slowing creep.

synergies.text: Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Explosivo tears can also be booger tears which damage the enemy over time while stuck to them before exploding.
synergies.raw: {{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{i|Sinus Infection}}: Explosivo tears can also be booger tears which damage the enemy over time while stuck to them before exploding.

synergies.text: Soy Milk: The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by Soy Milk's penalty, combining efficiently with the high fire rate.
synergies.raw: {{i|Soy Milk}}: The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by Soy Milk's penalty, combining efficiently with the high fire rate.

synergies.text: Spirit Sword: The fired projectile can take on Explosivo's effects. The sword swing can leave behind Explosivo tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Spirit Sword}}: The fired projectile can take on Explosivo's effects. The sword swing can leave behind Explosivo tears.

synergies.text: Strange Attractor: When a tear sticks to an enemy, nearby enemies will be quickly pulled in the direction of the tear. The constant pull may however make enemy movement unpredictable.
synergies.raw: {{i|Strange Attractor}}: When a tear sticks to an enemy, nearby enemies will be quickly pulled in the direction of the tear. The constant pull may however make enemy movement unpredictable.

synergies.text: Tech.5: The laser also has a chance to apply explosive tears on enemies.
synergies.raw: {{Dlc|r}}{{I|Tech.5}}: The laser also has a chance to apply explosive tears on enemies.

synergies.text: Technology: Regular explosive tears may stick to enemies hit by the laser.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}}{{i|Technology}}: Regular explosive tears may stick to enemies hit by the laser.

synergies.text: Technology 2: The laser has a chance to apply an explosive tear every tick. The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by the laser's penalty, combining efficiently with the high tick rate.
synergies.raw: {{Dlc|r}}{{I|Technology 2}}: The laser has a chance to apply an explosive tear every tick. The 60 point explosion damage bonus is not affected by the laser's penalty, combining efficiently with the high tick rate.

synergies.text: Technology Zero: Stuck tears will still generate arcs of electricity. Multiple tears stuck to a single enemy can cause very rapid damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Technology Zero}}: Stuck tears will still generate arcs of electricity. Multiple tears stuck to a single enemy can cause very rapid damage.

synergies.text: Trisagion: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Trisagion|r}}: Every tick of damage Isaac’s tears deal have a chance to attach a separate Explosivo tear on a hit enemy.

interactions.text: All other bomb modifiers: No bomb modifier outside Mr. Mega and Short Fuse has an effect on Explosivo tears.
interactions.raw: [[:Category:Bomb items|All other bomb modifiers]]: No bomb modifier outside {{I|Mr. Mega}} and {{T|Short Fuse}} has an effect on Explosivo tears.

interactions.text: Bob's Rotten Head: Bob's Rotten Head has a chance to stick onto enemies. The explosion damage bonus increases to 110.
interactions.raw: {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Bob's Rotten Head has a chance to stick onto enemies. The explosion damage bonus increases to 110.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Overrides Explosivo.
interactions.raw: {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Overrides Explosivo.

interactions.text: Holy Light: Some Explosivo tears have the Holy Light effect applied to them. These tears spawn a beam of light after a few seconds of sticking to an enemy instead of exploding.
interactions.raw: {{Dlc|r}}{{I|Holy Light}}: Some Explosivo tears have the Holy Light effect applied to them. These tears spawn a beam of light after a few seconds of sticking to an enemy instead of exploding.

interactions.text: Immaculate Heart/Saturnus: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
interactions.raw: {{I|Immaculate Heart}}/{{I|Saturnus|n}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

name: Chaos
description: Drops 1-6 random pickups on the floor. Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.

effects.text: Drops 1-6 random pickups around Isaac.
effects.raw: Drops 1-6 random [[pickup]]s around Isaac.

effects.text: Causes items to be chosen from random item pools.
effects.raw: Causes items to be chosen from random [[item pool]]s.

children.text: Fixed item drops that ignore the current room's item pool will not be replaced. Examples include Cube of Meat after defeating one of The Harbingers as a floor boss, or The Small Rock after breaking a Tinted Rock.
children.raw: Fixed item drops that ignore the current room's item pool will not be replaced. Examples include {{i|Cube of Meat}} after defeating one of [[The Harbingers]] as a floor boss, or {{i|The Small Rock}} after breaking a [[Tinted Rock]].

name: Spider Mod
description: Displays Isaac's tear damage and enemy health bars. Spawns a familiar that wanders around and inflicts random status effects on enemies it touches. Can spawn a Lil' Battery (Micro Battery) / Blue spider upon clearing a room.

effects.text: Spawns a grey spider familiar that wanders around and allows Isaac to see tear damage and the health bars of all enemies.
effects.raw: Spawns a grey spider [[familiar]] that wanders around and allows Isaac to see tear damage and the health bars of all enemies.

children.text: The spider will inflict a random status effect on any enemies it comes into contact with.
children.raw: The spider will inflict a random [[Effects#Status Effects|status effect]] on any enemies it comes into contact with.

children.text: The spider has a 10% chance to spawn a Blue Spider (2/3 chance) or drop a Lil' Battery (Micro Battery) (1/3 chance) when a room is completed.
children.raw: The spider has a 10% chance to spawn a [[Blue Spider]] (2/3 chance) or drop a {{E|Lil' Battery}} ({{E|Micro Battery}}) (1/3 chance) when a [[Rooms|room]] is completed.

effects.text: Counts towards the Spider Baby transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}

synergies.text: BFFS!: Makes Spider Mod bigger and increases the chance to 12.5% for Spider Mod to spawn a battery or blue spider. No effect on status effect damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Makes Spider Mod bigger and increases the chance to 12.5% for Spider Mod to spawn a battery or blue spider. No effect on status effect damage.

synergies.text: Hive Mind: Makes Spider Mod bigger. No effect on status effect damage.
synergies.raw: {{I|Hive Mind}}: Makes Spider Mod bigger. No effect on status effect damage.

name: Farting Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots. If a shot hits Farting Baby, it has a chance to fart, which charms, poisons, or knocks back nearby enemies.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of farting. Farting has a cooldown of 210 frames. There are three possible fart effects:
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac around and blocks enemy projectiles. Upon blocking a shot, it has a 25% chance of farting. Farting has a cooldown of 210 frames. There are three possible fart effects:

children.text: Charms all nearby enemies.
children.raw: [[Charm]]s all nearby enemies.

children.text: Poisons all nearby enemies.
children.raw: [[Poison]]s all nearby enemies.

children.text: Knocks back nearby enemies and hostile tears.
children.raw: [[Knockback|Knocks back]] nearby enemies {{dlc|r}}and hostile tears.

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect on damage or blocking radius; only the visual size is changed.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect on damage or blocking radius; only the visual size is changed.

name: GB Bug
description: Spawns a familiar that bounces diagonally around the room, applying a random status effect to enemies it hits and has a chance to re-roll pickups it passes over. Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster or pickup it hits.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first monster, trinket, or pickup it hits. It respawns after clearing a room.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac. Double tapping the fire button launches it forward, causing it to reroll the first [[monster]], [[Trinkets|trinket]], or [[pickup]] it hits. It respawns after clearing a room.

children.text: If it cannot reroll an enemy (e.g. a boss), it will deal 8 damage instead.
children.raw: If it cannot reroll an enemy (e.g. a boss), it will deal 8 damage instead.

children.text: Items and opened chests cannot be rerolled.
children.raw: Items and opened chests cannot be rerolled.

children.text: Pickups have a 10% chance of becoming chests (see the algorithm).
children.raw: Pickups have a 10% chance of becoming chests (see [[#Algorithm|the algorithm]]).

children.text: If a chest is rerolled, it has a 28% chance of staying as some kind of a chest.
children.raw: If a chest is rerolled, it has a 28% chance of staying as some kind of a chest.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.
interactions.raw: {{I|Blood Puppy}}: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.

interactions.text: Guppy's Eye in Chest / Dark Room: Using the 28% chance to stay as a chest, allows you to reroll chests with undesired items into different items.
interactions.raw: {{I|Guppy's Eye}} in {{S|Chest}} / {{S|Dark Room}}: Using the 28% chance to stay as a chest, allows you to reroll chests with undesired items into different items.

interactions.raw: {{I|King Baby|r}}: GB Bug will only throw itself at nearby enemies automatically if a fire button is double tapped while King Baby's effect is active.

interactions.text: Marked: Does not launch itself automatically or at the crosshair while Isaac is firing.
interactions.raw: {{I|Marked|r}}: Does not launch itself automatically or at the crosshair while Isaac is firing.

interactions.text: The Twins: The familiar can be duplicated even if it hasn’t respawned; by constantly moving to new rooms, GB Bug can constantly respawn, allowing pickups to be rerolled indefinitely.
interactions.raw: {{T|The Twins}}: The familiar can be duplicated even if it hasn’t respawned; by constantly moving to new rooms, GB Bug can constantly respawn, allowing pickups to be rerolled indefinitely.

name: D8
description: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.

effects.text: Re-rolls Isaac's damage, tears, range, and speed.
effects.raw: Re-rolls Isaac's [[damage]], [[tears]], [[range]], and [[speed]].

children.text: Each stat is given a multiplier, ranging from 0.5x to 2.0x, which applies after all other adjustments.
children.raw: Each stat is given a multiplier, ranging from 0.5x to 2.0x, which applies after all other adjustments.

synergies.text: Libra: Libra's balancing applies after the D8 multipliers, making it possible to aim for a high multiplier in the most efficient stats for a large across-the-board boost.
synergies.raw: {{i|Libra}}: Libra's balancing applies after the D8 multipliers, making it possible to aim for a high multiplier in the most efficient stats for a large across-the-board boost.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Allows affected stats to reach high multipliers, potentially doubling them if used enough.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Allows affected stats to reach high multipliers, potentially doubling them if used enough.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Re-rolls twice instantly without any benefits.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Re-rolls twice instantly without any benefits.

children.text: Rock Bottom: Considers both sets of multipliers, allowing higher stats to be reached faster.
children.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Considers both sets of multipliers, allowing higher stats to be reached faster.

interactions.text: Jacob and Esau: Only the brother using D8 will get their stats rerolled with the exception of Speed, which is shared between both brothers.
interactions.raw: {{C|Jacob and Esau|r}}: Only the brother using D8 will get their stats rerolled with the exception of Speed, which is shared between both brothers.

name: Purity
description: Boosts one of Isaac's stats depending on the color of the aura around him. The aura disappears upon taking damage and reappears with a random color upon entering a new room. Red boosts damage, blue boosts tears, yellow boosts speed, and orange boosts range.

effects.text: Grants a random aura around Isaac that grants a boost depending on the aura's color:
effects.raw: Grants a random aura around Isaac that grants a boost depending on the aura's color:

children.text: Red: +4 damage.
Blue: +2.0 fire rate.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} '''Blue''': +2.0 [[fire rate]].

children.text: Yellow: +0.5 speed.
children.raw: '''Yellow''': +0.5 [[speed]].

children.text: Orange: +3.0 range.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} '''Orange''': +3.0 [[range]].

effects.text: Taking damage causes the aura to disappear. When the next room is entered, the aura will reappear with a random color.
effects.raw: Taking damage causes the aura to disappear. When the next room is entered, the aura will reappear with a random color.

interactions.text: Diplopia/Crooked Penny: Holding multiple copies of Purity will still only grant one aura, providing no additional benefit.
interactions.raw: {{i|Diplopia}}/{{i|Crooked Penny}}: Holding multiple copies of Purity will still only grant one aura, providing no additional benefit.

name: Athame
description: When Isaac takes damage, a damaging black ring briefly appears around him. This ring can cause enemies to drop Black Hearts. After Isaac kills an enemy, adds a luck-based chance to spawn a damaging black ring around them.

effects.text: When Isaac kills an enemy, gives a chance for a black ring to appear around where it once was, dealing Isaac's tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it. The chance scales with Isaac's luck. The base chance is 25%, with an additional 2.5% chance per point of luck, capping out at 100% at 30 luck.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} When Isaac kills an enemy, gives a chance for a black ring to appear around where it once was, dealing Isaac's tear damage at a rapid rate to everything touching it. The chance scales with Isaac's [[luck]]. The base chance is 25%, with an additional 2.5% chance per point of luck, capping out at 100% at 30 luck.

synergies.text: Contagion/Toxic Shock: Can allow for substantial chains of enemy kills and rapid room clearing.
synergies.raw: {{i|Contagion}}/{{i|Toxic Shock}}: Can allow for substantial chains of enemy kills and rapid room clearing.

synergies.raw: [[Homing tears]]: The black ring becomes homing, curving around to hit enemies.

synergies.raw: {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the black ring deals to 2x and +3 flat damage. Enemies who die to the black ring under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Massively increases damage and poisons enemies. {{dlc|r}} Causes the ring to explode upon contact with walls or obstacles. The explosions can damage Isaac.

synergies.raw: {{t|Wiggle Worm}}: The ring has wavy edges.

interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can't create black rings.

interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli|r}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create black rings.

interactions.text: Proptosis: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{I|Proptosis}}: No effect.

effects.raw: When Isaac has no [[Health#Red Heart Containers|Red Hearts]]:

children.text: Grants flight.
children.raw: Grants [[flight]].

children.text: Every 40 seconds since activation or pickup, when the seconds on the timer hit 00, 20, or 40, while in a room with enemies, a shield triggers, nullifying all types of damage for 10 seconds.
children.raw: Every 40 seconds since activation or pickup, when the seconds on the timer hit 00, 20, or 40, while in a room with enemies, a [[shield]] triggers, nullifying all types of damage for 10 seconds.

synergies.raw: {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: If the player has no Red Hearts, they can stand still and wait for the shield to activate, allowing the player to deal damage without leaving invulnerability.

effects.text: Isaac will occasionally fire a slow-moving eye with an infinite range that fires tears identical to Isaac's tears.

synergies.raw: {{I|Ghost Pepper}} / {{I|Bird's Eye}}: Eye tears won't shoot fires. Instead, they make Isaac shoots fire more frequently.

synergies.raw: {{i|Trisagion}}: Eyes will fire beams. Occasionally causes Trisagion beams to stay static in the air for a few seconds, dealing damage to enemies that come in contact with them.

synergies.text: Any reroll item/collectible: Items in the room can be rerolled, and if the result is undesirable, then Isaac can go back in time to save whatever was used to reroll. However, note that activating the reroll on the same items again will result in the same items being generated as the first time. Rerolling different items from the same type of room (such as going to a different Shop) will result in the reroll effect creating new and different items. This technique is useful for saving charges on items like The D6, or getting multiple options with consumables like the Perthro.
synergies.raw: Any reroll item/collectible: Items in the room can be rerolled, and if the result is undesirable, then Isaac can go back in time to save whatever was used to reroll. However, note that activating the reroll on the same items again will result in the same items being generated as the first time. Rerolling different items from the same type of room (such as going to a different Shop) will result in the reroll effect creating new and different items. This technique is useful for saving charges on items like {{I|The D6}}, or getting multiple options with consumables like the {{p|Perthro}}.

synergies.text: Anything that spawns an item such as Mystery Gift / XVII - The Stars?: After the player activates them, they can then go back in time if the item is undesirable. However, unlike reroll effects, using something that spawns an item/collectible will always generate that same item, dependent on the room type, even if the player goes to a different one in the future. For example, activating XVII - The Stars? in a Secret Room will create two items from the Secret Room item pool, and even if the player goes to the next floor and uses it again in a new Secret Room, the same exact items will be generated. So, the best way to use something that spawns an item is to activate it in rooms with different item pools (Secret, Devil/Angel, Treasure, Shop, etc.) and see which item would be the best before accepting it.
synergies.raw: Anything that spawns an item such as {{i|Mystery Gift}} / {{p|XVII - The Stars?}}: After the player activates them, they can then go back in time if the item is undesirable. However, ''unlike'' reroll effects, using something that spawns an item/collectible will always generate that same item, dependent on the room type, even if the player goes to a different one in the future. For example, activating XVII - The Stars? in a Secret Room will create two items from the Secret Room item pool, and even if the player goes to the next floor and uses it again in a new Secret Room, the same exact items will be generated. So, the best way to use something that spawns an item is to activate it in rooms with different item pools (Secret, Devil/Angel, Treasure, Shop, etc.) and see which item would be the best before accepting it.

name: Eye of Greed
description: Every 20 tears, Isaac loses 1 Penny and shoots an additional gold tear that petrifies enemies and turns them into gold. Any enemy killed while in this state will drop coins.

interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Acidic tears break rocks and open secret rooms, without being broken themselves on impact.

name: Glyph of Balance
description: Grants 2 Soul Hearts and modifies drops from Champion monsters based on certain conditions. Also modifies room clear drops.

effects.text: Grants 2 Soul Hearts.
effects.raw: Grants 2 Soul Hearts.

effects.text: Modifies drops from Champion enemies depending on certain conditions.
effects.raw: Modifies drops from Champion enemies depending on certain conditions.

effects.text: Also modifies room clear drops.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Also modifies room clear drops.

effects.text: Every room is guaranteed to drop a reward.
effects.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Every room is guaranteed to drop a reward.

effects.text: The priorities of the drops, in order, are as follows:
effects.raw: The priorities of the drops, in order, are as follows:

children.text: Soul Hearts: When Isaac has no Red Heart containers and less than 2 Soul Hearts.
children.raw: '''{{E|Soul Heart}}s''': When Isaac has no Red Heart containers and less than 2 Soul Hearts.

children.text: Red Hearts: While at 0.5 Red Hearts.
children.raw: '''{{E|Red Heart}}s''': While at 0.5 Red Hearts.

children.text: Keys: When Isaac has no keys.
children.raw: '''{{E|Key}}s''': When Isaac has no keys.

children.text: Bombs: When Isaac has no bombs.
children.raw: '''{{E|Bomb}}s''': When Isaac has no bombs.

children.text: Red Hearts: When Isaac has at least half a Red Heart container empty.
children.raw: '''{{E|Red Heart}}s''': When Isaac has at least half a Red Heart container empty.

children.text: Tainted Bethany will always get this drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges".
children.raw: {{c|Tainted Bethany}} will always get this drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges".

children.text: Penny: While Isaac has less than 15 pennies.
children.raw: '''{{E|Penny|text=Pennies}}''': While Isaac has less than 15 pennies.

children.text: Keys: When Isaac has less than 5 keys.
children.raw: '''{{E|Key}}s''': When Isaac has less than 5 keys.

children.text: Bombs: When Isaac has less than 5 bombs.
children.raw: '''{{E|Bomb}}s''': When Isaac has less than 5 bombs.

children.text: Trinkets: If Isaac has no trinkets and there are no trinkets on the ground in the room.
children.raw: '''Trinkets''': If Isaac has no trinkets and there are no trinkets on the ground in the room.

children.text: Soul Hearts: When Isaac has less than 6 total Heart containers of any kind.
children.raw: '''{{E|Soul Heart}}s''': When Isaac has less than 6 total Heart containers of any kind.

children.text: Bethany will only get this drop until she reaches 12 "soul charges".
children.raw: {{c|Bethany}} will only get this drop until she reaches 12 "soul charges".

children.text: Tainted Bethany changes blue heart drop to red heart drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges", thus she is unable to receive any blue hearts.
children.raw: {{c|Tainted Bethany}} changes blue heart drop to red heart drop until she reaches 12 "blood charges", thus she is unable to receive any blue hearts.

children.text: If none of the above conditions are true, items dropped will be rolled as normal.
children.raw: If none of the above conditions are true, items dropped will be rolled as normal.

children.text: Chest drops override the Glyph of Balance.
children.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Chest drops override the Glyph of Balance.

interactions.text: Options?: Only one of the options will be modified by the Glyph.
interactions.raw: {{i|Options?}}: Only one of the options will be modified by the Glyph.

interactions.text: Perfection: Chest spawns are prioritized over Glyph of Balance, meaning it will be very hard to use the Glyph effectively.
interactions.raw: {{T|Perfection}}: Chest spawns are prioritized over Glyph of Balance, meaning it will be very hard to use the Glyph effectively.

name: Analog Stick
description: +0.35 tears up. Allows Isaac to fire tears diagonally.

effects.text: +0.35 tears up.
effects.raw: +0.35 [[tears]] up.

effects.text: Allows tears to be fired diagonally.
effects.raw: Allows tears to be fired diagonally.

children.text: With a keyboard or using buttons to fire with a controller, tears can be shot at 45-degree angles by holding two buttons. This is known as eight-directional firing. For example, holding the up button and right button will shoot diagonally towards the upper right-hand corner.
children.raw: With a keyboard or using buttons to fire with a controller, tears can be shot at 45-degree angles by holding two buttons. This is known as eight-directional firing. For example, holding the up button and right button will shoot diagonally towards the upper right-hand corner.

children.text: Using a controller with a physical analog stick, its input is accepted, allowing for tears to be shot in any direction, as it shoots wherever the analog stick is pointing without being limited to 45-degree angles.
children.raw: Using a controller with a physical analog stick, its input is accepted, allowing for tears to be shot in any direction, as it shoots wherever the analog stick is pointing without being limited to 45-degree angles.

interactions.text: Abyss: Locusts cannot attack diagonally, and will attack upwards or downwards instead.
interactions.raw: {{I|Abyss}}: Locusts cannot attack diagonally, and will attack upwards or downwards instead.

interactions.text: Book of Virtues: Summoned wisps are unable to shoot diagonally, and will shoot upwards or downwards instead.
interactions.raw: {{I|Book of Virtues}}: Summoned wisps are unable to shoot diagonally, and will shoot upwards or downwards instead.

interactions.text: Cain's Other Eye: The familiar will fire in completely random directions, not locked to the cardinal ones.
interactions.raw: {{i|Cain's Other Eye|r}}: The familiar will fire in completely random directions, not locked to the cardinal ones.

interactions.text: Compound Fracture: When bone tears are fired diagonally, the bone shards will not always move diagonally.
interactions.raw: {{i|Compound Fracture}}: When bone tears are fired diagonally, the bone shards will not always move diagonally.

interactions.text: Cricket's Body/The Parasite: When tears are fired diagonally, the split tears will also move diagonally.
interactions.raw: {{i|Cricket's Body}}/{{i|The Parasite}}: When tears are fired diagonally, the split tears will also move diagonally.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: No effect, as missiles will always be fired towards the landing point.
interactions.raw: {{i|Epic Fetus}}: No effect, as missiles will always be fired towards the landing point.

interactions.text: Epiphora: Tears fired diagonally can retain the bonus fire rate, as long as Isaac's head continues to face the same direction.
interactions.raw: {{I|Epiphora}}: Tears fired diagonally can retain the bonus fire rate, as long as Isaac's head continues to face the same direction.

interactions.text: Incubus can fire diagonally in the same direction Isaac is shooting.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Incubus can fire diagonally in the same direction Isaac is shooting.

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique: No effect; the singular tear already has this ability, being able move in any direction.
interactions.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: No effect; the singular tear already has this ability, being able move in any direction.

interactions.text: Marked: Overridden by Marked.
interactions.raw: {{i|Marked}}: Overridden by Marked.

interactions.text: Mom's Knife: Only the tears up applies, since Mom's Knife already has the ability of being able to be pointed in any direction.
interactions.raw: {{i|Mom's Knife}}: Only the tears up applies, since Mom's Knife already has the ability of being able to be pointed in any direction.

interactions.text: Tiny Planet: Overridden by Tiny Planet.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Overridden by Tiny Planet.

interactions.text: Tractor Beam: Overridden by Tractor Beam.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Overridden by Tractor Beam.

children.text: Tractor Beam can be pointed in any direction.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Tractor Beam can be pointed in any direction.

name: Contagion
description: The first enemy killed in a room releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.

effects.text: In each room, the first enemy killed will release a gas explosion and poison nearby enemies.
effects.raw: In each room, the first enemy killed will release a gas explosion and [[poison]] nearby enemies.

children.text: Poisoned enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.
children.raw: Poisoned enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect.

children.text: Poisoned enemies do not need to die while the poison is still active to spread the effect.
children.raw: Poisoned enemies do not need to die while the poison is still active to spread the effect.

children.text: The initial gas explosion deals 5 damage, and the poison deals Isaac's tear damage per tick, for 6 ticks.
children.raw: The initial gas explosion deals 5 damage, and the poison deals Isaac's [[Damage|tear damage]] per tick, for 6 ticks.

synergies.text: Gigante Bean: Greatly increases the size of the gas explosions, making the poison spread much more effective.
synergies.raw: {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Greatly increases the size of the gas explosions, making the poison spread much more effective.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can't create a gas explosion.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can't create a gas explosion.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus/Epic Fetus: Explosion damage does not apply to poison damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}: Explosion damage does not apply to poison damage.

interactions.text: E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create a gas explosion.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can't create a gas explosion.

interactions.text: Freeze effects: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} [[Freeze]] effects: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.

interactions.text: Ipecac: Ipecac only applies a 2x multiplier as opposed to +40 to poison damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Ipecac only applies a 2x multiplier as opposed to +40 to poison damage.

interactions.text: Poison tears: No effect. Gas explosions will only be triggered by poison caused by Contagion.
interactions.raw: [[Poison]] tears: No effect. Gas explosions will only be triggered by poison caused by Contagion.

interactions.text: Second Hand: Poison duration is not affected.
interactions.raw: {{t|Second Hand}}: Poison duration is not affected.

name: Finger!
description: Spawns a finger familiar that faces in the same direction as Isaac, rapidly damaging enemies it points at for 10% of Isaac's damage.

effects.text: Spawns a floating finger familiar that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions.
effects.raw: Spawns a floating finger [[familiar]] that can be aimed with the fire buttons in all directions.

children.text: The finger fires invisible spectral lasers, doing 10% of Isaac's Damage. The lasers fire 10 times per second and are not affected by Isaac's tear rate.
children.raw: The finger fires invisible [[spectral]] lasers, doing 10% of Isaac's [[Damage]]. The lasers fire 10 times per second and are not affected by Isaac's tear rate.

children.text: The lasers have thickness based on Isaac's Damage, making it easier to inflict damage on higher Damage.
children.raw: The lasers have thickness based on Isaac's Damage, making it easier to inflict damage on higher Damage.

children.text: While not being aimed with the fire buttons, the finger points in the direction of movement or downwards if standing still.
children.raw: While not being aimed with the fire buttons, the finger points in the direction of movement or downwards if standing still.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}}: Doubles the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness.

synergies.text: Box of Friends: Adds another finger on top of the previous one, effectively doubling its damage.
synergies.raw: {{I|Box of Friends}}: Adds another finger on top of the previous one, effectively doubling its damage.

synergies.text: Finger!: Multiple fingers will stack on top of each other and move simultaneously, effectively boosting the damage of the original one.
synergies.raw: '''Finger!''': Multiple fingers will stack on top of each other and move simultaneously, effectively boosting the damage of the original one.

children.text: Having too many fingers can cause the game to lag.
children.raw: Having too many fingers can cause the game to lag.

synergies.text: Spirit Sword: When doing a spin attack, the familiar will spin with the sword.
synergies.raw: {{i|Spirit Sword}}: When doing a spin attack, the familiar will spin with the sword.

synergies.text: Guppy: Flies are generated from the damage the finger does.
synergies.raw: {{tf|Guppy}}: Flies are generated from the damage the finger does.

synergies.text: Ipecac: The finger gains massive damage boost as expected.
synergies.raw: {{I|Ipecac}}: The finger gains massive damage boost as expected.

synergies.text: Proptosis:
synergies.raw: {{I|Proptosis}}:

children.text: Triples the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness. Has no penalty with range.
children.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Triples the finger's damage, but does not affect its lasers' thickness. Has no penalty with range.

synergies.text: Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The finger has a chance to destroy rocks when pointing at them.
synergies.raw: {{I|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{I|Terra}}: The finger has a chance to destroy rocks when pointing at them.

interactions.text: Godhead: Only increases damage.
interactions.raw: {{I|Godhead}}: Only increases damage.

interactions.text: Terra: Causes the finger to constantly destroy obstacles in its line of sight.
interactions.raw: {{I|Terra}}: Causes the finger to constantly destroy obstacles in its line of sight.

interactions.text: Homing tears: The finger's lasers do not become homing.
interactions.raw: [[Homing tears]]: The finger's lasers do not become homing.

interactions.text: A Lump of Coal: No effect on the finger's damage.
interactions.raw: {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: No effect on the finger's damage.

interactions.text: Marked: While actively aiming, the finger behaves as normal and while fire keys are not pressed, it points towards the targeting crosshair.
interactions.raw: {{I|Marked}}: While actively aiming, the finger behaves as normal and while fire keys are not pressed, it points towards the targeting crosshair.

interactions.text: Trinity Shield: When not firing, the finger will point towards the nearest cardinal direction as to where the shield is left. This favors the vertical directions when the shield is at a 45° angle.
interactions.raw: {{I|Trinity Shield}}: When not firing, the finger will point towards the nearest cardinal direction as to where the shield is left. This favors the vertical directions when the shield is at a 45° angle.

interactions.text: Trisagion: No effect on the finger's damage.
interactions.raw: {{I|Trisagion}}: No effect on the finger's damage.

interactions.text: Angelic Prism: No effect on the finger's fire.
interactions.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: No effect on the finger's fire.

name: Shade
description: Spawns a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 1 second delay and deals contact damage to enemies. After dealing enough damage, it is absorbed by Isaac and spawns friendly My Shadows.

effects.text: Grants a shadow familiar that follows Isaac's movements on a 0.66-second delay and deals 5 contact damage per tick, or 75 damage per second, to enemies.
effects.raw: Grants a shadow [[familiar]] that follows Isaac's movements on a {{dlc|nr}} 1-second/{{dlc|r}} 0.66-second delay and deals {{dlc|nr}} 2/{{dlc|r}} 5 contact damage per tick, or {{dlc|nr}} 30/{{dlc|r}} 75 damage per second, to enemies.

effects.text: Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing over 666 damage.
effects.raw: Shade is absorbed by Isaac after dealing {{dlc|nr}} over 600 damage {{dlc|r}} over 666 damage.

children.text: The familiar disappears and turns into friendly dark My Shadows, identical to those spawned by My Shadow.
children.raw: The familiar disappears and turns into friendly dark {{E|My Shadow|text=Charger}}s, identical to those spawned by {{i|My Shadow}}.

children.text: Isaac will now do equal contact damage at the same rate as the Shade used to.
children.raw: Isaac will now do equal contact damage at the same rate as the Shade used to.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Friendly monsters are still affected by Ace Cards.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Will continue to work on Isaac even after Shade is absorbed, doubling contact damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Will continue to work on Isaac even after Shade is absorbed, doubling contact damage.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly Chargers as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly Chargers however friendly Chargers can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
interactions.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly Chargers as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly Chargers however friendly Chargers can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

interactions.text: Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly chargers.
interactions.raw: {{i|Broken Modem}}: Broken Modem also affects friendly chargers.

interactions.text: Eraser: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning as the item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.
interactions.raw: {{I|Eraser}}: Erasing a {{E|Charger}} will prevent all newly created [[friendly]] Chargers from spawning as the item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.

interactions.text: Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly chargers.
interactions.raw: {{I|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{I|Purgatory}} / {{i|Vade Retro}}: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly chargers.

interactions.text: Shade: Isaac's contact damage increases when absorbing multiple Shade familiars.
interactions.raw: {{i|Shade}}: Isaac's contact damage increases when absorbing multiple Shade familiars.

name: Depression
description: Spawns a familiar that leaves a trail of creep that damages enemies at 6 damage per second. Has a chance to spawn damaging beams of light onto enemies that touch the cloud.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of blue creep that damages enemies.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and leaves a trail of [[blue creep]] that damages enemies.

children.text: The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.
children.raw: The creep deals 2 damage per tick or 6 damage per second to non-flying enemies.

effects.text: If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging Holy Light beam onto the enemy.
effects.raw: If the cloud touches an enemy, it has a 1% chance to spawn a damaging {{I|Holy Light}} beam onto the enemy.

children.text: The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.
children.raw: The light beams deal 20 + Isaac's tear damage per tick and may strike an enemy up to 8 times.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increase cloud size but does not increase damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Increase cloud size but does not increase damage.

name: Hushy
description: Spawns a Hush familiar that bounces diagonally around the room and deals contact damage. While firing tears, it stops moving. When stationary, Hushy will periodically fire out rings of projectiles.

effects.text: Spawns a Hush familiar that floats and travels diagonally around the room, bouncing on walls, and deals contact damage to enemies. While firing tears, Hushy stops moving. In this state, it will:
effects.raw: Spawns a {{E|Hush}} [[familiar]] that floats and travels diagonally around the [[Rooms|room]], bouncing on walls, and deals contact damage to enemies. While firing tears, Hushy stops moving. In this state, it will:

children.text: Block enemy projectiles.
children.raw: Block enemy projectiles.

children.text: Fire out rings of 8 blue projectiles that deal 6 damage each, once every 1.033 seconds.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Fire out rings of 8 blue projectiles that deal 6 damage each, once every 1.033 seconds.

effects.text: Hushy deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 damage per second.
effects.raw: Hushy deals 2 contact damage per tick or 30 damage per second.

name: Lil Monstro
description: Spawns a familiar that fires clusters of tears. Must be charged before shooting.

effects.text: Spawns a small flying Monstro familiar that charges up and fires a large cluster of tears, similar to Monstro's main attack.
effects.raw: Spawns a small flying {{E|Monstro}} [[familiar]] that charges up and fires a large cluster of tears, similar to Monstro's main attack.

children.text: It fires between 12 and 14 tears that do 3.5 damage each.
children.raw: It fires between 12 and 14 tears that do 3.5 damage each.

children.text: It can do a minimum of 3.5 damage to 49 damage, depending on how many shots are fired and how many hit.
children.raw: It can do a minimum of 3.5 damage to 49 damage, depending on how many shots are fired and how many hit.

name: King Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and makes other familiars follow it. While firing tears, other familiars stop moving.

effects.text: Grants a familiar that follows Isaac and always appears first in the familiar chain.
effects.raw: Grants a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and always appears first in the familiar chain.

effects.text: While firing tears, King Baby stops moving and glows white.
effects.raw: While firing tears, King Baby stops moving and glows white.

effects.text: When Isaac stops firing tears, King Baby moves rapidly back towards Isaac.
effects.raw: When Isaac stops firing tears, King Baby moves rapidly back towards Isaac.

effects.text: While King Baby is stationary, other familiars remain stationary as well. This affects every familiar that has priority in how closely it follows behind Isaac.
effects.raw: While King Baby is stationary, other familiars remain stationary as well. {{dlc|r}} This affects every familiar that has priority in how closely it follows behind Isaac.

children.text: Shooting familiars fire at nearby enemies automatically and throwable familiars launch themselves at nearby enemies automatically.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} [[Familiar#Shooting familiars|Shooting familiars]] fire at nearby enemies automatically and [[Familiar#Throwable familiars|throwable familiars]] launch themselves at nearby enemies automatically.

children.text: Familiars that have charged attacks will operate on similar rules to Marked: they will immediately fire at full charge, and variable-charged attacks will be released earlier the closer that King Baby is to the target.
children.raw: Familiars that have charged attacks will operate on similar rules to {{I|Marked}}: they will immediately fire at full charge, and variable-charged attacks will be released earlier the closer that King Baby is to the target.

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}

synergies.text: Lil Brimstone: Can fire in full 360 degrees and will fire as soon as he's fully charged, making him extremely effective.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lil Brimstone}}: Can fire in full 360 degrees and will fire as soon as he's fully charged, making him extremely effective.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increases King Baby's size. No other effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases King Baby's size. No other effect.

interactions.text: Child Leash: Familiars stay closer to King Baby while Isaac is firing.
interactions.raw: {{T|Child Leash}}: Familiars stay closer to King Baby while Isaac is firing.

interactions.text: Cain's Other Eye: Cain's Other Eye will attempt to fire directly at enemies but only when they are on the same side as the random direction it is firing in.
interactions.raw: {{I|Cain's Other Eye|r}}: Cain's Other Eye will attempt to fire directly at enemies but only when they are on the same side as the random direction it is firing in.

interactions.text: Duct Tape: King Baby will stay in place relative to Isaac until Isaac starts firing tears. Then King Baby will remain stationary until Isaac has stopped firing and will rapidly move back to him.
interactions.raw: {{t|Duct Tape}}: King Baby will stay in place relative to Isaac until Isaac starts firing tears. Then King Baby will remain stationary until Isaac has stopped firing and will rapidly move back to him.

interactions.text: Friendship Necklace: Familiars will orbit King Baby at all times instead of Isaac, even while not firing. King Baby itself is unaffected.
interactions.raw: {{T|Friendship Necklace}}: Familiars will orbit King Baby at all times instead of Isaac, even while not firing. King Baby itself is unaffected.

interactions.text: GB Bug: GB Bug will only throw itself at nearby enemies automatically if a fire button is double tapped while King Baby's effect is active.
interactions.raw: {{I|GB Bug|r}}: GB Bug will only throw itself at nearby enemies automatically if a fire button is double tapped while King Baby's effect is active.

interactions.text: Gemini: Suture will rest near King Baby as long as there are no enemies near Isaac. When Isaac gets near enemies, Suture will rapidly snap from King Baby toward the enemy. Functionally, King Baby has no real effect on Gemini.
interactions.raw: {{I|Gemini}}: Suture will rest near King Baby as long as there are no enemies near Isaac. When Isaac gets near enemies, Suture will rapidly snap from King Baby toward the enemy. Functionally, King Baby has no real effect on Gemini.

children.text: Visually, this can result in the umbilical between Isaac and Suture getting stretched to a long length.
children.raw: Visually, this can result in the umbilical between Isaac and Suture getting stretched to a long length.

interactions.text: Jaw Bone: After being thrown, Jaw Bone will return to Isaac and then reappear behind King Baby.
interactions.raw: {{I|Jaw Bone|r}}: After being thrown, Jaw Bone will return to Isaac and then reappear behind King Baby.

interactions.text: RC Remote: Overrides King Baby's halting; familiars will mimic Isaac's movements even while firing. King Baby's auto-targeting remains active.
interactions.raw: {{T|RC Remote}}: Overrides King Baby's halting; familiars will mimic Isaac's movements even while firing. King Baby's auto-targeting remains active.

name: Big Chubby
description: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, blocking shots and dealing 40.5 damage per second on contact.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that follows Isaac and charges across the room when Isaac fires, dealing 2.7 damage per tick or 40.5 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac and charges across the [[room]] when Isaac fires, dealing 2.7 damage per tick or 40.5 damage per second to enemies it comes in contact with.

children.text: The familiar's charging speed is very slow, unlike its counterpart Little Chubby.
children.raw: The familiar's charging speed is very slow, unlike its counterpart {{i|Little Chubby}}.

children.text: The familiar blocks enemy shots.
children.raw: The familiar blocks enemy shots.

interactions.text: Duct Tape: Big Chubby stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.
interactions.raw: {{t|Duct Tape}}: Big Chubby stays in place relative to Isaac until it is fired.

name: Broken Glass Cannon
description: Begins with no charges and turns into Glass Cannon when used. Only acquired by taking damage while holding Glass Cannon.

effects.text: This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding Glass Cannon. It begins with no charges.
effects.raw: This item is acquired when Isaac takes damage while holding {{i|Glass Cannon}}. It begins with no charges.

effects.text: Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.
effects.raw: Once fully charged, it automatically turns back into Glass Cannon.

name: Tonsil
description: Grants a familiar that follows Isaac and blocks enemy shots.

effects.text: After taking 6-12 hits a removed tonsil familiar starts following Isaac, blocking enemy shots.
effects.raw: After taking {{dlc|nr+}} 12-20 / {{dlc|r+}} 6-12 hits a removed tonsil [[familiar]] starts following Isaac, blocking enemy shots.

effects.text: The effect can happen twice, after which the trinket will be destroyed.
effects.raw: The effect can happen twice, after which the trinket will be destroyed.

effects.text: The familiar does not deal damage to enemies.
effects.raw: The familiar does not deal damage to enemies. {{clear}}

synergies.text: / Mom's Box: Having either can generate a 3rd tonsil before destroying the trinket. Having both can generate a 4th tonsil before destroying it.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r+}} {{a|Golden Trinket|n}} / {{i|Mom's Box}}: Having either can generate a 3rd tonsil before destroying the trinket. Having both can generate a 4th tonsil before destroying it.

name: Plan C
description: Kills all enemies in the room, then kills Isaac three seconds later.

effects.text: Upon use, deals 9,999,999 damage to every enemy in the room, then kills Isaac 3 seconds later.
effects.raw: Upon use, deals 9,999,999 damage to every enemy in the room, then kills Isaac 3 seconds later.

effects.text: Kills Isaac 10 seconds later in Delirium's room and 11.5 seconds later in Mother's room.
effects.raw: Kills Isaac 10 seconds later in {{e|Delirium}}'s room and 11.5 seconds later in {{e|Mother}}'s room.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

name: D1
description: Duplicates a random pickup in the room. The new pickup may be different than the original (i.e. a different card, etc).

synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Generates two pickups instead of just one.

children.text: Car Battery + Lil' Battery: Allows for infinite generation of Lil' Batteries. While it's still possible to generate infinite batteries with this synergy, it is slow to do so since mostly Micro Batteries will spawn. children.raw: {{dlc|r}} An endless supply of Lil' Batteries allows for an endless supply of every kind of unlocked pickups, chests, and trinkets, as long as there is at least one of the initial pickup type on the floor.

children.text: Pill + PHD: Allows for an infinite supply of beneficial pills.

interactions.text: Guppy's Eye: Guppy's Eye can be used to see what changed when duplicating a chest. This essentially allows rerolling the rewards within them, especially useful in Chest and Dark Room.

name: Void
description: Consumes all pedestal items in the room. Activated items will have their effects added to Void, and passive items will grant random stat upgrades.

effects.text: Upon use, destroys all pedestal items in the room. Items that require payment cannot be absorbed unless they are bought first.
effects.raw: Upon use, destroys all pedestal items in the room. Items that require payment cannot be absorbed unless they are bought first.

children.text: If Void destroys an activated item, it gains the activated ability of that item; whenever Void is used, it will simultaneously use all previous active items that were absorbed in the same order they were absorbed. Passive effects of absorbed active items will not apply (e.g., the passive effect of Mom's Box). The active item effects happen after the initial destruction of current pedestal items, and in the order that the active items were absorbed.
children.raw: If Void destroys an [[activated item]], it gains the activated ability of that item; whenever Void is used, it will simultaneously use all previous active items that were absorbed in the same order they were absorbed. The active item effects happen after the initial destruction of current pedestal items, and in the order that the active items were absorbed.

children.raw: {{dlc|r}} +2.5 [[Range]]

synergies.raw: {{i|Alabaster Box}}: Allows the box to be charged through normal means, rather than by absorbing soul hearts.

synergies.text: Breath of Life: Immediately grants invincibility frames.
synergies.raw: {{i|Breath of Life|r}}: Immediately grants invincibility frames.

synergies.text: Eraser: Allows the Eraser to be used multiple times per floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Eraser}}: Allows the Eraser to be used multiple times per floor.

synergies.text: Glass Cannon: Can be used without it ever breaking or causing damage to the player.
synergies.raw: {{i|Glass Cannon}}: Can be used without it ever breaking or causing damage to the player.

synergies.text: Moving Box: Moving Box will not be added to Void; instead, it is converted into stat boosts like a passive item.
synergies.raw: {{i|Moving Box}}: Moving Box will not be added to Void; instead, it is converted into stat boosts like a passive item.

interactions.text: Abyss: Since consumed activated items are used before absorbing new items in a room, using Void with Abyss stored inside will destroy pedestals with Abyss' effect first, essentially overriding Void's item consumption effects. Previously consumed active items will still function as normal when using Void. Passive items can still be consumed with Void by picking them up before using Void.
interactions.raw: {{i|Abyss}}: Since consumed activated items are used before absorbing new items in a room, using Void with Abyss stored inside will destroy pedestals with Abyss' effect first, essentially overriding Void's item consumption effects. Previously consumed active items will still function as normal when using Void. Passive items can still be consumed with Void by picking them up before using Void.

interactions.text: Blank Card + ? Card: Using the ? Card with an absorbed Blank Card simply activates Void. Isaac will not be teleported to the room and Void will not be deleted.
interactions.raw: {{i|Blank Card}} + {{p|? Card}}: Using the ? Card with an absorbed Blank Card simply activates Void. Isaac will not be teleported to the {{r|I AM ERROR}} room and Void will not be deleted.

interactions.text: Broken Remote / Teleport! / Teleport 2.0 / Undefined / any other teleport method: Void will still consume any item pedestals in the room, after which the teleport occurs.
interactions.raw: {{t|Broken Remote}} / {{i|Teleport!}} / {{i|Teleport 2.0|n}} / {{i|Undefined}} / any other teleport method: Void will still consume any item pedestals in the room, after which the teleport occurs.

interactions.text: The D6 and D100 can't roll items while being absorbed since their effect isn't triggered the first time anymore but any subsequent Void uses will still roll items before absorbing them.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} The D6 and D100 can't roll items while being absorbed since their effect isn't triggered the first time anymore but any subsequent Void uses will still roll items before absorbing them.

interactions.text: Death Certificate: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
interactions.raw: {{i|Death Certificate}}: Only allows the consumption of one item per Death Certificate room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.

interactions.text: Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice D infinity can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice {{i|D infinity}} can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.

interactions.text: Single-use items won't be used upon their absorption, instead being invoked on the next usage of the Void, which allows Isaac to use the absorbed item later when needed. Their effects will still only be invoked once.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Single-use items won't be used upon their absorption, instead being invoked on the next usage of the Void, which allows Isaac to use the absorbed item later when needed. Their effects will still only be invoked once.

children.text: Car Battery: As Void will be activated twice, single-use items are immediately used when absorbed.
children.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: As Void will be activated twice, single-use items are immediately used when absorbed.

children.text: When multiple copies of a given single-use active are in Void, only half of them will be used each time Void is activated, rounded up.
children.raw: When multiple copies of a given single-use active are in Void, only half of them will be used each time Void is activated, rounded up.

interactions.text: Everything Jar/Larynx: Will only replicate the 1-charge version of the effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Everything Jar}}/{{i|Larynx}}: Will only replicate the 1-charge version of the effect.

interactions.text: Flip/Jar of Flies/The Jar/Stitches/Notched Axe/Esau Jr.: None of these items do anything when absorbed by Void.
interactions.raw: {{i|Flip}}/{{i|Jar of Flies}}/{{i|The Jar}}/{{i|Stitches}}/{{i|Notched Axe}}/{{i|Esau Jr.}}: None of these items do anything when absorbed by Void.

children.text: When playing as Tainted Lazarus, and Flip is absorbed by the void, it will still flip the character. But it is not normally possible to obtain a second Flip, and therefore not normally possible to absorb it.
children.raw: When playing as {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}, and {{i|Flip}} is absorbed by the void, it will still flip the character. But it is not normally possible to obtain a second Flip, and therefore not normally possible to absorb it.

interactions.text: Genesis: All effects granted by absorbed items including stat ups and activated item abilities Void takes are removed without creating items to replace them. Since Void is stripped of any active item abilities it would have gained, any other Void found will also have no other active effects stored in it.
interactions.raw: {{i|Genesis}}: All effects granted by absorbed items including stat ups and [[activated item]] abilities Void takes are removed without creating items to replace them. Since Void is stripped of any active item abilities it would have gained, any other Void found will also have no other active effects stored in it.

children.text: Void's active effects are reset even if Isaac is currently not holding it.
children.raw: Void's active effects are reset even if Isaac is currently not holding it.

interactions.text: Hourglass can now be used indefinitely per floor, but every use will cost the entire charge of Void. Makes most active items and Apollyon's Birthright useless.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Hourglass can now be used indefinitely per floor, but every use will cost the entire charge of Void. Makes most active items and Apollyon's Birthright useless.

interactions.raw: {{i|How to Jump}}: If this item is activated by {{i|Void}}, it is possible to get stuck in an impassable area with no ability to escape. Exiting and resuming the run will place Isaac at whichever door he entered the room through.

interactions.raw: {{i|Jar of Wisps}}: Each use will spawn only one wisp.

interactions.raw: {{i|Mega Blast}} / {{i|Mega Mush}}: Allow to use it every {{dlc|nr+}} 6 or {{dlc|r+}} 4 charges instead of 12. Batteries will also full charge Void, instead of giving {{dlc|nr}} 3 or {{dlc|r}} 6 charges to Mega Blast.

interactions.text: Remote Detonator: Absorbing it with Void does not cause bombs to remain on the ground until Void is used, but using Void explodes all player-placed bombs as usual.
interactions.raw: {{i|Remote Detonator}}: Absorbing it with Void does not cause bombs to remain on the ground until Void is used, but using Void explodes all player-placed bombs as usual.

interactions.raw: {{i|Sharp Key}}: Using the Void will cause Isaac to shoot a key the next time he will press the fire key. Keys are consumed as normal.

interactions.text: Spin to Win: A spinning top orbital will spawn every time the Void is used. The orbitals will last until Isaac leaves the room.
interactions.raw: {{i|Spin to Win}}: A spinning top orbital will spawn every time the Void is used. The orbitals will last until Isaac leaves the room.

interactions.text: Urn of Souls: Although a sound effect will play, using Void will do nothing.
interactions.raw: {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Although a sound effect will play, using Void will do nothing.

description: Freezes all enemies until a fire button is pressed.

effects.text: Stops all enemies including bosses until a fire button is pressed.
effects.raw: Stops all enemies including bosses until a fire button is pressed.

children.text: This does not affect troll bombs.
children.raw: This does not affect troll bombs.

children.text: Touching frozen enemies will still damage Isaac.
children.raw: Touching frozen enemies will still damage Isaac.

children.text: Co-op babies can fire without ending the effect.

synergies.raw: {{I|120 Volt}} / {{I|Monstrance}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Continues to damage enemies even while paused, allowing for insane amounts of damage.

children.raw: Any item that does damage without firing + {{i|4.5 Volt}}: Pause can be recharged while the effect is active, allowing for potentially infinite uptime.

synergies.raw: {{C|Tainted Jacob}}: Dark Esau will also be affected by Pause. With proper timing, this allows him to melt through endgame bosses with large amounts of armor-piercing damage by having Dark Esau sit on top of them.

interactions.raw: Using the item in [[Greed Mode]] will freeze all enemies but will not pause the timer. New waves of enemies will continue to spawn even while the effect is active.

synergies.text: Ghost Pepper / Bird's Eye: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Wait What. Despite Car Battery not duplicating Wait What's shockwave, the flame shot is duplicated.
synergies.raw: {{i|Ghost Pepper}} / {{i|Bird's Eye}}: Shoots a flame behind Isaac upon each use of Wait What. Despite {{I|Car Battery}} not duplicating Wait What's shockwave, the flame shot is duplicated.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

name: Crooked Penny
description: Has a 50% chance to double all items, Chest, trinkets, and pickups in the room. If the effect fails, spawns a Penny and the other items and pickups disappear.

effects.text: Upon use, has a 50% chance to double all items, pickups, trinkets, and Chest in the current room.
effects.raw: Upon use, has a 50% chance to double all [[item]]s, [[pickup]]s, [[trinket]]s, and {{e|Chest||chests}} in the current room.

children.text: If the effect fails, the items, pickups, and chests disappear, and a Penny is spawned.
children.raw: If the effect fails, the items, pickups, and chests disappear, and a {{e|Penny}} is spawned.

synergies.text: Void does not absorb the item if Crooked Penny fails, but one penny still appears. Void absorbs only the original item if Crooked Penny succeeds, leaving behind a copy.
synergies.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Void does not absorb the item if Crooked Penny fails, but one penny still appears. Void absorbs only the original item if Crooked Penny succeeds, leaving behind a copy.

interactions.text: Activates the item twice, quadrupling all items/drops in the room at a 25% chance but having a combined 75% chance to fail. A failure followed by a success generates 2 pennies.
interactions.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Activates the item twice, quadrupling all items/drops in the room at a 25% chance but having a combined 75% chance to fail. A failure followed by a success generates 2 pennies.

name: Dull Razor
description: Hurts Isaac without depleting health, activating any items that trigger upon taking damage.

effects.text: Hurts Isaac without taking away health, giving him invincibility frames equal to a full heart damage and activating any items that trigger upon getting hit.
effects.raw: Hurts Isaac without taking away health, giving him invincibility frames equal to a full heart damage and activating any items that trigger upon getting hit.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Dull Razor activates twice, triggering on-damage items twice. Invincibility frames are the same.
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Dull Razor activates twice, triggering on-damage items twice. Invincibility frames are the same.

synergies.text: Cambion Conception: Allows for free familiar spawns on repeated use.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cambion Conception}}: Allows for free familiar spawns on repeated use.

interactions.text: Cone Head / Star of Bethlehem / Aura from White Poops or White Dips: Can block the "hit" Dull Razor inflicts, nullifying the invincibility frames and causing no effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Cone Head}} / {{i|Star of Bethlehem}} / Aura from {{e|White Poop}}s or [[Familiar#Dips|White Dips]]: Can block the "hit" Dull Razor inflicts, nullifying the invincibility frames and causing no effect.

interactions.text: Crown Of Light: Disables the effect for the current room.
interactions.raw: {{i|Crown Of Light}}: Disables the effect for the current room.

interactions.text: Habit: Will try to charge Dull Razor itself, but fails due to the effect trigger before the charge bar is emptied.
interactions.raw: {{i|Habit}}: Will try to charge Dull Razor itself, but fails due to the effect trigger before the charge bar is emptied.

children.text: Habit + The Battery: Will charge Dull Razor itself only when the charge bar is not filled by extra charges.
children.raw: '''Habit''' + {{i|The Battery}}: Will charge Dull Razor itself only when the charge bar is not filled by extra charges.

children.text: Habit + The Battery + Car Battery: Will fully charge Dull Razor itself, allowing for infinite uses of the item.
children.raw: '''Habit''' + '''The Battery''' + {{i|Car Battery}}: Will fully charge Dull Razor itself, allowing for infinite uses of the item.

children.text: Habit + Schoolbag: The secondary item will be charged.
children.raw: '''Habit''' + {{i|Schoolbag}}: The secondary item will be charged.

children.text: Habit + Schoolbag + 9 Volt: If Dull Razor is copied into the second active item through an effect such as Diplopia or Crooked Penny, the two Dull Razors can be switched between infinitely.
children.raw: '''Habit''' + '''Schoolbag''' + {{i|9 Volt}}: If Dull Razor is copied into the second active item through an effect such as {{i|Diplopia}} or {{i|Crooked Penny}}, the two Dull Razors can be switched between infinitely.

interactions.text: Perfection: Is not destroyed by a use of Dull Razor, as it counts as self-damage.
interactions.raw: {{t|Perfection}}: Is not destroyed by a use of Dull Razor, as it counts as self-damage.

interactions.text: Purity: Cancels the current effect of Purity, allowing a different aura to be gained instead.
interactions.raw: {{i|Purity}}: Cancels the current effect of Purity, allowing a different aura to be gained instead.

name: Potato Peeler
description: Removes a Heart Container, increases Damage and Range, and grants a Cube of Meat. If Isaac has a Ball of Bandages, it will instead give additional copies of that.

effects.text: On use:
effects.raw: On use:

children.text: Removes one Red Heart Container.
children.raw: Removes one Red [[Heart Container]].

children.text: Increases damage by a flat +0.2.
children.raw: Increases [[damage]] by a flat +0.2.

children.text: Grants one Cube of Meat.
children.raw: Grants one {{i|Cube of Meat}}.

children.text: The Cube of Meat is not added as a real item in Isaac's inventory.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} The Cube of Meat is not added as a real item in Isaac's inventory.

children.text: If Isaac has Ball of Bandages, Potato Peeler will give additional copies of that instead.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} If Isaac has {{i|Ball of Bandages}}, Potato Peeler will give additional copies of that instead.

children.text: Grants an active Anemic effect for the current room.
children.raw: Grants an active {{i|Anemic}} effect for the current room.

children.text: Counts as self-damage for the purposes of damage-triggered items.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} Counts as self-damage for the purposes of damage-triggered items.

synergies.raw: {{p|III - The Empress?}}/{{p|XI - Strength}}: The temporary hearts granted by the cards can be used to create a Cube of Meat.

synergies.text: Tainted Eden: The Cube of Meat is not re-rolled when Tainted Eden takes damage, but the loss of a heart container is permanent.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Eden}}: The {{i|Cube of Meat}} is not re-rolled when Tainted Eden takes damage, but the loss of a heart container is permanent.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: The Cubes of Meat from Potato Peeler cannot be duplicated by Box of Friends.
interactions.raw: {{i|Box of Friends|r}}: The Cubes of Meat from Potato Peeler cannot be duplicated by Box of Friends.

interactions.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: No effect.

children.text: Car Battery + Book of Virtues: Summons 2 wisps and one Cube of Meat upon use.
children.raw: Car Battery + {{I|Book of Virtues}}: Summons 2 wisps and one Cube of Meat upon use.

name: Metronome
description: Grants a random item effect for the current room.

effects.text: Grants a random item's effect for the current room.
effects.raw: Grants a random item's effect for the current room.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Metronome is activated twice at once as expected, but the item chosen for the first activation is shown raised above Isaac's head, instead of the second one that actually remains active.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Metronome is activated twice at once as expected, but the item chosen for the first activation is shown raised above Isaac's head, instead of the second one that actually remains active.

children.text: Moreover, active item effects chosen by Metronome are only activated once.
children.raw: Moreover, active item effects chosen by Metronome are only activated once.

interactions.raw: {{i|Bird Cage}}: Spawns the familiar for the current room, leaving the room it spawned in will only left the sprite over Isaac's head without doing nothing.

name: D infinity
description: Has the effect of a random die item that changes each use. Replicates the effect of a selected die item (except Spindown Dice), and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.

effects.text: Upon use, acts as any die item except for Spindown Dice, and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.
effects.raw: Upon use, acts as any [[Dice (Disambiguation)|die item]] except for {{I|Spindown Dice}}, and can be cycled through by pressing the drop key.

children.raw: The charge time when picked up is 4, but changes to that of the last used die. Cycling does not change the charge time.
