interactions.text: Car Battery: Activates 2 dice.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}:  Activates 2 dice. {{dlc|nr}}The second activation die cannot be predicted.

children.text: The second activation die is determined by the seed and never changes.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} The second activation die is determined by the seed and never changes.

interactions.text: Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice D infinity can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}} Acts as a copy of one of the 10 dice D infinity can replicate. This die is randomly chosen and does not change.

interactions.text: ? Card: Activates the selected die, updating the charge time and keeping the charges stored.
interactions.raw: {{p|? Card|r}}: Activates the selected die, updating the charge time and keeping the charges stored.

name: Eden's Soul
description: Spawns two random items from the current room's Item Pool and then disappears. Starts with no charges.

effects.text: Upon use, spawns two random item pedestals using the item pool of the current room. Eden's Soul is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.
effects.raw: Upon use, spawns two random item pedestals using the [[Item Pool|item pool]] of the current room. Eden's Soul is consumed and vanishes from Isaac's inventory.

synergies.text: ? Card: Activates the item without consuming it, allowing for potential multiple uses.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card|r}}: Activates the item without consuming it, allowing for potential multiple uses.

synergies.text: Wild Card: Gives the effect of Eden's Soul if it was the last item/card used.
synergies.raw: {{p|Wild Card}}: Gives the effect of Eden's Soul if it was the last item/card used.

interactions.text: The Battery: Eden's Soul cannot be activated twice with a double charge.
interactions.raw: {{i|The Battery}}: Eden's Soul cannot be activated twice with a double charge.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Does not affect Eden's Soul. Only two items will spawn upon use.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Does not affect Eden's Soul. Only two items will spawn upon use.

interactions.text: Void: If absorbed, Eden's Soul is stored, and allows for a single use in a desired location. Also effectively reduces charge time to 6 / 4 rooms.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void|r}}: If absorbed, Eden's Soul is stored, and allows for a single use in a desired location. Also effectively reduces charge time to {{dlc|r}} 6 / {{dlc|r+}} 4 rooms.

children.text: Car Battery + Void: Eden's Soul is Voided and then immediately consumed, spawning 2 items from the current item pool. This is likely to be the Angel Room as that is where Eden’s Soul is usually found. Effectively removes the charge time of Eden’s Soul.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}}{{i|Car Battery}} + {{i|Void}}: Eden's Soul is Voided and then immediately consumed, spawning 2 items from the current item pool. This is likely to be the Angel Room as that is where Eden’s Soul is usually found. Effectively removes the charge time of Eden’s Soul.

children.text: If Car Battery is picked up after Eden's Soul was absorbed, the next Void use will spawn 2 item pedestals and immediately Void them.
children.raw: If Car Battery is picked up after Eden's Soul was absorbed, the next Void use will spawn 2 item pedestals and immediately Void them.

name: Acid Baby
description: Spawns a familiar that drops a random pill every 3 / 7 rooms. Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room are poisoned.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that drops random pills.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that drops random [[pill]]s.

children.text: Acid Baby drops a pill every 7 cleared rooms. The first drop happens after 6 rooms.
children.raw: Acid Baby drops a pill every {{dlc|nr}} 3 / {{dlc|r}} 7 cleared [[room]]s. The first drop happens after {{dlc|nr}} 2 / {{dlc|r}} 6 rooms.

effects.text: Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room will be poisoned.
effects.raw: Upon using a pill, all enemies in the room will be [[poison]]ed.

children.text: The poison lasts for 6 ticks. Enemies also take 10 additional damage.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} The poison lasts for 6 ticks. Enemies also take 10 additional damage.

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}}{{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}

synergies.text: Acid Baby drops a pill every 6 cleared rooms.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} Acid Baby drops a pill every 6 cleared rooms.

synergies.text: Vurp!: If Isaac's last used pill is a Vurp! pill and Isaac finds another Vurp! pill afterward, he can infinitely generate Vurp! pills and repeatedly use them for mass poison damage.
synergies.raw: [[Vurp!]]: If Isaac's last used pill is a Vurp! pill and Isaac finds another Vurp! pill afterward, he can infinitely generate Vurp! pills and repeatedly use them for mass poison damage.

interactions.text: Second Hand: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{T|Second Hand}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Starter Deck: All pills dropped by Acid Baby will turn into cards.
interactions.raw: {{i|Starter Deck}}: All pills dropped by Acid Baby will turn into cards.

name: YO LISTEN!
description: +1 luck. Spawns a fairy familiar that points out s, entrances, and tinted rocks.

effects.text: +1 luck.
Spawns a familiar that sporadically moves around the room.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that sporadically moves around the [[Rooms|room]].

effects.text: Upon entering a room with a / entrance, tinted rock, or a rock with a underneath, it will fly towards it.
effects.raw: Upon entering a room with a {{R|Secret Room}}/{{R|Super Secret Room}} entrance,  [[Obstacles#Tinted Rocks|tinted rock]], or a rock with a {{R|Crawl Space}} underneath, it will fly towards it.

children.text: If there are multiple secrets, then it will fly from one to the other.
children.raw: If there are multiple secrets, then it will fly from one to the other.

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

name: Adrenaline
description: Increases damage based on how many empty Red Heart containers Isaac has.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a flat damage up based on how many empty Red Heart containers he has.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a flat [[damage]] up based on how many empty [[Red Heart container]]s he has.

children.text: The damage up given is ((2 × MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) × 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}} The damage up given is ((2 × MissingHearts) ^ 1.6) × 0.1, where MissingHearts is the number of full red hearts of health missing. The amount of damage gained this way is exponential, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.

children.text: Damage ups are only applied for every fully empty heart container.
children.raw: Damage ups are only applied for every fully empty heart container.

effects.text: Counts towards the Spun transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Spun}}

synergies.text: Birthright + Magdalene: Allows Magdalene to gain more damage than the other characters can because of her 6 additional heart containers.
synergies.raw: {{I|Birthright}} + {{C|Magdalene}}: Allows Magdalene to gain more damage than the other characters can because of her 6 additional heart containers.

synergies.text: Blood Oath: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Blood Oath}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.

synergies.text: Empty Heart: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if an empty heart container is granted at the beginning of each floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Empty Heart}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if an empty heart container is granted at the beginning of each floor.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Allows Isaac to keep the damage up after refilling hearts.
synergies.raw: {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Allows Isaac to keep the damage up after refilling hearts.

name: Jacob's Ladder
description: Tears fire sparks of electricity in random directions upon hitting an obstacle or enemy.

effects.text: Tears fire 1 short-ranged spark of electricity in a random direction upon hitting an obstacle or enemy. When an arc strikes an enemy, it will strike another nearby enemy, chaining up to four times.
effects.raw: {{Dlc|r}} Tears fire 1 short-ranged spark of electricity in a random direction upon hitting an obstacle or enemy. When an arc strikes an enemy, it will strike another nearby enemy, chaining up to four times.

effects.text: Sparks deal half of the tear's damage.
effects.raw: Sparks deal half of the tear's damage.

children.text: Sparks behave like spectral and piercing lasers and will arc to hit enemies that are close enough, even striking multiple ones in a row.
children.raw: Sparks behave like [[Spectral tears|spectral]] and [[Piercing tears|piercing]] lasers and will arc to hit enemies that are close enough, even striking multiple ones in a row.

children.text: An enemy can take damage multiple times from sparks of a single chain. If an enemy take damage from a tear, it does not take any damage from the chain which the tear causes.
children.raw: An enemy can take damage multiple times from sparks of a single chain. If an enemy take damage from a tear, it does not take any damage from the chain which the tear causes.

children.text: Tears that hit the floor due to running out of range do not generate arcs.
children.raw: Tears that hit the floor due to running out of range do not generate arcs.

children.text: If the floor is wet, such as Downpour, Dross, Flooded Caves, some rooms in Scarred Womb and Corpse, and after using Flush!, the arcing distance is increased.
children.raw: If the floor is wet, such as {{S|Downpour}}, {{S|Dross}}, {{S|Flooded Caves}}, some rooms in {{S|Scarred Womb}} and {{S|Corpse}}, and after using {{I|Flush!}}, the arcing distance is increased.

synergies.text: Multiple battery-themed items have special synergies with the sparks:
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} Multiple battery-themed items have special synergies with the sparks:

children.text: Sharp Plug / Car Battery: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 100% if Isaac owns both.
children.raw: {{I|Sharp Plug}} / {{I|Car Battery}}: Electricity deals 75% of Isaac's tear damage if he owns 1 of these items, and 100% if Isaac owns both.

children.text: 9 Volt / Watch Battery / Hairpin: Increases arcing distance of sparks.
children.raw: {{I|9 Volt}} / {{T|Watch Battery}} / {{T|Hairpin}}: Increases arcing distance of sparks.

children.text: The Battery / Jumper Cables / AAA Battery: Increases amount of arcs a spark can generate.
children.raw: {{I|The Battery}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}} / {{T|AAA Battery}}: Increases amount of arcs a spark can generate.

children.text: Old Capacitor: Allows sparks to arc on the same enemy multiple times.
children.raw: {{T|Old Capacitor|n}}: Allows sparks to arc on the same enemy multiple times.

synergies.text: Abyss: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Jacob's Ladder, it turns into a pale blue locust.
synergies.raw: {{I|Abyss}}: When Isaac uses Abyss to absorb Jacob's Ladder, it turns into a pale blue locust.

children.text: The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} The locust can create arcs of electricity dealing 25% of Isaac's damage per tick.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: All of the split tears will be electrified.
synergies.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: All of the split tears will be electrified. {{Dlc|nr}} Also, the sparks that pass through the prism will be split.

synergies.text: Brimstone / Azazel / Tainted Azazel: The beam gains a light blue tint, spawning sparks at the end of the beam and near enemies hit by the beam.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{I|Brimstone}} / {{c|Azazel}} / {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam gains a light blue tint, spawning sparks at the end of the beam and near enemies hit by the beam.

synergies.text: C Section: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.
synergies.raw: {{I|C Section}}: Spawns the sparks for each tick they hit.

synergies.text: Little Horn: Enemies hit by the sparks also get hit with Big Horn's hand.
synergies.raw: {{I|Little Horn}}: Enemies hit by the sparks also get hit with Big Horn's hand.

synergies.raw: {{I|Lost Contact}}: Tears block enemy shots as normal and will then spawn the sparks where the shot was blocked.

synergies.raw: {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: Sparks deal damage based on the tear's range, increasing with distance. No extra damage is applied by the distance covered by the spark.

synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{I|Mom's Knife}}: The knife will occasionally generate sparks when hitting an enemy.

synergies.raw: [[Piercing tears]]: A tear will generate sparks for each enemy it hits.

synergies.raw: [[Spectral tears]]: The tears can spawn sparks while passing through obstacles, and a tear can spawn sparks only once in this way.

synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Magdalene}}: Hugs cause sparks to spawn.

synergies.raw: [[Tear effects]]: The tear effects will be applied over the sparks as well.

children.raw: {{I|Serpent's Kiss}}: The poison caused by the sparks will not drop black hearts.

children.raw: {{T|Nose Goblin}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: The boogers do not spawn sparks when directly hit on an enemy, but their sparks spawn the boogers for each enemy hit.

name: Mr. ME!
description: Summons a controllable ghost that can perform various tasks depending on what it targets.

effects.text: Summons a ghost near Isaac that will follow him around, and summons a controllable blue crosshair. After a few seconds, the crosshair disappears, and the ghost will act depending on what the crosshair was targeting:
effects.raw: Summons a ghost near Isaac that will follow him around, and summons a controllable blue crosshair. After a few seconds, the crosshair disappears, and the ghost will act depending on what the crosshair was targeting:

children.text: Items / Pickups / Trinkets / Chests / Red Chests / Spiked Chests / Mega Chests: Brings it to Isaac.
children.raw: [[Items]] / [[Pickups]] / [[Trinkets]] / {{e|Chest}}s / {{e|Red Chest}}s / {{e|Spiked Chest}}s / {{e|Mega Chest}}s: Brings it to Isaac.

children.text: Can steal from s, s, and s, making the item/pickup free. Stealing an item has a 33% chance to fail. If that happens, a buzzer sound will play and the ghost will disappear without doing anything.
children.raw: Can steal from {{r|Shop}}s, {{r|Devil Room}}s, and {{r|Black Market}}s, making the item/pickup free. Stealing an item has a 33% chance to fail. If that happens, a buzzer sound will play and the ghost will disappear without doing anything.

children.text: Locked Chests / Eternal Chests / Bomb Chests: Opens the chest for free.
children.raw: {{e|Locked Chest}}s / {{e|Eternal Chest}}s / {{e|Bomb Chest}}s: Opens the chest for free.

children.raw: {{E|Pressure Plate}}/{{E|Reward Plate}}: Presses the button. This includes the wave pause button in [[Greed Mode]].

children.raw: [[Monsters|Enemies]]: Attacks the enemy until it dies or can no longer be targeted due to a form change or similar cause. The ghost does 3 damage per tick, for 9 damage per second.

children.raw: This does not work on the hidden closet in {{s|Home}} to unlock the tainted characters.

children.text: entrances: Explodes, opening the entrance.
children.raw: {{r|Secret Room}} entrances: Explodes, opening the entrance.

children.raw: If the room has nothing to interact with, the ghost will disappear without doing anything.

interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Does not increase the ghost's damage when attacking enemies.

interactions.raw: {{i|Restock}}: Stolen items will not be restocked, even in [[Greed Mode]].

interactions.raw: {{I|Sack Head}}: If Mr. ME! successfully stole a consumable from the shop, there is a chance he will drop a sack instead.

name: Angelic Prism
description: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

effects.text: Spawns an orbital familiar with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.
effects.raw: Spawns an [[orbital familiar]] with a large orbital radius. Tears that pass through the prism split into four multi-colored tears.

synergies.text: Akeldama: Turns the chain of tears into four multi-colored chains.
synergies.raw: {{I|Akeldama}}: Turns the chain of tears into four multi-colored chains.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears that are floating in the air when they hit the prism will quadruple but will not move. Tears that begin moving before they hit the prism will travel outwards normally.
synergies.raw: {{i|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears that are floating in the air when they hit the prism will quadruple but will not move. Tears that begin moving before they hit the prism will travel outwards normally.

children.text: By releasing the built up tears as the prism passes by, significantly more tears can be affected than normal.
children.raw: By releasing the built up tears as the prism passes by, significantly more tears can be affected than normal.

children.text: With Flat Stone, split suspended tears will bounce in place until their duration ends.
children.raw: With {{i|Flat Stone}}, split suspended tears will bounce in place until their duration ends.

synergies.text: Duct Tape: By keeping the prism in the same spot, damage output can be significantly increased in that direction.
synergies.raw: {{T|Duct Tape}}: By keeping the prism in the same spot, damage output can be significantly increased in that direction.

children.text: Duct Tape + Incubus: By stacking the incubus familiar on top of the prism before picking up Duct Tape, the shots will be affected no matter what direction Isaac is firing.
children.raw: '''Duct Tape''' + {{i|Incubus}}: By stacking the incubus familiar on top of the prism before picking up Duct Tape, the shots will be affected no matter what direction Isaac is firing.

synergies.text: Immaculate Heart: The extra spectral tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
synergies.raw: {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: The extra spectral tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.

synergies.text: Jacob's Ladder: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, electric arcs that pass through the prism will be split.
synergies.raw: {{i|Jacob's Ladder}}: All of the split tears will be electrified. Also, electric arcs that pass through the prism will be split.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: While the tear is in contact with the prism, it will fire 4 additional tears in cardinal directions at Isaac's tear rate.

synergies.text: Saturnus: Since the prism and the orbiting tears have the exact same orbital radius, orbiting tears will immediately be split into 28 multi-colored tears upon entering a room.
synergies.raw: {{I|Saturnus}}: Since the prism and the orbiting tears have the exact same orbital radius, orbiting tears will immediately be split into 28 multi-colored tears upon entering a room.

synergies.text: Tractor Beam: Tears will split but continue stacked on top of each other along the tractor beam, essentially quadrupling the shot's damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Tears will split but continue stacked on top of each other along the tractor beam, essentially quadrupling the shot's damage.

interactions.text: Bot Fly: Its tears are split in four.
interactions.raw: {{i|Bot Fly}}: Its tears are split in four.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Only a visual size change, with no difference in the hitbox and thus usefulness of the Prism.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Only a visual size change, with no difference in the hitbox and thus usefulness of the Prism.

interactions.text: Brimstone / Revelation / Salvation / Shoop da Whoop! / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2: The laser is split in four.
interactions.raw: {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Revelation}} / {{i|Salvation}} / {{I|Shoop da Whoop!}} / {{I|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: The laser is split in four.

interactions.text: C Section: Fetuses split in four.
interactions.raw: {{I|C Section}}: Fetuses split in four.

interactions.text: Chaos Card: Four cards are shot out if Chaos Card hits the prism.
interactions.raw: {{p|Chaos Card}}: Four cards are shot out if Chaos Card hits the prism.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Epic Fetus}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Eraser: The Eraser splits, like normal tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eraser}}: The Eraser splits, like normal tears.

interactions.text: The duplicated knives deal full damage and return to Isaac normally.
interactions.raw: {{Dlc|r}} The duplicated knives deal full damage and return to Isaac normally.

interactions.text: My Reflection: Tears made by the prism will not quadruple once more if they hit the prism again.
interactions.raw: {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears made by the prism will not quadruple once more if they hit the prism again.

interactions.text: Proptosis: Tears that hit the prism will continue to shrink as normal even after they split until they disappear.
interactions.raw: {{i|Proptosis}}: Tears that hit the prism will continue to shrink as normal even after they split until they disappear.

interactions.text: Rocket in a Jar: Rockets do not split, unless its paired with Dr. Fetus, and even then only normal attacks are affected.
interactions.raw: {{I|Rocket in a Jar}}: Rockets do not split, unless its paired with Dr. Fetus, and even then only normal attacks are affected.

interactions.text: Rubber Cement: Tears will split and will bounce if they hit a wall. However, if split tears hit the prism, they will not split again.
interactions.raw: {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Tears will split and will bounce if they hit a wall. However, if split tears hit the prism, they will not split again.

interactions.text: Sharp Key: Key projectiles can split through the prism.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sharp Key}}: Key projectiles can split through the prism.

interactions.text: Tech X: Laser rings are split into four.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tech X}}: Laser rings are split into four.

interactions.text: Tiny Planet: Tears that hit the prism will quadruple, but all four tears will overlap and follow the same orbit.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Tears that hit the prism will quadruple, but all four tears will overlap and follow the same orbit.

interactions.text: Urn of Souls: The flames split into four multicolored flames.
interactions.raw: {{I|Urn of Souls}}: The flames split into four multicolored flames.

name: Pop!
description: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other. The eyeballs are not limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.

effects.text: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other.
effects.raw: Replaces Isaac's tears with eyeballs that can bounce off of each other.

effects.text: Isaac's tears are no longer limited by range, and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.
effects.raw: Isaac's tears are no longer limited by [[range]], and will instead dissipate when they stop moving or when hitting an enemy or obstacle.

effects.text: Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r}} Eyeball tears will start to fall to the ground after bouncing off of each other 8 times.

synergies.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears will force each other out of the way if placed on top of another tear. Releasing the trigger button propels the tears in the direction Isaac was firing at the time before slowing down to a stop.
synergies.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears will force each other out of the way if placed on top of another tear. Releasing the trigger button propels the tears in the direction Isaac was firing at the time before slowing down to a stop.

synergies.text: Azazel/Brimstone/Tainted Azazel/Technology 2: Fires out multiple Pop! tears at the end of the laser, which is dramatically shortened.
synergies.raw: {{c|Azazel|r}}/{{i|Brimstone}}/{{c|Tainted Azazel}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: Fires out multiple Pop! tears at the end of the laser, which is dramatically shortened.

children.text: Brimstone + Tainted Azazel: The beam is shortened to around double the range of Azazel's, while a constant stream of red eyeballs come out of the end.
children.raw: {{i|Brimstone}} + {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam is shortened to around double the range of Azazel's, while a constant stream of red eyeballs come out of the end.

synergies.text: Continuum: The tears will bump into each other, increasing in speed as they go through the room until they dissipate or hit an enemy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Continuum}}: The tears will bump into each other, increasing in speed as they go through the room until they dissipate or hit an enemy.

children.text: Tractor Beam + Continuum: Occasionally, some tears will glitch out of their position for a short while. Contact with an enemy while a glitched tear is on-screen will fling Isaac to a corner of the room. This can potentially cause a softlock if Isaac is blocked by obstacles and does not have How to Jump or flight to escape. Bombs will not work either, as the explosion will not trigger despite the sound of one playing once the bomb sets off.
children.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}} + '''Continuum''': Occasionally, some tears will glitch out of their position for a short while. Contact with an enemy while a glitched tear is on-screen will fling Isaac to a corner of the room. This can potentially cause a softlock if Isaac is blocked by obstacles and does not have {{i|How to Jump}} or flight to escape. Bombs will not work either, as the explosion will not trigger despite the sound of one playing once the bomb sets off.<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=miHh3IdfNM4</ref>

synergies.text: Compound Fracture/Cricket's Body: Split tears can also be knocked around.
synergies.raw: {{i|Compound Fracture}}/{{i|Cricket's Body}}: Split tears can also be knocked around.

synergies.text: Eye of the Occult: Tears will continuously try to follow the crosshair, virtually extending their lifespan ad infinitum until they hit an enemy or obstacle. This can cause tears to quickly fill the room.
synergies.raw: {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Tears will continuously try to follow the crosshair, virtually extending their lifespan ad infinitum until they hit an enemy or obstacle. This can cause tears to quickly fill the room.

synergies.text: Godhead: Tears gain a damaging aura and become damaging aura fields.
synergies.raw: {{i|Godhead}}: Tears gain a damaging aura and become damaging aura fields.

children.text: Godhead + A Lump of Coal: Tears will quickly fill up the screen and increase in damage, easily killing any enemy.
children.raw: '''Godhead''' + {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Tears will quickly fill up the screen and increase in damage, easily killing any enemy.

synergies.text: Haemolacria: Tears fire a burst of smaller tears in random directions when hitting an obstacle or stopping and falling to the ground.
synergies.raw: {{i|Haemolacria}}: Tears fire a burst of smaller tears in random directions when hitting an obstacle or stopping and falling to the ground.

synergies.text: Immaculate Heart: Tears that orbit Isaac will be constantly moving and therefore will never disappear until they hit an enemy or Isaac leaves the room. Filling the orbit with enough tears can potentially cause a chaotic, vibrating ring of eyeballs enveloping Isaac as the tears constantly collide with one another.
synergies.raw: {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: Tears that orbit Isaac will be constantly moving and therefore will never disappear until they hit an enemy or Isaac leaves the room. Filling the orbit with enough tears can potentially cause a chaotic, vibrating ring of eyeballs enveloping Isaac as the tears constantly collide with one another.

synergies.text: Ipecac: Tears do not arc and will instead shoot straight. They retain their explosive abilities on impact with enemies or obstacles, or when they eventually fall. Tears also do not explode when bouncing off of each other, which can be used to propel the high-powered tears to other enemies.
synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears do not arc and will instead shoot straight. They retain their explosive abilities on impact with enemies or obstacles, or when they eventually fall.  Tears also do not explode when bouncing off of each other, which can be used to propel the high-powered tears to other enemies.

synergies.text: Lead Pencil/Monstro's Lung: Removes the arcing effect from the tears, greatly increasing air time. The tight cluster the tears are shot in will cause unpredictable spread, however.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lead Pencil}}/{{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Removes the arcing effect from the tears, greatly increasing air time. The tight cluster the tears are shot in will cause unpredictable spread, however.

synergies.text: A Lump of Coal: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.
synergies.raw: {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: Tears will increase their damage and size as they travel, and they are not limited by range.

synergies.text: My Reflection: Tears constantly swarm around Isaac, quickly filling the room.
synergies.raw: {{i|My Reflection}}: Tears constantly swarm around Isaac, quickly filling the room.

synergies.text: The Parasite: When tears hit an enemy, obstacle, or wall, they split into many smaller tears that have the same behavior as eyeball tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Parasite}}: When tears hit an enemy, obstacle, or wall, they split into many smaller tears that have the same behavior as eyeball tears.

synergies.text: Rubber Cement: Allows tears to never disappear when hitting enemies and objects, increasing the uptime of tears greatly.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rubber Cement}}: Allows tears to never disappear when hitting enemies and objects, increasing the uptime of tears greatly.

children.text: Rubber Cement + A Lump Of Coal: Tears continuously increase in size and damage as they bounce endlessly around the room. Eventually the damage can be enough to kill bosses in a single frame.
children.raw: '''Rubber Cement''' + '''A Lump Of Coal''': Tears continuously increase in size and damage as they bounce endlessly around the room. Eventually the damage can be enough to kill bosses in a single frame.

synergies.text: Tech.5/Technology/Technology 2: The laser's range is drastically reduced, and an eyeball is created at the end of the laser each shot.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}: The laser's range is drastically reduced, and an eyeball is created at the end of the laser each shot.

children.text: Technology + Monstro's Lung Lung will fire laser beams as normal, but Pop eyeballs will appaear at the tail end of every shot, including obstacles hit by the beams.
children.raw: {{dlc|r}}{{i|Technology}} + {{i|Monstro's Lung}} Lung will fire laser beams as normal, but Pop eyeballs will appaear at the tail end of every shot, including obstacles hit by the beams.

synergies.text: Tiny Planet: With enough tears and/or fire rate, the Pop! tears can constantly collide with each other, causing them to orbit Isaac indefinitely.
synergies.raw: {{dlc|r}} {{I|Tiny Planet}}: With enough tears and/or fire rate, the Pop! tears can constantly collide with each other, causing them to orbit Isaac indefinitely.

synergies.raw: {{i|Trisagion|r}}: Every damage tick will shoot out a Pop! tear making this synergy a potent combination. Trisagion shots will also hover in the air longer than normal.

interactions.text: Angelic Prism: The Prism will split eyeballs that it passes over.
interactions.raw: {{i|Angelic Prism}}: The Prism will split eyeballs that it passes over.

interactions.raw: {{I|C Section|r}}: Fetuses' movements do not extend their lifespan, it is still limited by Range. Fetuses do not fall after bouncing off of each other 8 times.

interactions.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Pop!.

interactions.raw: {{I|Immaculate Heart}}: Tears will be blocked by orbiting the eyeballs, severely reducing damage output.

interactions.text: Flat Stone: Eyeball tears bounce repeatedly against the floor when they're about to disappear.
interactions.raw: {{i|Flat Stone}}: Eyeball tears bounce repeatedly against the floor when they're about to disappear.

interactions.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Overridden by The Ludovico Technique, though the tear looks like an eyeball.

interactions.raw: {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Chance of tears to bounce off each other when the first tear is eaten or the tear bursting.

interactions.raw: {{I|Sinus Infection}}: Boogers that are stuck to enemies will cause other tears to bounce off them, making the enemy unable to be hit from that side until the boogers dissipate.

interactions.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Tears can now only knock each other forward.

name: Death's List
description: Grants a pickup or stat upgrade if all enemies in a room are killed in the order they are marked.

effects.text: Upon entering a room, a skull appears over an enemy's head.
effects.raw: Upon entering a room, a skull appears over an enemy's head.

children.text: The marked enemy will have a bigger shadow.
children.raw: The marked enemy will have a bigger shadow.

children.text: Killing the marked enemy will cause the skull to move to a different enemy.
children.raw: Killing the marked enemy will cause the skull to move to a different enemy.

children.text: If all enemies in the room are cleared in the order they are marked, Isaac gains one of the following rewards at random:
children.raw: If all enemies in the room are cleared in the order they are marked, Isaac gains one of the following rewards at random:

children.text: A Soul Heart, a pill, a Key, a Bomb, or a Nickel.
children.raw: A {{e|Soul Heart}}, a [[pill]], a {{e|Key}}, a {{e|Bomb}}, or a {{e|Nickel}}.

children.text: +0.2 speed, +0.5 range, +0.5 fire rate, +0.2 shot speed, +1 flat damage, or +1 luck.
children.raw: +0.2 [[speed]], +0.5 [[range]], {{dlc|nr}} +0.5 [[tears]], {{dlc|r}} +0.5 [[fire rate]], +0.2 [[shot speed]], +1 flat [[damage]], or +1 [[luck]].

children.text: If a non-marked enemy is killed, the skull will disappear and no bonuses will be granted for that room.

synergies.raw: {{i|Camo Undies}}: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely zap enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.

synergies.text: Isaac's Heart: 120 Volt becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Isaac's Heart}}: 120 Volt becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.

synergies.text: Items granting invulnerability or a shield: 120 Volt zaps enemies while Isaac is invincible.
synergies.raw: Items granting [[invulnerability]] or a [[shield]]: 120 Volt zaps enemies while Isaac is invincible.

children.text: This includes Gnawed Leaf, allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
children.raw: This includes {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}, allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.

children.text: Dark Arts: Enemies and bosses will be zapped while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.
children.raw: {{i|Dark Arts}}: Enemies and bosses will be zapped while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.

synergies.text: Pause: Zaps will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Pause}}: Zaps will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.

synergies.text: Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten zaps enemies, allowing Tainted Soul to damage enemies from a safe distance.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Forgotten zaps enemies, allowing {{c|Tainted Soul}} to damage enemies from a safe distance.

interactions.text: Ipecac: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40 from Ipecac. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: The zaps get only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40 from Ipecac. The 0.75x-1.5x damage multiplier applies afterwards.

interactions.text: Libra: The zaps ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
interactions.raw: {{i|Libra}}: The zaps ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

interactions.text: Mine Crafter: The TNT is spawned and then instantly detonated by 120 Volt's electric shock, inflicting 1 full heart of damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|Mine Crafter}}: The TNT is spawned and then instantly detonated by 120 Volt's electric shock, inflicting 1 full heart of damage.

name: It Hurts
description: Releases a ring of tears and increases fire rate for the current room when Isaac takes damage. Isaac's tears also leave pools of red creep for the rest of the room.

effects.text: Taking damage causes Isaac to release a ring of 10 tears and gain tears up for the current room. For the rest of the room, Isaac's tears, including the initial ring of tears, leave pools of red creep where they land.
effects.raw: Taking damage causes Isaac to release a ring of 10 tears and gain [[tears]] up for the current room. {{dlc|r+}} For the rest of the room, Isaac's tears, including the initial ring of tears, leave pools of [[red creep]] where they land.

children.text: The first hit taken increases Isaac's tears fired per second by 1.2, then by 0.4 for every subsequent hit in the same room. This ignores the tears cap and can stack indefinitely.
children.raw: The first hit taken increases Isaac's tears fired per second by 1.2, then by 0.4 for every subsequent hit in the same room. This ignores the tears cap and can stack indefinitely.

children.text: Each tear in the ring deals 10 damage and doesn't use Isaac's tear effects.
children.raw: Each tear in the ring deals 10 damage and doesn't use Isaac's tear effects.

interactions.text: Varicose Veins: Two rings of tears are released at once.
interactions.raw: {{i|Varicose Veins}}: Two rings of tears are released at once.

name: Almond Milk
description: Quadruples fire rate, with ×0.3 damage multiplier. Each tear is given a random effect that alters its movement.

effects.text: Quadruples fire rate.
effects.raw: Quadruples [[fire rate]].

effects.text: ×0.3 damage multiplier.
effects.raw: ×0.3 [[damage]] multiplier.

effects.text: -0.16 tear size.
effects.raw: -0.16 tear size.

effects.text: Each tear gains the effects of either Flat Worm, Pulse Worm, Wiggle Worm, Hook Worm, Ring Worm, Whip Worm, Lazy Worm, Tape Worm, Ouroboros Worm, Brain Worm, Rubber Cement, My Reflection or Tiny Planet at random.
effects.raw: Each tear gains the effects of either {{T|Flat Worm}}, {{T|Pulse Worm}}, {{T|Wiggle Worm}}, {{T|Hook Worm}}, {{T|Ring Worm}}, {{T|Whip Worm}}, {{T|Lazy Worm}}, {{T|Tape Worm}}, {{T|Ouroboros Worm}}, {{T|Brain Worm}}, {{I|Rubber Cement}}, {{I|My Reflection}} or {{I|Tiny Planet}} at random.

children.text: Some tears may have multiple effects at once.
children.raw: Some tears may have multiple effects at once.

children.text: These inherit the movement, shot speed, range, and spectral effects, but not changes to tears or damage.
children.raw: These inherit the movement, [[shot speed]], [[range]], and [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral]] effects, but not changes to [[tears]] or [[damage]].

synergies.text: Brimstone / Azazel / Tainted Azazel: The beam will fire continuously as long as the fire button is held and can be aimed in any direction. It shuffles through the worm effects rapidly.
synergies.raw: {{i|Brimstone}} / {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel}}: The beam will fire continuously as long as the fire button is held and can be aimed in any direction. It shuffles through the worm effects rapidly.

synergies.text: Chocolate Milk / Cursed Eye / Monstro's Lung / Tech X: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge.
synergies.raw: {{i|Chocolate Milk}} / {{i|Cursed Eye}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}} / {{i|Tech X}}: Fires automatically upon reaching full charge.

children.text: Tech X overrides the worm trinket effects.
children.raw: Tech X overrides the worm trinket effects.

synergies.text: Tractor Beam: All tears now travel along the beam, improving overall accuracy and DPS.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: All tears now travel along the beam, improving overall accuracy and DPS.

interactions.text: Soy Milk: Overridden by Almond Milk (no additional effect on tears or damage).
interactions.raw: {{i|Soy Milk}}: Overridden by Almond Milk (no additional effect on tears or damage).

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique: The tear will rapidly teleport in a small area around it, making it difficult to aim.
interactions.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: The tear will rapidly teleport in a small area around it, making it difficult to aim.

name: Rock Bottom
description: Prevents Isaac's attributes from being lowered.

effects.text: Prevents Isaac's attributes from falling below their highest values reached.
effects.raw: Prevents Isaac's [[attributes]] from falling below their highest values reached.

children.text: Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.
children.raw: Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use Isaac's current stats, items and effects will impact Isaac the same way they would as if he did not have Rock Bottom.

synergies.text: 20/20 / The Inner Eye / Mutant Spider / Conjoined: Multiple tears will be shot without the source's respective stat downgrades. The damage and tear multipliers will still affect future stat ups.
synergies.raw: {{i|20/20}} / {{i|The Inner Eye}} / {{i|Mutant Spider}} / [[Conjoined]]: Multiple tears will be shot without the source's respective stat downgrades. The damage and tear multipliers will still affect future stat ups.

synergies.text: Azazel's Stump: Isaac will keep Azazel’s base stats after transforming back. This includes 1.25 base speed, +0.5 tears per second, and a 1.5× damage. The tear delay multiplier will not be given, including while Isaac is Azazel.
synergies.raw: {{t|Azazel's Stump}}: Isaac will keep Azazel’s base stats after transforming back. This includes 1.25 base speed, +0.5 tears per second, and a 1.5× damage. The tear delay multiplier will not be given, including while Isaac is Azazel.

synergies.text: Berserk!: +3 flat damage and +0.4 speed last indefinitely. Will also give a tears up if (½ tears fired per second + 2), unless Isaac’s tears fired per second is already 4 or higher.
synergies.raw: {{i|Berserk!}}: +3 flat damage and +0.4 speed last indefinitely. Will also give a tears up if (½ tears fired per second + 2), unless Isaac’s tears fired per second is already 4 or higher.

synergies.text: Binge Eater: Speed down from picking up food items no longer applies, and all temporary stat boosts are permanent.
synergies.raw: {{i|Binge Eater}}: Speed down from picking up food items no longer applies, and all temporary stat boosts are permanent.

synergies.text: Brimstone / Chocolate Milk / Monstro's Lung: Charged shot can be fired at Isaac’s normal fire rate.
synergies.raw: {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Chocolate Milk}} / {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Charged shot can be fired at Isaac’s normal fire rate.

synergies.text: VII - The Chariot?: The 4x fire rate bonus from the card makes it possible to reach and keep extremely high values.
synergies.raw: {{p|VII - The Chariot?}}: The 4x fire rate bonus from the card makes it possible to reach and keep extremely high values.

synergies.text: Clicker: Will keep stat bonuses from items removed, and will retain the best stats of all characters that are cycled through.
synergies.raw: {{i|Clicker}}: Will keep stat bonuses from items removed, and will retain the best stats of all characters that are cycled through.

synergies.text: D8 / Cracked Dice: With repeated use, 1.5-2× higher values can be applied to Isaac’s speed, tears, range, and damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|D8}} / {{t|Cracked Dice}}: With repeated use, 1.5-2× higher values can be applied to Isaac’s speed, tears, range, and damage.

synergies.text: Dataminer: If one overflows Isaac's tear rate to 120 before picking up Rock Bottom, the tear rate stays at 120.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dataminer}}: If one overflows Isaac's tear rate to 120 before picking up Rock Bottom, the tear rate stays at 120.

synergies.text: Deck of Cards /Ace of Spades: Allows for more cards to spawn, which can then all be used in the same room to maximize stats gained.
synergies.raw: {{I|Deck of Cards}} /{{t|Ace of Spades}}: Allows for more cards to spawn, which can then all be used in the same room to maximize stats gained.

synergies.text: Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: Gives 2× damage multiplier without immediate reduction to tears or shot speed.
synergies.raw: {{i|Eve's Mascara}} / {{i|Polyphemus}}: Gives 2× damage multiplier without immediate reduction to tears or shot speed.

synergies.text: False PHD: When using a pill applies only the damage up with no downside.
synergies.raw: {{I|False PHD}}: When using a pill applies only the damage up with no downside.

synergies.text: The Forgotten / The Soul: Allows transfer of stat-ups between the two. For example, collecting Ipecac as The Forgotten doesn't give him the +40 damage boost, but it does give it to The Soul. Switching to the Soul, then switching back to the Forgotten prevents him from losing the +40 damage.
synergies.raw: {{c|The Forgotten}} / {{c|The Soul}}: Allows transfer of stat-ups between the two. For example, collecting Ipecac as The Forgotten doesn't give him the +40 damage boost, but it does give it to The Soul. Switching to the Soul, then switching back to the Forgotten prevents him from losing the +40 damage.

synergies.text: Ipecac: Gives Isaac a massive damage up without the tears down.
synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Gives Isaac a massive damage up without the tears down.

children.text: Ipecac + Brimstone / Tech X: If Ipecac is taken before Brimstone / Tech X, its full damage up is applied to the beam/ring properly, but if the order of the items is reversed, Ipecac will only give +2 damage.
children.raw: {{i|Ipecac}} + {{i|Brimstone}} / {{i|Tech X}}: If Ipecac is taken before Brimstone / Tech X, its full damage up is applied to the beam/ring properly, but if the order of the items is reversed, Ipecac will only give +2 damage.

synergies.text: Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: Only the character that has Rock Bottom will be immune to stat downgrades.
synergies.raw: {{c|Jacob and Esau}} / {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: Only the character that has Rock Bottom will be immune to stat downgrades.

synergies.text: Jupiter: The +0.5 speed boost becomes permanent, turning Jupiter into a +0.2 speed up. Farts made while moving still must be charged by standing still.
synergies.raw: {{i|Jupiter}}: The +0.5 speed boost becomes permanent, turning Jupiter into a +0.2 speed up. Farts made while moving still must be charged by standing still.

synergies.text: Kidney Stone: Permanently gives Isaac a ×6 fire rate multiplier after firing a kidney stone. Accuracy penalty from firing kidney stones is unaffected.
synergies.raw: {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Permanently gives Isaac a ×6 fire rate multiplier after firing a kidney stone. Accuracy penalty from firing kidney stones is unaffected.

synergies.text: Libra: Stat balancing applies after Rock Bottom.
synergies.raw: {{i|Libra}}: Stat balancing applies after Rock Bottom.

synergies.text: Metronome: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run. This allows Isaac to potentially accrue a large number of stat upgrades.
synergies.raw: {{i|Metronome}}: Isaac keeps any stat upgrades gained by a random temporary item as long as the item brings his stats over their highest value reached on that run. This allows Isaac to potentially accrue a large number of stat upgrades.

synergies.text: Neptunus: Not affected by Rock Bottom. Fire Rate will decrease normally.
synergies.raw: {{i|Neptunus}}: Not affected by Rock Bottom. Fire Rate will decrease normally.

synergies.text: Perfection: The large luck boost remains even if Perfection is lost.
synergies.raw: {{t|Perfection}}: The large luck boost remains even if Perfection is lost.

synergies.text: Purity: Allows for all stat boosts given by Purity to stay active at the same time.
synergies.raw: {{I|Purity}}: Allows for all stat boosts given by Purity to stay active at the same time.

synergies.text: Red Stew: The +21.6 damage is permanent.
synergies.raw: {{i|Red Stew}}: The +21.6 damage is permanent.

synergies.text: Razor Blade / Golden Razor: Can be used multiple times in one room for a large permanent damage boost.
synergies.raw: {{i|Razor Blade}} / {{i|Golden Razor}}: Can be used multiple times in one room for a large permanent damage boost.

synergies.text: Soy Milk / Almond Milk: Gives Isaac the full tears up while keeping his previous damage; however, the damage divider still applies to any future damage increases.
synergies.raw: {{i|Soy Milk}} / {{i|Almond Milk}}: Gives Isaac the full tears up while keeping his previous damage; however, the damage divider still applies to any future damage increases.

synergies.text: Tainted Eden + Birthright: If Rock Bottom is picked up before Birthright, it is protected from being rerolled, allowing Tainted Eden to retain the highest stats they have reached.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Eden}} + {{i|Birthright}}: If Rock Bottom is picked up before Birthright, it is protected from being rerolled, allowing Tainted Eden to retain the highest stats they have reached.

children.text: This reroll protection is even effective against similar reroll effects such as D4 and Missing No..
children.raw: This reroll protection is even effective against similar reroll effects such as {{i|D4}} and {{i|Missing No.}}.

synergies.text: Tainted Isaac: Prevents any stat from decreasing, letting the effects of picked up items linger even after discarding them. However, raising stats beyond the values reached will be more difficult after leaving the source item, and swapping away Rock Bottom resets them to Tainted Isaac's current set. Picking it up again will not give the stats back.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Isaac}}: Prevents any stat from decreasing, letting the effects of picked up items linger even after discarding them. However, raising stats beyond the values reached will be more difficult after leaving the source item, and swapping away Rock Bottom resets them to Tainted Isaac's current set. Picking it up again will not give the stats back.

synergies.text: Taurus: Prevents Isaac's speed from dropping whenever a room is cleared.
synergies.raw: {{I|Taurus}}: Prevents Isaac's speed from dropping whenever a room is cleared.

name: Nancy Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Each bomb gains 1-4 random bomb synergies.

effects.text: Grants 5 Bombs.
effects.raw: Grants 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.

effects.text: Causes Isaac's bombs to gain the effects of 1-4 random bomb synergies (most commonly 1).
effects.raw: Causes Isaac's bombs to gain the effects of 1-4 random bomb synergies (most commonly 1).

children.text: Aside from normal bomb synergy items, this also includes Bob's Bladder, Strange Attractor, and Golden Bombs (golden bombs will not be free).
children.raw: Aside from normal bomb synergy items, this also includes {{t|Bob's Bladder}}, {{i|Strange Attractor}}, and {{e|Golden Bomb}}s (golden bombs will not be free).

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs have a chance to be affected by Nancy Bombs.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs have a chance to be affected by Nancy Bombs.

interactions.text: Kamikaze!: Gains the effect of a random bomb synergy each time it is used.
interactions.raw: {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Gains the effect of a random bomb synergy each time it is used.

interactions.text: Scatter Bombs: Extra bombs will copy the bomb synergies of the original bomb.
interactions.raw: {{i|Scatter Bombs}}: Extra bombs will copy the bomb synergies of the original bomb.

name: A Bar of Soap
description: +0.5 Tears, +0.2 Shot Speed.

effects.text: +0.5 Tears.
+0.2 Shot Speed.
effects.raw: +0.2 [[Shot Speed]].

name: Blood Puppy
description: Spawns a familiar that chases enemies. After killing enough enemies, it becomes more powerful but will also try to hurt Isaac. Dealing enough damage to it returns it to normal.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that chases nearby enemies and deals 2 contact damage to them per tick (~8.57 per second).

effects.text: After killing 15 enemies, Blood Puppy becomes angry, and changes in the following ways:
effects.raw: After killing 15 enemies, Blood Puppy becomes angry, and changes in the following ways:

children.text: Deals 7.5 damage per tick instead of 2 (15 per second, or 90 per second while charging).
children.raw: Deals 7.5 damage per tick instead of 2 (15 per second, or 90 per second while charging).

children.text: Charges at enemies that are aligned with it in the cardinal directions.
children.raw: Charges at enemies that are aligned with it in the cardinal directions.

children.text: If Blood Puppy charges into a live Bomb, it will get caught on its mouth, preventing it from moving until it explodes.
children.raw: If Blood Puppy charges into a live {{e|Bomb}}, it will get caught on its mouth, preventing it from moving until it explodes.

children.text: Drops a Half Red Heart for every 10 enemies it kills.
children.raw: Drops a {{e|Half Red Heart}} for every 10 enemies it kills.

children.text: Will also try to attack Isaac, dealing a half heart of contact damage to him.
children.raw: Will also try to attack Isaac, dealing a half heart of contact damage to him.

children.text: Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 armor (effective health is ~140-180).
children.raw: Can be damaged by Isaac, returning it to normal after it takes enough damage. Blood Puppy has 20 health and 90 [[armor]] (effective health is ~140-180).

effects.text: After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications:
effects.raw: After getting 25 more kills (40 total), the angry version evolves, gaining the following modifications:

children.text: Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).
children.raw: Becomes much larger and deals 15 damage per tick instead of 7.5 (30 per second, or 180 per second while charging).

children.text: Destroys obstacles it runs into while charging.
children.raw: Destroys [[obstacle]]s it runs into while charging.

children.text: Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.
children.raw: Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac instead of half a heart.

children.text: Drops a Red Heart after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.
children.raw: Drops a {{e|Red Heart}} after every 10 kills instead of a half red heart.

children.text: Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).
children.raw: Has 50 health instead of 20 (effective health is ~400-500).

effects.text: Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.
effects.raw: Each boss killed by Blood Puppy counts as killing 4 enemies.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Only increases the size and damage of Blood Puppy during its first phase.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Only increases the size and damage of Blood Puppy during its first phase.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Spawns another tamed Blood Puppy.
interactions.raw: {{I|Box of Friends}}: Spawns another tamed Blood Puppy.

interactions.text: C Section: C Section babies do not home on angry Blood Puppy.
interactions.raw: {{I|C Section}}: C Section babies do not home on angry Blood Puppy.

interactions.text: Camo Undies: While the camo effect is active, stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy will not target Isaac, but will still target other enemies.
interactions.raw: {{I|Camo Undies}}: While the camo effect is active, stages 2 and 3 of Blood Puppy will not target Isaac, but will still target other enemies.

interactions.text: Eraser: Using Eraser on Blood Puppy while it's angry will permanently prevent it from advancing to the erased phase. Using it on phase two will prevent it from becoming angry altogether.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eraser}}: Using Eraser on Blood Puppy while it's angry will permanently prevent it from advancing to the erased phase. Using it on phase two will prevent it from becoming angry altogether.

interactions.text: Flush!: Using Flush! will instantly tame an angry Blood Puppy and create a Poop.
interactions.raw: {{I|Flush!}}: Using Flush! will instantly tame an angry Blood Puppy and create a {{e|Poop}}.

interactions.text: Freeze effects: "Killing" an angry Blood Puppy by freezing it will cause it to stay frozen until Isaac touches it or leaves the room, causing the frozen Blood Puppy to revert back to its tamed phase.
interactions.raw: [[Freeze]] effects: "Killing" an angry Blood Puppy by freezing it will cause it to stay frozen until Isaac touches it or leaves the room, causing the frozen Blood Puppy to revert back to its tamed phase.

interactions.text: Friendly Ball: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.
interactions.raw: {{I|Friendly Ball}}: Using the ball on an angered Blood Puppy will instantly tame it. Using the ball again results in a purely cosmetic blood explosion.

interactions.text: Friendly enemies: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies; however, friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
interactions.raw: [[Friendly]] enemies: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies; however, friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

interactions.text: GB Bug: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.
interactions.raw: {{i|GB Bug}}: Hitting Blood Puppy with GB Bug will transform it into a random enemy and spawn a tamed Blood Puppy.

interactions.text: God's Flesh: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.
interactions.raw: {{i|God's Flesh}}: If an angry Blood Puppy is shot with a God's Flesh tear, Isaac can instantly change it back to a tamed Blood Puppy by touching it.

interactions.text: Humbleing Bundle: Allows an angry Blood Puppy to drop Double Hearts.
interactions.raw: {{I|Humbleing Bundle}}: Allows an angry Blood Puppy to drop {{e|Double Heart}}s.

interactions.text: Meat Cleaver: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.
interactions.raw: {{i|Meat Cleaver}}: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

interactions.text: Spider Mod: An angry Blood Puppy can be inflicted with a random status effect if the spider comes into contact with it.
interactions.raw: {{i|Spider Mod}}: An angry Blood Puppy can be inflicted with a random [[status effect]] if the spider comes into contact with it.

children.text: Status effects will persist through multiple rooms.
children.raw: Status effects will persist through multiple rooms.

interactions.text: Using Horse Pill Pheromones on angry Blood Puppy will make it friendly until it becomes angrier or dies, preventing it from dealing damage to Isaac.
interactions.raw: Using Horse Pill Pheromones on angry Blood Puppy will make it friendly until it becomes angrier or dies, preventing it from dealing damage to Isaac.

name: Dream Catcher
description: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the contents of the upcoming floor's , as well as the floor's boss. Grants a Half Soul Heart when entering a new floor.

effects.text: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the item that will be found in the and what Boss will be at the end of the floor.
effects.raw: During the transition between floors, Isaac's nightmare shows the item that will be found in the {{r|Treasure Room}} and what [[Boss]] will be at the end of the floor.

children.text: items will be revealed, as well as the hidden second item on the alternate floors (Downpour, etc.)
children.raw: {{cu|Blind}} items will be revealed, as well as the hidden second item on the alternate floors ({{s|Downpour}}, etc.)

effects.text: Grants a Half Soul Heart upon entering a new floor (this includes each floor of the Ascent).
effects.raw: Grants a {{e|Half Soul Heart}} upon entering a new floor (this includes each floor of the [[Ascent]]).

synergies.text: Book of Revelations: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, therefore Book of Revelations can be used early, as the downside is no longer relevant.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Revelations}}: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the [[The Harbingers|horsemen]], therefore Book of Revelations can be used early, as the downside is no longer relevant.

synergies.text: Satanic Bible: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, and if the player has no interest in the Cube of Meat or doesn't mind paying health for it, Satanic Bible can be used early.
synergies.raw: {{i|Satanic Bible}}: If the floor boss is revealed to be one of the horsemen, and if the player has no interest in the {{i|Cube of Meat}} or doesn't mind paying health for it, Satanic Bible can be used early.

interactions.text: Devil's Crown: Dream Catcher will show what the Treasure Room will have if Isaac chooses to enter the room without the crown.
interactions.raw: {{t|Devil's Crown}}: Dream Catcher will show what the Treasure Room will have if Isaac chooses to enter the room without the crown.

interactions.text: Found Soul: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.
interactions.raw: {{t|Found Soul}}: The soul will receive half a soul heart for every new floor he follows Isaac to, allowing him to survive multiple hits and gather up to a maximum of 12 soul hearts. His health resets when the trinket is dropped.

interactions.text: More Options + Downpour / Dross, etc.: Dream Catcher will not show the third item if going to the alternate floors.
interactions.raw: {{I|More Options}} + {{s|Downpour}} / {{s|Dross}}, etc.: Dream Catcher will not show the third item if going to the alternate floors.

children.raw: Enemies pushed into walls or [[obstacles]] take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.

children.raw: Homing projectiles (e.g. from {{E|Psychic Horf}}) do not retain their homing effect after being reflected.

children.text: Does not reflect:
children.raw: Does not reflect:

children.raw: Projectiles from {{E|Big Bony}}, {{E|Coal Boy}}, {{E|Danny}}.

effects.raw: The shield lasts 1 second and has a cooldown of 3 seconds.

name: Blood Oath
description: Stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor, draining his Red Hearts. Increases damage and speed for the floor based on the amount drained.

effects.text: Spawns a familiar that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each floor if Isaac has more than a Half Red Heart. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.
effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that stabs Isaac at the beginning of each [[floor]] if Isaac has more than a {{e|Half Red Heart}}. This drains as much red health as possible without killing him, leaving a half red heart if Isaac only had red health, or none at all if Isaac has soul/black/bone hearts.

effects.text: For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is quadratic, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.
effects.raw: For the rest of the floor, Isaac gains extra damage and speed for each heart lost. The amount of damage gained this way is quadratic, so each heart lost will provide a bigger bonus than the last.

children.text: The exact formula is about +(0.15 * HeartsLost ^ 2) damage and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) speed, where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).
children.raw: The exact formula is about +(0.15 <!-- exactly 20/132.25 --> * HeartsLost ^ 2) [[damage]] and +(0.1 * HeartsLost) [[speed]], where HeartsLost is the total hearts of damage taken from Blood Oath (half a heart counts as 0.5).

synergies.text: Adrenaline: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.
synergies.raw: {{i|Adrenaline}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline for the resulting empty heart containers at the start of each floor.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Adds 2 full hearts' worth of bonuses if any health is drained at all, e.g. losing 1 heart gives the bonuses of 3 hearts. This allows for up to 14 hearts' worth of bonuses.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}}: Adds 2 full hearts' worth of bonuses if any health is drained at all, e.g. losing 1 heart gives the bonuses of 3 hearts. This allows for up to 14 hearts' worth of bonuses.

children.text: 14 hearts' bonus gives +29.6 damage and +1.4 Speed.
children.raw: 14 hearts' bonus gives +29.6 damage and +1.4 Speed.

synergies.text: Damage-triggered items: Activate a number of times equal to the total half hearts drained.
synergies.raw: [[:Category:Damage-triggered items|Damage-triggered items]]: Activate a number of times equal to the total half hearts drained.

children.text: Does not activate the Panic Button trinket.
children.raw: Does ''not'' activate the {{T|Panic Button}} trinket.

children.raw: {{i|Bozo}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a rainbow poop, allowing for full red heart regeneration.

children.raw: {{i|Gimpy}} / {{i|Old Bandage}} / {{i|Shard of Glass}}: Each half-heart lost has a chance of spawning a full red/soul heart, allowing Isaac to heal back some of the damage immediately if he has high luck or a large amount of hearts lost.

children.raw: {{i|Scapular}}: Gives Isaac a soul heart if he had only red heart containers upon entering a floor.

synergies.raw: {{i|The Jar}}: Red hearts can be stored for use on the next floor.
