interactions.raw: {{I|Brimstone}} + {{I|Twisted Pair}}: Twisted pair will only fire brimstone when the crosshair is moved.

interactions.text: Brimstone + Taurus: When Taurus' effect triggers, Isaac will be unable to move the crosshair, but he'll keep firing the Brimstone laser at wherever the crosshair remained before Taurus triggered, effectively circumventing Taurus' penalty of being unable to fire during the invincibility period.
interactions.raw: {{I|Brimstone}} + {{i|Taurus}}: When Taurus' effect triggers, Isaac will be unable to move the crosshair, but he'll keep firing the Brimstone laser at wherever the crosshair remained before Taurus triggered, effectively circumventing Taurus' penalty of being unable to fire during the invincibility period.

interactions.text: Chocolate Milk: Not Recommended. Releasing the key to fire tears will stop the tear's movement, making it difficult to shoot enemies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Not Recommended. Releasing the key to fire tears will stop the tear's movement, making it difficult to shoot enemies.

interactions.text: C Section/Epic Fetus/Mom's Knife: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.
interactions.raw: {{i|C Section}}/{{i|Epic Fetus}}/{{i|Mom's Knife}}: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.

interactions.text: Cursed Eye: The tears stack on top of each other, and only move forward when holding a direction afterwards.
interactions.raw: {{i|Cursed Eye}}: The tears stack on top of each other, and only move forward when holding a direction afterwards.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus: Bombs will now be controlled both in direction and range.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Bombs will now be controlled both in direction and range.

interactions.text: Evil Eye: Eyes cannot be controlled, but the tears they shoot can be.
interactions.raw: {{i|Evil Eye}}: Eyes cannot be controlled, but the tears they shoot can be.

interactions.text: Homing Tears: Tears still home towards enemies, but controlled movement is stronger than the homing effect.
interactions.raw: [[Tear Effects#Homing|Homing Tears]]: Tears still home towards enemies, but controlled movement is stronger than the homing effect.

interactions.text: Immaculate Heart: Extra tears are not affected by Eye of the Occult. Stat changes still apply.
interactions.raw: {{I|Immaculate Heart}}: Extra tears are not affected by Eye of the Occult. Stat changes still apply.

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique + Technology: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.
interactions.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}} + {{i|Technology}}: Overrides Eye of the Occult, stat effects still apply.

interactions.text: My Reflection: Causes the pull to be lessened while actively controlling the tears. Pull returns to normal when not firing.
interactions.raw: {{i|My Reflection}}: Causes the pull to be lessened while actively controlling the tears. Pull returns to normal when not firing.

interactions.text: Pop!: When being actively moved, tears can stay in the air until the fire button is let go.
interactions.raw: {{i|Pop!}}: When being actively moved, tears can stay in the air until the fire button is let go.

interactions.text: Saturnus: Extra tears are only affected by Eye of the Occult when holding fire while moving between rooms causing some of the orbiting tears' spacing and shot speed to be uneven. Stat changes still apply.
interactions.raw: {{I|Saturnus}}: Extra tears are only affected by Eye of the Occult when holding fire while moving between rooms causing some of the orbiting tears' spacing and shot speed to be uneven. Stat changes still apply.

interactions.text: Sprinkler: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sprinkler}}: Sprinkler's tears travel a very short distance in their original direction and can be controlled afterwards.

interactions.text: Tech X: Overrides Eye of the Occult; however, the shot speed down is still beneficial for Tech X.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tech X}}: Overrides Eye of the Occult; however, the shot speed down is still beneficial for Tech X.

interactions.text: Tiny Planet: Not Recommended. The tears will stop moving when not shooting in the direction of their orbit, making it nearly impossible to control where they go.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tiny Planet}}: Not Recommended. The tears will stop moving when not shooting in the direction of their orbit, making it nearly impossible to control where they go.

interactions.text: Tractor Beam: Tears will only move forward while being fired, but control is otherwise overridden.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Tears will only move forward while being fired, but control is otherwise overridden.

name: Immaculate Heart
description: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully restores health. x1.2 damage multiplier. Isaac will occasionally fire extra tears that orbit around him.

effects.text: Isaac will frequently fire extra spectral tears that orbit around him until they hit the ground, similar to Tiny Planet. These tears mimic Isaac's in most cases.
effects.raw: Isaac will frequently fire extra [[spectral tears]] that orbit around him until they hit the ground, similar to {{i|Tiny Planet}}. These tears mimic Isaac's in most cases.

effects.text: x1.2 damage multiplier. This multiplier does not stack with multiple Immaculate Hearts.
effects.raw: x1.2 [[damage]] multiplier. This multiplier does not stack with multiple Immaculate Hearts.

effects.text: Adds one Red Heart Container and fully replenishes Isaac's health.
effects.raw: Adds one Red [[Heart Container]] and fully replenishes Isaac's health.

effects.text: Counts towards the Seraphim transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: The extra tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.
synergies.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: The extra tears share the same orbit as Angelic Prism, making them very easy to split.

synergies.text: Chemical Peel: Some of the orbiting tears will gain Chemical Peel's 2 flat damage bonus.
synergies.raw: {{I|Chemical Peel}}: Some of the orbiting tears will gain Chemical Peel's 2 flat damage bonus.

synergies.text: Chocolate Milk: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Orbiting tears' damage does not depend on the charge of Chocolate Milk, so Isaac can shoot low damage tears rapidly to produce a large number of orbiting tears which do full damage.

synergies.text: Death's Touch: Death's Touch tear modification will also affect the orbiting tears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Death's Touch}}: Death's Touch tear modification will also affect the orbiting tears.

synergies.text: Eye of Belial: Orbiting tears get piercing and homing on nearby enemies on contact, and return orbiting after no targets left.
synergies.raw: {{I|Eye of Belial}}: Orbiting tears get piercing and homing on nearby enemies on contact, and return orbiting after no targets left.

synergies.text: Haemolacria: The orbiting tears will be affected by Haemolacria but the tears created upon hit will not orbit.
synergies.raw: {{I|Haemolacria}}: The orbiting tears will be affected by Haemolacria but the tears created upon hit will not orbit.

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: Lachryphagy will affect the orbiting tears and become bigger when in contact with other tears. The Lachryphagy tears will split upon hit and the split shots will orbit around the point where the original tear had split.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Lachryphagy will affect the orbiting tears and become bigger when in contact with other tears. The Lachryphagy tears will split upon hit and the split shots will orbit around the point where the original tear had split.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: Isaac will frequently shoot tears that orbit around him, even without pressing any fire buttons.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac will frequently shoot tears that orbit around him, even without pressing any fire buttons.

synergies.text: Monstro's Lung: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.
synergies.raw: {{i|Monstro's Lung}}: Fires a large number of extra tears alongside the burst that begin orbiting Isaac once they reach the orbit range.

synergies.text: Urn of Souls: Each individual flame shot from the Urn has a chance to spawn an orbiting tear.
synergies.raw: {{I|Urn of Souls}}: Each individual flame shot from the Urn has a chance to spawn an orbiting tear.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: Tears will orbit very close and fast around Isaac's body, and return to normal orbit once he stops firing.
interactions.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Tears will orbit very close and fast around Isaac's body, and return to normal orbit once he stops firing.

interactions.text: Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
interactions.raw: {{I|Brimstone}} / {{I|C Section}} / {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Tech X}}: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.

interactions.text: Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
interactions.raw: {{i|Explosivo}}/{{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{i|Sinus Infection}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: Orbiting tears cannot be controlled.
interactions.raw: {{I|Eye of the Occult}}: Orbiting tears cannot be controlled.

interactions.text: Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier does not stack with that from a white poop.
interactions.raw: {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: The damage multiplier does not stack with that from a white poop.

interactions.text: Incubus: The orbiting tears will orbit whoever fired it, whether it be Isaac or the Incubus.
interactions.raw: {{I|Incubus}}: The orbiting tears will orbit whoever fired it, whether it be Isaac or the Incubus.

interactions.text: Ipecac: Orbiting tears explode.
interactions.raw: {{I|Ipecac}}: Orbiting tears explode.

interactions.text: Tainted Bethany: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.
interactions.raw: {{C|Tainted Bethany}}: On pickup, grants 12 blood charges.

interactions.text: Technology 2: The laser does not contribute in generating orbiting tears.
interactions.raw: {{I|Technology 2}}: The laser does not contribute in generating orbiting tears.

name: Monstrance
description: Isaac gains an aura that deals damage to enemies inside it.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a large pulsing aura around him that deals damage to enemies inside of it.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a large pulsing aura around him that deals damage to enemies inside of it.

children.text: The aura deals more damage the closer enemies are to Isaac, ranging from 0.4 on the edge up to 3.9 + 0.3 * floor damage.
children.raw: The aura deals more damage the closer enemies are to Isaac, ranging from 0.4 on the edge up to 3.9 + 0.3 * floor damage.

children.text: The aura deals damage up to 7.5 times per second.
children.raw: The aura deals damage up to 7.5 times per second.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely damage enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.
synergies.raw: {{i|Camo Undies}}: Enemies won't target Isaac, thus he can safely damage enemies while standing near them. However, this won't work with bosses.

synergies.text: Isaac's Heart: Monstrance becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Isaac's Heart}}: Monstrance becomes much safer to use offensively as Isaac's body no longer takes damage.

synergies.text: Items granting invulnerability or a shield: Monstrance damages enemies while Isaac is invincible.
synergies.raw: Items granting [[invulnerability]] or a [[shield]]: Monstrance damages enemies while Isaac is invincible.

children.text: This includes Gnawed Leaf / VII - The Chariot? allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.
children.raw: This includes {{i|Gnawed Leaf}} / {{p|VII - The Chariot?}} allowing Isaac to clear most rooms without moving.

children.text: Dark Arts: Enemies will still be damaged while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.
children.raw: {{i|Dark Arts}}: Enemies will still be damaged while Dark Arts' effect is active, allowing Isaac to safely deal damage while invulnerable in this way.

synergies.text: Pause: Monstrance will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Pause}}: Monstrance will not stop the pause effect allowing Isaac to kill or chip bosses easily by standing near them for the duration of the pause effect.

synergies.text: Tainted Forgotten: The aura surrounds Tainted Forgotten allowing Tainted Soul to damage enemies from a safe distance.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The aura surrounds Tainted Forgotten allowing {{c|Tainted Soul}} to damage enemies from a safe distance.

name: The Intruder
description: A familiar burrows in Isaac's head, firing 4 slowing tears. Upon taking damage, there's a chance it will burst out of Isaac's head, spawning blue spiders and chasing enemies for the current room.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a spider familiar that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a spider [[familiar]] that burrows in Isaac's head, firing four slowing tears in addition to Isaac's normal tears.

children.text: The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.
children.raw: The slowing tears deal 1.5 damage each, and fired every 1.5 seconds.

children.text: These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.
children.raw: These tears are unaffected by Isaac's damage and tears stats; they have fixed damage and fire rate.

effects.text: Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning friendly spiders, and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.
effects.raw: Upon taking damage, there is a chance that Isaac's head will pop, spawning [[Familiar#Blue Spiders|friendly spiders]], and release the Intruder familiar, who will leap at enemies to deal contact damage, and fires four slowing tears towards nearby enemies instead of Isaac.

children.text: The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.
children.raw: The spider familiar deals up to 4.5 contact damage depending on how fast it's moving and fires slowing tears twice as fast compared to when it's in Isaac's head.

children.text: The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 luck.
children.raw: The chance for activation goes up to 100% at 4 [[luck]].

children.text: The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.
children.raw: The familiar lasts for the current room, and Isaac's head is reattached upon entering a new room.

effects.text: Counts towards the Spider Baby transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Spider Baby}}

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: The shots are homing even while in Isaac's head.
synergies.raw: {{t|Baby-Bender}}: The shots are homing even while in Isaac's head.

synergies.text: Box of Friends: Doubles the number of tears fired from Isaac's head (if both copies fire at the same time, the tears will stack perfectly so it can be difficult to tell). If The Intruder is released, then interacts normally and spawns a copy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: Doubles the number of tears fired from Isaac's head (if both copies fire at the same time, the tears will stack perfectly so it can be difficult to tell). If The Intruder is released, then interacts normally and spawns a copy.

synergies.text: Hive Mind: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Hive Mind}}: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage. Does not stack with Hive Mind.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}}: Increases The Intruder's tear and contact damage. Does not stack with Hive Mind.

interactions.text: Azazel: The Intruder's tears come from Azazel while charging his Brimstone.
interactions.raw: {{C|Azazel}}: The Intruder's tears come from Azazel while charging his {{i|Brimstone}}.

interactions.text: Guillotine: The Intruder's tears come from Isaac's body.
interactions.raw: {{i|Guillotine}}: The Intruder's tears come from Isaac's body.

interactions.text: Lilith: The Intruder's tears come from Lilith, despite her blindfold.
interactions.raw: {{C|Lilith}}: The Intruder's tears come from Lilith, despite her blindfold.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while in Isaac's head.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: The Intruder can be sacrificed even while in Isaac's head.

interactions.text: Transcendence: When The Intruder is released, only Isaac's shadow will be visible.
interactions.raw: {{I|Transcendence}}: When The Intruder is released, only Isaac's shadow will be visible.

name: Dirty Mind
description: Destroying poop spawns Dip Familiars that follow Isaac and damage enemies. Destroying different types of poop spawns different Dips with special effects.

effects.text: Converts all enemy Dips and Drips into Dip Familiars.
effects.raw: Converts all enemy {{e|Dip}}s and {{e|Drip}}s into [[Familiar#Dips|Dip Familiars]].

effects.text: Rocks have a chance to be replaced with poop when generated.
effects.raw: Rocks have a chance to be replaced with poop when generated.

children.text: The formula to calculate the chance is: \mathit{Chance} = \mathit{Luck} \times 0.5 + 6.25, capped at 10% at 7.5 Luck.
children.raw: The formula to calculate the chance is: <math>\mathit{Chance} = \mathit{Luck} \times 0.5 + 6.25</math>, capped at 10% at 7.5 Luck.

effects.text: Destroying Poops spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.
effects.raw: Destroying {{e|Poop}}s spawn 1-4 Dip Familiars, which loosely follow Isaac around, block enemy shots, and deal contact damage to enemies.

children.text: Dips deal contact damage to enemies equal to the damage Isaac had at the time it spawned, and can deal up to 2 ticks of contact damage and/or block 2 shots before dying.
children.raw: Dips deal contact damage to enemies equal to the [[damage]] Isaac had at the time it spawned, and can deal up to 2 ticks of contact damage and/or block 2 shots before dying.

effects.text: Destroying different types of poop will spawn special Dips:
effects.raw: Destroying different types of poop will spawn special Dips:

children.text: Corny Poops create Corny Dips that spawn 1 Blue Fly on death.
children.raw: {{E|Corny Poop}}s create Corny Dips that spawn 1 [[Blue Fly]] on death.

children.text: Brownie Dips spawned by Brownie and Dangle have the same behavior.
children.raw: Brownie Dips spawned by {{E|Brownie}} and {{E|Dangle}} have the same behavior.

children.text: Red Poops create Red Dips that deal twice as much damage and autonomously charge at enemies, but automatically die after 15 seconds.
children.raw: {{E|Red Poop}}s create Red Dips that deal twice as much damage and autonomously charge at enemies, but automatically die after 15 seconds.

children.text: Golden Poops create Gold Dips that have a chance to inflict the Midas' Touch effect on enemies they hit. They can also take 5 hits before being destroyed, at which point they will drop 2-3 random coins.
children.raw: {{E|Golden Poop}}s create Gold Dips that have a chance to inflict the {{i|Midas' Touch}} effect on enemies they hit. They can also take 5 hits before being destroyed, at which point they will drop 2-3 random coins.

children.text: Rainbow Poops create Rainbow Dips that charm enemies they hit and have a chance to drop a Half Red Heart on death.
children.raw: {{E|Rainbow Poop}}s create Rainbow Dips that [[charm]] enemies they hit and have a chance to drop a {{e|Half Red Heart}} on death.

children.text: Black Poops create Black Dips that leave a trail of slowing creep.
children.raw: {{E|Black Poop}}s create Black Dips that leave a trail of [[slow]]ing [[creep]].

children.text: White Poops create White Dips that recreate the effect of Hallowed Ground and can take 3 hits before being destroyed.
children.raw: {{E|White Poop}}s create White Dips that recreate the effect of {{I|Hallowed Ground}} and can take 3 hits before being destroyed.

effects.text: Poops unique to Tainted ??? and IBS also spawn Dips with special effects:
effects.raw: Poops unique to {{C|Tainted ???}} and {{I|IBS}} also spawn Dips with special effects:

children.text: Stone Poops create Rock Dips that deal an additional 3.5 damage per hit and can take 6 hits before dying instead of 2.
children.raw: Stone Poops create Rock Dips that deal an additional 3.5 damage per hit and can take 6 hits before dying instead of 2.

children.text: Stinky Poops create Stinky Dips that release toxic gas as they move and a larger cloud of toxic gas when they die.
children.raw: Stinky Poops create Stinky Dips that release toxic gas as they move and a larger cloud of toxic gas when they die.

children.text: The toxic gas does 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (~1.2x Isaac's damage per second) and poisons enemies; clouds left behind while alive last 1.5 seconds and the cloud created on death lasts 8 seconds.
children.raw: The toxic gas does 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (~1.2x Isaac's damage per second) and [[poison]]s enemies; clouds left behind while alive last 1.5 seconds and the cloud created on death lasts 8 seconds.

children.text: Fire Poops create Flaming Dips that burn enemies they hit and leave behind a fire when they die.
children.raw: Fire Poops create Flaming Dips that [[Status Effects#Burn|burn]] enemies they hit and leave behind a fire when they die.

children.text: The burn deals 3.5 damage up to 6 times, and the fire deals 8 damage at full durability, 6 after taking 1 hit, and 4 otherwise, for a maximum of 22 damage.
children.raw: The burn deals 3.5 damage up to 6 times, and the fire deals 8 damage at full durability, 6 after taking 1 hit, and 4 otherwise, for a maximum of 22 damage.

effects.text: Counts towards the Oh Crap transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Oh Crap}}

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles damage dealt and halves damage taken by Dips, as well as increasing their size.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}}: Doubles damage dealt and halves damage taken by Dips, as well as increasing their size.

synergies.text: Butt Penny: Grants a chance to spawn a Dip each time a coin is picked up.
synergies.raw: {{T|Butt Penny}}: Grants a chance to spawn a Dip each time a coin is picked up.

synergies.text: A Card Against Humanity: Allows Isaac to obtain a large number of Dips.
synergies.raw: {{p|A Card Against Humanity}}: Allows Isaac to obtain a large number of Dips.

synergies.text: E. Coli / Flush!: Poops generated by these items spawn double the normal amount of Dips.
synergies.raw: {{i|E. Coli}} / {{I|Flush!}}: Poops generated by these items spawn double the normal amount of Dips.

synergies.text: Mom's Bracelet: Friendly Dips can be picked up and thrown.
synergies.raw: {{I|Mom's Bracelet}}: Friendly Dips can be picked up and thrown.

synergies.text: Mysterious Candy: Allows a steady supply of Dips, with time. Useful for later chapters.
synergies.raw: {{T|Mysterious Candy}}: Allows a steady supply of Dips, with time. Useful for later chapters.

synergies.text: The Poop: Allows generation of extra Dips after every room.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Poop}}: Allows generation of extra Dips after every room.

interactions.text: Compost: Compost does not multiply Dips.
interactions.raw: {{I|Compost}}: Compost does not multiply Dips.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: All Dips are sacrificed and a coin is spawned for each Dip sacrificed. The Dips do not count towards the 2 familiar limit of Sacrificial Altar.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sacrificial Altar}}: All Dips are sacrificed and a [[coin]] is spawned for each Dip sacrificed. The Dips do not count towards the 2 [[familiar]] limit of Sacrificial Altar.

name: Damocles
description: Spawns a sword above Isaac's head, which doubles all item pedestals. After Isaac takes damage, the sword can randomly fall at any point, instantly killing him.

effects.text: Upon use, summons a sword that hangs directly above Isaac. As long as the sword hangs above Isaac, all item pedestals are doubled, spawning an additional free item next to them.
effects.raw: Upon use, summons a sword that hangs directly above Isaac. As long as the sword hangs above Isaac, all [[item]] pedestals are doubled, spawning an additional free item next to them.

children.text: Items spawned via other means, like Machines, s, and certain items and cards, are also doubled.
children.raw: Items spawned via other means, like [[Machines]], {{M|Beggar}}s, and certain [[items]] and [[Cards and Runes|cards]], are also doubled.

children.text: The extra item will be pulled from the current room's item pool, even if the original item is from a different pool (ex. Beggars or items from Alabaster Box).
children.raw: The extra item will be pulled from the current room's item pool, even if the original item is from a different pool (ex. Beggars or items from {{I|Alabaster Box}}).

effects.text: After Isaac takes damage (with exceptions, see below) once with the item activated, at any time with only a brief warning, the sword may fall, instantly killing Isaac regardless of his health. The sword has a 1/10000 chance every 4 game ticks (every 0.133 seconds) to fall, so on average, 50% of all Damocles runs will not drop the sword until after at least 15 minutes and 24 seconds have passed.
effects.raw: After Isaac takes damage (with exceptions, see below) once with the item activated, at any time with only a brief warning, the sword may fall, instantly killing Isaac regardless of his health. The sword has a 1/10000 chance every 4 game ticks (every 0.133 seconds) to fall, so on average, 50% of all Damocles runs will not drop the sword until after at least 15 minutes and 24 seconds have passed.

children.text: Self-damage (such as from a , , , , Spiked Chest, Bad Trip pill, or self-damage Active Items) does not count as damage taken for Damocles, and will not give it the chance to fall.
children.raw: Self-damage (such as from a {{Machine|Blood Donation Machine}}, {{Machine|Devil Beggar}}, {{r|Curse Room}}, {{r|Sacrifice Room}}, {{e|Spiked Chest}}, Bad Trip pill, or self-damage Active Items) does not count as damage taken for Damocles, and will not give it the chance to fall.

synergies.text: Blanket / Holy Mantle / Holy Card / Wooden Cross: Damage blocked by the shield doesn't count as damage taken. It will not, however, protect Isaac from the falling sword.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blanket}} / {{I|Holy Mantle}} / {{p|Holy Card}} / {{T|Wooden Cross}}: Damage blocked by the shield doesn't count as damage taken. It will not, however, protect Isaac from the falling sword.

synergies.text: Book of Shadows / Empty Vessel / Algiz / other items that give shield: Nullifies the instant kill of Damocles if the shield is active when the sword falls.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Shadows}} / {{i|Empty Vessel}} / {{p|Algiz}} / other items that give [[shield]]: Nullifies the instant kill of Damocles if the shield is active when the sword falls.

synergies.text: Cone Head / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate: Blocked damage does not count as damage and can delay the triggering of Damocles.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cone Head}} / {{I|Host Hat}} / {{I|Infamy}} / {{i|Metal Plate}}: Blocked damage does not count as damage and can delay the triggering of Damocles.

synergies.text: Crooked Penny / Diplopia: An extra item is spawned per each item cloned.
synergies.raw: {{I|Crooked Penny}} / {{I|Diplopia}}: An extra item is spawned per each item cloned.

children.text: However, duplicating Damocles itself and activating additional copies has no effect.
children.raw: However, duplicating Damocles itself and activating additional copies has no effect.

synergies.text: Dark Arts: When in the shadow state, Isaac can survive the instant kill of Damocles, though this requires precise timing and can be impossible if Dark Art's charge is empty as the sword is falling.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dark Arts}}: When in the shadow state, Isaac can survive the instant kill of Damocles, though this requires precise timing and can be impossible if Dark Art's charge is empty as the sword is falling.

synergies.text: Filigree Feather: Angels spawn 2 items when defeated. However, if a Key Piece spawns, a second pedestal will not appear.
synergies.raw: {{t|Filigree Feather}}: [[Angel]]s spawn 2 items when defeated. However, if a [[Key Piece]] spawns, a second pedestal will not appear.

synergies.text: Genesis: If the player acquires Damocles and uses it before all items have been collected, then each subsequent item spawned after using it will each spawn an extra item. Unlike the Genesis choices, the other extra items will not disappear upon collecting one of them, potentially allowing the player to obtain a much higher amount of items than usual.
synergies.raw: {{i|Genesis}}: If the player acquires Damocles and uses it before all items have been collected, then each subsequent item spawned after using it will each spawn an extra item. Unlike the Genesis choices, the other extra items will not disappear upon collecting one of them, potentially allowing the player to obtain a much higher amount of items than usual.

children.text: Using Genesis will remove the hanging sword and its effects.
children.raw: Using Genesis will remove the hanging sword and its effects.

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt / Jumper Cables: Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.
synergies.raw: {{i|4.5 Volt}} / {{i|Jumper Cables}}: Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Allows the player to go through rooms at a quicker pace due to the invisibility.
synergies.raw: {{I|Camo Undies}}: Allows the player to go through rooms at a quicker pace due to the invisibility.

synergies.text: Charm of the Vampire / Leech: Allows for unlimited healing.
synergies.raw: {{I|Charm of the Vampire}} / {{i|Leech}}: Allows for unlimited healing.

synergies.text: Gimpy / Sharp Straw: Allows the possibility to generate unlimited Hearts.
synergies.raw: {{I|Gimpy}} / {{i|Sharp Straw}}: Allows the possibility to generate unlimited [[Hearts]].

synergies.text: Head of the Keeper: With enough patience, Coins can be gathered infinitely.
synergies.raw: {{I|Head of the Keeper}}: With enough patience, [[Coins]] can be gathered infinitely.

synergies.text: Tainted Keeper: Leaving and re-entering the room allows for unlimited coin farming; however, enemies in rooms Tainted Keeper has already visited will eventually stop dropping coins.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: Leaving and re-entering the room allows for unlimited coin farming; however, enemies in rooms Tainted Keeper has already visited will eventually stop dropping coins.

name: Venus
description: Adds one red Heart container. Heals 1 additional Red Heart. Enemies near Isaac become charmed.

effects.text: Grants one Red Heart Container.
effects.raw: Grants one Red [[Heart Container]].

effects.text: Heals 1 additional Red Heart.
effects.raw: Heals 1 additional {{e|Red Heart}}.

effects.text: Charms enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.
effects.raw: [[Charm]]s enemies close to Isaac. The effect wears off quickly after enemies move away from Isaac.

interactions.text: 2Spooky: Overridden by Venus.
interactions.raw: {{i|2Spooky}}: Overridden by Venus.

name: Terra
description: +1 Damage. Replaces tears with rocks that deal variable damage, have increased knockback, and can destroy obstacles.

effects.text: +1 damage.
effects.raw: +1 [[damage]].

effects.text: Isaac's tears become rocks that have extra knockback and have a chance to destroy obstacles (including walls to s, entrances to Mines/Ashpit and Bedrooms, and normal closed doors).
effects.raw: Isaac's tears become rocks that have extra knockback and have a chance to destroy [[obstacles]] (including walls to {{R|Secret Room}}s, entrances to {{s|Mines}}/{{s|Ashpit}} and [[Bedroom]]s, and normal closed doors).

children.text: Rocks can be pushed onto holes to cover them as if they were bombed normally.
children.raw: Rocks can be pushed onto holes to cover them as if they were bombed normally.

effects.text: Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between ×0.5 and ×2 Isaac's damage per tear.
effects.raw: Rock tears randomly deal increased/decreased damage, ranging between ×0.5 and ×2 Isaac's damage per tear.

synergies.text: Broken Padlock: Locked doors can be opened by shooting at them.
synergies.raw: {{t|Broken Padlock}}: Locked doors can be opened by shooting at them.

synergies.text: Finger!: The finger will destroy rocks.
synergies.raw: {{I|Finger!}}: The finger will destroy rocks.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: Controllable rock tear that will destroy rocks. The size of the tear changes per room.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Controllable rock tear that will destroy rocks. The size of the tear changes per room.

synergies.text: Mom's Knife: The knife will sometimes destroy rocks. Rocks can be destroyed by walking into them.
synergies.raw: {{i|Mom's Knife}}: The knife will sometimes destroy rocks. Rocks can be destroyed by walking into them.

interactions.text: Azazel/Brimstone/Technology/Technology 2/Tech.5/Tech X: Lasers will sometimes destroy rocks and gains increased knockback, but will not open doors or Secret Room entrances.
interactions.raw: {{C|Azazel}}/{{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}/{{i|Technology 2}}/{{i|Tech.5}}/{{i|Tech X}}: Lasers will sometimes destroy rocks and gains increased [[knockback]], but will not open doors or [[Secret Room]] entrances.

children.text: Lasers can now open doors.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Lasers can now open doors.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Explosions retain the extra damage and knockback, but cannot destroy Key Blocks.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Explosions retain the extra damage and knockback, but cannot destroy Key Blocks.

interactions.text: Spectral tears: Tears continue to destroy obstacles.
interactions.raw: [[Spectral tears]]: Tears continue to destroy obstacles.

interactions.text: Spirit Sword: Sword swings and spin attacks cannot destroy rocks, only its projectiles.
interactions.raw: {{i|Spirit Sword}}: Sword swings and spin attacks cannot destroy rocks, only its projectiles.

interactions.text: Tainted Lilith: The damage from hitting enemies with the fetus is affected by Terra's damage randomization.
interactions.raw: {{C|Tainted Lilith}}: The damage from hitting enemies with the fetus is affected by Terra's damage randomization.

name: Mars
description: Dash by double-tapping the movement key, becoming invulnerable and damaging enemies. There's a short cooldown before Isaac can dash again. Knocks away nearby enemies and briefly grants i-frames after dashing.

effects.text: Double tapping a direction makes Isaac quickly dash in that direction.
effects.raw: Double tapping a direction makes Isaac quickly dash in that direction.

children.text: Isaac is immune to damage from all sources during the dash, with the exception of s, s, and similar self-damage active items.
children.raw: Isaac is immune to damage from all sources during the dash, with the exception of {{M|Blood Donation Machine}}s, {{M|Devil Beggar}}s, and similar self-damage active items.

children.text: At the end of the dash, Isaac gains i-frames that protect him against s and s damage. They will also not activate if touched during those i-frames.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} At the end of the dash, Isaac gains i-frames that protect him against {{M|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{M|Devil Beggar}}s damage. They will also not activate if touched during those i-frames.

children.text: The dash deals damage equal to 4× Isaac's damage + 8.
children.raw: The dash deals damage equal to 4× Isaac's [[damage]] + 8.

children.text: The direction of the dash can be angled by holding another button.
children.raw: The direction of the dash can be angled by holding another button.

children.text: The dash has an approximate 3 second cooldown.
children.raw: The dash has an approximate 3 second cooldown.

children.text: If Isaac collides with a wall or obstacle, he releases 8 columns of fire that deal 10 damage and can burn enemies.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} If Isaac collides with a wall or obstacle, he releases 8 columns of fire that deal 10 damage and can [[burn]] enemies.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Can be used to deal damage without breaking the confusion effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Camo Undies}}: Can be used to deal damage without breaking the confusion effect.

synergies.text: Kamikaze!: Kamikaze can be used without taking damage while dashing.
synergies.raw: {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Kamikaze can be used without taking damage while dashing.

synergies.text: A Pony / White Pony: Lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1.5 seconds.
synergies.raw: {{i|A Pony}} / {{i|White Pony}}: Lowers the dash cooldown to approximately 1.5 seconds.

synergies.text: Tainted Forgotten: Tainted Forgotten will charge on double-tap if Tainted Soul is not holding him. This can be used to let Tainted Forgotten attack enemies from a resting position, or move him away from damaging hazards so Tainted Soul can pick him up.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Forgotten will charge on double-tap if Tainted Soul is not holding him. This can be used to let Tainted Forgotten attack enemies from a resting position, or move him away from damaging hazards so Tainted Soul can pick him up.

name: Jupiter
description: +2 red Heart containers, -0.3 speed. Isaac builds speed while standing still, and releases poison gas clouds when he moves afterwards.

effects.text: Grants two full Red Heart containers.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Grants two full Red [[Heart container]]s.

effects.text: -0.3 Speed.
Standing still causes Isaac to build up speed at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.
effects.raw: Standing still causes Isaac to build up [[speed]] at a rate of +0.25 per second, up to a +0.5 speed bonus.

effects.text: Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting Poison on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.
effects.raw: Isaac charges up while standing still. Moving releases a fart cloud behind Isaac, damaging and inflicting [[Status Effects#Poison|Poison]] on enemies that pass through it and draining the speed buff at a rate of -0.25 speed per second. The fart clouds are left behind for the duration of the speed buff.

children.text: The fart clouds deal 0.5× Isaac's damage per tick (1.5× Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.
children.raw: The fart clouds deal 0.5× Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (1.5× Isaac's damage per second), and last ~2.5 seconds.

effects.text: Isaac is immune to Poison from enemies, such as Gasbag or Mushrooms.
effects.raw: Isaac is immune to Poison from enemies, such as {{E|Gasbag}} or [[Mushroom (Obstacle)|Mushrooms]].

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Damaging enemies with the fart clouds will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
synergies.raw: {{I|Camo Undies}}: Damaging enemies with the fart clouds will not take away Isaac's camouflage.

synergies.text: Dark Arts: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dark Arts}}: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.

synergies.text: Gigante Bean: Greatly increases size of fart clouds.
synergies.raw: {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Greatly increases size of fart clouds.

synergies.text: Tainted Forgotten: Gives a flat +0.20 speed boost and +2 soul hearts with no other effects.
synergies.raw: {{C|Tainted Forgotten}}: Gives a flat +0.20 speed boost and +2 soul hearts with no other effects.

name: Saturnus
description: Upon entering a room, a circle of 7 tears orbits Isaac, which last for 13 seconds before falling to the ground. Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in orbit, turning them friendly.

effects.text: A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.
effects.raw: A circle surrounds Isaac. When entering a room, the circle is filled with 7 orbiting tears that copy Isaac's tear properties.

children.text: The tears will deal 1.5× Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.
children.raw: The tears will deal 1.5× Isaac's damage +5 flat damage.

children.text: After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.
children.raw: After 13 seconds, the tears will automatically fall to the ground.

children.text: Orbiting tears are spectral, although they don't visually appear to be.
children.raw: Orbiting tears are [[spectral tears|spectral]], although they don't visually appear to be.

children.text: The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.
children.raw: The room does not have to be a new room to renew the 7 orbiting tears.

effects.text: Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.
effects.raw: Enemy tears have a chance to be caught in the orbit, making them able to damage enemies.

children.text: Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.
children.raw: Captured tears deal damage based on their size rather than how much they would've hurt Isaac: basic enemy shots deal 3.5 damage, and most champion shots deal 4.9 damage, but there is further variance.

children.text: Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.
children.raw: Enemy tears caught disappear after a short time or upon leaving the current room.

synergies.text: A Lump of Coal: The tears grow in size and damage as they orbit around Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{i|A Lump of Coal}}: The tears grow in size and damage as they orbit around Isaac.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: The prism and tears share the same orbit, making them easy to split.
synergies.raw: {{i|Angelic Prism}}: The prism and tears share the same orbit, making them easy to split.

synergies.text: Blood Clot/Chemical Peel/Stye: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Clot}}/{{i|Chemical Peel}}/{{i|Stye}}: Orbiting tears will be the same as the last fired tear before leaving the previous room.

children.text: Having an item that randomly applies the bonus (Mom's Knife, Brimstone, Stapler, etc), will give each tear a 50% chance to have the bonus.
children.raw: Having an item that randomly applies the bonus ({{i|Mom's Knife}}, {{i|Brimstone}}, {{i|Stapler}}, etc), will give each tear a 50% chance to have the bonus.

synergies.text: Cricket's Body: The orbiting tears will split as normal, but the tears produced by the split will orbit Isaac instead of spreading out.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cricket's Body}}: The orbiting tears will split as normal, but the tears produced by the split will orbit Isaac instead of spreading out.

synergies.text: Godhead: The orbiting tears have Godhead's damaging aura without the homing effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Godhead}}: The orbiting tears have Godhead's damaging aura without the homing effect.

synergies.text: Homing tears: Tears will break orbit to home into nearby enemies. With piercing, tears will return to the orbit after dealing damage.
synergies.raw: [[Homing tears]]: Tears will break orbit to home into nearby enemies. With [[piercing tears|piercing]], tears will return to the orbit after dealing damage.

synergies.text: Kidney Stone: It's possible for one of the tears surrounding Isaac to be the stone.
synergies.raw: {{i|Kidney Stone}}: It's possible for one of the tears surrounding Isaac to be the stone.

synergies.text: Multidimensional Baby: Because both the orbiting tears and multidimensional baby start on top of Isaac when entering a room, all of the tears are immediately doubled.
synergies.raw: {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Because both the orbiting tears and multidimensional baby start on top of Isaac when entering a room, all of the tears are immediately doubled.

synergies.text: The Parasite + piercing tears: The tears continuously create two smaller tears as they hit enemies, all of which in turn orbit and pierce enemies as well, resulting in far higher damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Parasite}} + [[piercing]] tears: The tears continuously create two smaller tears as they hit enemies, all of which in turn orbit and pierce enemies as well, resulting in far higher damage.

interactions.text: Brimstone / C Section / Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus / Mom's Knife / Technology / Tech X: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.
interactions.raw: {{I|Brimstone}} / {{I|C Section}} / {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Epic Fetus}} / {{I|Mom's Knife}} / {{I|Technology}} / {{I|Tech X}}: No unique interactions; regular tears are generated which orbit Isaac normally.

interactions.text: Crown Of Light: Functions as intended, but the tears surrounding Isaac will appear normal.
interactions.raw: {{I|Crown Of Light}}: Functions as intended, but the tears surrounding Isaac will appear normal.

interactions.text: Explosivo/Nose Goblin/Sinus Infection/Mucormycosis: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.
interactions.raw: {{i|Explosivo}}/{{t|Nose Goblin}}/{{i|Sinus Infection}}/{{i|Mucormycosis}}: Orbiting tears that stick to an enemy will return to the ring if the enemy cannot be stuck to anymore before the tear's duration ends.

interactions.text: Friend Finder: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.
interactions.raw: {{I|Friend Finder}}: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.

interactions.text: Hook Worm: No effect upon ring's tear.
interactions.raw: {{T|Hook Worm}}: No effect upon ring's tear.

interactions.text: Ipecac: Tears surrounding Isaac will not cause self damage if at maximum distance until high tear size. If Isaac enters a room and his Saturnus tears have not spread out, they could hit an entity and cause self damage.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Tears surrounding Isaac will not cause self damage if at maximum distance until high tear size. If Isaac enters a room and his Saturnus tears have not spread out, they could hit an entity and cause self damage.

interactions.text: Lachryphagy: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.
interactions.raw: {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Orbiting tears are Lachryphagy tears, including enemy tears caught in orbit. Tears will still burst after a set duration, greatly the reducing the amount of time the tears orbit for. Burst tears will remain in an orbital path instead of spreading out.

interactions.text: Proptosis: Causes the tears to immediately fall, making Saturnus almost irrelevant. Enemy tears caught in the orbit will not fade away, and its defensive benefits helps slightly to maintain the aggressive playstyle required by Proptosis.
interactions.raw: {{i|Proptosis}}: Causes the tears to immediately fall, making Saturnus almost irrelevant. Enemy tears caught in the orbit will not fade away, and its defensive benefits helps slightly to maintain the aggressive playstyle required by Proptosis.

interactions.text: Ring Worm / Ouroboros Worm: The trinkets cause the ring tears to move with a very anarchistic movement in and out of the circle.
interactions.raw: {{T|Ring Worm}} / {{t|Ouroboros Worm}}: The trinkets cause the ring tears to move with a very anarchistic movement in and out of the circle.

interactions.text: Sulfuric Acid / Terra: As the orbiting tears can destroy rocks, Isaac can unintentionally detonate Bomb Rocks, causing self damage.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{I|Terra}}: As the orbiting tears can destroy rocks, Isaac can unintentionally detonate [[Rocks#Bomb Rocks|Bomb Rocks]], causing self damage.

interactions.text: Tractor Beam: No effect on surrounding tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: No effect on surrounding tears.

name: Uranus
description: Isaac shoots ice tears, which slow enemies and freeze monsters they kill. Frozen enemies slide away and explode into ice shards when touched.

effects.text: Isaac's tears become icicles that freeze enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.
effects.raw: Isaac's tears become icicles that [[freeze]] enemies upon death, turning them into ice statues.

children.text: Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be frozen.
children.raw: [[Bosses]] and [[mini-boss]]es cannot be frozen.

effects.text: Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, obstacle or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.
effects.raw: Frozen enemies can be kicked, sliding and leaving damaging creep across the room and shattering when they hit a wall, [[obstacle]] or an enemy, releasing 10 icicle tears in a circle.

children.text: These icicles can either slow enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.
children.raw: These icicles can either [[slow]] enemies for 4 seconds or turn them into ice statues as well if they deal the lethal hit.

effects.text: Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.
effects.raw: Killing an enemy by freezing them will prevent any on-death effects from occurring (i.e. splitting into other enemies, firing any post-death tears, exploding, etc.), even after shattering.

effects.text: Isaac's tears have a chance to petrify enemies.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Isaac's tears have a chance to [[petrify]] enemies.

synergies.text: Athame / Maw Of The Void / Montezuma's Revenge / Revelation: The beam will freeze enemies upon death.
synergies.raw: {{i|Athame}} / {{i|Maw Of The Void}} / {{i|Montezuma's Revenge}} / {{i|Revelation}}: The beam will freeze enemies upon death.

synergies.text: Bob's Rotten Head: Enemies are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.
synergies.raw: {{i|Bob's Rotten Head}}: Enemies are frozen when dying to Bob's Rotten Head.

synergies.text: Brimstone / Jacob's Ladder / Tech.5 / Technology / Technology 2 / Tech X: The normally firing laser gets an icy white color and freezes enemies upon death.
synergies.raw: {{i|Brimstone}}  / {{i|Jacob's Ladder}} / {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology}} / {{i|Technology 2}} / {{i|Tech X}}: The normally firing laser gets an icy white color and freezes enemies upon death.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Bombs will freeze enemies upon death.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Bombs will freeze enemies upon death.

synergies.text: Gello/Tainted Lilith: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide similarly to when kicked by Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{i|Gello}}/{{c|Tainted Lilith}}: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide similarly to when kicked by Isaac.

synergies.text: Suplex!: Provides another method of shattering the ice statues.
synergies.raw: {{i|Suplex!}}: Provides another method of shattering the ice statues.

synergies.text: Trisagion: Can help break statues faster due to tears hitting multiple times.
synergies.raw: {{i|Trisagion}}: Can help break statues faster due to tears hitting multiple times.

interactions.text: 4.5 Volt: Damage dealt during the killing blow doesn't provide charge.
interactions.raw: {{I|4.5 Volt}}: Damage dealt during the killing blow doesn't provide charge.

interactions.text: 120 Volt/Technology Zero: No effect on lasers.
interactions.raw: {{I|120 Volt}}/{{I|Technology Zero}}: No effect on lasers.

interactions.text: Freezing enemies properly extends effect duration.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Freezing enemies properly extends effect duration.

interactions.text: Contagion: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Contagion}}: Enemies that are frozen are still "alive" and can create a gas explosion when they are the first ice statue broken before any other enemy in the room dies.

interactions.text: D10: Even though frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, rerolling them into a different enemy will bring them back to life.
interactions.raw: {{i|D10}}: Even though frozen enemies are considered dead by the game, rerolling them into a different enemy will bring them back to life.

interactions.text: Friendly Ball: Cannot be used to capture frozen enemies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Friendly Ball}}: Cannot be used to capture frozen enemies.

interactions.text: Shoop da Whoop!: The beam is unable to freeze enemies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Shoop da Whoop!}}: The beam is unable to freeze enemies.

name: Neptunus
description: Isaac's mouth fills with tears over time while not firing, up to a cap. Holding the fire button will release all stored tears in rapid succession.

effects.text: While Isaac is not firing tears, a charge bar will start to fill up. Holding down the fire button will release the stored tears rapidly. The fire rate is greater and the bar drains faster when more full.
effects.raw: While Isaac is not firing tears, a charge bar will start to fill up. Holding down the fire button will release the stored tears rapidly. The fire rate is greater and the bar drains faster when more full.

effects.text: The charge time and maximum tears per charge scale with Isaac's tears stat, with higher tears charging faster and having more of them.
effects.raw: The charge time and maximum tears per charge scale with Isaac's [[tears]] stat, with higher tears charging faster and having more of them.

synergies.text: Camo Undies: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.
synergies.raw: {{i|Camo Undies}}: The passive charge of Neptunus does not disrupt Camo, and the initial burst of damage is enhanced by Neptunus.

synergies.text: Chocolate Milk: Neptunus' passive charge overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.
synergies.raw: {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: Neptunus' passive charge overrides Chocolate Milk's active charge. Tear damage is determined by how charged Neptunus is.

children.text: Once Neptunus' charge is used up, Isaac will fire uncharged Chocolate Milk tears, resulting in a much lower damage output than without Chocolate Milk.
children.raw: Once Neptunus' charge is used up, Isaac will fire uncharged Chocolate Milk tears, resulting in a much lower damage output than without Chocolate Milk.

children.text: Chocolate Milk + Kidney Stone: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.
children.raw: '''Chocolate Milk''' + {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Isaac will not fire any tears during the Kidney Stone burst.

synergies.text: Kidney Stone: Tear bursts stack, firing a very large number of tears in combination with each other.
synergies.raw: {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Tear bursts stack, firing a very large number of tears in combination with each other.

effects.text: +0.7 tears
Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.
effects.raw: Significantly shrinks Isaac, allowing him to squeeze between objects and makes some enemy shots pass over him.

interactions.text: Cricket's Body: Split tears' range is dropped drastically. Range ups do not mitigate the effect.

name: Voodoo Head
description: Spawns an additional on each floor. Curse Rooms have improved layouts.

effects.text: Spawns an additional on each floor, if possible.
effects.raw: Spawns an additional {{R|Curse Room}} on each floor, if possible.

children.text: Doesn't work on the Ascent.
children.raw: Doesn't work on the [[Ascent]].

effects.text: Curse rooms have improved layouts and rewards while Voodoo Head is held.
effects.raw: Curse rooms have improved layouts and rewards while Voodoo Head is held.

effects.text: A coin is guaranteed to spawn in Curse Rooms.

children.raw: {{C|Tainted Forgotten}} can be picked up by any other player using it.

children.raw: All tears shot from the right eye will deal 35% more damage, same as with {{I|The Peeper}} affecting the left eye.

synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Will summon 2 peepers in a bifurcated direction.

children.raw: Rifts deal half of the tear's damage twice each tick (3x its damage per second), and enemy shots pulled into the rift will damage other enemies.

effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] that follows Isaac around and fires chaotic bursts of tears in all directions at random intervals while in a room with enemies, shooting faster the closer it is to an enemy, similarly to {{E|Boil}}s.

effects.raw: Spawns a [[familiar]] who follows Isaac around and fires icicles once every 0.75 seconds that each do 3.5 damage and have a chance to [[petrify]] enemies they hit and [[freeze]] enemies they kill.

effects.raw: Gives Isaac a fat bird familiar that sits on Isaac's head until he takes damage.

effects.raw: Upon taking damage, it will jump off of Isaac's head and land on the nearest enemy, dealing damage and creating a rock line in a random direction. For the rest of the room, it acts like {{i|Dead Bird}}, flying around, albeit slower, and dealing contact damage to enemies.

effects.raw: Gives Isaac a Dumpy [[familiar]], which follows behind him. Enemies that collide with obstacles or walls take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage. Pushed shots that hit an enemy deal 6 damage normally and 7 damage if they would deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.

children.text: Lil Dumpy has a larger, hidden secondary radius that may randomly trigger its fart effect if an enemy projectile enters it.
children.raw: Lil Dumpy has a larger, hidden secondary radius that may randomly trigger its fart effect if an enemy projectile enters it.

effects.text: After farting, Lil Dumpy goes on cooldown and "falls asleep" until Isaac walks up to it to wake it up. Lil Dumpy resets upon entering a new room.
effects.raw: After farting, Lil Dumpy goes on cooldown and "falls asleep" until Isaac walks up to it to wake it up. Lil Dumpy resets upon entering a new room.

effects.text: Lil Dumpy deals contact damage, which depends on its speed. If it hits an enemy right after farting, it will deal 8.33 damage.
effects.raw: Lil Dumpy deals contact damage, which depends on its speed. If it hits an enemy right after farting, it will deal 8.33 damage.

synergies.text: BFFS!: The contact damage is boosted greatly. For instance, if the familiar hits an enemy right after farting, it will now deal 33.33 damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: The contact damage is boosted greatly. For instance, if the familiar hits an enemy right after farting, it will now deal 33.33 damage.

synergies.text: Gigante Bean: Applies to Lil Dumpy and causes the fart to become much bigger and also deal 10 damage.
synergies.raw: {{t|Gigante Bean}}: Applies to Lil Dumpy and causes the fart to become much bigger and also deal 10 damage.

synergies.text: The Twins: Can duplicate Lil Dumpy, practically adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's Holy Mantle-like protection.
synergies.raw: {{t|The Twins}}: Can duplicate Lil Dumpy, practically adding an extra charge to Lil Dumpy's {{i|Holy Mantle}}-like protection.

synergies.text: Box of Friends: Will copy Lil Dumpy for extra protection, this process can be repeated many times to make Isaac near-invincible in Greed mode, Greedier mode, or with 4.5 Volt.
synergies.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: Will copy Lil Dumpy for extra protection, this process can be repeated many times to make Isaac near-invincible in [[Greed mode]], [[Greedier mode]], {{R|Boss Rush}} or with {{i|4.5 Volt}}.

synergies.text: Ventricle Razor / Other methods of teleportation: Lil Dumpy will quickly fly to Isaac instead of teleporting, dealing damage to everything in its path.
synergies.raw: {{i|Ventricle Razor}} / Other methods of teleportation: Lil Dumpy will quickly fly to Isaac instead of teleporting, dealing damage to everything in its path.

name: Bird's Eye
description: Gives a chance to shoot fires alongside tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by Red Candle.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a chance to shoot fires alongside his regular tears that block enemy shots and deal damage to enemies that touch them, similar to those shot by {{I|Red Candle}}.

children.text: Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.
children.raw: Fires can block up to four shots and/or deal four ticks of damage before being destroyed, and last up to 10 seconds.

children.text: Fires deal 4× Isaac's damage at full durability, 3× Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2× Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11× Isaac's damage per fire.
children.raw: Fires deal 4× Isaac's [[damage]] at full durability, 3× Isaac's damage after taking damage once, and 2× Isaac's damage otherwise, for a max possible damage output of 11× Isaac's damage per fire.

children.text: Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using The Poop or when generating a bomb with No. 2.
children.raw: Any fart-related effect that occurs will also generate a flame, like using {{I|The Poop}} or when generating a bomb with {{I|No. 2}}.

synergies.text: Butter Bean / Wait What? /The Black Bean / Mega Bean: Spawn a fire upon activation.
synergies.raw: {{I|Butter Bean}} / {{I|Wait What?}} /{{I|The Black Bean}} / {{I|Mega Bean}}: Spawn a fire upon activation.

synergies.text: Chocolate Milk: As each flame's damage is unaffected by the charge of each tear, a flame-thrower-like effect with very high damage can be achieved with a decent luck stat and rapidly fired low-charge tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Chocolate Milk}}: As each flame's damage is unaffected by the charge of each tear, a flame-thrower-like effect with very high damage can be achieved with a decent luck stat and rapidly fired low-charge tears.

synergies.text: Contagion: Creates a fire behind Isaac for each enemy that produces a gas cloud on death.
synergies.raw: {{I|Contagion}}: Creates a fire behind Isaac for each enemy that produces a gas cloud on death.

synergies.text: Farting Baby: Farts have a chance to spawn a fire.
synergies.raw: {{I|Farting Baby}}: Farts have a chance to spawn a fire.

synergies.text: Ghost Pepper: Changes the activation rate to \frac1 { 8 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}
synergies.raw: {{i|Ghost Pepper}}: Changes the activation rate to <math>\frac1 { 8 - \left \lfloor \mathit{Luck} \right \rfloor}</math>

children.text: At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.
children.raw: At base luck (0), the chance is 12.5%, maxing out at 100% at 7 luck. Only one type of fire can be spawned at a time; however, each flame has an equal chance of being launched.

synergies.text: Monstro's Lung: When releasing the tear barrage, multiple fires are fired.
synergies.raw: {{I|Monstro's Lung}}: When releasing the tear barrage, multiple fires are fired.

synergies.text: Mucormycosis: When a mucormyosis spore explodes, Isaac has a chance to spawn a fire
synergies.raw: {{I|Mucormycosis}}: When a mucormyosis spore explodes, Isaac has a chance to spawn a fire

synergies.text: The Poop: Creates a fire behind Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Poop}}: Creates a fire behind Isaac.

synergies.text: Proptosis: Size and damage of fires is increased but does not decrease with range.
synergies.raw: {{i|Proptosis}}: Size and damage of fires is increased but does not decrease with range.

synergies.text: Pupula Duplex: The fires and their hitbox get a lot bigger.
synergies.raw: {{I|Pupula Duplex}}: The fires and their hitbox get a lot bigger.

synergies.text: Urn of Souls: Causes the Urn to emit Bird's Eye's red flames in addition to its regular flames.
synergies.raw: {{i|Urn of Souls}}: Causes the Urn to emit Bird's Eye's red flames in addition to its regular flames.

synergies.text: Tear-copying Familiars like Incubus / Lil Clot / Evil Eye: Don't shoot fires, but make Isaac shoot fires more often.
synergies.raw: Tear-copying [[Familiar]]s like {{I|Incubus}} / {{T|Lil Clot}} / {{I|Evil Eye}}: Don't shoot fires, but make Isaac shoot fires more often.

synergies.text: Lil Dumpy: Every time Lil Dumpy farts, Isaac emits a flame too.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lil Dumpy}}: Every time Lil Dumpy farts, Isaac emits a flame too.

interactions.text: Brimstone: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing and with high luck will spawn four fires.
interactions.raw: {{I|Brimstone}}: Will occasionally spawn a fire when firing and with high luck will spawn four fires.

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique: Will occasionally shoot fire from Isaac toward the floating tear.
interactions.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Will occasionally shoot fire from Isaac toward the floating tear.

interactions.text: 20/20/Mutant Spider/The Inner Eye: Only one fire spawns at a time.
interactions.raw: {{I|20/20}}/{{I|Mutant Spider}}/{{I|The Inner Eye}}: Only one fire spawns at a time.

interactions.text: : No effect. Will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Ghost Pepper.
interactions.raw: {{i|1=Bird's Eye}}: No effect. Will not boost the chances of shooting out a fire like with Ghost Pepper.

interactions.text: Dr. Fetus / Tech X / Technology: fires spawn when firing.
interactions.raw: {{I|Dr. Fetus}} / {{I|Tech X}} / {{I|Technology}}: fires spawn when firing.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Fires spawn when moving the crosshair and are launched in the direction of the crosshair similarly to Marked.
interactions.raw: {{I|Epic Fetus}}: Fires spawn when moving the crosshair and are launched in the direction of the crosshair similarly to {{i|Marked}}.

interactions.text: Homing Tears: Fires aren't homing.
interactions.raw: [[Tear Effects#Homing|Homing Tears]]: Fires aren't homing.

interactions.text: IBS: Not Recommended. Farts caused by IBS release flames, which will automatically detonate the toxic cloud and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. Similarly, stinky poops can explode while held by Isaac if he happens to be near flames when IBS activates
interactions.raw: {{I|IBS}}: '''Not Recommended.''' Farts caused by IBS release flames, which will automatically detonate the toxic cloud and hurt Isaac, unless he has explosion immunity. Similarly, stinky poops can explode while held by Isaac if he happens to be near flames when IBS activates

interactions.raw: {{I|Ipecac}}: Fires spawn as normal, but can be hit by ipecac tears, making them especially dangerous.

interactions.text: A Lump of Coal: No effect on fires.
interactions.raw: {{I|A Lump of Coal}}: No effect on fires.

interactions.text: Mom's Knife: Fires spawn occasionally when fired.
interactions.raw: {{I|Mom's Knife}}: Fires spawn occasionally when fired.

interactions.text: Sprinkler: No effect. Sprinkler doesn't shoot fires.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sprinkler}}: No effect. Sprinkler doesn't shoot fires.

interactions.text: Jupiter: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Jupiter}}: No effect.

name: Lodestone
description: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, causing them to attract nearby pickups and enemies, as well as tears/shots from all sources.

effects.text: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that magnetize enemies they hit, giving them properties similar to tears fired by Isaac when he has Strange Attractor:
effects.raw: Gives Isaac the chance to fire tears that [[Status Effects#Magnetized|magnetize]] enemies they hit, giving them properties similar to tears fired by Isaac when he has {{i|Strange Attractor}}:

children.text: Enemies and pickups that are near magnetized enemies are pulled towards them. This includes live Bombs.
children.raw: Enemies and [[pickup]]s that are near magnetized enemies are pulled towards them. This includes live {{e|Bomb}}s.

children.text: All tears/enemy shots (from Isaac, his familiars, and all enemies, including the magnetized one) will be strongly pulled towards magnetized enemies.
children.raw: All tears/enemy shots (from Isaac, his familiars, and all enemies, including the magnetized one) will be strongly pulled towards magnetized enemies.

children.text: Enemy shots that get pulled in will now also damage enemies other than the ones that fired them.
children.raw: Enemy shots that get pulled in will now also damage enemies other than the ones that fired them.

synergies.text: Book of Virtues: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Virtues}}: The wisps' tears are attracted to the magnetic enemy, making it much easier to connect all of the wisps' tears on an enemy.

synergies.text: E. Coli: If an enemy is hit by a lodestone tear perfectly simultaneously with it being turned into poop, the resulting poop will be tinted black and have a lodestone aura that sucks in enemies. This poop will return to normal after a few seconds.
synergies.raw: {{I|E. Coli}}: If an enemy is hit by a lodestone tear perfectly simultaneously with it being turned into poop, the resulting poop will be tinted black and have a lodestone aura that sucks in enemies. This poop will return to normal after a few seconds.

synergies.text: Pop!: Magnetizing an enemy causes all active eyeball tears to rush to the enemy.
synergies.raw: {{I|Pop!}}: Magnetizing an enemy causes all active eyeball tears to rush to the enemy.

synergies.text: Rotten Tomato: Enemies affected by Lodestone and Rotten Tomato will be quickly swarmed and killed by other enemies.
synergies.raw: {{I|Rotten Tomato}}: Enemies affected by Lodestone and Rotten Tomato will be quickly swarmed and killed by other enemies.

synergies.text: Tech X: Changes the color of rings to gray. They still apply the magnetized effect, but the effect being applied is random for each enemy damaged with the same ring. Has increased chance of magnetizing enemy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tech X}}: Changes the color of rings to gray. They still apply the magnetized effect, but the effect being applied is random for each enemy damaged with the same ring. Has increased chance of magnetizing enemy.

children.text: Tech X + Dr. Fetus: Only the explosions from Dr. Fetus' bombs can magnetize enemies.
children.raw: {{i|Tech X}} + {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Only the explosions from Dr. Fetus' bombs can magnetize enemies.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: Isaac's tear has a chance to magnetize and stick to enemies or bosses, making it impossible to move the tear until the enemy dies or until the magnetization effect somehow doesn't get reapplied long enough for the effect to end.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Isaac's tear has a chance to magnetize and stick to enemies or bosses, making it impossible to move the tear until the enemy dies or until the magnetization effect somehow doesn't get reapplied long enough for the effect to end.

interactions.text: Brimstone: Changes the beam to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The beams are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Brimstone}}: Changes the beam to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The beams are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.

interactions.text: Technology: Changes the laser to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The lasers are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.
interactions.raw: {{I|Technology}}: Changes the laser to gray, can still apply the magnetized effect. The lasers are not attracted to enemies with the magnetized effect.

description: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait are attacked by other enemies.

effects.text: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the Bait status effect. Enemies marked as bait will move slower and be attacked by other enemies until it is killed or the effect wears off.
effects.raw: Adds a chance to fire tears that mark enemies with the [[Status Effects#Bait|Bait]] status effect. Enemies marked as bait will move slower and be attacked by other enemies until it is killed or the effect wears off.

effects.text: Tears that apply the effect are red.
effects.raw: Tears that apply the effect are red.

synergies.text: Brimstone: Firing can mark enemies as bait.
synergies.raw: {{I|Brimstone}}: Firing can mark enemies as bait.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus: Fired bombs can mark enemies as bait.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dr. Fetus}}: Fired bombs can mark enemies as bait.

synergies.raw: {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Chaining electricity arcs can mark enemies as bait.

name: Red Stew
description: Refills all heart containers. Grants an enormous damage boost that wears off over time.

effects.text: On pickup, fully heals Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 damage up.
effects.raw: On pickup, fully [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heals]] Isaac and gives him a temporary +21.6 [[damage]] up.

children.text: The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the damage formula works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.
children.raw: The damage upgrade scales down to 0 over the course of three minutes. Due to how the [[Damage#Effective Damage|damage formula]] works, the damage upgrade scales down faster over time, starting at -~0.015 per half second and increasing to -~.1 per half second as the bonus approaches 0.

children.text: While Red Stew is active, Isaac gains an effect similar to Lusty Blood, gaining a small damage bonus every time he kills an enemy. This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.

This damage bonus persists between rooms and floors, allowing Isaac to sustain the temporary damage up for longer than he otherwise would if he manages to kill many enemies. This effect disappears once Red Stew's damage bonus completely runs out.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: The damage up becomes permanent and if Isaac kills enemies fast enough it can increase even further. It would be difficult to gain further damages 3 minutes later, but the first damage up is so high that this isn't a real problem.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: The damage up becomes permanent and if Isaac kills enemies fast enough it can increase even further. It would be difficult to gain further damages 3 minutes later, but the first damage up is so high that this isn't a real problem.

name: Genesis
description: Removes all of Isaac's items and pickups and takes him to a unique with some pickups and Chests and a passage to the next floor. For every item Isaac lost, he gets to take an item from a set of three.

effects.text: On use, Isaac is teleported to a unique that acts like an room. It has a Bed, two random Chests, two Grab Bags, and a random Trinket. The only way out is through the beam of light, which teleports Isaac to the next floor (with some exceptions, seen below).
effects.raw: On use, Isaac is teleported to a unique {{R|Clean Bedroom}} that acts like an {{r|I AM ERROR}} room. It has a [[Bed]], two random {{E|Chest}}s, two {{E|Grab Bag}}s, and a random [[Trinket]]. The only way out is through the beam of light, which teleports Isaac to the next floor (with some exceptions, seen below).

effects.text: Isaac loses all items and is reset to a state exactly like if he started a new run, though keeping quest items to not block progression. All stats, consumables, trinkets, and all items except for starting items and quest items, are removed. Isaac gains back all of his starting trinkets and consumables.
effects.raw: Isaac loses all items and is reset to a state exactly like if he started a new run, though keeping quest items to not block progression. All [[Attributes|stats]], consumables, trinkets, and all items except for starting items and quest items, are removed. Isaac gains back all of his starting trinkets and consumables.

effects.text: For every item removed using Genesis, there will be a set of three items from the removed item's pool to choose from, each set appearing one after the other at the bottom of the room.
effects.raw: For every item removed using Genesis, there will be a set of three items from the removed item's pool to choose from, each set appearing one after the other at the bottom of the room.

interactions.text: ? Card: If ? Card is used in place of Genesis, Genesis will be counted as an extra item for the choice set.
interactions.raw: {{P|? Card}}: If ? Card is used in place of Genesis, Genesis will be counted as an extra item for the choice set.

interactions.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Multidimensional Baby: Keys passing through the baby turn into normal tears and loses all of its effects.
interactions.raw: {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Keys passing through the baby turn into normal tears and loses all of its effects.

interactions.text: Pay To Play: The key cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests and open secret room doors.
