interactions.raw: {{i|Pay To Play}}: The key cannot unlock doors that originally were accessible by keys, but can still open chests and open secret room doors.

interactions.text: Poker Chip: Enemies have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an Attack Fly: The attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.
interactions.raw: {{t|Poker Chip}}: Enemies have a 50/50 chance to spawn extra pickups or an {{E|Attack Fly}}: The attack fly will be instantly killed by the thrown key.

interactions.text: Spectral Tears: Rocks that thrown keys pass over have a chance of being destroyed.
interactions.raw: [[Tear Effects#Spectral|Spectral Tears]]: Rocks that thrown keys pass over have a chance of being destroyed.

interactions.text: Trisagion: Thrown keys become Trisagion blasts and no longer cause enemies to drop chest contents on kill.
interactions.raw: {{I|Trisagion}}: Thrown keys become Trisagion blasts and no longer cause enemies to drop chest contents on kill.

name: Booster Pack (Item)
description: Drops 5 random cards.

effects.text: Drops 5 random cards.
effects.raw: Drops 5 random [[card]]s.

interactions.text: Little Baggy: Spawns 5 random pills instead.
interactions.raw: {{i|Little Baggy}}: Spawns 5 random [[pill]]s instead.

name: Mega Mush
description: Gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, increasing damage and range while lowering tears, granting invulnerability, and allowing Isaac to crush enemies and obstacles he walks on. The effect persists between rooms.

effects.text: Upon use, gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, persisting between rooms and floors. While gigantic, Isaac gains the following effects:
effects.raw: Upon use, gigantifies Isaac for 30 seconds, persisting between rooms and floors. While gigantic, Isaac gains the following effects:

children.text: A 4x damage multiplier, +2 range, and -1.9 tears.
children.raw: A 4x [[damage]] multiplier, +2 [[range]], and -1.9 [[tears]].

children.text: Cannot take damage for the duration of the effect.
children.raw: Cannot take damage for the duration of the effect.

children.text: Can destroy Objects, Obstacles, and Pitfalls when walking over them. This includes Metal Blocks and Key Blocks without using keys.
children.raw: Can destroy [[Object]]s, [[Obstacles]], and {{e|Pitfall}}s when walking over them. This includes [[Metal Block]]s and [[Key Block]]s without using keys.

children.text: Can break through normal doors, s, and any doors that require Bombs such as s, by walking into them.
children.raw: Can break through normal doors, {{r|Secret Room}}s, and any doors that require {{e|Bomb}}s such as {{r|Clean Bedroom}}s, by walking into them.

children.text: Cannot break through s, s, s, s, s, or any doors that require Keys such as s. Bedrooms also cannot be broken back into if they are closed but no longer boarded up.
children.raw: Cannot break through {{r|Challenge Room}}s, {{r|Boss Room}}s, {{r|Mini-Boss Room}}s, {{r|Curse Room}}s, {{r|Sacrifice Room}}s, or any doors that require {{e|Key}}s such as {{r|Shop}}s. Bedrooms also cannot be broken back into if they are closed but no longer boarded up.

children.text: Deals extremely heavy contact damage to enemies (80 per tick, or 2,400 per second).
children.raw: Deals extremely heavy contact damage to enemies (80 per tick, or 2,400 per second).

effects.text: Counts towards the Fun Guy transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Fun Guy}}

synergies.text: 4.5 Volt: The contact damage dealt by Mega Mush will allow it to be recharged and used multiple times in the same room.
synergies.raw: {{i|4.5 Volt}}: The contact damage dealt by Mega Mush will allow it to be recharged and used multiple times in the same room.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Mega Mush's active time will be doubled to 60 seconds.
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Mega Mush's active time will be doubled to 60 seconds.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Retains massive damage increase after Mega Mush's timer is up, though can make it nearly impossible to raise it afterwards without another use.
synergies.raw: {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Retains massive damage increase after Mega Mush's timer is up, though can make it nearly impossible to raise it afterwards without another use.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss: Enemies killed with contact damage will frequently drop hearts.
synergies.raw: {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}: Enemies killed with contact damage will frequently drop hearts.

interactions.text: Book of Virtues: Spawns a basic wisp.
interactions.raw: {{I|Book of Virtues}}: Spawns a basic wisp.

interactions.text: Keeper's Kin: Destroying rocks and blocks will allow Isaac to amass a lot of blue spiders.
interactions.raw: {{i|Keeper's Kin}}: Destroying [[rocks]] and [[blocks]] will allow Isaac to amass a lot of [[blue spider]]s.

name: Knife Piece 1
description: Combined with Knife Piece 2, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

effects.text: Spawns a knife handle familiar that follows Isaac.
effects.raw: Spawns a knife handle familiar that follows Isaac.

effects.text: Generates a room in Mines / Ashpit II for Knife Piece 2 to spawn in.
effects.raw: Generates a room in {{s|Mines}} / {{s|Ashpit}} II for {{i|Knife Piece 2}} to spawn in.

effects.text: Combines with Knife Piece 2 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
effects.raw: Combines with {{i|Knife Piece 2}} to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.

effects.text: Launching it at the red door at the end of Mausoleum/Gehenna II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
effects.raw: Launching it at the red door at the end of {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}} II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.

name: Knife Piece 2
description: Combined with Knife Piece 1, creates a knife familiar that damages enemies and can open the door to the Corpse.

effects.text: Combines with Knife Piece 1 to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.
effects.raw: Combines with {{i|Knife Piece 1}} to form a knife familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots, dealing 25 damage to and piercing enemies it hits.

effects.text: Launching it at the red door at the end of Mausoleum/Gehenna II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.
effects.raw: Launching it at the red door at the end of {{s|Mausoleum}}/{{s|Gehenna}} II will open the door, destroying the knife in the process.

name: Death Certificate
description: Transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which contains one copy of every item in the game. After taking an item, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

effects.text: Upon use, transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of Home, which has one copy of almost every item the player has unlocked on that save file on pedestals. After taking an item from a pedestal, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.
effects.raw: Upon use, transports Isaac to an abandoned and expanded version of {{S|Home}}, which has one copy of almost '''every''' item the player has unlocked on that save file on pedestals. After taking an item from a pedestal, Isaac returns to the room he used Death Certificate in.

children.text: There are also several pickups and Chest in the area. Picking them up/opening them will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
children.raw: There are also several [[pickups]] and {{E|Chest||chests}} in the area. Picking them up/opening them will not cause Isaac to leave the area.

children.text: If a chest in the area contains an item, picking it up will not cause Isaac to leave the area.
children.raw: If a chest in the area contains an item, picking it up will ''not'' cause Isaac to leave the area.

children.text: Items spawned through the use of pre-obtained items brought into the area, such as Eden's Soul or Mystery Gift, will also not cause Isaac to leave the area.
children.raw: Items spawned through the use of pre-obtained items brought into the area, such as {{i|Eden's Soul}} or {{i|Mystery Gift}}, will also not cause Isaac to leave the area.

synergies.text: ? Card: Mimics the effect of Death Certificate without consuming it.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card}}: Mimics the effect of Death Certificate without consuming it.

synergies.text: Diplopia: Has no use inside of the Home area, as Isaac can only take 1 item. However, it can be used to duplicate the Death Certificate item, allowing Isaac to enter the area twice.
synergies.raw: {{i|Diplopia}}: Has no use inside of the Home area, as Isaac can only take 1 item. However, it can be used to duplicate the Death Certificate item, allowing Isaac to enter the area twice.

synergies.text: Jacob and Esau: Both characters can take an item from any given room if they're lined up correctly and take them at the same time. This can be very powerful in the case of Brimstone and Mom's Knife, as they are both close together.
synergies.raw: {{c|Jacob and Esau}}: Both characters can take an item from any given room if they're lined up correctly and take them at the same time. This can be very powerful in the case of Brimstone and Mom's Knife, as they are both close together.

synergies.text: Red Key: Using the Red Key in this area has a chance of spawning rooms with many items from the Treasure Room pool in them, all of which can be taken without being returned back to the floor. It can also spawn special rooms from Home. If Mom's bedroom is spawned and Isaac sleeps in the bed, it will behave like a normal bed, but can be slept in while at full health.
synergies.raw: {{i|Red Key}}: Using the Red Key in this area has a chance of spawning rooms with many items from the [[Treasure Room (Item Pool)|Treasure Room pool]] in them, all of which can be taken without being returned back to the floor. It can also spawn special rooms from {{s|Home}}. If Mom's bedroom is spawned and Isaac sleeps in the bed, it will behave like a normal bed, but can be slept in while at full health.

synergies.text: Schoolbag: Allows Isaac to hold another Active item in the area along with Death Certificate.
synergies.raw: {{i|Schoolbag}}: Allows Isaac to hold another Active item in the area along with Death Certificate.

synergies.text: Tainted Cain: Unlike his modified pedestal behavior in the rest of the run, Tainted Cain can pick up an item like normal in this area, effectively allowing him to craft any specific item for the cost of 8 bone hearts (the guaranteed recipe for Death Certificate in the Bag of Crafting).
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Cain}}: Unlike his modified pedestal behavior in the rest of the run, Tainted Cain can pick up an item like normal in this area, effectively allowing him to craft any specific item for the cost of 8 bone hearts (the guaranteed recipe for Death Certificate in the Bag of Crafting).

synergies.text: Wild Card: Will use Death Certificate if it was the item/card Isaac most recently used.
synergies.raw: {{p|Wild Card}}: Will use Death Certificate if it was the item/card Isaac most recently used.

synergies.text: Metronome: Can invoke the effect of Death Certificate as normal, even if it is not unlocked.
synergies.raw: {{i|Metronome}}: Can invoke the effect of Death Certificate as normal, even if it is not unlocked.

interactions.text: Abyss / Black Rune / Void: Only allows the consumption of one item per room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
interactions.raw: {{i|Abyss}} / {{P|Black Rune}} / {{i|Void}}: Only allows the consumption of one item per room and the consumed item is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.

interactions.text: Binge Eater/Glitched Crown: No effect; items will not cycle through multiple items.
interactions.raw: {{i|Binge Eater}}/{{i|Glitched Crown}}: No effect; items will not cycle through multiple items.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Moving Box: Takes one random item which is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.
interactions.raw: {{i|Moving Box}}: Takes one random item which is treated as if it was picked up causing all other items in the room to disappear and forcing Isaac to leave the area.

interactions.text: Book of Virtues: Spawns a single, regular wisp with no special properties.
interactions.raw: {{i|Book of Virtues}}: Spawns a single, regular wisp with no special properties.

interactions.text: Damocles: No effect; Damocles doesn't duplicate the item pedestals in any room.
interactions.raw: {{i|Damocles}}: No effect; Damocles doesn't duplicate the item pedestals in any room.

interactions.text: NO!: causes Death Certificate to no longer spawn. inside Death Certificate floor Ignores changes to item availability.
interactions.raw: {{t|NO!}}: causes Death Certificate to no longer spawn. inside Death Certificate floor Ignores changes to item availability.

interactions.text: Sacred Orb / Tainted Lost / The Lost's Birthright: Ignores changes to item availability caused by characters/items.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacred Orb}} / {{C|Tainted Lost}} / [[Birthright (The Lost)|The Lost's Birthright]]: Ignores changes to item availability caused by characters/items.

interactions.text: IX - The Hermit?: When used with items present no coins are spawned and the floor exit sequence is triggered as if Isaac had taken an item.
interactions.raw: {{p|IX - The Hermit?}}: When used with items present no coins are spawned and the floor exit sequence is triggered as if Isaac had taken an item.

name: Bot Fly
description: Spawns an orbiting fly familiar that fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles.

effects.text: Spawns a robotic Pooter familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.
effects.raw: Spawns a robotic {{E|Pooter}} familiar that orbits around Isaac and fires shielded tears at incoming enemy projectiles, which destroy them on contact.

children.text: The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.
children.raw: The shielded tears home in on projectiles, but not enemies.

children.text: The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.
children.raw: The familiar deals 1 contact damage per tick or 3 damage per second, and instantly kills weak fly enemies on contact.

children.text: The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.
children.raw: The shielded tears deal 3 damage if they hit an enemy.

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

interactions.text: BFFS!: Increases contact damage but does not increase the damage of the tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases contact damage but does not increase the damage of the tears.

name: Meat Cleaver
description: Splits all enemies in the room into two smaller versions of themselves with much less health.

effects.text: Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.
effects.raw: Upon use, splits enemies in the current room into two smaller versions with ~40% health each.

children.text: Normal enemies can be split twice, while champions and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.
children.raw: Normal enemies can be split twice, while [[champion]]s and bosses can be split three times. If an enemy cannot be split, they instead take 25 damage.

children.text: If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as Squirt, Teratoma, or The Fallen, they will instead take the damage required to split them.
children.raw: If the enemy splits as part of their mechanic, such as {{E|Squirt}}, {{E|Teratoma}}, or {{E|The Fallen}}, they will instead take the damage required to split them.

children.text: If the enemy has segments, such as Larry Jr. or Buttlickers, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.
children.raw: If the enemy has segments, such as {{E|Larry Jr.}} or {{E|Buttlicker}}s, they will have their segments cut down to half, rounding down. There are several exceptions listed in the notes section.

children.text: If the enemy has a cable between them, such as Mr. Maw, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.
children.raw: If the enemy has a cable between them, such as {{E|Mr. Maw}}, it will immediately be cut. Mr. Maws specifically will be left with just their head.

synergies.text: Lusty Blood: Each split enemy killed grants a damage boost.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lusty Blood}}: Each split enemy killed grants a damage boost.

synergies.text: Sigil of Baphomet: Split enemies will allow the shield to activate and stack up more easily.
synergies.raw: {{T|Sigil of Baphomet}}: Split enemies will allow the shield to activate and stack up more easily.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.
interactions.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: If Blood Puppy is angry, splits it into two copies. One copy can level up and be tamed like normal, but the other cannot level up and dies instead of being tamed.

name: Evil Charm
description: +2 luck. Provides immunity to burn, confusion, fear, and poison. Prevents slowdown from cobwebs, and allows Isaac to stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.

effects.text: Gives Isaac +2.0 luck.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac +2.0 [[luck]].

effects.text: Makes Isaac immune to:
effects.raw: Makes Isaac immune to:

children.text: Confusion and fear status effects.
children.raw: [[Confusion]] and [[fear]] status effects.

children.text: Burn effects.
children.raw: [[Burn]] effects.

children.text: And damage from Fire Places, enemy fires (i.e. Candler), and fire projectiles (i.e. Great Gideon).
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} And damage from {{e|Fire Place}}s, enemy fires (i.e. {{e|Candler}}), and fire projectiles (i.e. {{e|Great Gideon}}).

children.text: Toxic clouds (i.e. Gasbags).
children.raw: Toxic clouds (i.e. {{E|Gasbag}}s).

children.text: This includes poison effects such as those from destroying Mushrooms.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} This includes poison effects such as those from destroying [[Mushroom (Obstacle)|Mushrooms]].

children.text: The Godhead aura from Dogma's projectiles.
children.raw: The {{i|Godhead}} aura from {{E|Dogma}}'s projectiles.

children.text: Slowdown from cobwebs.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Slowdown from [[cobweb]]s.

effects.text: Isaac can stand in enemy creep for 1 second before taking damage.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Isaac can stand in enemy [[creep]] for 1 second before taking damage.

name: Dogma (Item)
description: Grants flight, +2 damage, and increases speed to 1.1. Grants enough health to have 6 full hearts, if possible. Grants the Holy Mantle effect for the room it was obtained in. Automatically given to Isaac after defeating Dogma.

effects.text: Grants flight.
effects.raw: Grants [[flight]].

effects.text: Grants a one-time Holy Mantle-like effect. This effect wears off upon leaving the room.
effects.raw: Grants a one-time {{i|Holy Mantle}}-like effect. This effect wears off upon leaving the room.

effects.text: Prevents Isaac's speed from going under 1.1.
effects.raw: Prevents Isaac's [[speed]] from going under 1.1.

effects.text: +2 damage.
effects.raw: +2 [[damage]].

effects.text: If Isaac has fewer than six full hearts of health, Isaac is given enough hearts to get to six full hearts, first by restoring empty red heart containers, and then by granting soul hearts if that isn't enough.
effects.raw: If Isaac has fewer than six full [[health|hearts]] of health, Isaac is given enough hearts to get to six full hearts, first by restoring empty [[Health#Red Heart Containers|red heart containers]], and then by granting [[Health#Soul Hearts|soul hearts]] if that isn't enough.

children.text: Does not affect The Lost or Tainted Lost normally.
children.raw: Does not affect {{c|The Lost}} or {{c|Tainted Lost}} normally.

children.text: Keeper and Tainted Keeper's coin heart containers are affected by the red heart healing, but they will gain Blue Flies instead of soul hearts.
children.raw: {{c|Keeper}} and {{c|Tainted Keeper}}'s [[Health#Coin Hearts|coin heart containers]] are affected by the red heart healing, but they will gain [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] instead of soul hearts.

children.text: The Forgotten will have all his bone hearts replenished, and any soul hearts earned will go to The Soul.
children.raw: {{c|The Forgotten}} will have all his bone hearts replenished, and any soul hearts earned will go to The Soul.

children.text: Bethany will gain soul charges instead of soul hearts.
children.raw: {{c|Bethany}} will gain soul charges instead of soul hearts.

children.text: Tainted Lazarus will receive the flight and stat bonuses for both forms. Since defeating Dogma will swap between forms, the active character before the cutscene will not receive the healing and shield effect, which will instead be given to the form present after the cutscene.
children.raw: {{c|Tainted Lazarus}} will receive the flight and stat bonuses for both forms. Since defeating Dogma will swap between forms, the active character before the cutscene will ''not'' receive the healing and shield effect, which will instead be given to the form present after the cutscene.

children.text: Alabaster Box will take the soul hearts before they're given to Isaac, like normal.
children.raw: {{I|Alabaster Box}} will take the soul hearts before they're given to Isaac, like normal.

effects.text: On Normal mode, grants The Wafer effect, reducing all damage taken to half a heart.
effects.raw: {{mode|normal}} On Normal mode, grants {{I|The Wafer}} effect, reducing all damage taken to half a heart.

name: Purgatory
description: While in a room with enemies, spawns red cracks in the ground. Walking over these cracks summons ghosts that launch themselves at enemies and explode.

effects.text: Spawns a red crack in the ground somewhere in the room while Isaac is in a room with enemies. Walking over the crack summons a ghost that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.
effects.raw: Spawns a red crack in the ground somewhere in the room while Isaac is in a room with enemies. Walking over the crack summons a [[Familiar#Ghosts|ghost]] that homes in on the nearest enemy, exploding when it hits it. After the ghost is summoned, cracks will keep showing up in the room until it is cleared.

children.text: The ghost spends one second spawning in before it attacks.
children.raw: The ghost spends one second spawning in before it attacks.

children.text: The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.
children.raw: The ghost deals double Isaac's damage per tick, up to 4 times.

interactions.text: Dark Arts: Walking over cracks will not summon ghosts while under the effect of Dark Arts.
interactions.raw: {{I|Dark Arts}}: Walking over cracks will not summon ghosts while under the effect of Dark Arts.

interactions.text: Spindown Dice: When used on Purgatory, turns the item into Dogma, a unique item usually only able to be obtained by killing the boss Dogma.
interactions.raw: {{I|Spindown Dice}}: When used on Purgatory, turns the item into {{I|Dogma}}, a unique item usually only able to be obtained by killing the boss {{E|Dogma}}.

name: Stitches
description: Passively spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. On use, Isaac swaps places with the familiar.

effects.text: While held, spawns a familiar that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.
effects.raw: While held, spawns a [[familiar]] that moves in the direction Isaac shoots. Activating the item causes Isaac to swap places with Stitches. Isaac is briefly immune to damage after teleporting.

children.text: Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).
children.raw: Stitches deals 1.5 contact damage to enemies per tick (3.0 damage per second).

children.text: If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.
children.raw: If Isaac teleports onto an enemy, they will take 40 + 3x Isaac's damage.

children.text: If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.
children.raw: If Stitches teleports onto an enemy, it deals an additional hit for Isaac's damage.

children.text: Teleporting next to a Fire Place will put it out, including blue fires.
children.raw: Teleporting next to a {{E|Fire Place}} will put it out, including blue fires.

children.text: Teleporting on top of Shopkeepers will destroy them.
children.raw: Teleporting on top of {{E|Shopkeeper}}s will destroy them.

children.text: Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an will not break it.
children.raw: Teleporting on top of an angel statue in an {{R|Angel Room}} will not break it.

synergies.text: 9 Volt: Halves Stitches' charge time.
synergies.raw: {{i|9 Volt}}: Halves Stitches' charge time.

synergies.text: BFFS!: On teleport, fires 8 tears outwards at Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects and deal Isaac's damage. Stitches' teleport-on-enemy damage is increased to 3 + 2x Isaac's damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: On teleport, fires 8 tears outwards at Isaac's original location. The tears synergize with Isaac's tear effects and deal Isaac's damage. Stitches' teleport-on-enemy damage is increased to 3 + 2x Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss / The Virus: Can poison enemies during the brief immunity granted after teleporting.
synergies.raw: {{i|Serpent's Kiss}} / {{I|The Virus}}: Can poison enemies during the brief immunity granted after teleporting.

synergies.text: Midas' Touch: Enemies that survive being teleported onto will immediately turn into gold due to contact with Isaac. Thanks to the brief immunity, Isaac will not be harmed by this.
synergies.raw: {{i|Midas' Touch}}: Enemies that survive being teleported onto will immediately turn into gold due to contact with Isaac. Thanks to the brief immunity, Isaac will not be harmed by this.

synergies.text: Panic Button: As long as Stitches is charged, Isaac will teleport right before getting hit, negating damage. This can effectively be used as a 3-second-recharge Holy Mantle.
synergies.raw: {{t|Panic Button}}: As long as Stitches is charged, Isaac will teleport right before getting hit, negating damage. This can effectively be used as a 3-second-recharge {{i|Holy Mantle}}.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc. It will deal telefrag damage in both places (where Stitches is and where Isaac was).
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Swaps places with Isaac twice in quick succession, rendering Stitches useless for collecting pickups & items beyond pits, rocks etc. It will deal telefrag damage in both places (where Stitches is and where Isaac was).

name: R Key
description: Returns Isaac back to the first floor of a new run, retaining all of his stats and items.

effects.text: Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in Chapter 1, with all stat boosts, items, pickups, and trinkets intact, similar to a Victory Lap. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.
effects.raw: Returns Isaac to the beginning of the run in [[Chapter 1]], with all [[Attributes|stat]] boosts, [[items]], [[pickups]], and [[trinkets]] intact, similar to a [[Victory Lap]]. Unlike a Victory Lap, however, no effects are applied after a certain number of uses, and the timer is not reset.

synergies.text: ? Card: Activates R Key without consuming it, allowing for multiple run restarts.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card}}: Activates R Key without consuming it, allowing for multiple run restarts.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Dad's Note: Using R Key during the Ascent sequence will end it.
interactions.raw: {{i|Dad's Note}}: Using R Key during the [[Ascent]] sequence will end it.

name: Knockout Drops
description: Adds a chance to shoot a fist tear that has extremely high knockback and confuses enemies.

effects.text: Adds a chance to shoot red fist-shaped tears that deal extreme knockback and cause confusion for 2 seconds.
effects.raw: Adds a chance to shoot red fist-shaped tears that deal extreme knockback and cause [[confusion]] for 2 seconds.

children.text: Enemies will take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage when they are knocked into a wall/obstacle or when hit by another knocked back enemy.
children.raw: Enemies will take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) damage when they are knocked into a wall/[[obstacle]] or when hit by another knocked back enemy.

synergies.text: Aquarius: The trail of tears has a chance to knockback enemies.
synergies.raw: {{i|Aquarius}}: The trail of tears has a chance to knockback enemies.

synergies.text: Brimstone: Gives the lasers high knockback.
synergies.raw: {{I|Brimstone}}: Gives the lasers high knockback.

synergies.text: Jacob's Ladder: Enemies that are shocked by a knockback tear will also be knocked back.
synergies.raw: {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Enemies that are shocked by a knockback tear will also be knocked back.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: Hovering tear alternates between a normal tear and a fist.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: Hovering tear alternates between a normal tear and a fist.

synergies.text: Technology: Laser receives knockback effect as with normal tears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Technology}}: Laser receives knockback effect as with normal tears.

name: Eraser
description: Throws an eraser that instantly kills the first monster it hits, and prevents that enemy from spawning for the rest of the run. Deals 15 damage to bosses, erasing the boss from the rest of the run if damage is fatal. Only recharges upon entering a new floor.

effects.text: Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a monster, the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.
effects.raw: Upon use, Isaac holds an Eraser above his head, which can be thrown in any cardinal direction. Upon hitting a [[monster]], the enemy will be "erased", preventing any of the same enemy from appearing for the rest of the run.

children.text: Deals 15 damage to bosses. If fatal, erases the boss for the rest of the run.
children.raw: Deals 15 damage to [[boss]]es. If fatal, erases the boss for the rest of the run.

effects.text: Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. Batteries and most other methods of recharging have no effect.
effects.raw: Can only be recharged by entering a new floor. [[Batteries]] and most other methods of recharging have no effect.

synergies.text: ? Card: Can throw an additional Eraser.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card}}: Can throw an additional Eraser.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Throwing the Eraser through the Angelic Prism will cause it to split into four.
synergies.raw: {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Throwing the Eraser through the Angelic Prism will cause it to split into four.

synergies.text: The Battery: The eraser can gain an extra charge if it is not used on one floor.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Battery}}: The eraser can gain an extra charge if it is not used on one floor.

synergies.text: Bethany / Tainted Bethany: Soul and blood charges can be used with the Eraser, allowing multiple uses per floor.
synergies.raw: {{c|Bethany}} / {{c|Tainted Bethany}}: Soul and blood charges can be used with the Eraser, allowing multiple uses per floor.

synergies.text: Blood Puppy: Throwing the Eraser at an enraged Blood Puppy (second stage) will 'erase' its enraged form, keeping it permanently tame.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Throwing the Eraser at an enraged Blood Puppy (second stage) will 'erase' its enraged form, keeping it permanently tame.

children.text: Throwing the Eraser at its third stage will make it cycle through its normal and second stage as it kills enemies.
children.raw: Throwing the Eraser at its third stage will make it cycle through its normal and second stage as it kills enemies.

synergies.text: Void: An eraser can be thrown with each use of Void after absorbing it, allowing multiple uses per floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Void}}: An eraser can be thrown with each use of Void after absorbing it, allowing multiple uses per floor.

synergies.text: Tainted Lazarus: Enemies erased in one form will still be erased when Tainted Lazarus flips.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: Enemies erased in one form will still be erased when Tainted Lazarus flips.

interactions.text: 9 Volt / Battery Pack: Item doesn't fully charge the Eraser when picked up.
interactions.raw: {{I|9 Volt}} / {{I|Battery Pack}}: Item doesn't fully charge the Eraser when picked up.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Kidney Stone / Number One / Pluto / Inner Child's revive: Lowers the Eraser's range drastically and can only be improved with tear height ups.
interactions.raw: {{i|Kidney Stone}} / {{i|Number One}} / {{i|Pluto}} / {{i|Inner Child}}'s revive: Lowers the Eraser's range drastically and can only be improved with [[tear height]] ups.

interactions.text: My Shadow / Shade: Erasing a Charger will prevent all newly created friendly Chargers from spawning, rendering the item useless as this item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.
interactions.raw: {{I|My Shadow}} / {{I|Shade}}: Erasing a {{E|Charger}} will prevent all newly created [[friendly]] Chargers from spawning, rendering the item useless as this item spawns a normal Charger before changing it to the special My Shadow variant.

interactions.text: Sharp Plug: Attempting to recharge the Eraser with the Sharp Plug hurts Isaac for half a heart without recharging the item.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sharp Plug}}: Attempting to recharge the Eraser with the Sharp Plug hurts Isaac for half a heart without recharging the item.

interactions.text: Habit: Taking damage with Habit will not charge Eraser.
interactions.raw: {{I|Habit}}: Taking damage with Habit will not charge Eraser.

name: Yuck Heart
description: Grants Isaac a Rotten Heart.

effects.text: Grants a Rotten Heart upon use.
effects.raw: Grants a {{e|Rotten Heart}} upon use.

children.text: If Isaac has an empty red heart container or empty bone heart, the rotten heart will fill it.
children.raw: If Isaac has an empty red heart container or empty bone heart, the rotten heart will fill it.

children.text: If Isaac has only filled red and/or bone hearts, it will replace the contents.
children.raw: If Isaac has only filled red and/or bone hearts, it will replace the contents.

children.text: If Isaac has no red or bone hearts, or they all are already rotten, there is no effect.
children.raw: If Isaac has no red or bone hearts, or they all are already rotten, there is no effect.

name: Urn of Souls
description: Isaac pulls out or puts away an urn that fires a stream of damaging blue flames. It gains Soul Charges each time an enemy dies, which are used to fuel the urn.

effects.text: Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.
effects.raw: Upon use, Isaac pulls out (or puts away) the urn; holding a fire button when it's pulled out emits a stream of blue flames in whichever direction Isaac is aiming. Each flame deals 22.5-31.5 damage per second, depending on how far it's traveled, plus an additional 4.5 damage per second times floor number. Multiple flames can damage the same enemy simultaneously.

children.text: Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.
children.raw: Isaac is also pushed backwards slightly while using it.

children.text: The flames destroy enemy projectiles, Poop, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.
children.raw: The flames destroy enemy projectiles, {{e|Poop}}, and other fires, but bounce off rocks.

effects.text: Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.
effects.raw: Killing enemies grants a soul charge to the Urn, up to a maximum of 20. Killing bosses grants a larger boost. Charges must be used to power Urn of Souls, with each charge being equivalent to 15 flames over the course of half a second.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Flames can be split into four multi-colored flames.
synergies.raw: {{i|Angelic Prism}}: Flames can be split into four multi-colored flames.

synergies.text: Bird's Eye / Ghost Pepper: The urn can emit flames from these items. Ghost Pepper flames are indistinguishable from Urn of Souls flames, but persist on the ground for longer.
synergies.raw: {{i|Bird's Eye}} / {{i|Ghost Pepper}}: The urn can emit flames from these items. Ghost Pepper flames are indistinguishable from Urn of Souls flames, but persist on the ground for longer.

synergies.text: Eye of Greed / Large Zit / Tech.5 / Technology 2: Tears from these items will still shoot as normal while using the urn.
synergies.raw: {{I|Eye of Greed}} / {{i|Large Zit}} / {{i|Tech.5}} / {{i|Technology 2}}: Tears from these items will still shoot as normal while using the urn.

synergies.text: Guppy / The Mulligan: Fires have a chance to spawn Blue Flies.
synergies.raw: {{tf|Guppy}} / {{i|The Mulligan}}: Fires have a chance to spawn [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]].

synergies.text: Immaculate Heart: Each individual flame has a chance to cause Immaculate Heart to generate an orbiting tear.
synergies.raw: {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: Each individual flame has a chance to cause Immaculate Heart to generate an orbiting tear.

synergies.text: Lead Pencil: Every 15 flames shot out of the urn will shoot a barrage of Isaac's tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lead Pencil}}: Every 15 flames shot out of the urn will shoot a barrage of Isaac's tears.

synergies.text: Multidimensional Baby: All flames shot through Multidimensional Baby are doubled, providing a burst of flashing black-and-white tears.
synergies.raw: {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: All flames shot through Multidimensional Baby are doubled, providing a burst of flashing black-and-white tears.

synergies.text: Tear Detonator: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tear Detonator}}: Each flame splits into six tears, unlike other fire effects.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups don’t grant soul charges.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s don’t grant soul charges.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't grant soul charges.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't grant soul charges.

interactions.text: Kidney Stone: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.
interactions.raw: {{i|Kidney Stone}}: Firing the urn counts as fire time but the urn must be put away for Isaac to charge and shoot the kidney shot. Switching to the urn while auto-firing from Kidney Stone forces the urn to fire as well.

interactions.text: Void: No effect when absorbed by Void.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: No effect when absorbed by Void.

name: Akeldama
description: While in an uncleared room, Isaac forms a trail of bloody tears that drags behind him, bursting and dealing damage upon contact with enemies.

effects.text: While in a room with enemies, creates a trail of tears that Isaac drags behind him.
effects.raw: While in a room with enemies, creates a trail of tears that Isaac drags behind him.

children.text: Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.
children.raw: Each tear deals 3.5 damage, regardless of Isaac's damage.

children.text: Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.
children.raw: Tears are spawned at an irregular rate, roughly between once every 0.1 to 1 seconds.

children.text: The tears are spectral.
children.raw: The tears are [[spectral]].

effects.text: Once the room is cleared, the trail will remain but will stop regenerating.
effects.raw: Once the room is cleared, the trail will remain but will stop regenerating.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Splits the trail of tears into four multi-colored chains.
synergies.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: Splits the trail of tears into four multi-colored chains.

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: Some Akeldama tears will absorb tears shot by Isaac and gain size and damage as expected, but will not burst from being overloaded and can be fed infinite amount of tears. Meaning that each tear, if fed enough, can deal massive amounts of damage.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lachryphagy}}: Some Akeldama tears will absorb tears shot by Isaac and gain size and damage as expected, but will not burst from being overloaded and can be fed infinite amount of tears. Meaning that each tear, if fed enough, can deal massive amounts of damage.

synergies.text: Lodestone: Magnetized enemies will attract the tears from Akeldama's trail, making it easier to use.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lodestone}}: Magnetized enemies will attract the tears from Akeldama's trail, making it easier to use.

synergies.text: Multidimensional Baby: Akeldama tears that passes through Multidimensional baby will be cloned and may also create a separate trail if enough tears are cloned.
synergies.raw: {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}: Akeldama tears that passes through Multidimensional baby will be cloned and may also create a separate trail if enough tears are cloned.

synergies.text: Tear Detonator: Will burst tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Tear Detonator}}: Will burst tears generated by Akeldama into Isaac's current tears.

synergies.text: Technology Zero: Shot tears will create a laser between it and the Akeldama tear closest to Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{I|Technology Zero}}: Shot tears will create a laser between it and the Akeldama tear closest to Isaac.

synergies.text: Dead Eye: The tears in the trail will contribute to the damage boost, making it possible to stack damage while having items that do not interact with Dead Eye on their own (such as Brimstone).
synergies.raw: {{i|Dead Eye}}: The tears in the trail will contribute to the damage boost, making it possible to stack damage while having items that do not interact with Dead Eye on their own (such as {{i|Brimstone}}).

synergies.text: IBS: Holding a White Poop above your head will give Akeldama tears homing.
synergies.raw: {{I|IBS}}: Holding a {{e|White Poop}} above your head will give Akeldama tears homing.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: Akeldama tears are unaffected by Anti-Gravity.
interactions.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: Akeldama tears are unaffected by Anti-Gravity.

interactions.text: Brimstone: Akeldama creates normal tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|Brimstone}}: Akeldama creates normal tears.

interactions.text: Godhead: Akeldama tears do not have the aura.
interactions.raw: {{I|Godhead}}: Akeldama tears do not have the aura.

interactions.text: Ipecac: Akeldama creates normal tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: Akeldama creates normal tears.

interactions.text: Pop!: Akeldama blocks the eyeballs created by Pop!, making it quite difficult to hit enemies.
interactions.raw: {{i|Pop!}}: Akeldama blocks the eyeballs created by {{i|Pop!}}, making it quite difficult to hit enemies.

interactions.text: Scissors: The trail will follow Isaac's body.
interactions.raw: {{I|Scissors}}: The trail will follow Isaac's body.

name: Magic Skin
description: Consumes one heart container or two Soul Hearts to spawn an item and grant Isaac a broken heart container that can never be filled. If Magic Skin is not held after being used, it is very likely to replace any future items.

effects.text: Upon use, spawns an item pedestal from the current room's item pool.
effects.raw: Upon use, spawns an [[item]] pedestal from the current room's [[item pool]].

effects.text: Consumes one of Isaac's heart containers, one Bone Heart, or two Soul Hearts, replaced by a broken heart container.
effects.raw: Consumes one of Isaac's [[Health#Red Heart Containers|heart containers]], one {{e|Bone Heart}}, or two {{e|Soul Heart}}s, replaced by a [[Health#Broken Hearts|broken heart container]].

children.text: The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.
children.raw: The priority order of hearts that will be consumed is: one heart container, one bone heart, and two soul hearts.

effects.text: After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.
effects.raw: After using Magic Skin, if Isaac is not currently holding it, Magic Skin has a chance to replace any item that spawns in the future.

children.text: The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.
children.raw: The original item that was replaced is considered seen and, depending on the pool, possibly can't be found again.

children.text: The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.
children.raw: The chance is 33% after one use, 50% after two uses, and 100% after three uses.

children.text: If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.
children.raw: If Magic Skin is on a pedestal somewhere on the current floor, the replacement chance is reduced to 1% per use. Unpurchased Shop and Devil Deal items do not count.

children.text: Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.
children.raw: Each new Magic Skin is fully recharged.

effects.text: If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.
effects.raw: If Isaac's entire health bar is filled with broken heart containers by using Magic Skin (which kills him, but an extra life will remove one broken heart container), this item will disappear and future items won't be replaced.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Spawns 2 items and adds 2 broken hearts (removing 2 heart containers or 4 soul hearts) with each use. Two broken hearts are added regardless of Isaac's remaining health. If Isaac already has 11 broken hearts and uses Magic Skin, it will only be used once.
synergies.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: Spawns 2 items and adds 2 broken hearts (removing 2 heart containers or 4 soul hearts) with each use. Two broken hearts are added regardless of Isaac's remaining health. If Isaac already has 11 broken hearts and uses Magic Skin, it will only be used once.

synergies.text: Damocles: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.
synergies.raw: {{I|Damocles}}: Spawns 2 items on every use instead of 1.

synergies.text: Esau Jr.: Since Esau Jr.'s health is separate from Isaac's, one character can use Magic Skin at no cost to the other. Future items will still be replaced when playing as the character that hasn't used Magic Skin.
synergies.raw: {{I|Esau Jr.}}: Since Esau Jr.'s health is separate from Isaac's, one character can use Magic Skin at no cost to the other. Future items will still be replaced when playing as the character that hasn't used Magic Skin.

synergies.text: Schoolbag: Isaac can keep Magic Skin in the inactive slot to prevent its respawning while still being able to use another active item.
synergies.raw: {{i|Schoolbag}}: Isaac can keep Magic Skin in the inactive slot to prevent its respawning while still being able to use another active item.

synergies.text: Spindown Dice: Using Spindown Dice on Magic Skin 6 times turns it into R Key.
synergies.raw: {{I|Spindown Dice}}: Using Spindown Dice on Magic Skin 6 times turns it into {{I|R Key}}.

children.text: Spindown Dice + Schoolbag: Allows Isaac to keep Spindown Dice between runs, allowing a theoretically infinite run with enough luck.
children.raw: '''Spindown Dice''' + '''Schoolbag''': Allows Isaac to keep Spindown Dice between runs, allowing a theoretically infinite run with enough luck.

children.text: Restock: If Isaac can find a Battery in the shop, as long as one has enough coins, runs can actually be infinite.
children.raw: '''Restock:''' If Isaac can find a Battery in the shop, as long as one has enough coins, runs can actually be infinite.

interactions.text: Alabaster Box: Magic Skin can use Soul hearts from the box, and will prioritize them over those in health.
interactions.raw: {{i|Alabaster Box}}: Magic Skin can use Soul hearts from the box, and will prioritize them over those in health.

interactions.text: Binge Eater: Will still offer a food item even if Magic Skin replaced an item.
interactions.raw: {{I|Binge Eater}}: Will still offer a food item even if Magic Skin replaced an item.

interactions.text: Dream Catcher: If Magic Skin has replaced the item in the , it will be shown in the dream sequence.
interactions.raw: {{I|Dream Catcher}}: If Magic Skin has replaced the item in the {{R|Treasure Room}}, it will be shown in the dream sequence.

children.text: Holding Magic Skin or having a pedestal with it on the same floor can cause the item in the Treasure Room to not be replaced by Magic Skin.
children.raw: Holding Magic Skin or having a pedestal with it on the same floor can cause the item in the Treasure Room to not be replaced by Magic Skin.

interactions.text: Genesis: Removes all broken hearts as well as items. Magic Skin can still replace items in the Genesis room.
interactions.raw: {{I|Genesis}}: Removes all broken hearts as well as items. Magic Skin can still replace items in the Genesis room.

interactions.text: Glowing Hourglass: Recovers a broken heart when used after using Magic Skin. Using Magic Skin in the same type of room will spawn the same item, it must be used in a different room type first to spawn a different item in the previous room type.
interactions.raw: {{I|Glowing Hourglass}}: Recovers a broken heart when used after using Magic Skin. Using Magic Skin in the same type of room will spawn the same item, it must be used in a different room type first to spawn a different item in the previous room type.

interactions.text: Lemegeton: Magic Skin can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run. As long as Isaac has this flame, Magic Skin will not respawn/replace items.
interactions.raw: {{I|Lemegeton}}: Magic Skin can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run. As long as Isaac has this flame, Magic Skin will not respawn/replace items.

interactions.text: Metronome: Getting Magic Skin from Metronome has a chance to instantly apply the item replacement and spawn Magic Skin as an item pedestal.
interactions.raw: {{I|Metronome}}: Getting Magic Skin from Metronome has a chance to instantly apply the item replacement and spawn Magic Skin as an item pedestal.

interactions.text: Mystery Gift: Does not replace A Lump of Coal or The Poop.
interactions.raw: {{I|Mystery Gift}}: Does not replace {{I|A Lump of Coal}} or {{I|The Poop}}.

interactions.text: NO!: Does not prevent Magic Skin from replacing items, despite it being an active item.
interactions.raw: {{T|NO!}}: Does not prevent Magic Skin from replacing items, despite it being an active item.

interactions.text: Tainted Eden: Broken hearts persist even after Magic Skin is rerolled.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Eden}}: Broken hearts persist even after Magic Skin is rerolled.

interactions.text: TMTRAINER: Prevents Magic Skin from replacing items, since future Magic Skins will be glitched.
interactions.raw: {{I|TMTRAINER}}: Prevents Magic Skin from replacing items, since future Magic Skins will be glitched.

interactions.text: R Key: Magic Skin still replaces items after using R Key.
interactions.raw: {{I|R Key}}: Magic Skin still replaces items after using R Key.

interactions.text: Void: Absorbing Magic Skin does not prevent future items from being replaced, including items spawned by the absorbed Magic Skin. Additional Magic Skins can be absorbed, allowing multiple items to be spawned per use at the cost of adding more broken hearts.
interactions.raw: {{I|Void}}: Absorbing Magic Skin does not prevent future items from being replaced, including items spawned by the absorbed Magic Skin. Additional Magic Skins can be absorbed, allowing multiple items to be spawned per use at the cost of adding more broken hearts.

name: Revelation
description: Grants flight. In addition to tears, Isaac can charge up and fire a powerful holy laser. Also grants two Soul Hearts.

effects.text: Grants flight.
effects.raw: Grants [[flight]].

effects.text: Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the Angel bosses.
effects.raw: Continuously firing for 2.35 seconds allows Isaac to fire a powerful holy laser when Isaac stops shooting, similar to the attacks used by the [[Angel]] bosses.

children.text: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).
children.raw: The laser deals Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (up to a maximum of 15 times) and can be aimed diagonally. It lasts for ~1.28 seconds (77 frames).

children.text: With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to Analog Stick.
children.raw: With the EnableMouseControl enabled or an analog controller, the laser can be aimed in any direction, similarly to {{I|Analog Stick}}.

effects.text: Counts towards the Seraphim transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}

synergies.text: Revelation, Maw Of The Void, No. 2, and Montezuma's Revenge all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at the same time.
synergies.raw: Revelation, {{I|Maw Of The Void}}, {{I|No. 2}}, and {{I|Montezuma's Revenge}} all have the same charge time, allowing Isaac to easily utilize them at the same time.

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: When the laser hits the prism, it will split in four.
synergies.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: When the laser hits the prism, it will split in four.

synergies.text: Brain Worm: The laser can bend completely to hit an enemy, effectively acting as a better form of homing on single enemies and bosses.
synergies.raw: {{T|Brain Worm}}: The laser can bend completely to hit an enemy, effectively acting as a better form of homing on single enemies and bosses.

synergies.text: Continuum The laser loops around. The laser cannot hit the same enemy twice.
synergies.raw: {{I|Continuum}} The laser loops around. The laser cannot hit the same enemy twice.

synergies.text: Cricket's Body: Spawns 4 split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits every other tick. The tears are Piercing and deal half damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
synergies.raw: {{I|Cricket's Body}}: Spawns 4 split tears on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits every other tick. The tears are [[Piercing]] and deal half damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

synergies.text: Eve's Mascara / Polyphemus: As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly increased.
synergies.raw: {{I|Eve's Mascara}} / {{I|Polyphemus}}: As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly increased.

synergies.text: Homing tears: The laser will home in on enemies in a very effective way.
synergies.raw: [[Homing tears]]: The laser will home in on enemies in a very effective way.

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: The laser has reduced range, but spawns a red Lachryphagy tear per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
synergies.raw: {{I|Lachryphagy}}: The laser has reduced range, but spawns a red Lachryphagy tear per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

synergies.text: Marked: The laser is fired automatically upon reaching full charge in the direction of the mark. Combined with charged attacks, this allows them to keep their DPS.
synergies.raw: {{I|Marked}}: The laser is fired automatically upon reaching full charge in the direction of the mark. Combined with charged attacks, this allows them to keep their DPS.

synergies.text: Multidimensional Baby: The baby can duplicate the laser.
synergies.raw: {{I|Multidimensional Baby}}: The baby can duplicate the laser.

children.text: Multidimensional Baby + Lachryphagy / Pop!: Lasers modified by Multidimensional Baby are no longer affected by Lachryphagy or Pop!, being normal length and not firing additional tears/eyes out the end.
children.raw: Multidimensional Baby + {{I|Lachryphagy}} / {{I|Pop!}}: Lasers modified by Multidimensional Baby are no longer affected by Lachryphagy or Pop!, being normal length and not firing additional tears/eyes out the end.

synergies.text: The Parasite: Spawns two perpendicular lasers on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits. The laser and its split lasers cannot hit the same enemy.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Parasite}}: Spawns two perpendicular lasers on the first enemy or obstacle the laser hits. The laser and its split lasers cannot hit the same enemy.

children.text: Also spawn small split tears.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Also spawn small split tears.

synergies.text: Pop!: The laser has reduced range, but shoots out an eyeball per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.
synergies.raw: {{I|Pop!}}: The laser has reduced range, but shoots out an eyeball per tick. The tears are Piercing and deal the damage of the laser. They can hit the same enemy the laser hit.

synergies.text: Proptosis: The beam deals ~2.47× Isaac's Damage at point blank range.
synergies.raw: {{I|Proptosis}}: The beam deals ~2.47× Isaac's Damage at point blank range.

synergies.text: Rubber Cement: The laser will bounce off the walls for a short distance.
synergies.raw: {{I|Rubber Cement}}: The laser will bounce off the walls for a short distance.

synergies.text: Tiny Planet: The laser will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.
synergies.raw: {{I|Tiny Planet}}: The laser will wrap around Isaac once and then shoot straight forward.

synergies.text: Jacob's Ladder: Upon hitting an enemy, wall or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.
synergies.raw: {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: Upon hitting an enemy, wall or obstacle, the beam generates sparks that home in on enemies.

interactions.text: Anti-Gravity: The laser fires in place, not following Isaac.
interactions.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: The laser fires in place, not following Isaac.

interactions.text: Almond Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased. The laser do not gain worm trinket effects.
interactions.raw: {{I|Almond Milk}}: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased. The laser do not gain worm trinket effects.

interactions.text: Diplopia: Multiple copies of Revelation have no extra effect.
interactions.raw: {{I|Diplopia}}: Multiple copies of Revelation have no extra effect.

interactions.text: Explosivo / Mucormycosis / Sinus Infection: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{I|Explosivo}} / {{I|Mucormycosis}} / {{I|Sinus Infection}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: No effect.

children.text: Eye of the Occult + Brimstone/Technology: The Revelation beam also automatically fires at the crosshair.
children.raw: '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: The Revelation beam also automatically fires at the crosshair.

interactions.text: Ipecac: The laser will poison enemies and repeatedly explode on contact with an enemy or obstacle. Despite its high damage increase, Ipecac only adds +2 damage to the beam, similarly to Brimstone.
interactions.raw: {{I|Ipecac}}: The laser will poison enemies and repeatedly explode on contact with an enemy or obstacle. Despite its high damage increase, Ipecac only adds +2 damage to the beam, similarly to {{I|Brimstone}}.

interactions.text: Kidney Stone: The laser can be fired as normal while the kidney stone is charging. The laser is charged and fired automatically after the kidney stone is fired.
interactions.raw: {{I|Kidney Stone}}: The laser can be fired as normal while the kidney stone is charging. The laser is charged and fired automatically after the kidney stone is fired.

interactions.text: Luck-based tear effects: No effect.
interactions.raw: [[Luck]]-based tear effects: No effect.

interactions.text: Libra: The laser ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
interactions.raw: {{i|Libra}}: The laser ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

interactions.text: My Reflection: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac and then shoots straight backwards.
interactions.raw: {{I|My Reflection}}: The laser makes a thin loop in front of Isaac and then shoots straight backwards.

interactions.text: Mysterious Liquid: The laser leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the laser hits per tick.
interactions.raw: {{I|Mysterious Liquid}}: The laser leaves a creep for each enemy and obstacle the laser hits per tick.

interactions.text: Playdough Cookie: The laser rapidly flashes between different colors while firing, with a chance to inflict status effects.
interactions.raw: {{I|Playdough Cookie}}: The laser rapidly flashes between different colors while firing, with a chance to inflict status effects.

interactions.text: Soy Milk: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased.
interactions.raw: {{I|Soy Milk}}: Unlike charged attacks, the laser cannot be fired automatically. As the laser deals Isaac’s damage, but is not affected by tear delay, the DPS of the laser is greatly decreased.

interactions.text: Sulfuric Acid / Terra: The laser will occasionally break obstacles.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sulfuric Acid}} / {{I|Terra}}: The laser will occasionally break obstacles.

interactions.text: Tech X: If the Revelation beam and the Tech X are both charged, it will sometimes fire the Revelation beam first and the Tech X ring at the end of it.
interactions.raw: {{I|Tech X}}: If the Revelation beam and the Tech X are both charged, it will sometimes fire the Revelation beam first and the Tech X ring at the end of it.

name: Consolation Prize
description: Increases Isaac's lowest stat and drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key depending on what Isaac has the least of.

effects.text: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what attribute Isaac has the least of:
effects.raw: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts, depending on what [[attribute]] Isaac has the least of:

children.text: +1.0 flat damage
children.raw: +1.0 flat [[damage]]

children.text: +0.5 fire rate
children.raw: +0.5 [[fire rate]]

children.text: +0.2 speed
+2.5 range

effects.text: Also drops either 3 Penny, 1 Bomb, or 1 Key on the ground.
effects.raw: Also drops either 3 {{e|Penny|text=Coins}}, 1 {{e|Bomb}}, or 1 {{e|Key}} on the ground.

children.text: Bombs and keys are valued at 3 coins' worth. The pickup dropped will be what Isaac has the least value of, and in case of a tie one is chosen randomly.
children.raw: Bombs and keys are valued at 3 coins' worth. The pickup dropped will be what Isaac has the least value of, and in case of a tie one is chosen randomly.

effects.text: As Bethany and Tainted Bethany, one Soul Heart or two Red Hearts can also be dropped if they are low on charges.
effects.raw: As {{C|Bethany}} and {{c|Tainted Bethany}}, one {{e|Soul Heart}} or two {{e|Red Heart}}s can also be dropped if they are low on charges.

children.text: Charges are valued at 2 × Charges - 1 coins' worth. For instance having 7 charges would be valued at 13 coins.
children.raw: Charges are valued at ''2 × Charges - 1'' coins' worth. For instance having 7 charges would be valued at 13 coins.

name: Tinytoma
description: Gives Isaac a Teratoma orbital that blocks shots, deals contact damage, and splits into smaller versions of itself upon taking damage. The smaller versions break into blue spiders.

effects.text: Grants a large orbital similar to Teratoma that slowly orbits Isaac.
effects.raw: Grants a large [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] similar to {{E|Teratoma}} that slowly orbits Isaac.

children.text: The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.
children.raw: The orbital repels enemies that touch it and deals 3.5 contact damage to enemies, once per second.

effects.text: After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 blue spiders in the process.
effects.raw: After blocking 3 shots and/or dealing 3 ticks of contact damage, the orbital splits into two smaller ones that orbit opposite of each other. They behave the same as the original, except they are smaller and can only take 2 hits before being destroyed, bursting into 3 [[blue spider]]s in the process.

children.text: 5 seconds after both orbitals are destroyed, the original, full-size orbital respawns.
children.raw: 5 seconds after both orbitals are destroyed, the original, full-size orbital respawns.

name: Brimstone Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Bombs fire four Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions upon exploding.

effects.text: Gives Isaac +5 Bombs.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac +5 {{e|Bomb}}s.

effects.text: Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 Brimstone lasers in the cardinal directions.
effects.raw: Upon exploding, Isaac's bombs fire 4 {{i|Brimstone}} lasers in the cardinal directions.

children.text: Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.
children.raw: Each laser deals 8 damage per tick, and can hit up to 19 times.

children.text: Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.
children.raw: Multiple lasers cannot hit the same enemy simultaneously.

children.text: The lasers cannot damage Isaac.
children.raw: The lasers cannot damage Isaac.

synergies.text: BBF / Bob's Brain: Inherits the effect in full, firing lasers every time they explode.
synergies.raw: {{i|BBF}} / {{I|Bob's Brain}}: Inherits the effect in full, firing lasers every time they explode.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus / Epic Fetus: Attacks have a small chance to trigger this effect. Chance goes up to 100% at 30 luck.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}} / {{i|Epic Fetus}}: Attacks have a small chance to trigger this effect. Chance goes up to 100% at 30 luck.

synergies.text: Hemoptysis: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone lasers deal to 19 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone lasers under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.
synergies.raw: {{i|Hemoptysis}}: Enemies hit by the sneeze will gain a curse that increases the damage the Brimstone lasers deal to 19 damage per tick. Enemies who die to the Brimstone lasers under the curse will damage and spread the curse to nearby enemies.

synergies.text: Guppy / The Mulligan: The lasers can create Blue Flies when they deal damage.
synergies.raw: {{tf|Guppy}} / {{i|The Mulligan}}: The lasers can create [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] when they deal damage.

synergies.text: Kamikaze!: Activating Kamikaze! sends Brimstone lasers in all 4 directions.
synergies.raw: {{I|Kamikaze!}}: Activating Kamikaze! sends Brimstone lasers in all 4 directions.

synergies.text: Red Locusts / Scatter Bombs: Explosions made by the red locusts and tiny bombs create thinner lasers that deal 4.8 damage per tick instead of 8.
synergies.raw: [[Locust|Red Locusts]] / {{i|Scatter Bombs}}: Explosions made by the red locusts and tiny bombs create thinner lasers that deal 4.8 damage per tick instead of 8.

synergies.text: Multidimensional Baby: Placing Multidimensional Baby in front of the beam will transform it into two black-and-white beams.
synergies.raw: {{i|Multidimensional Baby}}: Placing Multidimensional Baby in front of the beam will transform it into two black-and-white beams.

interactions.text: Bomber Boy: Only the center explosion will fire lasers.
interactions.raw: {{i|Bomber Boy}}: Only the center explosion will fire lasers.

interactions.text: Anarchist Cookbook: The lasers fired by the troll bombs will push other troll bombs around, likely to the edges of the room.
interactions.raw: {{i|Anarchist Cookbook}}: The lasers fired by the troll bombs will push other troll bombs around, likely to the edges of the room.

name: 4.5 Volt
description: Active items don't charge when clearing rooms. Instead, they're charged by dealing damage to enemies.

effects.text: Causes Isaac's active item to charge when Isaac deals damage to enemies, rather than when he clears rooms.
effects.raw: Causes Isaac's active item to charge when Isaac deals damage to enemies, rather than when he clears rooms.

children.text: Damage dealt by charmed/friendly enemies, active items, orbitals, and familiars (including blue flies and spiders) works as well.
children.raw: Damage dealt by [[charm]]ed/[[friendly]] enemies, active items, orbitals, and familiars (including blue flies and spiders) works as well.

effects.text: Charges are gained at a rate equal to the following formula: (40 + (20 × stage)). For example:
effects.raw: Charges are gained at a rate equal to the following formula: (40 + (20 × stage)). For example:

children.text: In Basement I / Downpour I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.
children.raw: In {{s|Basement}} I / {{s|Downpour}} I, it takes 60 damage to gain 1 charge.

children.text: In Caves II / Mines II, it takes 120 damage.
children.raw: In {{s|Caves}} II / {{s|Mines}} II, it takes 120 damage.

children.text: In Womb I / Corpse I, it takes 180 damage.
children.raw: In {{s|Womb}} I / {{s|Corpse}} I, it takes 180 damage.

children.text: In Sheol / Cathedral, it takes 240 damage.
children.raw: In {{s|Sheol}} / {{s|Cathedral}}, it takes 240 damage.

children.text: In Home, it takes 300 damage.
children.raw: In {{s|Home}}, it takes 300 damage.

children.text: Ascent floors use the values of their regular floors, meaning the amount of damage 4.5 Volt needs to gain charges steadily decreases during the Ascent sequence until reaching Home.
children.raw: [[Ascent]] floors use the values of their regular floors, meaning the amount of damage 4.5 Volt needs to gain charges steadily decreases during the Ascent sequence until reaching Home.

effects.text: Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.
effects.raw: Multiple charges cannot be gained at once.

effects.text: Overkill damage does not count towards a charge.
effects.raw: Overkill damage does not count towards a charge.

synergies.text: Book of Shadows: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Shadows}}: With sufficient damage, the Book of Shadows can be kept active indefinitely.

children.text: If combined with 9 Volt, it becomes even easier to achieve invincibility.
children.raw: If combined with {{i|9 Volt}}, it becomes even easier to achieve invincibility.

synergies.text: Door Stop / Mercurius / any means of room resetting (infinite bombs): Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.
synergies.raw: {{t|Door Stop}} / {{i|Mercurius}} / any means of room resetting (infinite bombs): Provides infinite charges by clearing some enemies then leaving the room, and repeating.

synergies.text: Jumper Cables: Increases the rate of charge by appending its 15-kills-per-charge quality on top of 4.5 Volt's damage-based charge.
synergies.raw: {{i|Jumper Cables}}: Increases the rate of charge by appending its 15-kills-per-charge quality on top of 4.5 Volt's damage-based charge.

synergies.text: Old Capacitor: Since the 4.5 Volt also makes it so that active items don't charge when clearing rooms, this trinket can be picked up with no downside.
synergies.raw: {{t|Old Capacitor}}: Since the 4.5 Volt also makes it so that active items don't charge when clearing rooms, this trinket can be picked up with no downside.

synergies.text: Unicorn Stump + Sacrificial Dagger: In most boss fights, charges are regenerated faster than invincibility wears off.
synergies.raw: {{i|Unicorn Stump}} + {{i|Sacrificial Dagger}}: In most boss fights, charges are regenerated faster than invincibility wears off.

synergies.text: White Pony: Since the beam trail from the charge attack deals so much damage, if used on a boss with a high amount of health, 4.5 Volt will often completely recharge the item after each use, allowing for repeated usage while the boss is still alive.
synergies.raw: {{i|White Pony}}: Since the beam trail from the charge attack deals so much damage, if used on a boss with a high amount of health, 4.5 Volt will often completely recharge the item after each use, allowing for repeated usage while the boss is still alive.

children.text: For the same reason (so much damage against bosses that the active item is recharged from its use), Tammy's Head + Brimstone / Azazel / Tainted Azazel is also a strong synergy.
children.raw: For the same reason (so much damage against bosses that the active item is recharged from its use), {{I|Tammy's Head}} + {{I|Brimstone}} / {{C|Azazel}} / {{C|Tainted Azazel|r}} is also a strong synergy.

interactions.text: Does not charge items which gain charge over time by default. (e.g. Sharp Straw, The Candle, Butter Bean etc.)
interactions.raw: Does not charge items which gain charge over time by default. (e.g. {{i|Sharp Straw}}, {{I|The Candle}}, {{i|Butter Bean}} etc.)

children.text: Items converted to charge-over-time by 9 Volt are not affected and may gain charge in both ways.
children.raw: Items converted to charge-over-time by {{i|9 Volt}} are not affected and may gain charge in both ways.

interactions.text: Alabaster Box: No effect. It still must be charged with Soul Hearts.
interactions.raw: {{i|Alabaster Box}}: No effect. It still must be charged with Soul Hearts.

interactions.text: Dim Bulb: Does not deactivate until the first charge bar is completely filled. A partial charge of the first bar will retain Dim Bulb's bonus.
interactions.raw: {{t|Dim Bulb}}: Does not deactivate until the first charge bar is completely filled. A partial charge of the first bar will retain Dim Bulb's bonus.

interactions.text: Schoolbag: The item in the second slot gets charged when the first one is full. Overcharges on the first item also jump to the second one.
interactions.raw: {{i|Schoolbag}}: The item in the second slot gets charged when the first one is full. Overcharges on the first item also jump to the second one.

name: Fruity Plum
description: Gives Isaac a miniature Baby Plum familiar that propels itself diagonally around the room, firing tears behind itself as it travels.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a familiar that mimics Baby Plum's attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a [[familiar]] that mimics {{E|Baby Plum}}'s attack of shooting tears and propelling itself diagonally around the room. It deals 2 contact damage per tick to enemies (6 per second). It fires 15 tears per second behind itself while moving which deals 3 damage.

children.text: Fruity Plum will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.
children.raw: Fruity Plum will prioritize moving towards nearby enemies.

children.text: If there are no enemies, Fruity Plum loosely orbits Isaac.
children.raw: If there are no enemies, Fruity Plum loosely orbits Isaac.

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: The homing effect is applied as normal which drastically improves its damage output.
synergies.raw: {{T|Baby-Bender}}: The [[homing]] effect is applied as normal which drastically improves its damage output.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles its contact damage and tear damage. The effect does not stack.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}} / {{I|Hive Mind}}: Doubles its contact damage and tear damage. The effect does not stack.

interactions.text: Child Leash: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{T|Child Leash}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Forgotten Lullaby: Does not increase its fire rate.
interactions.raw: {{T|Forgotten Lullaby}}: Does not increase its fire rate.

interactions.text: Friendship Necklace: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{T|Friendship Necklace}}: No effect.

interactions.text: RC Remote: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{T|RC Remote}}: No effect. {{nav|fly}}

name: Plum Flute
description: Summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac for roughly 10 seconds, dealing high damage.

effects.text: On use, summons Baby Plum to fight for Isaac in the current room for roughly 10 seconds.
effects.raw: On use, summons {{E|Baby Plum}} to fight for Isaac in the current room for roughly 10 seconds.

children.text: Baby Plum will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before waving goodbye and flying away.
children.raw: Baby Plum will always twirl, jump, then spit blood and bounce around the room before waving goodbye and flying away.
