children.text: Baby Plum does 12 contact damage per tick (24 per second), 3.5 damage per shot, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).
children.raw: Baby Plum does 12 contact damage per tick (24 per second), 3.5 damage per shot, and 2 damage per tick with creep (20 per second).

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

synergies.text: Angelic Prism: Baby Plum's shots that pass through the Prism will be split into four.
synergies.raw: {{I|Angelic Prism}}: {{E|Baby Plum}}'s shots that pass through the Prism will be split into four.

synergies.text: BFFS! / Hive Mind: Doubles Baby Plum's contact damage, but not projectile damage. Plum is also larger.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}} / {{I|Hive Mind}}: Doubles {{E|Baby Plum}}'s contact damage, but not projectile damage. Plum is also larger.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Summons two Baby Plums, the Baby Plums start out overlapped but can sometimes split up when using different attacks.
synergies.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: Summons two Baby Plums, the Baby Plums start out overlapped but can sometimes split up when using different attacks.

synergies.text: Lost Cork: Affects Baby Plum's blood puddle.
synergies.raw: {{T|Lost Cork}}: Affects Baby Plum's blood puddle.

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar: Baby Plum can be sacrificed for free, instead of a familiar. Plum Flute can still be used as normal afterwards.
synergies.raw: {{I|Sacrificial Altar}}: Baby Plum can be sacrificed for free, instead of a familiar. Plum Flute can still be used as normal afterwards.

interactions.text: Baby-Bender: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{T|Baby-Bender}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Eraser: Plum Flute will still function normally if the boss Baby Plum is erased.
interactions.raw: {{I|Eraser}}: Plum Flute will still function normally if the boss Baby Plum is erased.

name: Star of Bethlehem
description: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels towards the , giving an aura that increases damage and tears and grants homing tears.

effects.text: Spawns a star familiar that slowly travels toward the , fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.
effects.raw: Spawns a star [[familiar]] that slowly travels toward the {{R|Boss Room}}, fading through doors as it travels towards it. Once it reaches the boss room, the familiar stands in the center of the boss room for the rest of the floor.

effects.text: The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5× fire rate multiplier, and homing tears. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to Cone Head's effect except with a higher chance.
effects.raw: The familiar emits an aura that, while Isaac stands inside it, gives him a {{dlc|nr+}} 1.8× / {{dlc|r+}} 1.2x damage multiplier, a 2.5× [[Tears|fire rate]] multiplier, and [[Tear Effects#Homing|homing tears]]. It also gives Isaac a 50% chance to ignore damage similarly to {{I|Cone Head}}'s effect except with a higher chance.

synergies.text: Blood Rights/IV Bag/Kamikaze!/Razor Blade: The aura has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Rights}}/{{i|IV Bag}}/{{i|Kamikaze!}}/{{i|Razor Blade}}: The aura has a chance to block the damage inflicted, but the effects will still occur.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Isaac will keep the stat upgrades even after leaving the aura. However, it won't keep the homing effect outside of the aura.
synergies.raw: {{I|Rock Bottom}}: Isaac will keep the stat upgrades even after leaving the aura. However, it won't keep the homing effect outside of the aura.

synergies.text: Sprinkler: The tears that the Sprinkler shoots will also be buffed, along with its rotation speed.
synergies.raw: {{I|Sprinkler}}: The tears that the Sprinkler shoots will also be buffed, along with its rotation speed.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The star appears larger, but the aura's size does not increase and neither do the stat gains.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: The star appears larger, but the aura's size does not increase and neither do the stat gains.

interactions.text: Hallowed Ground: The damage multiplier from the aura does not stack with white poop.
interactions.raw: {{i|Hallowed Ground}}: The damage multiplier from the aura does not stack with white poop.

interactions.text: Immaculate Heart: The damage multiplier does not stack.
interactions.raw: {{i|Immaculate Heart}}: The damage multiplier {{dlc|nr+}} is reduced to 1.5× while in the aura / {{dlc|r+}} does not stack.

name: Cube Baby
description: Spawns an ice cube familiar that slides around when walked into. It slows and deals contact damage, freezing monsters it kills.

effects.text: Spawns an ice cube familiar. It cannot move on its own, but slides around when Isaac walks into it, uses a melee attack on it, or when Isaac or enemies shoot at it.
effects.raw: Spawns an ice cube familiar. It cannot move on its own, but slides around when Isaac walks into it, uses a melee attack on it, or when Isaac or enemies shoot at it.

effects.text: The familiar damages and slows enemies it touches while moving. It can deal up to 17.5 damage when it collides with enemies, depending on how fast it's moving.
effects.raw: The familiar damages and [[slow]]s enemies it touches while moving. It can deal up to 17.5 damage when it collides with enemies, depending on how fast it's moving.

effects.text: Monsters killed by Cube Baby are frozen.
effects.raw: Monsters killed by Cube Baby are [[Freeze|frozen]].

children.text: Frozen monsters will follow the same physics as Cube Baby, and will shatter on impact creating ice shards that are capable of freezing other monsters
children.raw: Frozen monsters will follow the same physics as Cube Baby, and will shatter on impact creating ice shards that are capable of freezing other monsters

effects.text: Cube Baby can block enemy projectiles.
effects.raw: Cube Baby can block enemy projectiles.

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}

synergies.text: Mom's Bracelet: Cube Baby can be picked up and thrown. It will then slide at maximum speed in the direction it's thrown at and leave a trail of damaging white creep until it slows down.
synergies.raw: {{I|Mom's Bracelet}}: Cube Baby can be picked up and thrown. It will then slide at maximum speed in the direction it's thrown at and leave a trail of damaging white creep until it slows down.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Increases the size and doubles the damage dealt.
synergies.raw: {{I|BFFS!}}: Increases the size and doubles the damage dealt.

name: Vade Retro
description: While held, enemies leave behind ghosts on death. Stronger enemies leave bigger ghosts. Using the item causes the ghosts to explode and damage nearby enemies, and instantly kills all ghost enemies with less than 50% HP.

effects.text: While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.
effects.raw: While held, enemies leave behind small, red ghosts on death; using the item causes the ghosts to explode, dealing damage to nearby enemies and destroying nearby enemy projectiles. The explosions will not destroy obstacles, move pickups, or damage Isaac.

children.text: The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.
children.raw: The damage exploding ghosts deal is equal to 3 + 0.04x the health of the enemy the ghost spawned from + ((floor-1)x0.5), and each explosion can hit the same enemy up to 4 times. Blast radius increases the more powerful the explosion is.

children.text: Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.
children.raw: Enemies with high health, such as champion enemies, minibosses, and bosses will leave behind a larger ghost that creates three explosions.

children.text: Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.
children.raw: Isaac will also leave a ghost upon death, which deals 200 flat damage if detonated.

effects.text: Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.
effects.raw: Using the item will instantly kill any enemy that has the 'ghost' tag and is at 50% or less HP, including bosses.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t leave ghosts.
interactions.raw: [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t leave ghosts.

interactions.text: E. Coli / Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t leave ghosts.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}} / {{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t leave ghosts.

interactions.text: Void: When absorbed, enemies no longer leave behind ghosts on death. Retains ghost instant kill effect when void is used.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: When absorbed, enemies no longer leave behind ghosts on death. Retains ghost instant kill effect when void is used.

name: False PHD
description: Converts good pills into bad pills and identifies all pills. Bad pills now have secondary positive effects. Grants one Black Heart.

effects.text: Identifies all pills upon pickup.
effects.raw: Identifies all [[pills]] upon pickup.

effects.text: Spawns a pill.
effects.raw: Spawns a pill.

effects.text: Grants one Black Heart on pickup.
effects.raw: Grants one {{E|Black Heart}} on pickup.

effects.text: Converts all good pills into their bad counterparts.

synergies.raw: {{t|Black Feather}}: Counts as an evil item, granting a damage up.

synergies.raw: {{i|The Wafer}}: Using a Bad Trip pill will only deal half a heart of damage and spawn a full Black Heart, resulting in a net gain of health.

children.text: The Wafer + Placebo: Allows for farming infinite health using Bad Trip pills.
children.raw: The Wafer + {{i|Placebo}}: Allows for farming infinite health using Bad Trip pills.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Prevents stat-decreasing pills from decreasing your current stats. They still have an effect in the background, making it more difficult to raise that stat in the future.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Prevents stat-decreasing pills from decreasing your current stats. They still have an effect in the background, making it more difficult to raise that stat in the future.

interactions.text: Libra: The balancing of stats mostly leads to a net decrease between Stat Downs and +0.6 damage up, while Luck Down provides +0.6 damage and -1 luck.
interactions.raw: {{I|Libra}}: The balancing of stats mostly leads to a net decrease between Stat Downs and +0.6 [[damage]] up, while Luck Down provides +0.6 damage and -1 [[luck]].

name: Spin to Win
description: Gives +0.5 speed and greatly increases the rotation speed and damage of orbitals for 3 seconds. Passively gives Isaac a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage.

effects.text: While the item is held, grants a spinning top orbital that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).
effects.raw: While the item is held, grants a spinning top [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] that blocks enemy shots and deals contact damage (3.5 per tick, or 35 per second).

effects.text: While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 speed and increases the contact damage on Isaac's familiars, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, orbital familiars spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.
effects.raw: While the item is being used, gives Isaac +0.5 [[speed]] and increases the contact damage on Isaac's [[familiar]]s, even if they do not normally deal any. Additionally, [[orbital familiar]]s spin much faster and knock back both enemies and Isaac when they deal damage.

children.text: The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.
children.raw: The contact damage improves to (1.5 x contact damage + 6). If a familiar has no contact damage naturally, it still receives the +6.

children.text: Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.
children.raw: Blue flies and blue spiders are also affected, and don't disappear while the item is in use.

effects.text: The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.
effects.raw: The recharge timer is gradually drained over 3 seconds while the item is being used.

children.text: Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.
children.raw: Isaac can stop using Spin to Win at any time by releasing the use item button, at which point Spin to Win starts recharging.

children.text: Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.
children.raw: Spin to Win can be used while it is not fully charged, gradually draining however much charge there is.

synergies.raw: {{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Generates up to eight wisps in the middle ring while charging the item, which are immediately extinguished once the charge runs out. These wisps shoot six times faster than an average wisp and deal 3 damage.}}

children.text: All wisps, including those produced by Lemegeton, become invulnerable while using Spin to Win, regardless of whether the Book of Virtues is active.
children.raw: All wisps, including those produced by {{i|Lemegeton}}, become invulnerable while using Spin to Win, regardless of whether the Book of Virtues is active.

synergies.text: Duct Tape/RC Remote: Allows Isaac to use familiars' contact damage without getting close to enemies.
synergies.raw: {{t|Duct Tape|n}}/{{t|RC Remote}}: Allows Isaac to use familiars' contact damage without getting close to enemies.

synergies.text: The Forgotten: While playing as The Soul, channeling Spin to Win will cause the Forgotten's skeleton to deal contact damage.
synergies.raw: {{c|The Forgotten}}: While playing as {{C|The Soul}}, channeling Spin to Win will cause the Forgotten's skeleton to deal contact damage.

synergies.text: Gnawed Leaf: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac. Activating or deactivating Spin to Win will remove Gnawed Leaf's invincibility.
synergies.raw: {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: Gnawed Leaf will activate while using Spin to Win, as long as Isaac is stationary. This allows for a brief moment of high damage against enemies that chase Isaac. Activating or deactivating Spin to Win will remove Gnawed Leaf's invincibility.

synergies.text: Guardian Angel: The orbital speed boost from Guardian Angel can be combined with that of Spin to Win, causing all the orbital familiars to spin extremely fast around Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{i|Guardian Angel}}: The orbital speed boost from Guardian Angel can be combined with that of Spin to Win, causing all the orbital familiars to spin extremely fast around Isaac.

synergies.text: Panic Button: Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room. This is most likely a bug.
synergies.raw: {{t|Panic Button}}: Has a chance to spawn additional wheels upon taking damage that last only for the current room. This is most likely a bug.

synergies.text: Pluto: The exceedingly high speed and small hitbox enables Isaac to clip into obstacles such as rocks or pits, allowing him to effectively fly over them. Isaac can potentially get stuck, which can be fixed by exiting and continuing the run.
synergies.raw: {{I|Pluto}}: The exceedingly high speed and small hitbox enables Isaac to clip into obstacles such as rocks or pits, allowing him to effectively fly over them. Isaac can potentially get stuck, which can be fixed by exiting and continuing the run.

synergies.text: Taurus: Spin to Win's speed boost can instantly trigger the item's invincibility effect if it puts Isaac at 2.0 speed.
synergies.raw: {{I|Taurus}}: Spin to Win's speed boost can instantly trigger the item's invincibility effect if it puts Isaac at 2.0 speed.

interactions.text: BFFS!: The damage bonus of BFFS! is removed while Spin to Win is active. Most notably, this means familiars without natural contact damage do not gain additional damage, and others gain less than expected. Familiars that deal over 12 damage per hit before BFFS!' damage bonus is applied will deal reduced damage with Spin to Win active.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: The damage bonus of BFFS! is removed while Spin to Win is active. Most notably, this means familiars without natural contact damage do not gain additional damage, and others gain less than expected. Familiars that deal over 12 damage per hit before BFFS!' damage bonus is applied will deal reduced damage with Spin to Win active.

interactions.text: Bob's Brain / BBF / Holy Water / GB Bug: While Spin to Win is active, prevents the familiar from exploding/being destroyed on enemy contact.
interactions.raw: {{i|Bob's Brain}} / {{i|BBF}} / {{i|Holy Water}} / {{i|GB Bug}}: While Spin to Win is active, prevents the familiar from exploding/being destroyed on enemy contact.

children.text: GB Bug wont reroll enemies on contact while Spin to Win is active.
children.raw: GB Bug wont reroll enemies on contact while Spin to Win is active.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Metronome: When Metronome chooses Spin to Win, Isaac gains two orbitals with no other benefits of Spin to Win.
interactions.raw: {{I|Metronome}}: When Metronome chooses Spin to Win, Isaac gains two orbitals with no other benefits of Spin to Win.

interactions.text: Mom's Razor: Mom's Razor deals a fixed 16.5 contact damage, instead of its usual damage-scaled value, while Spin to Win is active.
interactions.raw: {{i|Mom's Razor}}: Mom's Razor deals a fixed 16.5 contact damage, instead of its usual damage-scaled value, while Spin to Win is active.

interactions.text: Tainted Forgotten: Unlike the non-tainted counterpart, Tainted Forgotten's body gains no extra contact damage while Spin to Win is active. Additionally, Tainted Forgotten's contact damage familiars have only 80% of their usual damage.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Unlike the non-tainted counterpart, Tainted Forgotten's body gains no extra contact damage while Spin to Win is active. Additionally, Tainted Forgotten's contact damage familiars have only 80% of their usual damage.

interactions.text: Void: After absorbing Spin to Win, using Void spawns a temporary, passive Spin to Win familiar for the room. It cannot be activated further for the damage and speed bonuses.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: After absorbing Spin to Win, using Void spawns a temporary, passive Spin to Win familiar for the room. It cannot be activated further for the damage and speed bonuses.

name: Vasculitis
description: Enemies explode into tears upon death, which inherit the effects of Isaac's tears.

effects.text: Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.
effects.raw: Upon killing an enemy, 1 - 16 blood clot tears are released from them in random directions.

children.text: The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.
children.raw: The amount of tears released from an enemy is based on the enemy's health, and is not affected by Isaac's damage, nor the number of tears hit.

children.text: These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy status effects.
children.raw: These tears are red in coloration, regardless of Isaac's tears, but will inherit the coloration of applied to enemy [[Status Effects|status effects]].

effects.text: Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).
effects.raw: Burst tears will do set damage per floor. The formula for this is: (3.2 + 0.3 x stage).

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t release tears.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t release tears.

interactions.text: Burn: Burning enemies release fire mind tears.
interactions.raw: [[Burn]]: Burning enemies release fire mind tears.

interactions.text: Poison: When a poisoned enemy dies, the released tears are tinted green and will poison other enemies.
interactions.raw: [[Poison]]: When a poisoned enemy dies, the released tears are tinted green and will poison other enemies.

interactions.text: E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t release tears.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t release tears.

interactions.text: Fire Mind: Not recommended. Vasculitis' tears can explode, with great potential to harm Isaac.
interactions.raw: {{I|Fire Mind}}: Not recommended. Vasculitis' tears can explode, with great potential to harm Isaac.

interactions.text: Freeze Effects: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t release tears.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Freeze|Freeze Effects]]: Enemies that die from being frozen can’t release tears.

children.text: Frozen enemies can release tears.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies can release tears.

name: Giant Cell
description: Causes Isaac to spawn Minisaac familiars when he takes damage, which chase and shoot at nearby enemies.

effects.text: Whenever Isaac takes damage, he summons a micro-Isaac familiar, known as Minisaac, that chases nearby enemies and attacks on its own.
effects.raw: Whenever Isaac takes damage, he summons a micro-Isaac [[familiar]], known as Minisaac, that chases nearby enemies and attacks on its own.

children.raw: Minisaacs deal 1.35 base damage that scales with +0.15 per floor: damage = 1.35 + 0.15 * (floor - 1)

children.text: Minisaacs shoot 3 tears per second and their tear delay is not affected by Isaac's stats.
children.raw: Minisaacs shoot 3 tears per second and their tear delay is not affected by Isaac's stats.

children.text: Minisaacs persists between rooms and floors.
children.raw: Minisaacs persists between rooms and floors.

children.raw: Each Minisaac is spawned with 15 health points that are constantly drained with a rate of 0.4 per second. The draining stops when they reach 0.8 HP.

children.text: They are healed back to full HP whenever Isaac takes damage, even when the familiars cap is reached.
children.raw: They are healed back to full HP whenever Isaac takes damage, even when the familiars cap is reached.

children.text: Enemies can damage Minisaacs by shooting projectiles at them or dealing contact damage.
children.raw: Enemies can damage Minisaacs by shooting projectiles at them or dealing contact damage.

children.text: Isaac's bomb explosions will also damage the familiars.
children.raw: Isaac's bomb explosions will also damage the familiars.

children.text: Minisaacs are immune to spikes and lasers.
children.raw: Minisaacs are immune to spikes and lasers.

synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Increases damage dealt by the familiars by 40%.

synergies.raw: {{i|Dull Razor}}: Provides a penalty-free way of spawning Minisaacs and/or healing existing ones.

synergies.raw: {{i|Glowing Hourglass}}: Each use of Glowing Hourglass that does not move Isaac to a different room than the one he is currently in (such as the starting room of a new floor) will duplicate the Minisaacs. (This is possibly a bug)

synergies.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Converts all Minisaacs into 1 {{E|Penny}} each upon use.

name: Tooth and Nail
description: Isaac periodically turns into a spiked statue, briefly becoming invulnerable and dealing contact damage.

effects.text: Every 6 seconds, Isaac turns to stone and sprouts spikes for 1 second. While Isaac is in this state, he is immune to damage and deals 40 contact damage.
effects.raw: Every 6 seconds, Isaac turns to stone and sprouts spikes for 1 second. While Isaac is in this state, he is immune to damage and deals 40 contact damage.

children.text: Isaac flashes white three times before turning to stone on the fourth flash. The first three flashes are accompanied by a "ticking" sound, the final one with the spike extension sound of a mimic chest.
children.raw: Isaac flashes white three times before turning to stone on the fourth flash. The first three flashes are accompanied by a "ticking" sound, the final one with the spike extension sound of a mimic chest.

children.text: Unlike Gnawed Leaf, Isaac can still move and shoot tears.

name: Binge Eater
description: +1 Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac. Item pedestals also offer a random food item. Picking up a food item temporarily grants +3.6 damage and permanently boosts 2 stats.

effects.text: Grants one Red Heart Container and fully heals Isaac.
effects.raw: Grants one Red [[Heart Container]] and fully heals Isaac.

effects.text: Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.
effects.raw: Item pedestals cycle between the initial item and one of several food items.

effects.text: Upon picking up an affected food item, in addition to their normal effects, Isaac gains a temporary +3.6 Damage boost (which fades over 30 seconds), a permanent boost to 2 stats depending on the food item consumed, and a permanent -0.03 speed reduction.

children.raw: When transformed into a ghost in {{s|Downpour}} II or as {{C|Tainted Jacob}}, or playing as{{C|The Lost}}, Isaac can buy items indefinitely.

synergies.text: Maggy's Bow: Buying a Red Heart will out-heal the damage taken from the spikes if Isaac can survive it.
synergies.raw: {{I|Maggy's Bow}}: Buying a Red Heart will out-heal the damage taken from the spikes if Isaac can survive it.

synergies.text: The Wafer / Cancer / Percs!: The spikes only deal half a heart damage, allowing Isaac to gain health from buying hearts.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Wafer}} / {{I|Cancer}} / [[Percs!]]: The spikes only deal half a heart damage, allowing Isaac to gain health from buying hearts.

children.text: With Restock, any character except Bethany can buy items indefinitely if a Soul Heart is on sale.
children.raw: With {{i|Restock}}, any character except {{C|Bethany}} can buy items indefinitely if a Soul Heart is on sale.

interactions.text: Chaos: Items in Devil Rooms that would otherwise cost two heart containers will only cost one if found in Shops.
interactions.raw: {{I|Chaos}}: Items in Devil Rooms that would otherwise cost two heart containers will only cost one if found in Shops.

interactions.text: Flat File: No effect. Spikes generated surrounding consumables will not be removed.
interactions.raw: {{t|Flat File}}: No effect. Spikes generated surrounding consumables will not be removed.

interactions.text: Holy Mantle / Holy Card / Wooden Cross / Blanket / Dogma: Unless Isaac is The Lost, the spikes around consumables will simply break the shield without letting him take them.
interactions.raw: {{I|Holy Mantle}} / {{p|Holy Card}} / {{t|Wooden Cross}} / {{I|Blanket}} / {{I|Dogma}}: Unless Isaac is {{C|The Lost}}, the spikes around consumables will simply break the shield without letting him take them.

interactions.text: Isaac's Heart: Consumables can no longer be picked up in shops.
interactions.raw: {{I|Isaac's Heart}}: Consumables can no longer be picked up in shops.

interactions.text: Judas' Tongue: Ensures that items in the Member Card secret shop only cost one heart container, but Devil Deal prices are not reduced, and other shop items already only cost one heart container.
interactions.raw: {{T|Judas' Tongue}}: Ensures that items in the {{I|Member Card}} secret shop only cost one heart container, but Devil Deal prices are not reduced, and other shop items already only cost one heart container.

interactions.text: Keeper's Box: Items and pickups generated outside Devil Rooms will cost health, but items generated inside Devil Rooms will cost coins.
interactions.raw: {{i|Keeper's Box}}: Items and pickups generated outside Devil Rooms will cost health, but items generated inside Devil Rooms will cost coins.

interactions.text: Keeper's Sack: Because shop items no longer cost coins, stat bonuses are no longer gained from buying shop items, but they are gained from Devil Deals.
interactions.raw: {{i|Keeper's Sack}}: Because shop items no longer cost coins, stat bonuses are no longer gained from buying shop items, but they are gained from Devil Deals.

interactions.text: The Lost: Only one item can be picked up from each shop; any other items will vanish. Consumables can be taken for free.
interactions.raw: {{C|The Lost}}: Only one item can be picked up from each shop; any other items will vanish. Consumables can be taken for free.

children.text: However, multiple items can be bought from Devil Deals.
children.raw: However, multiple items can be bought from Devil Deals.

children.text: Items will not disappear when taking any consumable.
children.raw: Items will not disappear when taking any consumable.

children.text: With Restock, the Lost can buy items indefinitely.
children.raw: With {{i|Restock}}, the Lost can buy items indefinitely.

interactions.text: Member Card: Items in the secret shop can cost two heart containers.
interactions.raw: {{I|Member Card}}: Items in the secret shop can cost two heart containers.

interactions.text: Redemption: Doesn't change the conditions to lose or keep the cross even when spending health in shops.
interactions.raw: {{I|Redemption}}: Doesn't change the conditions to lose or keep the cross even when spending health in shops.

interactions.text: The Stairway: Affects Angel Shops the same way it does regular shops.
interactions.raw: {{I|The Stairway}}: Affects Angel Shops the same way it does regular shops.

interactions.text: Steam Sale: Devil Deals will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.
interactions.raw: {{I|Steam Sale}}: Devil Deals will have their price reduced. Shop items will cost the same amount of health.

interactions.text: Store Credit: Store Credit becomes a useless trinket, as neither Devil Deals nor shop items will become free.
interactions.raw: {{T|Store Credit}}: Store Credit becomes a useless trinket, as neither Devil Deals nor shop items will become free.

name: Redemption
description: If Isaac enters a but leaves without taking/opening anything in it, he gets +1 Damage and a Soul Heart at the start of the next floor.

effects.text: Upon entering a , a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a Soul Heart and +1.0 damage.
effects.raw: Upon entering a {{R|Devil Room}}, a white inverted cross will appear above Isaac's head. If Isaac goes to the next floor with the icon still above his head, he will gain a {{e|Soul Heart}} and +1.0 [[damage]].

effects.text: Taking anything generated by the room (items or consumables) will result in the icon going away, including opening Red Chests / Black Sacks.
effects.raw: Taking anything generated by the room (items or consumables) will result in the icon going away, including opening {{e|Red Chest}}s / {{e|Black Sack}}s.

interactions.text: Devil's Crown: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular s for the purposes of this item.
interactions.raw: {{t|Devil's Crown}}: Devil Treasure Rooms will count as regular {{r|Devil Room}}s for the purposes of this item.

interactions.text: Found Soul: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.
interactions.raw: {{t|Found Soul}}: The soul will receive a cross when a Devil Room is entered, and will not lose it when Isaac takes an item/pickup. When Isaac goes to a new floor with the familiar having the cross, the soul will receive a damage boost (even if Isaac doesn't) and a Soul Heart, allowing it to survive multiple hits.

interactions.text: Jacob and Esau: The cross will only disappear if the character holding Redemption takes something. The other character is free to take items and pickups.
interactions.raw: {{C|Jacob and Esau}}: The cross will only disappear if the character holding Redemption takes something. The other character is free to take items and pickups.

interactions.text: Satanic Bible: Taking a Boss item that was replaced with a Devil Deal will remove the cross, however the doesn't give the cross.
interactions.raw: {{i|Satanic Bible}}: Taking a Boss item that was replaced with a Devil Deal will remove the cross, however the {{r|Boss Room}} doesn't give the cross.

interactions.text: Tainted Lazarus: Only the character initially entering the will receive the cross over his head. The character that leaves the floor with the icon above his head is the one that gains Redemption's benefits.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: Only the character initially entering the {{r|Devil Room}} will receive the cross over his head. The character that leaves the floor with the icon above his head is the one that gains Redemption's benefits.

children.text: Using Flip inside the Devil Room will make both forms have the icon over their heads. Even if one form's cross is removed, the other's is unaffected.
children.raw: Using {{i|Flip}} inside the Devil Room will make both forms have the icon over their heads. Even if one form's cross is removed, the other's is unaffected.

children.text: Ghostly items that were already bought from taking a deal can safely be taken without deactivating Redemption.
children.raw: Ghostly items that were already bought from taking a deal can safely be taken without deactivating Redemption.

name: Spirit Shackles
description: On taking fatal damage, instead of dying, Isaac's ghost is chained to his dead body, and he can continue to fight with 1/2 of a heart, returning to life after 10 seconds. After it activates, it must be recharged by gaining a Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source.

effects.text: If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling The Soul, with half a heart. The ghost has flight, spectral tears, and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.
effects.raw: If Isaac were to take fatal damage, rather than dying, he instead transforms into a ghostly form, resembling {{c|The Soul}}, with half a heart. The ghost has [[flight]], [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]], and is chained to Isaac's immobile corpse. Isaac's soul returns to his corpse' position after 10 seconds, if he doesn't die while in ghost form.

children.text: Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.
children.raw: Isaac will have invulnerability frames for 1/3rd of a second after reviving.

children.text: After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full Soul Heart or Black Heart from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.
children.raw: After activation, Spirit Shackles is disabled until Isaac gains a half or full {{E|Soul Heart}} or {{E|Black Heart}} from any source. HP that is used to charge Spirit Shackles will not be added to Isaac's health.

synergies.text: Found Soul: Spirit Shackles activates for Found Soul, functioning as normal. However, it cannot be recharged, and can only be activated again after Found Soul dies and respawns.
synergies.raw: {{t|Found Soul}}: Spirit Shackles activates for Found Soul, functioning as normal. However, it cannot be recharged, and can only be activated again after Found Soul dies and respawns.

synergies.text: The Lost: Effectively acts as a rechargeable extra life, granting additional defensive measures on top of his inherent Holy Mantle and granting a use to normally useless Soul Hearts.
synergies.raw: {{C|The Lost}}: Effectively acts as a rechargeable extra life, granting additional defensive measures on top of his inherent {{i|Holy Mantle}} and granting a use to normally useless Soul Hearts.

synergies.text: Magic Skin: When all hearts are converted to Broken Hearts, Isaac will be revived with half a soul heart, allowing many more uses with low health.
synergies.raw: {{I|Magic Skin}}: When all hearts are converted to [[Health#Broken Hearts|Broken Hearts]], Isaac will be revived with half a soul heart, allowing many more uses with low health.

synergies.text: Scapular: Can activate at the same time. When this happens, the soul heart granted by Scapular will immediately charge Spirit Shackles.
synergies.raw: {{I|Scapular}}: Can activate at the same time. When this happens, the soul heart granted by Scapular will immediately charge Spirit Shackles.

interactions.text: Ankh / Broken Ankh / Judas' Shadow: Soul hearts given on respawn cannot recharge Spirit Shackles.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ankh}} / {{t|Broken Ankh}} / {{i|Judas' Shadow}}: Soul hearts given on respawn cannot recharge Spirit Shackles.

interactions.text: Bethany: Soul charges cannot be used to recharge Spirit Shackles. Picking up soul hearts recharges it as normal.
interactions.raw: {{c|Bethany}}: Soul charges cannot be used to recharge Spirit Shackles. Picking up soul hearts recharges it as normal.

interactions.text: Damocles / Plan C / Suicide King: Ignores Spirit Shackles and fully kills Isaac.
interactions.raw: {{i|Damocles}} / {{I|Plan C}} / {{P|Suicide King}}: Ignores Spirit Shackles and fully kills Isaac.

interactions.text: The Forgotten: Spirit Shackles can activate for both characters. They can toggle between The Forgotten and The Soul as normal while it's active, and the form that didn't "die" will have their normal health. Toggling from The Forgotten to The Soul will also create another body of The Forgotten that The Soul will be chained to in addition to the original body.
interactions.raw: {{c|The Forgotten}}: Spirit Shackles can activate for both characters. They can toggle between The Forgotten and The Soul as normal while it's active, and the form that didn't "die" will have their normal health. Toggling from The Forgotten to The Soul will also create another body of The Forgotten that The Soul will be chained to in addition to the original body.

interactions.text: Jacob and Esau / Tainted Lazarus: The character that has Spirit Shackles must die for it to activate; if the other character dies, it will not activate. Only the character that has Spirit Shackles can recharge it.
interactions.raw: {{c|Jacob and Esau}} / {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: The character that has Spirit Shackles must die for it to activate; if the other character dies, it will not activate. Only the character that has Spirit Shackles can recharge it.

children.text: In the case of Jacob and Esau, the brother that has Spirit Shackles will be chained to their dead body, while the one that doesn't can move freely. If either brother dies while Spirit Shackles is active, the other dies with them as normal.
children.raw: In the case of Jacob and Esau, the brother that has Spirit Shackles will be chained to their dead body, while the one that doesn't can move freely. If either brother dies while Spirit Shackles is active, the other dies with them as normal.

interactions.text: Keeper / Tainted Keeper: As Hearts cannot spawn or be collected, Spirit Shackles can only be recharged from effects that add Soul Hearts to health directly.
interactions.raw: {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: As Hearts cannot spawn or be collected, Spirit Shackles can only be recharged from effects that add Soul Hearts to health directly.

interactions.text: Tainted Forgotten: The ghost will spawn from Tainted Forgotten instead of Tainted Soul; it will be invulnerable, unable to move, and use the bone club instead of Tainted Forgotten. It can also be thrown, but will rapidly return to Tainted Forgotten due to being chained to them. Tainted Soul is unaffected, and can take damage as normal.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: The ghost will spawn from Tainted Forgotten instead of Tainted Soul; it will be invulnerable, unable to move, and use the bone club instead of Tainted Forgotten. It can also be thrown, but will rapidly return to Tainted Forgotten due to being chained to them. Tainted Soul is unaffected, and can take damage as normal.

interactions.text: Tainted Jacob: will not activate during Lost Form, or when killed by Dark Esau.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Jacob}}: will not activate during Lost Form, or when killed by {{E|Dark Esau}}.

name: Cracked Orb
description: Unlocks doors and reveals a random room on the map when Isaac takes damage.

effects.text: Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:
effects.raw: Upon taking damage, activates the following effects:

children.text: Unlocks all locked doors in the room (doors that need the room to be cleared are not affected).
children.raw: Unlocks all locked doors in the room (doors that need the room to be cleared are not affected).

children.text: Opens the and the if adjacent to the room you are in.
children.raw: Opens the {{R|Secret Room}} and the {{R|Super Secret Room}} if adjacent to the room you are in.

children.text: Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor.
children.raw: Reveals a random unmapped room on the floor.

children.text: Destroys all tinted rocks and rocks with s in the room.
children.raw: Destroys all [[tinted rock]]s and rocks with {{R|Crawl Space}}s in the room.

synergies.text: Dog Tooth / Shiny Rock / YO LISTEN!: Makes it extremely easy to destroy tinted rocks and enter Crawl Spaces.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dog Tooth}} / {{t|Shiny Rock}} / {{i|YO LISTEN!}}: Makes it extremely easy to destroy tinted rocks and enter Crawl Spaces.

synergies.text: Dull Razor: Allows the player to benefit from the item without taking actual damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dull Razor}}: Allows the player to benefit from the item without taking actual damage.

synergies.text: Book of Secrets / The Mind / Blue Map / Treasure Map / The Compass: Having more rooms already discovered makes Cracked Orb more likely to reveal the ultra secret room.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Secrets}} / {{i|The Mind}} / {{i|Blue Map}} / {{i|Treasure Map}} / {{i|The Compass}}: Having more rooms already discovered makes Cracked Orb more likely to reveal the ultra secret room.

synergies.text: XIV - Temperance: Allows the player to spawn a source of damage, making it easier to access rooms such as the entrance to Mom's Heart and Mega Satan's door when lacking bombs or being immune to explosive damage. Category:Damage-triggered items
synergies.raw: {{p|XIV - Temperance}}: Allows the player to spawn a source of damage, making it easier to access rooms such as the entrance to {{E|Mom's Heart}} and {{E|Mega Satan}}'s door when lacking bombs or being immune to explosive damage. {{nav|eve unlock|the beast unlock|broken|fr=Orbe Fêlé}} [[Category:Damage-triggered items]]

name: Empty Heart
description: If Isaac has one red heart or fewer at the beginning of a floor, he gains an empty red heart container.

effects.text: If Isaac has one red heart or less at the beginning of a floor, an empty heart container is added.
effects.raw: If Isaac has one red heart or less at the beginning of a floor, an empty heart container is added.

synergies.text: Adrenaline: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if conditions are met to grant an empty heart container at the beginning of each floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Adrenaline}}: Activates the damage up effect of Adrenaline if conditions are met to grant an empty heart container at the beginning of each floor.

synergies.text: Crow Heart: If no s or s can be found, the Crow Heart trinket is a great way to guarantee red hearts are lost so long as you still have non-red health available.
synergies.raw: {{T|Crow Heart}}: If no {{M|Devil Beggar}}s  or {{M|Blood Donation Machine}}s can be found, the Crow Heart trinket is a great way to guarantee red hearts are lost so long as you still have non-red health available.

synergies.text: Dark Prince's Crown: The heart containers are empty when granted, which allows the crown's buff to stay active when advancing floors.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dark Prince's Crown}}: The heart containers are empty when granted, which allows the crown's buff to stay active when advancing floors.

synergies.text: Guppy's Paw: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Guppy's Paw while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting massively increased survivability.
synergies.raw: {{I|Guppy's Paw}}: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Guppy's Paw while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting massively increased survivability.

synergies.text: Lazarus: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart allows Lazarus to effectively negate the downside that removes a single heart container on death, allowing him to purposefully use his mechanic to get a +0.5 damage up per floor. (As long as he still proceeds at one red heart or less)
synergies.raw: {{C|Lazarus}}: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart allows Lazarus to effectively negate the downside that removes a single heart container on death, allowing him to purposefully use his mechanic to get a +0.5 damage up per floor. (As long as he still proceeds at one red heart or less)

synergies.text: Potato Peeler: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Potato Peeler while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting increased damage and a Cube of Meat per floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Potato Peeler}}: The heart containers granted by Empty Heart can be used by Potato Peeler while staying at or below 1 red heart, granting increased damage and a {{I|Cube of Meat}} per floor.

name: Astral Projection
description: Causes Isaac to turn into a ghost if he gets hit while in an uncleared room, giving him flight and spectral tears and blocking the next hit he takes.

effects.text: The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has flight and spectral tears and the next hit he takes is negated.
effects.raw: The first time Isaac takes damage while in an uncleared room, time is stopped for 2 seconds and Isaac becomes a ghost and leaves his body behind, which drops to the floor. While in ghost form, Isaac has [[flight]] and [[Tear Effects#Spectral|spectral tears]] and the next hit he takes is negated.

children.text: Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.
children.raw: Isaac's tears and speed are greatly increased while time is stopped, although this is not shown on the HUD.

children.text: Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.
children.raw: Isaac's ghost re-enters his body after the room is cleared or if he gets hit again.

synergies.text: Hypercoagulation: Due to the effective speed up, the heart used to activate Astral Projection can easily be collected before it disappears.
synergies.raw: {{I|Hypercoagulation}}: Due to the effective speed up, the heart used to activate Astral Projection can easily be collected before it disappears.

synergies.text: IV Bag / Dull Razor / Other sources of self damage: If used in a hostile room, Astral Projection will trigger, effectively granting flight and Holy Mantle for the room.
synergies.raw: {{i|IV Bag}} / {{i|Dull Razor}} / Other sources of self damage: If used in a hostile room, Astral Projection will trigger, effectively granting flight and {{i|Holy Mantle}} for the room.

synergies.text: Old Bandage / Gimpy: When getting hit with only one heart left, Astral Projection allows for picking up the dropped heart in the brief time of invincibility even when the player has no hearts left. Failing to do so or having no hearts dropped results in guaranteed death however, but with luck this loop can be used to potentially save runs.
synergies.raw: {{I|Old Bandage}} / {{i|Gimpy}}: When getting hit with only one heart left, Astral Projection allows for picking up the dropped heart in the brief time of invincibility even when the player has no hearts left. Failing to do so or having no hearts dropped results in guaranteed death however, but with luck this loop can be used to potentially save runs.

interactions.text: Holy Mantle: The shield will activate before Astral Projection.
interactions.raw: {{i|Holy Mantle}}: The shield will activate before Astral Projection.

interactions.text: The Lost / Tainted Lost: The Lost will continue to fight after taking damage, however he will instantly die upon taking damage again or once the room is cleared.
interactions.raw: {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: The Lost will continue to fight after taking damage, however he will instantly die upon taking damage again or once the room is cleared.

children.text: If The Lost receives at least half a Soul Heart through any means while the effect is active, he will survive. Black Hearts cannot be used for this.
children.raw: If The Lost receives at least half a {{e|Soul Heart}} through any means while the effect is active, he will survive. {{e|Black Heart}}s cannot be used for this.

interactions.text: Plan C / Other insta-kill effects: Will kill Isaac without triggering the ghost effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Plan C}} / Other insta-kill effects: Will kill Isaac without triggering the ghost effect.

interactions.text: Rock Bottom: Does not preserve the tears and speed bonus Isaac receives after activating Astral Projection.
interactions.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Does not preserve the tears and speed bonus Isaac receives after activating Astral Projection.

interactions.text: Spirit Shackles: This item will not activate if Isaac received lethal damage when Astral Projection activated.
interactions.raw: {{i|Spirit Shackles}}: This item will not activate if Isaac received lethal damage when Astral Projection activated.

name: C Section
description: Replaces tears with fetuses that chase down enemies and deal contact damage. Each shot requires a brief charge up.

effects.text: Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires homing, piercing, spectral fetus tears.
effects.raw: Isaac gains a short delay charge attack that fires [[homing]], [[piercing]], [[spectral]] fetus tears.

children.text: The fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's Damage, 3.75 times per second, until they run out of Range.
children.raw: The fetus tears do 75% of Isaac's [[Damage]], 3.75 times per second, until they run out of [[Range]].

children.text: The fetuses will automatically fire when Isaac is at full charge, meaning the charge cannot be held.
children.raw: The fetuses will automatically fire when Isaac is at full charge, meaning the charge cannot be held.

children.text: Charge time is calculated based on Tear Delay.
children.raw: Charge time is calculated based on [[Tear Delay]].

children.text: \text{Fetuses per Second} = \frac{30}{Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1}
children.raw: <math>\text{Fetuses per Second} = \frac{30}{Roundup(\text{Tear Delay} \times 3) + 1}</math>

children.text: Fetuses per second is capped at 15.
children.raw: Fetuses per second is capped at 15.

synergies.text: Berserk!: Isaac can fire the fetuses on duration. The fetuses hold and attack with bone clubs that are identical to The Forgotten's one.
synergies.raw: {{I|Berserk!}}: Isaac can fire the fetuses on duration. The fetuses hold and attack with bone clubs that are identical to {{C|The Forgotten}}'s one.

synergies.text: Brimstone / Azazel: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the brimstone beam.
synergies.raw: {{i|Brimstone}} / {{c|Azazel}}: Shoots 4 fetus tears along with the brimstone beam.

children.text: Each additional beam created from Monstro's Lung, split tears (such as The Parasite), or multi-shot effects (including Loki's Horns and Eye Sore) spawns four additional fetuses.
children.raw: Each additional beam created from {{I|Monstro's Lung}}, split tears (such as {{I|The Parasite}}), or multi-shot effects (including {{I|Loki's Horns}} and {{I|Eye Sore}}) spawns four additional fetuses.

children.text: Anti-Gravity: The fetuses spawn when the beam is being released. The fetuses do not spawn if Isaac is charging when the beam is being released.
children.raw: {{I|Anti-Gravity}}: The fetuses spawn when the beam is being released. The fetuses do not spawn if Isaac is charging when the beam is being released.

children.text: The Ludovico Technique: When combined with Brimstone, overrides C Section: fetuses no longer spawn.
children.raw: {{I|The Ludovico Technique}}: When combined with {{i|Brimstone}}, overrides {{i|C Section}}: fetuses no longer spawn.

synergies.text: Compound Fracture: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.
synergies.raw: {{i|Compound Fracture}}: Fetuses are skeletons that shoot splitting bone fragments when in contact with an enemy.

synergies.text: Cricket's Body: Fetuses drop four short-ranged tears when they hit the ground.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cricket's Body}}: Fetuses drop four short-ranged tears when they hit the ground.

synergies.text: Dead Eye: Damage boost is granted once a fetus hits an enemy (once per fetus) and is reset when a fetus does not hit anything before going down, using the same rule to determine whether the damage boost is reset or not.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dead Eye}}: Damage boost is granted once a fetus hits an enemy (once per fetus) and is reset when a fetus does not hit anything before going down, using the same rule to determine whether the damage boost is reset or not.

children.text: This makes for a great synergy since the fetuses are homing and stay up much longer than regular tears.
children.raw: This makes for a great synergy since the fetuses are homing and stay up much longer than regular tears.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus: The fetuses drop small bombs when they touch an enemy. The bomb's damage follows Dr. Fetus' damage calculation, based on half of the fetuses damage. A fetus can drop only one bomb.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: The fetuses drop small bombs when they touch an enemy. The bomb's damage follows Dr. Fetus' damage calculation, based on half of the fetuses damage. A fetus can drop only one bomb.

children.text: The fetuses' bombs do not benefit from Isaac's bomb effects such as Hot Bombs or Bobby-Bomb. However, they do benefit from Isaac's tear effects and have the appearance of the corresponding bombs. For example, Hot Bombs from Fire Mind, Bobby-Bomb from homing tears. As such, Cricket's Body, The Parasite, and Polyphemus leave a subsequent bomb or bombs, and Mysterious Liquid leaves a creep.
children.raw: The fetuses' bombs do not benefit from Isaac's bomb effects such as {{I|Hot Bombs}} or {{I|Bobby-Bomb}}. However, they do benefit from Isaac's tear effects and have the appearance of the corresponding bombs. For example, {{I|Hot Bombs}} from {{I|Fire Mind}}, {{I|Bobby-Bomb}} from [[homing]] tears. As such, {{I|Cricket's Body}}, {{I|The Parasite}}, and {{I|Polyphemus}} leave a subsequent bomb or bombs, and {{I|Mysterious Liquid}} leaves a creep.

children.text: Dr. Fetus + Ipecac: The fetuses explode before dropping any bomb.
children.raw: Dr. Fetus + {{I|Ipecac}}: The fetuses explode before dropping any bomb.

children.text: Dr. Fetus + Haemolacria: Fetuses will both drop a bomb on touching an enemy and burst into multiple small bombs upon hitting the ground.
children.raw: Dr. Fetus + {{I|Haemolacria}}: Fetuses will both drop a bomb on touching an enemy and burst into multiple small bombs upon hitting the ground.

synergies.text: Explosivo: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then explode. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking.
synergies.raw: {{I|Explosivo}}: Some Fetuses stick to enemies, expand, then explode. However, they do not inflict their contact damage while sticking.

Fetuses can fire lasers while sticking to an enemy and spin, while tears do not spin.
