synergies.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: The poop beam gets only a +2 flat damage bonus instead of +40. The beam explodes 10 times, either on the first enemy or obstacle it hits or at the very end otherwise, dealing 10 + twice of the beam's damage.

synergies.text: Jacob's Ladder: The brown laser Isaac fires will produce random arcs of electricity at the end of the laser. The corn Isaac poops out does not interact with the electricity.
synergies.raw: {{I|Jacob's Ladder}}: The brown laser Isaac fires will produce random arcs of electricity at the end of the laser. The corn Isaac poops out does not interact with the electricity.

synergies.text: Lachryphagy: Spawns a large amount of tears at the end of the poop beam, heavily increasing Isaac's damage output.
synergies.raw: {{i|Lachryphagy}}: Spawns a large amount of tears at the end of the poop beam, heavily increasing Isaac's damage output.

synergies.text: My Reflection: Causes the poop beam range behind Isaac to become significantly increased as well as having a short range similar to Azazel's beam in front of him. This greatly eases the use of this item allowing for high DPS.
synergies.raw: {{I|My Reflection}}: Causes the poop beam range behind Isaac to become significantly increased as well as having a short range similar to Azazel's beam in front of him. This greatly eases the use of this item allowing for high DPS.

synergies.text: The Parasite: The poop beam splits into two horizontal beams meaning less risk for Isaac and a bigger area for enemies to be hit.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Parasite}}: The poop beam splits into two horizontal beams meaning less risk for Isaac and a bigger area for enemies to be hit.

interactions.text: Censer: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.
interactions.raw: {{i|Censer}}: The corn shots are slowed by the aura.

interactions.text: Eye of the Occult: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eye of the Occult}}: No effect.

children.text: Eye of the Occult + Brimstone/Technology: The poop beam also automatically fires at the crosshair and becomes a lasso. The loop starts where the beam would normally end and extends out to the cross-hair.
children.raw: '''Eye of the Occult''' + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: The poop beam also automatically fires at the crosshair and becomes a lasso. The loop starts where the beam would normally end and extends out to the cross-hair.

interactions.text: Libra: The poop beam ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
interactions.raw: {{i|Libra}}: The poop beam ignores damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

name: Lil Portal
description: Spawns a familiar that flies forward, consuming pickups in its path and dealing damage to enemies. Each pickup increases its size and damage and spawns a Blue Fly. Every 4 pickups, opens a portal that leads to an unexplored room. After 1 + (stage number) pickups, opens a portal which leads to a special room with contents that persist between floors.

effects.text: Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies.
effects.raw: Summons a portal familiar that launches itself in the direction Isaac shoots to deal contact damage to enemies.

children.text: The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} The portal will launch itself forward after double-tapping.

effects.text: The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into blue flies and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage.
effects.raw: The portal will consume all pickups and trinkets in its path, converting them into [[blue fly|blue flies]] and causing the familiar to become larger and deal more contact damage.

effects.text: When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r+}} When the familiar consumes 1 + (stage number) pickups, it will summon a portal that leads to a unique purple {{r|Clean Bedroom}} and will disappear for the rest of the floor, respawning upon entering a new floor.

children.text: The room contains a random Chest in the top left corner, a chance for a random battery in the bottom left corner, and a chance of Dice Shard, Soul of Eden, Butter!, or Moving Box, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered.
children.raw: The room contains a random {{e|Chest}} in the top left corner, a chance for a random [[Batteries|battery]] in the bottom left corner, and a chance of {{p|Dice Shard}}, {{p|Soul of Eden}}, {{t|Butter!}}, or {{i|Moving Box}}, in the bottom right corner. In the center of the room is the portal exit, which will bring Isaac back out through the portal he entered.

children.text: This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal.
children.raw: This room, and any contents within, will remain constant for the rest of the player's run, accessible by any portal.

effects.text: Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.
effects.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Lil Portal deals damage equal to 2 * (familiar size) and ticks up to 10 times per second.

children.text: There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.
children.raw: There are 4 distinct sizes, the amount of consumables required to increase size depending on the stage Isaac is in. It is not possible to reach the maximum size in earlier stages before the familiar summons a portal.

interactions.text: R Key: The special room's contents will be reset after using R Key.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r+}} {{I|R Key}}: The special room's contents will be reset after using R Key.

name: Worm Friend
description: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab and deal damage to enemies over time.

effects.text: Gives Isaac a Nerve Ending familiar that burrows out of the ground to grab enemies for 4 seconds. Grabbed enemies take damage over time, are slowed, and are unable to move.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac a {{E|Nerve Ending}} [[familiar]] that burrows out of the ground to grab enemies for 4 seconds. Grabbed enemies take damage over time, are [[slow|slowed]], and are unable to move.

children.text: Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.
children.raw: Worm Friend deals 4 damage per tick (8 per second), for a total of 32 damage per grab.

children.text: Worm Friend can target and restrain bosses in addition to normal enemies, even including endgame bosses such as Ultra Greed.
children.raw: Worm Friend can target and restrain bosses in addition to normal enemies, even including endgame bosses such as {{E|Ultra Greed}}.

name: Bone Spurs
description: Enemies spawn floating bones on death, which block shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

effects.text: Enemies spawn 1–2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.
effects.raw: Enemies spawn 1–2 floating bones on death, which block enemy shots and damage/repel enemies that touch them.

children.text: Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.
children.raw: Bones block 2 shots and/or deal 2 ticks of damage before breaking.

children.text: Bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the moment they were created.
children.raw: Bones deal contact damage equal to Isaac's damage at the moment they were created.

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the bones' size and damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles the bones' size and damage.

synergies.text: Spin to Win: Boosts the bones' damage while spinning even though there's no visual tell of the effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Spin to Win}}: Boosts the bones' damage while spinning even though there's no visual tell of the effect.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Turning enemies into pickups doesn't spawn bones.
interactions.raw: [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Turning enemies into [[pickup]]s doesn't spawn bones.

interactions.text: E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop don't spawn bones.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop don't spawn bones.

name: Hungry Soul
description: Enemies have a chance to spawn ghosts on death, which chase and deal contact damage to enemies and explode after a short time.

effects.text: Grants Isaac a chance to spawn a friendly ghost upon killing an enemy, which rapidly chases down and deals contact damage to enemies.
effects.raw: Grants Isaac a chance to spawn a friendly ghost upon killing an enemy, which rapidly chases down and deals contact damage to enemies.

children.text: The chance to spawn a ghost is 33% and is not affected by luck.
children.raw: The chance to spawn a ghost is 33% and is not affected by [[luck]].

children.text: Ghosts deal contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage, 4 times per second (2x Isaac's damage per second).
children.raw: Ghosts deal contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage, 4 times per second (2x Isaac's damage per second).

effects.text: After 7 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 flat damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times.
effects.raw: After 7 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 flat damage to nearby enemies up to 3-4 times.

children.text: The explosion cannot damage Isaac or the environment.
children.raw: The explosion cannot damage Isaac or the environment.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Enemies that are turned into pickups can’t spawn ghosts.
interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Enemies that are turned into [[pickup]]s can’t spawn ghosts.

interactions.text: BFFS!: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: No effect.

interactions.text: E. Coli/Flush!: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn ghosts.
interactions.raw: {{i|E. Coli}}/{{i|Flush!}}: Enemies that are turned into poop can’t spawn ghosts.

interactions.text: Ipecac: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, not the expected +20.
interactions.raw: {{i|Ipecac}}: The ghosts get only +1 flat damage from Ipecac, not the expected +20.

interactions.text: Libra: The ghosts ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.
interactions.raw: {{i|Libra}}: The ghosts ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: Ghosts cannot be sacrificed.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Ghosts cannot be sacrificed.

name: Jar of Wisps
description: Spawns random wisps that shoot various tears, block shots, and deal contact damage. The number of wisps spawned increases every time the jar is used.

effects.text: Spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac, fires tears, blocks enemy shots, and deals contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by Book of Virtues.
effects.raw: Spawns a wisp that orbits Isaac, fires tears, blocks enemy shots, and deals contact damage to enemies, much like the ones spawned by {{I|Book of Virtues}}.

children.text: The jar initially spawns only two wisps, but spawns an additional wisp each time the jar is used, up to a maximum of 12 per use. The number of wisps that will be spawned by the jar is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.
children.raw: The jar initially spawns only {{dlc|nr+}} one / {{dlc|r+}} two wisps, but spawns an additional wisp each time the jar is used, up to a maximum of 12 per use. The number of wisps that will be spawned by the jar is indicated by both a counter and the jar visually filling up with wisps.

children.text: The wisps spawned by the jar can be ones created by any Book of Virtues synergy, although basic wisps are much more common than special variants.
children.raw: The wisps spawned by the jar can be ones created by any Book of Virtues synergy, although basic wisps are much more common than special variants.

effects.text: Isaac can have up to 3 rings of wisps; an inner, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 6 wisps, a center, clockwise-spinning ring of 8 wisps, and an outer, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 12 wisps, for a total of 26.
effects.raw: Isaac can have up to 3 rings of wisps; an inner, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 6 wisps, a center, clockwise-spinning ring of 8 wisps, and an outer, counter-clockwise spinning ring of 12 wisps, for a total of 26.

synergies.text: Car Battery: The number of wisps spawned is doubled.
synergies.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: The number of wisps spawned is doubled.

children.text: Car Battery + Book of Virtues: The number of wisps spawned is multiplied by 6.
children.raw: '''Car Battery''' + {{i|Book of Virtues}}: The number of wisps spawned is multiplied by 6.

interactions.text: Void: Will spawn only one wisp per use.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: Will spawn only one wisp per use.

name: Soul Locket
description: Gives Isaac a permanent stat boost whenever he picks up a Soul Heart.

effects.text: Gives Isaac one of the following stat boosts per half heart gained by picking up Soul Hearts or Black Hearts:
effects.raw: Gives Isaac one of the following [[Attributes|stat]] boosts per half heart gained by picking up {{e|Soul Heart}}s or {{e|Black Heart}}s:

children.text: +0.04 speed.
+0.1 tears.
+0.2 flat damage.
children.raw: +0.2 flat [[damage]].

children.text: +0.5 range.
+0.04 shot speed.
children.raw: +0.04 [[shot speed]].

children.text: +0.20 luck.

effects.text: Spawns a Soul Heart when picked up.
effects.raw: Spawns a {{e|Soul Heart}} when picked up.

name: Friend Finder
description: Spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks.

effects.text: On use, spawns a random friendly monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to Jacob and Esau.
effects.raw: On use, spawns a random [[friendly]] monster that mimics Isaac's movements and attacks, similar to {{C|Jacob and Esau}}.

effects.text: Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.
effects.raw: Friendly monsters can take damage from flames, spikes, and other hazards.

synergies.text: Car Battery: Doubles the amount of random friendly monsters spawned.
synergies.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: Doubles the amount of random [[friendly]] monsters spawned.

synergies.text: Forgotten Lullaby: Doubles the fire rate of spawned monsters, if they fire projectiles.
synergies.raw: {{t|Forgotten Lullaby}}: Doubles the fire rate of spawned monsters, if they fire projectiles.

interactions.text: Ace Cards: Monsters spawned by Friend Finder are still affected by Ace Cards.
interactions.raw: [[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Monsters spawned by Friend Finder are still affected by Ace Cards.

interactions.text: Blood Puppy: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.
interactions.raw: {{i|Blood Puppy}}: Either angry version of Blood Puppy will target friendly enemies as well and can drag them along with it when it charges them. Blood Puppy cannot damage friendly enemies however friendly enemies can damage Blood Puppy despite not targeting it outright.

interactions.text: Broken Modem: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.
interactions.raw: {{i|Broken Modem}}: Broken Modem also affects friendly enemies and projectiles created by them.

interactions.text: Eraser: If Friend Finder attempts to spawn an erased monster it will simply fail and waste the charge, instead of choosing a different monster.
interactions.raw: {{I|Eraser}}: If Friend Finder attempts to spawn an erased monster it will simply fail and waste the charge, instead of choosing a different monster.

interactions.text: Ghost Bombs / Hungry Soul / Purgatory / Vade Retro: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.
interactions.raw: {{I|Ghost Bombs}} / {{i|Hungry Soul}} / {{I|Purgatory}} / {{i|Vade Retro}}: Explosions from ghosts can kill friendly enemies.

interactions.text: Saturnus: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.
interactions.raw: {{I|Saturnus}}: Bullets fired from friendly enemies can still get caught in the orbit.

interactions.text: The Soul: Projectiles shot from charmed monsters will be repelled by the aura.
interactions.raw: {{I|The Soul}}: Projectiles shot from charmed monsters will be repelled by the aura.

interactions.text: Tick: Friendly enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or more.
interactions.raw: {{t|Tick}}: [[Friendly]] enemies start with less health if they have 60HP or more.

name: Inner Child
description: Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.

effects.text: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon death, Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a Red Heart, a massive size down, and +0.2 Speed.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac an extra life. Upon [[death]], Isaac respawns in the current room with half of a {{E|Red Heart}}, a massive size down, and +0.2 [[Speed]].

children.text: If Isaac doesn't have any Red Heart Containers, he will respawn with a Half Soul Heart instead of a Half Red Heart.
children.raw: If Isaac doesn't have any [[Red Heart Container]]s, he will respawn with a {{E|Half Soul Heart}}  instead of a {{E|Half Red Heart}}.

effects.text: When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.
effects.raw: When Isaac respawns as the inner child, he emits a blood explosion that deals 35 flat damage to all nearby enemies.

name: Glitched Crown
description: Item pedestals cycle between 5 random items before being picked up.

effects.text: New item pedestals cycle very quickly between 5 random items.
effects.raw: New item pedestals cycle very quickly between 5 random items.

children.text: The 5 items will cycle in the same order every loop.
children.raw: The 5 items will cycle in the same order every loop.

children.text: Items are rerolled at a rate of once every 0.2 seconds.
children.raw: Items are rerolled at a rate of once every 0.2 seconds.

synergies.text: Spindown Dice: Rerolling a cycling item will reduce the ID number of the displayed item by 1 and randomize the other 4 options.
synergies.raw: {{i|Spindown Dice}}: Rerolling a cycling item will reduce the ID number of the displayed item by 1 and randomize the other 4 options.

children.text: This allows Spindown Dice to mimic The D6's rerolling effect on 4/5 of Glitched crown's displayed items.
children.raw: This allows {{i|Spindown Dice}} to mimic {{i|The D6}}'s rerolling effect on 4/5 of Glitched crown's displayed items.

synergies.text: The D6: All 5 items will be re-rolled.
synergies.raw: {{i|The D6}}: All 5 items will be re-rolled.

interactions.text: Binge Eater: Adds a random food item to the cycle, for a total of 6 items on the cycling pedestal. Only the pedestals generated after picking up Binge Eater will be affected.
interactions.raw: {{i|Binge Eater}}: Adds a random food item to the cycle, for a total of 6 items on the cycling pedestal. Only the pedestals generated after picking up Binge Eater will be affected.

interactions.text: Damocles: Extra item pedestals do not reroll.
interactions.raw: {{i|Damocles}}: Extra item pedestals do not reroll.

interactions.text: Diplopia: The items on-screen at the moment of activation will be duplicated, but the pedestal will also cycle through four new items.
interactions.raw: {{i|Diplopia}}: The items on-screen at the moment of activation will be duplicated, but the pedestal will also cycle through four new items.

interactions.text: Genesis: If Glitched Crown is picked up during the item sequence, the effect will start on the second item after grabbing Glitched Crown.
interactions.raw: {{i|Genesis}}: If Glitched Crown is picked up during the item sequence, the effect will start on the second item after grabbing Glitched Crown.

interactions.text: 0 - The Fool?: Items spawned using the card such as Boom! will not generate a cycling pedestal.
interactions.raw: {{p|0 - The Fool?}}: Items spawned using the card such as {{I|Boom!}} will not generate a cycling pedestal.

name: Belly Jelly
description: Causes enemies to bounce off of Isaac, dealing damage to them if they hit an enemy or obstacle. Also gives Isaac the chance to deflect enemy shots.

effects.text: Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.
effects.raw: Enemies that touch Isaac will bounce off him and propel in the opposite direction. If they hit an obstacle or wall while bouncing, they will take damage.

children.text: If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.
children.raw: If an enemy bounces into another enemy, the second enemy will also take damage.

effects.text: When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.
effects.raw: When an enemy bounces off of Isaac, there's a 50% chance that Isaac won't receive contact damage.

effects.text: Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.
effects.raw: Additionally grants a 50% chance for projectiles to bounce off of Isaac without taking damage.

synergies.text: Aries: Retains the chance to bounce enemies while preventing damage simultaneously.
synergies.raw: {{i|Aries}}: Retains the chance to bounce enemies while preventing damage simultaneously.

synergies.text: Book of Shadows / Unicorn Stump: Can be used as a powerful offensive item since Isaac can still bounce off enemies while invincible.
synergies.raw: {{i|Book of Shadows}} / {{i|Unicorn Stump}}: Can be used as a powerful offensive item since Isaac can still bounce off enemies while invincible.

synergies.text: Cone Head / Hallowed Ground / Host Hat / Infamy / Metal Plate / Star of Bethlehem: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Cone Head}} / {{i|Hallowed Ground}} / {{i|Host Hat}} / {{i|Infamy}} / {{i|Metal Plate}} / {{i|Star of Bethlehem}}: Offers an additional chance to negate damage.

synergies.text: Gnawed Leaf: The bouncing effect works while Isaac is invincible.
synergies.raw: {{i|Gnawed Leaf}}: The bouncing effect works while Isaac is invincible.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss: Allows Isaac to bounce enemies and poison them at the same time, with a decent chance to get a lot more health back in the form of Black Hearts than originally spent.
synergies.raw: {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}: Allows Isaac to bounce enemies and poison them at the same time, with a decent chance to get a lot more health back in the form of {{e|Black Heart}}s than originally spent.

interactions.text: Panic Button: The active item will still be activated if Belly Jelly blocks damage.
interactions.raw: {{t|Panic Button}}: The active item will still be activated if Belly Jelly blocks damage.

name: Sacred Orb
description: Prevents items of quality 0-1 from appearing, and items of quality 2 from appearing 33% of the time. Quest items are unaffected.

effects.text: Prevents low-quality items from appearing, greatly increasing the quality of items received from all item pools.
effects.raw: Prevents low-quality [[items]] from appearing, greatly increasing the [[Item quality|quality]] of items received from all [[item pools]].

children.text: Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.
children.raw: Items with a quality of 0-1 are automatically rerolled.

children.text: Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.
children.raw: Items with a quality of 2 have a 33% chance to be automatically rerolled.

children.text: Quest items cannot be rerolled.
children.raw: [[Item Tags quest|Quest items]] cannot be rerolled.

effects.text: Counts towards the Seraphim transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}

interactions.text: Bag of Crafting: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
interactions.raw: {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

interactions.text: Binge Eater: The food item is not re-rolled.
interactions.raw: {{i|Binge Eater}}: The food item is not re-rolled.

interactions.text: Death Certificate: Death Certificate's item generation ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.
interactions.raw: {{I|Death Certificate}}: Death Certificate's item generation ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

interactions.text: Dice Bag: The one-time-use dice given by this trinket are not affected.
interactions.raw: {{t|Dice Bag}}: The one-time-use dice given by this trinket are not affected.

interactions.text: Expansion Pack: The random effects generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
interactions.raw: {{t|Expansion Pack}}: The random effects generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.

interactions.text: Genesis: If obtained from one of the Genesis room pedestals, no effect on future pedestals spawned in the room. Will function normally upon leaving.
interactions.raw: {{I|Genesis}}: If obtained from one of the Genesis room pedestals, no effect on future pedestals spawned in the room. Will function normally upon leaving.

interactions.text: Lemegeton: Generated items are affected by Sacred Orb.
interactions.raw: {{i|Lemegeton}}: Generated items are affected by Sacred Orb.

interactions.text: Modeling Clay: Temporary items generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.
interactions.raw: {{t|Modeling Clay}}: Temporary items generated by this trinket are affected by Sacred Orb.

interactions.text: Sacred Orb: Additional copies of this item provide no benefit. The chance of quality 2 items being rerolled does not increase.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacred Orb}}: Additional copies of this item provide no benefit. The chance of quality 2 items being rerolled does not increase.

interactions.text: Spindown Dice: Spindown Dice ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.
interactions.raw: {{I|Spindown Dice}}: Spindown Dice ignores Sacred Orb's changes to item availability.

name: Sanguine Bond
description: Spawns a special set of spikes in the . Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

effects.text: Spawns a special set of spikes in the . They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.
effects.raw: Spawns a special set of spikes in the {{r|Devil Room}}. They deal 1 full heart of damage per use.

effects.text: Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.
effects.raw: Taking damage from the spikes has a chance to grant a reward.

synergies.text: Goat Head: Allows Isaac to enter and leave the Devil Room at will, making this item substantially more powerful, as red hearts can be collected throughout the floor.
synergies.raw: {{I|Goat Head}}: Allows Isaac to enter and leave the Devil Room at will, making this item substantially more powerful, as red hearts can be collected throughout the floor.

children.text: Goat Head + Scapular: The spikes generated by Sanguine Bond can be farmed infinitely.
children.raw: {{I|Goat Head}} + {{I|Scapular}}: The spikes generated by Sanguine Bond can be farmed infinitely.

children.text: Quitting and reloading the game will also reset the soul heart regeneration provided by Scapular, thus negating the need for Goat Head.
children.raw: Quitting and reloading the game will also reset the soul heart regeneration provided by {{I|Scapular}}, thus negating the need for {{I|Goat Head}}.

synergies.text: Keeper / Tainted Keeper / Strawman: The pennies that are spawned when stepping on the spikes can be used to heal Keeper and infinitely farm rewards.
synergies.raw: {{c|Keeper}} / {{c|Tainted Keeper}} / {{i|Strawman}}: The pennies that are spawned when stepping on the spikes can be used to heal Keeper and infinitely farm rewards.

synergies.text: Placenta: With a lot of time, the spikes can be farmed infinitely.
synergies.raw: {{I|Placenta}}: With a lot of time, the spikes can be farmed infinitely.

synergies.text: Portable Slot: The pennies that are spawned can be gambled to give hearts, allowing more uses.
synergies.raw: {{I|Portable Slot}}: The pennies that are spawned can be gambled to give hearts, allowing more uses.

synergies.text: The Wafer / Percs: Hearts will last twice as long, allowing more uses. Further uses may be obtained by sacrificing the black hearts given, and any hearts added from devil room items.
synergies.raw: {{I|The Wafer}} / [[Pills|Percs]]: Hearts will last twice as long, allowing more uses. Further uses may be obtained by sacrificing the black hearts given, and any hearts added from devil room items.

interactions.text: Callus: Will not prevent the damage from spikes created by Sanguine Bond.
interactions.raw: {{t|Callus}}: Will not prevent the damage from spikes created by Sanguine Bond.

interactions.text: Flat File: Retracts the spikes. The trinket must be dropped and the Devil Deal re-entered for the spikes to appear again.
interactions.raw: {{t|Flat File}}: Retracts the spikes. The trinket must be dropped and the Devil Deal re-entered for the spikes to appear again.

name: The Swarm
description: Spawns eight orbital flies, which turn into Blue Flies after they block a shot. Each time a room is cleared, spawns another orbital fly.

effects.text: Gives eight orbital flies when picked up.
effects.raw: Gives eight [[Familiar#Orbital Familiars|orbital]] flies when picked up.

effects.text: Each time a fly blocks a projectile, it will turn into a blue fly.
effects.raw: Each time a fly blocks a projectile, it will turn into a blue fly.

effects.text: Each time a room is cleared, spawns an orbital fly.
effects.raw: Each time a room is cleared, spawns an orbital fly.

children.text: The maximum number of orbital flies Isaac can have is 16.
children.raw: The maximum number of orbital flies Isaac can have is 16.

effects.text: Counts towards the Beelzebub transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Beelzebub}}

name: Heartbreak
description: Grants 3 broken hearts and +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has. Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more until Isaac has nothing but broken hearts.

effects.text: Grants +0.25 damage for every broken heart Isaac has.
effects.raw: Grants +0.25 [[damage]] for every [[Health#Broken Hearts|broken heart]] Isaac has.

effects.text: Immediately grants 3 broken hearts.
effects.raw: Immediately grants 3 broken hearts.

children.text: Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more, replacing other types of hearts if necessary, and activates The Necronomicon's effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.
children.raw: Every otherwise fatal hit will add 2 more, replacing other types of hearts if necessary, and activates {{i|The Necronomicon}}'s effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

children.text: Once Isaac has no non-broken hearts left, he dies. Extra lives will apply at this point.
children.raw: Once Isaac has no non-broken hearts left, he dies. Extra lives will apply at this point.

synergies.text: A Missing Page / Missing Page 2: Deals an additional +40 damage when Isaac dies. Effects stack together and with multiple copies.
synergies.raw: {{t|A Missing Page|r}} / {{I|Missing Page 2|r}}: Deals an additional +40 damage when Isaac dies. Effects stack together and with multiple copies.

synergies.text: Found Soul: The ghost gains 2 extra hits per floor, and every hit they take will damage all enemies in a room as well.
synergies.raw: {{t|Found Soul}}: The ghost gains 2 extra hits per floor, and every hit they take will damage all enemies in a room as well.

interactions.text: Damocles: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from Damocles.
interactions.raw: {{i|Damocles}}: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from Damocles.

interactions.text: Keeper: Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking fatal damage will only grant Keeper 1 broken heart.
interactions.raw: {{c|Keeper}}: Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking fatal damage will only grant Keeper 1 broken heart.

interactions.text: Magdalene + Birthright: Can hold up to 17 broken hearts, totaling +4.25 damage instead.
interactions.raw: {{C|Magdalene}} + {{I|Birthright}}: Can hold up to 17 broken hearts, totaling +4.25 damage instead.

interactions.text: Plan C / Suicide King: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from these effects.
interactions.raw: {{i|Plan C}} / {{p|Suicide King}}: Heartbreak does not protect Isaac from these effects.

interactions.text: Tainted Eden / Tainted Isaac: The starting broken hearts are removed when Heartbreak is rerolled/dropped. However, any broken hearts gained from lethal damage will persist.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Eden}} / {{c|Tainted Isaac}}: The starting broken hearts are removed when Heartbreak is rerolled/dropped. However, any broken hearts gained from lethal damage will persist.

interactions.text: Tainted Jacob: This effect will save Tainted Jacob while he is in his Lost form, adding two broken hearts to his regular health.
interactions.raw: {{C|Tainted Jacob}}: This effect will save Tainted Jacob while he is in his Lost form, adding two broken hearts to his regular health.

interactions.text: Tainted Keeper: Tainted Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking any damage will kill him, as he will then have 2 broken hearts.
interactions.raw: {{C|Tainted Keeper}}: Tainted Keeper will gain 1 broken heart instead of 3. Taking any damage will kill him, as he will then have 2 broken hearts.

children.text: Mother's Kiss can mitigate this as it gives Tainted Keeper an extra coin heart.
children.raw: {{t|Mother's Kiss}} can mitigate this as it gives Tainted Keeper an extra coin heart.

interactions.text: The Lost / Tainted Lost: The Lost has full benefit of the item. This lets him survive 4 extra hits, each hit adding 1 damage, and the 5th is fatal.
interactions.raw: {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: The Lost has full benefit of the item. This lets him survive 4 extra hits, each hit adding 1 damage, and the 5th is fatal.

children.text: Tainted Lost can't normally obtain it, as it doesn't have the offensive item tag.
children.raw: Tainted Lost can't normally obtain it, as it doesn't have the offensive item tag.

children.text: The Lost / Tainted Lost + Magic Skin / VI - The Lovers?: No broken hearts are added by the item/card, thus having no effect on Heartbreak.
children.raw: '''The Lost''' / '''Tainted Lost''' + {{i|Magic Skin}} / {{p|VI - The Lovers?}}: No broken hearts are added by the item/card, thus having no effect on Heartbreak.

name: Bloody Gust
description: The first 6 times Isaac takes damage on a given floor, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor, up to a maximum of +1.02 and +3.00, respectively.

effects.text: When Isaac takes damage, he gains Speed and Fire Rate for the rest of the floor.
effects.raw: When Isaac takes damage, he gains [[Speed]] and [[Fire Rate]] for the rest of the floor.

children.text: Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.
children.raw: Speed gained per hit is (0.04x previous hits taken) +0.07.

children.text: Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.
children.raw: Fire Rate gained per hit is (0.1x previous hits taken) + 0.25.

children.text: Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.
children.raw: Both effects stack up to six times, for a total of +1.02 speed and +3 fire rate.

children.text: Fire rate bonuses can exceed the normal maximum fire rate limit.
children.raw: Fire rate bonuses can exceed the normal maximum fire rate limit.

synergies.text: Blood Rights / Razor Blade / IV Bag: The damage from the item counts for the stats up.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Rights}} / {{i|Razor Blade}} / {{i|IV Bag}}: The damage from the item counts for the stats up.

synergies.text: Bloody Lust: Bloody Gust's "rage" effect is shared with Bloody Lust, so if Isaac picks up Bloody Lust after already getting hit with Bloody Gust (or vice versa) the boosts will automatically update to that level.
synergies.raw: {{I|Bloody Lust}}: Bloody Gust's "rage" effect is shared with Bloody Lust, so if Isaac picks up Bloody Lust after already getting hit with Bloody Gust (or vice versa) the boosts will automatically update to that level.

synergies.text: Dull Razor: Safely provides the stat boosts without needing to take damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dull Razor}}: Safely provides the stat boosts without needing to take damage.

name: Salvation
description: Gives Isaac a halo that summons beams of light on enemies inside it. The halo grows larger the more times Isaac has taken damage this floor.

effects.text: Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.
effects.raw: Isaac receives an angelic halo around him.

effects.text: When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.
effects.raw: When an enemy comes in contact with the halo, a beam of light starts to form above them. If they stay in the halo for about a second, a beam of light will strike down on them, dealing 3.5 damage and creating 4 more beams that shoot out in all cardinal directions.

children.text: The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).
children.raw: The initial beam of light does 3.5 damage per tick (up to 15 times) and the others deal 1.75 damage per tick (up to 15 times).

children.text: If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.
children.raw: If an enemy is standing in the center of all the light beams, they will take a total of 152.5 damage.

effects.text: Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.
effects.raw: Each time Isaac takes damage, the halo will grow in size, up to a maximum of 10 times. This isn't damage scaled, but allows Isaac to trigger the Salvation effect from further away. The halo size will reset after leaving the floor.

effects.text: Counts towards the Seraphim transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Seraphim}}

synergies.text: Camo Undies: Damaging enemies with Salvation will not take away Isaac's camouflage.
synergies.raw: {{I|Camo Undies}}: Damaging enemies with Salvation will not take away Isaac's camouflage.

synergies.text: Dark Arts: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.
synergies.raw: {{I|Dark Arts}}: Stays in effect even while using Dark Arts, allowing Isaac to deal more damage to nearby enemies while invulnerable.

synergies.text: Gnawed Leaf: The light beams trigger even when Isaac is a statue.
synergies.raw: {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: The light beams trigger even when Isaac is a statue.

name: Vanishing Twin
description: Spawns a familiar that becomes a weaker clone of the floor's boss when entering the . Defeating it drops an extra item.

effects.text: Spawns a flat, rotating fetus familiar that follows Isaac.
effects.raw: Spawns a flat, rotating fetus [[familiar]] that follows Isaac.

effects.text: After entering a , the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the boss. Isaac must defeat both bosses.
effects.raw: After entering a {{R|Boss Room}}, the familiar will move closer to the center of the room, and become a clone of the [[boss]]. Isaac must defeat both bosses.

children.text: The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.
children.raw: The Vanishing Twin and original boss will be set to 75% of their maximum health, and their movements and attack patterns will be around 20% slower.

effects.text: Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the boss item pool, even if the fight isn't over yet.
effects.raw: Upon death, the clone boss will drop an item pedestal where it died from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|boss item pool]], even if the fight isn't over yet.

children.text: The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} The item cannot appear on top of the trapdoor's tile.

effects.text: The effect doesn't occur against mini-bosses and end-chapter bosses such as Mom, Mom's Heart, Isaac, Satan, etc.
effects.raw: The effect doesn't occur against [[mini-boss]]es and end-chapter bosses such as {{E|Mom}}, {{E|Mom's Heart}}, {{E|Isaac}}, {{E|Satan}}, etc.

effects.text: The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.
effects.raw: The Vanishing Twin familiar will return when Isaac reaches the next floor.

synergies.text: Sacrificial Altar: The twin can be sacrificed normally at any time.
synergies.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: The twin can be sacrificed normally at any time.

children.text: If sacrificed after it's transformed into a boss, it will still give an item from the sacrifice, but the boss will not disappear and will also not spawn an additional item.
children.raw: If sacrificed after it's transformed into a boss, it will still give an item from the sacrifice, but the boss will not disappear and will also ''not'' spawn an additional item.

synergies.text: Satanic Bible: Using it before killing the clone boss will cause it to spawn an item from the Devil Room item pool instead of from the Boss item pool. This item must be purchased just like a normal Devil Deal.
synergies.raw: {{i|Satanic Bible}}: Using it before killing the clone boss will cause it to spawn an item from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]] instead of from the [[Boss (Item Pool)|Boss item pool]]. This item must be purchased just like a normal [[Devil Room#Deals with the Devil|Devil Deal]].

synergies.text: There's Options: Will spawn an additional item choice for the item spawned by Vanishing Twin.
synergies.raw: {{i|There's Options}}: Will spawn an additional item choice for the item spawned by Vanishing Twin.

synergies.text: Tick: Further lowers the health of both the original boss and its clone.
synergies.raw: {{t|Tick}}: Further lowers the health of both the original boss and its clone.

synergies.text: Vanishing Twin: Picking up multiple copies of the item will result in multiple clones getting spawned.
synergies.raw: {{i|Vanishing Twin}}: Picking up multiple copies of the item will result in multiple clones getting spawned.

children.text: Each boss will have its health reduced down further to 75% of the health of its previous clone.
children.raw: Each boss will have its health reduced down further to 75% of the health of its previous clone.

children.text: Each of the bosses will spawn a separate item.
children.raw: Each of the bosses will spawn a separate item.

children.text: Each clone of Great Gideon adds 2 extra waves of enemies.
children.raw: Each clone of {{E|Great Gideon}} adds 2 extra waves of enemies.

interactions.text: BFFS!: Will increase the fetus' size, although it has no effect after the transformation happens.
interactions.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Will increase the fetus' size, although it has no effect after the transformation happens.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}: No effect.

interactions.text: IV - The Emperor?: The twin will clone the additional boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. However, this will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the twin won't be active until the next floor.
interactions.raw: {{p|IV - The Emperor?}}: The twin will clone the additional boss and spawn an item if the original one has not been visited yet. However, this will not allow for another item to be obtained from the floor's original boss, because the twin won't be active until the next floor.

interactions.text: Meat Cleaver: No effect on the number of items spawned.
interactions.raw: {{i|Meat Cleaver}}: No effect on the number of items spawned.

interactions.text: Tainted Keeper: If playing as Tainted Keeper, the item dropped by the clone boss will cost money.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Keeper}}: If playing as Tainted Keeper, the item dropped by the clone boss will cost money.

name: Twisted Pair
description: Spawns two familiars that float on either side of Isaac and fire tears that use his tears, range, shot speed, and tear effects, and scale with damage.

effects.text: Spawns two familiars who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's tears, range, shot speed, tear effects and that each deal 0.375x his damage.
effects.raw: Spawns two [[familiar]]s who float by Isaac's side and fire tears that use Isaac's [[tears]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], [[tear effects]] and that each deal 0.375x his [[damage]].

effects.text: Counts towards the Conjoined transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Conjoined}}

synergies.text: BFFS!: Twisted Pair's tears deal twice as much damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Twisted Pair's tears deal twice as much damage.

synergies.text: Box of Friends/Crooked Penny/Diplopia: Each additional Twisted Pair will add two more familiars that float farther out from Isaac.
synergies.raw: {{i|Box of Friends}}/{{i|Crooked Penny}}/{{i|Diplopia}}: Each additional Twisted Pair will add two more familiars that float farther out from Isaac.

synergies.text: Forgotten Lullaby: Increases the fire rate of Twisted Pair.
synergies.raw: {{T|Forgotten Lullaby}}: Increases the fire rate of Twisted Pair.

synergies.text: Tractor Beam: Twisted Pair's tears follow the beam.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tractor Beam}}: Twisted Pair's tears follow the beam.

synergies.text: Friendship Necklace: Causes the Twisted Pair to orbit Isaac, allowing for a more precise firing of tears.
synergies.raw: {{T|Friendship Necklace}}: Causes the Twisted Pair to orbit Isaac, allowing for a more precise firing of tears.

interactions.text: Epic Fetus: Each familiar will fire a missile from a two additional crosshairs. Not Recommended, as the twisted pair crosshairs are not synced to Isaac's crosshair and move at a much slower rate, making self damage much more likely as the additional crosshairs will struggle to make distance from Isaac. This is likely an oversight.
interactions.raw: {{I|Epic Fetus}}:  Each familiar will fire a missile from a two additional crosshairs. '''Not Recommended''', as the twisted pair crosshairs are not synced to Isaac's crosshair and move at a much slower rate, making self damage much more likely as the additional crosshairs will struggle to make distance from Isaac. This is likely an oversight.

interactions.text: Eye Drops: The familiars do not have the staggered attack, stat bonuses still apply.
interactions.raw: {{i|Eye Drops}}: The familiars do not have the staggered attack, stat bonuses still apply.

interactions.text: Eye of Greed The two familiars will also fire coin tears which spend Isaac's coins. Their shot counter is independent from Isaac's.
interactions.raw: {{I|Eye of Greed}} The two familiars will also fire coin tears which spend Isaac's coins. Their shot counter is independent from Isaac's.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: Only 1 item pedestal is spawned for their sacrifice, unless they were spawned through Cambion Conception, in which case they will count for two.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Only 1 item pedestal is spawned for their sacrifice, unless they were spawned through {{I|Cambion Conception}}, in which case they will count for two.

interactions.text: Terra + Brimstone/Technology: While Terra + laser items like Brimstone or Technology don't open doors normally, Twisted Pair's lasers can open doors. This is likely an oversight.
interactions.raw: {{i|Terra}} + {{i|Brimstone}}/{{i|Technology}}: While Terra + laser items like Brimstone or Technology don't open doors normally, Twisted Pair's lasers can open doors. This is likely an oversight.

name: Azazel's Rage
description: Isaac builds rage every time a room is cleared. After four rooms, fires a large Brimstone laser when entering the next room.

effects.text: Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.
effects.raw: Isaac builds up rage every time he clears a room, which is indicated by the patch of skin that spreads around his face, as well as the four sections of the horn lighting up red one at a time.

effects.text: After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large Brimstone laser for ~3.33 seconds.
effects.raw: After four rooms, Isaac's head will start to flash red; upon entering a room with enemies, he will fire a large {{I|Brimstone}} laser for ~3.33 seconds.

children.text: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).
children.raw: The laser deals Isaac's damage per tick (15x Isaac's damage per second).

name: Echo Chamber
description: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.

effects.text: When Isaac uses a Card, Pill, or Rune, he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.
effects.raw: When Isaac uses a [[Card]], [[Pill]], or [[Rune]], he also uses a copy of the previous three Cards/Pills/Runes he used after picking up Echo Chamber.

synergies.text: ? Card + Ancient Recall / Vurp Pill + R Key: The ? Card effect can be used in conjunction with R Key without consuming it, allowing the player to in theory (with the help of Clicker) obtain completion marks for up to four additional routes and characters in a single run.
synergies.raw: {{p|? Card}} + {{P|Ancient Recall}} / [[Pills#Pill Effects|Vurp Pill]] + {{I|R Key}}: The ? Card effect can be used in conjunction with R Key without consuming it, allowing the player to in theory (with the help of {{I|Clicker}}) obtain completion marks for up to four additional routes and characters in a single run.

synergies.text: Ancient Recall: Can be used to spawn many extra cards.
synergies.raw: {{p|Ancient Recall}}: Can be used to spawn many extra cards.

synergies.text: False PHD: Taking benign pills (e.g. puberty) will give black hearts or damage ups for each of the pills that are activated. Caution should be exercised when using this synergy, since the last three pills taken will be converted to their bad counterparts, and one stat down can ruin the synergy.
synergies.raw: {{I|False PHD}}: Taking benign pills (e.g. puberty) will give black hearts or damage ups for each of the pills that are activated. Caution should be exercised when using this synergy, since the last three pills taken will be converted to their bad counterparts, and one stat down can ruin the synergy.

synergies.text: PHD, Virgo, or Lucky Foot: The last three activated pills are converted to their good counterparts, including pills taken prior to picking up PHD, Virgo, or Lucky Foot.
synergies.raw: {{i|PHD}}, {{i|Virgo}}, or {{I|Lucky Foot}}: The last three activated pills are converted to their good counterparts, including pills taken prior to picking up {{i|PHD}}, {{i|Virgo}}, or {{I|Lucky Foot}}.

synergies.text: R Key: Using the R key does not reset the consumable pool, as such they stay the same in Echo Chamber too.
synergies.raw: {{I|R Key}}: Using the R key does not reset the consumable pool, as such they stay the same in Echo Chamber too.

synergies.text: Jera: Allows for repeat duplication of consumables in the room, up to 16x if used four times.
synergies.raw: {{p|Jera}}: Allows for repeat duplication of consumables in the room, up to 16x if used four times.

synergies.text: Suicide King + Dead Cat: Can be used to generate many pickups and items at the cost of three extra lives.
synergies.raw: {{p|Suicide King}} + {{i|Dead Cat}}: Can be used to generate many pickups and items at the cost of three extra lives.

synergies.text: Tarot Cloth: Every activated tarot card will be given a bonus effect.
synergies.raw: {{i|Tarot Cloth}}: Every activated tarot card will be given a bonus effect.

synergies.text: Vurp Pill: Can be used to spawn infinite pills.
synergies.raw: [[Pills#Pill Effects|Vurp Pill]]: Can be used to spawn infinite pills.

interactions.text: Genesis: The consumable pool is reset when Genesis is used, so if it's re-obtained after using Genesis, the previously stored consumable types won't be activated.
interactions.raw: {{i|Genesis}}: The consumable pool is reset when Genesis is used, so if it's re-obtained after using Genesis, the previously stored consumable types won't be activated.

interactions.text: Placebo/Blank Card/Clear Rune: Doesn't cause Echo Chamber to activate, or put the pill/card/rune into the queue.
interactions.raw: {{i|Placebo}}/{{i|Blank Card}}/{{i|Clear Rune}}: Doesn't cause Echo Chamber to activate, or put the pill/card/rune into the queue.

name: Isaac's Tomb
description: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.

effects.text: Spawns an Old Chest at the start of each floor.
effects.raw: Spawns an {{E|Old Chest}} at the start of each floor.

effects.text: Old Chests are similar in appearance to Locked Chests and likewise require a Key to unlock, but have the color of a normal Chest and a worn-down appearance. When opened, they contain one of the following:
effects.raw: Old Chests are similar in appearance to {{E|Locked Chest}}s and likewise require a {{E|Key}} to unlock, but have the color of a normal Chest and a worn-down appearance. When opened, they contain one of the following:

children.text: 1-3 Soul Hearts (43% chance)
children.raw: 1-3 {{E|Soul Heart}}s (43% chance)

children.text: 3 trinkets (42% chance)
children.raw: 3 [[trinkets]] (42% chance)

children.text: An Old Chest item (10% chance)
children.raw: An [[Old Chest (Item Pool)|Old Chest item]] (10% chance)

children.text: An Angel Room item (5% chance)
children.raw: An [[Angel Room (Item Pool)|Angel Room item]] (5% chance)

synergies.text: Death Certificate : An Old Chest will appear in the Death Certificate area, unless Death Certificate is used on the floor where Isaac's Tomb was obtained.
synergies.raw: {{i|Death Certificate}} : An Old Chest will appear in the Death Certificate area, unless Death Certificate is used on the floor where Isaac's Tomb was obtained.

interactions.text: Crooked Penny / Diplopia: Additional copies of Isaac's Tomb have no effect. Only one chest is spawned at the start of the floor.
interactions.raw: {{i|Crooked Penny}} / {{i|Diplopia}}: Additional copies of Isaac's Tomb have no effect. Only one chest is spawned at the start of the floor.

interactions.text: Gilded Key / The Left Hand / Mom's Key / Poker Chip: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{t|Gilded Key}} / {{t|The Left Hand}} / {{i|Mom's Key}} / {{t|Poker Chip}}: No effect.

name: Vengeful Spirit
description: After taking damage, spawns an orbital wisp that lasts for the entire floor, up to a maximum of six. They fire tears but do not block shots.

effects.text: When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time.
effects.raw: When Isaac takes damage, spawns a red wisp that fires spectral tears and deals contact damage to enemies (but does not block projectiles). These red wisps last for the entire floor, and Isaac can have up to 6 red wisps at a time.

children.text: Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.
children.raw: Wisps deal 3 + 0.1 * (current_floor - 1) damage per tear, and fire tears once per second.

children.text: Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).
children.raw: Wisps deal contact damage equal to 0.5x Isaac's damage per tick (15 ticks per second = 7.5x Isaac's damage).

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the wisps' size, on-hit and contact damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles the wisps' size, on-hit and contact damage.

synergies.text: Blood Oath: For each half heart of damage taken at the start of the room, a wisp is spawned.
synergies.raw: {{i|Blood Oath}}: For each half heart of damage taken at the start of the room, a wisp is spawned.

name: Esau Jr.
description: Swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has +2 flat damage and flight. Characters have independent items and health. Dying as either character ends the run.

effects.text: When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three Black Hearts, +2 flat damage, and flight. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.
effects.raw: When used, swaps between the current character and Esau Jr., who has three {{e|Black Heart}}s, +2 flat [[damage]], and [[flight]]. When used as Esau Jr., swaps back to the original character.

effects.text: Coins, Bombs, and Keys are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, items, cards/pills, and trinkets) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.
effects.raw: [[Coins]], {{e|Bomb}}s, and {{e|Key}}s are shared between the two characters, but everything else (including hearts, [[items]], [[cards]]/[[pills]], and [[trinkets]]) are not shared and apply only to the character that collects them.

effects.text: When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.
effects.raw: When used for the first time, Esau Jr. gains a random item for each item the original character had. Each new item comes from the same item pool the respective original item was taken from.

children.text: Trinkets, Cards, Pills, and/or Active items are not given; only passive items are.
children.raw: [[Trinkets]], [[Cards]], [[Pills]], and/or [[Items|Active items]] are not given; only passive items are.

children.text: Quest items like The Polaroid are given to both characters, as is the Esau Jr. item.
children.raw: Quest items like {{I|The Polaroid}} are given to both characters, as is the Esau Jr. item.

children.text: Pickups that would normally be generated by the new items will not drop when Esau Jr. is first used.
children.raw: Pickups that would normally be generated by the new items will not drop when Esau Jr. is first used.

effects.text: If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.
effects.raw: If either character dies, they both die, regardless of whether the other character has any remaining health.

effects.text: If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a familiar that behaves like Abel but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.
effects.raw: If multiple copies of Esau Jr. are used, starting from the fifth one, instead of activating its regular effect, the item is consumed and spawns a [[familiar]] that behaves like {{I|Abel}} but deals 7.5 damage per shot with higher fire rate.

synergies.text: Butter!: Puts Esau Jr. on a pedestal and generates an extra copy for the swapped character to hold, duplicating the item.

name: Berserk!
description: Isaac goes berserk for 5 seconds, greatly increasing his speed, tears, and damage, but restricting him to using a melee weapon instead of his tears. This item charges by dealing damage to enemies instead of clearing rooms.

effects.text: Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:
effects.raw: Upon use, puts Isaac in a berserk state for 5 seconds, during which the following effects apply:

children.text: +0.4 speed.
+3 flat damage .
children.raw: +3 flat [[damage]] .

children.text: Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to The Forgotten's bone club.
children.raw: Tears are replaced by a jawbone melee weapon that is similar to {{C|The Forgotten}}'s bone club.

children.text: The jaw bone deals 3× Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5× Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3× Isaac's damage per second).
children.raw: The jaw bone deals 3× Isaac's damage when swung and 1.5× Isaac's damage per tick when thrown (3× Isaac's damage per second).

children.text: The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.
children.raw: The swung jaw bone reflects enemy shots.

children.text: Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.
children.raw: Reflected projectiles deal 6 damage if they would've hurt Isaac for half a heart, and 7 for a full heart.

children.text: The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.
children.raw: The thrown jaw bone charges very quickly compared to the Forgotten's bone club, but as berserk only lasts five seconds, it uses a noticeable amount of the effect's limited duration to charge and throw the jaw bone.

children.text: The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open chests.
children.raw: The swung jaw bone can collect pickups and open [[chest]]s.

children.text: A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as IV Bag or .
children.raw: A successful melee hit on an enemy makes Isaac immune to damage for roughly 0.25 seconds. This immunity doesn't protect against self-inflicted damage such as {{i|IV Bag}} or {{m|Blood Donation Machine}}.

children.text: While Berserking, Isaac's fire rate is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.
children.raw: While Berserking, Isaac's [[fire rate]] is halved then increased by 2. This will be a tears upgrade unless Isaac's tears is 4 or above.

children.text: If playing as The Forgotten, the ×0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.
children.raw: If playing as The Forgotten, the ×0.5 fire rate modifier isn't applied, as he already has it.

children.text: Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.
children.raw: Killing an enemy while "Berserking" increases Berserk's current duration by 1 second.

children.text: Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.
children.raw: Killing an enemy grants very brief invincibility, preventing damage from exploding enemies.

children.text: Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 speed until the effect ends.
children.raw: Every enemy killed will also grant +0.4 [[speed]] until the effect ends.

children.text: Isaac is unable to die while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 hearts, but will not die until the effect ends.
children.raw: Isaac is unable to [[Death|die]] while Berserk is active. He can be reduced to 0 [[Health|hearts]], but will not die until the effect ends.

children.text: This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as Damocles and Plan C) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.
children.raw: This does not apply to insta-kill effects (such as {{i|Damocles}} and {{i|Plan C}}) - they will kill Isaac even if Berserk is active.

effects.text: This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.
effects.raw: This item charges when Isaac deals damage to enemies rather than by clearing rooms or picking up batteries. It requires a base total of 120 damage, and increases by 40 for every next floor.

synergies.text: C Section: Replaces club throw with two swings in quick succession which fire a fetus. All fetuses fired will hold bone clubs, similar to the interaction with The Forgotten.
synergies.raw: {{i|C Section}}: Replaces club throw with two swings in quick succession which fire a fetus. All fetuses fired will hold bone clubs, similar to the interaction with {{c|The Forgotten}}.

synergies.text: Scapular: If the fatal damage occurs during Berserk state, Scapular will trigger and grant the Soul Heart.
synergies.raw: {{i|Scapular}}: If the fatal damage occurs during Berserk state, Scapular will trigger and grant the {{e|Soul Heart}}.

synergies.text: Suplex!: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a Mama Mega! style explosion, destroying all obstacles in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage.
synergies.raw: {{i|Suplex!}}: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a {{i|Mama Mega!}} style explosion, destroying all [[obstacle]]s in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage.

synergies.text: The Lost / Tainted Lost: This can allow either variant of The Lost to survive being damaged if it happens while Berserk is active. Despite having no visible health bar, their health is normally set to a Half Soul Heart. If they take damage while Berserk is active, they will not die if they are able to pick up a Soul Heart or half soul heart before the effect ends. Black Hearts do not count for this.
synergies.raw: {{c|The Lost}} / {{c|Tainted Lost}}: This can allow either variant of The Lost to survive being damaged if it happens while Berserk is active. Despite having no visible health bar, their health is normally set to a {{e|Half Soul Heart}}. If they take damage while Berserk is active, they will not die if they are able to pick up a {{e|Soul Heart}} or half soul heart before the effect ends. {{e|Black Heart}}s do not count for this.

synergies.text: The Ludovico Technique: While under the Berserk state, you lose control of the Ludovico Technique tear, which can now be deflected by the jaw bone swing, bouncing off nearby walls and dealing damage to enemies.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: While under the Berserk state, you lose control of the Ludovico Technique tear, which can now be deflected by the jaw bone swing, bouncing off nearby walls and dealing damage to enemies.

interactions.raw: {{I|4.5 Volt}} / {{I|9 Volt}} / {{I|Jumper Cables}}: No effect.

interactions.raw: {{dlc|r}}[[Cards and Runes|Ace Cards]]: Turning enemies into [[pickup]]s doesn’t count as damaging or killing them for the sake of charging this item or extending its duration.

interactions.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: Duration is only extended if no enemies are killed during the first half, thus only providing a benefit against bosses that can't spawn enemies.

children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Frozen enemies do extend the timer.

interactions.text: Libra: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra will instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stats with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit due to the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.
interactions.raw: {{I|Libra}}: Because of Berserk giving you +0.4 speed with every kill, Libra will instead steadily increases the damage, tears, and range stats with seemingly no limit, allowing massively high DPS, but targets are much more difficult to hit due to the range of the swing gradually extending outwards more and more with each kill.

interactions.raw: {{I|Sharp Plug}}: Isaac will take damage without gaining any charges.

name: Dark Arts
description: Briefly grants +1 speed and makes Isaac invulnerable and intangible. When the effect ends, destroys all projectiles and damages all enemies Isaac passed through.

effects.text: When used, Isaac gains +1.0 speed and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2× Isaac's damage plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.
effects.raw: When used, Isaac gains +1.0 [[speed]] and can walk through enemies/bullets for 1 second or until he shoots. If Isaac walks through an enemy or bullet during this time, it freezes until the effect ends, then takes damage equal to 2× Isaac's [[damage]] plus a flat 3.5. If there are multiple enemies/projectiles caught in the attack, each consecutive attack deals an additional flat 3.5 damage. At the end of the effect, an area of effect blast is created, dealing more damage the more enemies or bullets were pierced during the effect.

children.text: The damage of the blast at the end of Dark Arts is equal to the sum of all damage dealt while dashing between enemies.
children.raw: The damage of the blast at the end of Dark Arts is equal to the sum of all damage dealt while dashing between enemies.

children.text: Bullets walked through will still count for the final blast damage calculation, even though they can't be damaged.
children.raw: Bullets walked through will still count for the final blast damage calculation, even though they can't be damaged.

synergies.raw: {{I|9 Volt}}: Halves the time required to charge Dark Arts.

synergies.raw: {{I|Backstabber}}: Tagging an enemy from behind will apply bleeding.

synergies.raw: {{I|The Battery}}: Second charge can be used while Dark Arts is active.

synergies.raw: {{I|Camo Undies}}: The stealth mode given by Camo Undies won't be removed by activating Dark Arts. However, Dark Arts only gives +0.5 speed while Camo Undies is active.

synergies.raw: {{I|Car Battery}}: Dark Arts will last twice as long, totalling at 2 seconds per use.

synergies.raw: {{I|Euthanasia}}: Dark Arts can apply the Euthanasia effect.

synergies.raw: {{I|Taurus}}: Dark Arts' speed increase will contribute towards Taurus' activation.

synergies.raw: {{c|Black Judas}} / {{c|Tainted Judas}}: For every enemy/bullet he walks through, he will gain a temporary +1 [[damage]] bonus, which wears off at a rate of -0.25 damage every half second.

synergies.raw: [[Wisps]]: Wisps cannot be destroyed while Dark Arts is in effect.

children.raw: The effects will safely activate if Isaac is touching an enemy when he reappears, as there are a few frames where he is immune to damage but can still collide with enemies.

interactions.raw: {{i|Blood Oath}}: Using Dark Arts will block the damage, preventing Blood Oath from activating.

interactions.raw: {{I|Gnawed Leaf}}: If Isaac is stationary when Dark Arts ends, he will gain invulnerability without any downtime. Dark Arts can also be used from invulnerability without taking damage.

interactions.raw: {{I|How to Jump}}: Can be used while Dark Arts is active.

interactions.raw: {{i|Kamikaze!}}: Can be activated without harm while using Dark Arts.

interactions.raw: {{I|Mars}}: Isaac is able to dash while using Dark Arts.

interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Tainted Soul will gain the speed increase, but the invulnerability & attack portion of the activation will only apply to Tainted Forgotten.

description: Destroys all item pedestals in the room and gives Isaac a unique locust familiar for each item destroyed. Locusts fly forwards in the direction Isaac shoots and damage enemies hit. Destroying certain items spawns special locusts with unique effects.

effects.text: On use, destroys all items on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust familiar for each item destroyed.
effects.raw: On use, destroys all [[item]]s on item pedestals in the room and gives a unique red locust [[familiar]] for each item destroyed.

effects.text: These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts.
effects.raw: These locusts are permanent once created, up to a maximum of 64, after which creating more will replace older locusts.

children.text: This limit is shared with Blue Flies and Spiders.
children.raw: This limit is shared with [[Blue Fly|Blue Flies]] and [[Blue Spider|Spiders]].
