description: Isaac dashes forward and picks up the first enemy hit. After a moment, he jumps and slams them into the ground to deal damage and create a circular rock wave.

effects.text: Upon use, Isaac dashes forward a short distance. If Isaac runs into an enemy while dashing, he picks them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with tear controls. After one second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on depending on his size. On impact, this move creates circular rock waves that damage nearby enemies and destroy obstacles.
effects.raw: Upon use, Isaac dashes forward a short distance. If Isaac runs into an enemy while dashing, he picks them up and a crosshair spawns under him that can be controlled with tear controls. After one second, Isaac leaps up and slams down on the crosshair with the enemy, dealing damage to them and any enemies he lands on depending on his size. On impact, this move creates circular rock waves that damage nearby enemies and destroy obstacles.

children.text: The damage the slam deals is 50 +/- 10 for each size up/down Isaac has.
children.raw: The damage the slam deals is 50 +/- 10 for each size up/down Isaac has.

children.text: Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the rock waves increases/decreases for each size up/down Isaac has.
children.raw: Each spike in the rock wave deals 10 damage, and the range of the rock waves increases/decreases for each size up/down Isaac has.

children.text: Isaac is immune to damage for the duration of the effect, which allows him to use it to get into s, open Spiked Chests, and travel over spikes without taking damage.
children.raw: Isaac is immune to damage for the duration of the effect, which allows him to use it to get into {{r|Curse Room}}s, open {{e|Spiked Chest}}s, and travel over spikes without taking damage.

children.text: s and s will still deal damage while Suplex! is active.
children.raw: {{m|Blood Donation Machine}}s and {{m|Devil Beggar}}s will still deal damage while Suplex! is active.

synergies.text: Berserk! / Soul of Samson / Tainted Samson: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a Mama Mega! style explosion, destroying all obstacles in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage. The reason this interaction exists is that prior to a patch, doing this would instantly kill any enemy, including end bosses. It was then nerfed to only produce an explosion.
synergies.raw: {{i|Berserk!}} / {{p|Soul of Samson}} / {{c|Tainted Samson}}: When used near the end of the Berserk state (any time after the second bell ring), Suplex receives a unique visual effect, and will deal massive damage to the target, while setting off a {{i|Mama Mega!}} style explosion, destroying all [[obstacle]]s in the current room and blowing open all doors. The target being Suplexed, as well as nearby enemies, will receive 300 base damage that scales with Isaac's size. All other enemies receive 200 flat damage. The reason this interaction exists is that prior to a patch, doing this would instantly kill any enemy, including end bosses. It was then nerfed to only produce an explosion.

synergies.text: Freeze effects: Isaac can suplex frozen enemies.
synergies.raw: [[Freeze]] effects: Isaac can suplex frozen enemies.

synergies.text: Friendly enemies: If Isaac uses Suplex! to dash in a room, he will suplex a friendly enemy upon entering the room. This gives more time to react to danger and allows to deal damage to a group of enemies without risk (since the item gives invincibility during suplexes).
synergies.raw: [[Friendly]] enemies: If Isaac uses Suplex! to dash in a room, he will suplex a friendly enemy upon entering the room. This gives more time to react to danger and allows to deal damage to a group of enemies without risk (since the item gives invincibility during suplexes).

synergies.text: Panic Button: As long as Suplex! is fully charged and Isaac is moving, Panic Button automatically triggers when about to take damage, avoiding the damage and potentially grabbing an enemy in the process. Allows Isaac to grab an enemy by simply walking into them, provided the item is charged.
synergies.raw: {{t|Panic Button}}: As long as Suplex! is fully charged and Isaac is moving, Panic Button automatically triggers when about to take damage, avoiding the damage and potentially grabbing an enemy in the process. Allows Isaac to grab an enemy by simply walking into them, provided the item is charged.

synergies.text: The Virus: The nature of suplexing helps to inherently poison enemies without consequences most of the time.
synergies.raw: {{i|The Virus}}: The nature of suplexing helps to inherently poison enemies without consequences most of the time.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Tainted Forgotten: Suplex can only be used while carrying the body or throwing the body, and can only control where he lands after being thrown. Tainted Soul gains the temporary damage immunity, including while Tainted Forgotten is suplexing a target. Tainted Forgotten cannot dash, requiring walking into enemies after using Suplex to grab them.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Forgotten}}: Suplex can only be used while carrying the body or throwing the body, and can only control where he lands after being thrown. {{c|Tainted Soul}} gains the temporary damage immunity, including while Tainted Forgotten is suplexing a target. Tainted Forgotten cannot dash, requiring walking into enemies after using Suplex to grab them.

interactions.text: Safety Scissors: Suplexed Troll Bombs (and their versions) will explode instead of turning into Bomb pickups.
interactions.raw: {{t|Safety Scissors}}: Suplexed {{e|Troll Bomb}}s (and their versions) will explode instead of turning into {{e|Bomb}} pickups.

name: Bag of Crafting
description: Swipes a bag that collects and holds up to 8 pickups, which can then be used to craft an item. The power level of the item is based on the quality of pickups used.

effects.text: Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.
effects.raw: Upon use, pressing an attack direction will cause a swipe attack with high knockback and 3 damage.

children.text: The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size.
children.raw: The swipe scales in size with Isaac's size.

children.text: The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his range is.
children.raw: The swipe will appear further from Isaac the higher his [[range]] is.

children.text: The swipe can be used to open Spiked Chests and Mimic Chests without taking damage.
children.raw: The swipe can be used to open {{e|Spiked Chest}}s and {{e|Mimic Chest}}s without taking damage.

children.text: The swipe can be used to block bullets.
children.raw: The swipe can be used to block bullets.

children.text: The swipe can be aimed at any direction.
children.raw: The swipe can be aimed at any direction.

effects.text: Swiping a pickup on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.
effects.raw: Swiping a [[pickup]] on the floor will add it to the bag. The bag's contents cannot be dropped. Up to 8 pickups can be stored.

children.text: Double pickups like Double Hearts will add two copies to the bag. Blended Hearts will add one red heart and one soul heart.
children.raw: Double pickups like {{e|Double Heart}}s will add two copies to the bag. {{E|Blended Heart}}s will add one red heart and one soul heart.

children.text: Sticky Nickels can't be picked up unless unstuck.
children.raw: {{e|Sticky Nickel}}s can't be picked up unless unstuck.

children.text: Chests and Grab Bag can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles.
children.raw: {{e|Chest}}s and {{e|Grab Bag|text=Sacks}} can't be picked up, but can be opened with a swipe even behind obstacles.

children.text: If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a , using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag.
children.raw: If Isaac has enough money to buy a pickup from a {{R|Shop}}, using Bag of Crafting on that pickup will purchase it and automatically add it to the bag.

effects.text: Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.
effects.raw: Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag can be used once more to spawn an item pedestal.

children.text: If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead.
children.raw: If a recipe would result in an item that hasn't yet been unlocked, a random item will be crafted instead.

effects.text: There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome. As Tainted Cain:
effects.raw: There are a total of 29 different types of consumables that can be placed in the bag. The ordering does not matter for the outcome. '''As {{c|Tainted Cain}}:'''

effects.text: If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.
effects.raw: If pickups are collected after the max of 8 is reached, the contents shift left and up, deleting the top left slot and adding at the bottom right. Tapping the switch key cycles the bag's contents left and up in a loop, making it possible to choose which pickup to overwrite.

effects.text: Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.
effects.raw: Once 8 pickups are held in the bag, the bag will show a preview what would be crafted. Holding down the Use Pill/Card button will craft the item and place it directly in Tainted Cain's inventory.

children.text: Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would.
children.raw: Crafting an activated item while already holding one will turn the old one into pickups like collecting it would.

children.text: hides the crafting preview. Item Tags: The Bag of Crafting respects item tags, and which items are available during the current run. This includes the following:
children.raw: {{cu|Blind}} hides the crafting preview. '''Item Tags:''' The Bag of Crafting respects item tags, and which items are available during the current run. This includes the following:

effects.text: As The Lost, Birthright prevents items with the nolostbr item tag from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.
effects.raw: As {{c|The Lost}}, {{i|Birthright}} prevents items with the [[Item Tags nolostbr|nolostbr item tag]] from appearing when using the Bag of Crafting.

effects.text: As Tainted Lost, items without the offensive item tag will not appear.
effects.raw: As {{c|Tainted Lost}}, items without the [[Item Tags offensive|offensive item tag]] will not appear.

effects.text: As Keeper, items with the nokeeper item tag will not appear.
effects.raw: As {{c|Keeper}}, items with the [[Item Tags nokeeper|nokeeper item tag]] will not appear.

effects.text: In Greed Mode or Greedier Mode, items with the nogreed item tag will not appear.
effects.raw: In {{mode|greed|greedier}}[[Greed Mode|Greed Mode or Greedier Mode]], items with the [[Item Tags nogreed|nogreed item tag]] will not appear.

effects.text: In Daily Challenges, items with the nodaily item tag will not appear.
effects.raw: In [[Daily Challenge]]s, items with the [[Item Tags nodaily|nodaily item tag]] will not appear.

effects.text: In Challenge, items with the nochallenge item tag will not appear.
effects.raw: In [[Challenges|Challenge]], items with the [[Item Tags nochallenge|nochallenge item tag]] will not appear.

effects.text: If NO! is held, active items will be skipped.
effects.raw: If {{t|NO!}} is held, active items will be skipped.

effects.text: If Sacred Orb is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
effects.raw: If {{i|Sacred Orb}} is held, items with Quality 0 or 1 will be skipped. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with {{i|Breakfast}} instead.

synergies.text: Abyss / Void: Can be used in conjunction with Bag of Crafting to gain a large amount of locusts/stat boosts.
synergies.raw: {{i|Abyss}} / {{i|Void}}: Can be used in conjunction with Bag of Crafting to gain a large amount of locusts/stat boosts.

synergies.text: Serpent's Kiss: Due to the high amount of Black Hearts generated by the item, they can be utilized to either craft a high amount of Devil Room items, or a ludicrous amount of Brimstone, due to its recipe always consisting of eight Black Hearts.
synergies.raw: {{i|Serpent's Kiss}}: Due to the high amount of {{e|Black Heart}}s generated by the item, they can be utilized to either craft a high amount of [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room items]], or a ludicrous amount of {{i|Brimstone}}, due to its recipe always consisting of eight {{e|Black Heart}}s.

synergies.text: Pay to Win / XX - Judgement?: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not Tainted Cain as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the which can be rerolled repeatedly using the generated .
synergies.raw: {{T|Pay to Win}} / {{P|XX - Judgement?}}: Can be a powerful combination for when Isaac is not {{C|Tainted Cain}} as he can craft multiple item pedestals in the {{r|Treasure Room}} which can be rerolled repeatedly using the generated {{m|Shop Restock Machine}}.

interactions.text: Butter!: Bag of Crafting is dropped before pickups can be collected or items crafted.
interactions.raw: {{t|Butter!}}: Bag of Crafting is dropped before pickups can be collected or items crafted.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: The Ludovico Technique: Swiping the bag at the Ludovico tear will bat it in the direction of the knockback.
interactions.raw: {{i|The Ludovico Technique}}: Swiping the bag at the Ludovico tear will bat it in the direction of the knockback.

interactions.text: Sacred Orb: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacred Orb}}: Sacred Orb prevents crafting quality 1 and 0 items, typically resulting in them being replaced by quality 2 items. If a recipe that can only result in a quality 0-1 item is put in the bag, it will replace the item with Breakfast instead.

interactions.text: Tainted Eden: If the Tainted Eden loses Bag of Crafting from a reroll while it contains pickups, then rerolls back into it at a later point, it will still contain the pickups.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Eden}}: If the Tainted Eden loses Bag of Crafting from a reroll while it contains pickups, then rerolls back into it at a later point, it will still contain the pickups.

interactions.text: Wild Card: Holding up Bag of Crafting counts as an active item use for Wild Card, and can be replicated.
interactions.raw: {{p|Wild Card}}: Holding up Bag of Crafting counts as an active item use for Wild Card, and can be replicated.

interactions.text: ? Card: Does NOT give a free duplicate of whatever the full bag would create.
interactions.raw: {{p|? Card}}: Does NOT give a free duplicate of whatever the full bag would create.

name: Flip
description: Item pedestals have a second un-interactable "ghostly" item behind them. Activating will flip the real and ghostly items around. If playing as Tainted Lazarus, also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.

effects.text: While holding Flip, when Isaac enters a new room containing an item (, , etc.), the item pedestal will have a second "ghostly" item behind it.
effects.raw: While holding Flip, when Isaac enters a new room containing an item ({{r|Treasure Room}}, {{r|Shop}}, etc.), the item pedestal will have a second "ghostly" item behind it.

children.text: The real item can be interacted with normally, while the ghostly item cannot.
children.raw: The real item can be interacted with normally, while the ghostly item cannot.

children.text: The ghostly item will vanish if there is no real item on the pedestal and Isaac leaves the room.
children.raw: The ghostly item will vanish if there is no real item on the pedestal and Isaac leaves the room.

effects.text: Upon use, flips all real / ghostly items around on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly items. Does not affect pedestals that do not contain a ghostly item.
effects.raw: Upon use, flips all real / ghostly items around on pedestals, allowing Isaac to collect the ghostly items. Does not affect pedestals that do not contain a ghostly item.

children.text: As long as Isaac does not exit the room, empty pedestals can be flipped, meaning both the original item and the flipped ghostly item can be collected.
children.raw: As long as Isaac does not exit the room, empty pedestals can be flipped, meaning both the original item and the flipped ghostly item can be collected.

effects.text: If playing as Tainted Lazarus, activating it also flips between them and Dead Tainted Lazarus.
effects.raw: If playing as {{C|Tainted Lazarus}}, activating it also flips between them and {{C|Dead Tainted Lazarus}}.

children.text: Tainted Lazarus' Flip also only requires 4 charges.
children.raw: {{dlc|r+}} Tainted Lazarus' Flip also only requires 4 charges.

synergies.text: Eternal D6: When Eternal D6 makes an item disappear, the ghostly item behind it will not be gone and can be taken after using Flip.
synergies.raw: {{i|Eternal D6}}: When Eternal D6 makes an item disappear, the ghostly item behind it will not be gone and can be taken after using Flip.

children.text: Upon using Flip, the new item will be free to take, even if the original item had to be purchased with money or health.
children.raw: Upon using Flip, the new item will be free to take, even if the original item had to be purchased with money or health.

interactions.text: Tainted Isaac / Glitched Crown: The cycling effect only gets applied to the primary item; the ghostly item does not cycle. Using Flip on a cycling item pedestal will cause the currently visible item to switch places with the ghostly one, after which neither item will cycle.
interactions.raw: {{c|Tainted Isaac}} /  {{I|Glitched Crown}}: The cycling effect only gets applied to the primary item; the ghostly item does not cycle. Using Flip on a cycling item pedestal will cause the currently visible item to switch places with the ghostly one, after which neither item will cycle.

interactions.text: The D6 / Perthro / Dice Shard, etc.: Only rerolls visible item. Ghostly items remain unchanged.
interactions.raw: {{i|The D6}} / {{p|Perthro}} / {{p|Dice Shard}}, etc.: Only rerolls visible item. Ghostly items remain unchanged.

interactions.text: Car Battery: No effect.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: No effect.

interactions.text: Damocles: Additional pedestals will not have ghostly items.
interactions.raw: {{i|Damocles}}: Additional pedestals will not have ghostly items.

interactions.text: Void: Ghostly items no longer appear when absorbed by Void, rendering Flip useless.
interactions.raw: {{i|Void}}: Ghostly items no longer appear when absorbed by Void, rendering Flip useless.

name: Lemegeton
description: Spawns a destructible orbital familiar representing a random passive item, which blocks shots and deals contact damage. While the wisp is alive, Isaac gains that item's effects.

effects.text: Upon use, Lemegeton will grant a random passive item as an orbital familiar. The item summoned has a 25% chance to be from the current room's Item Pool, or from a random item pool otherwise. The item must have the 'summonable' item tag in order to be generated.
effects.raw: Upon use, Lemegeton will grant a random [[passive item]] as an orbital familiar. The item summoned has a 25% chance to be from the current room's [[Item Pool]], or from a [[#Random pool choices|random item pool]] otherwise. The item must have the [[Item Tags summonable|'summonable' item tag]] in order to be generated.

children.text: These familiars can block up to 4 shots and/or get hit by 2 explosions before being destroyed. When the familiar is destroyed, the item it granted is lost.
children.raw: These familiars can block up to 4 shots and/or get hit by 2 explosions before being destroyed. When the familiar is destroyed, the item it granted is lost.

children.text: If Isaac is shielded or invulnerable, his familiars are also immune to damage.
children.raw: If Isaac is [[Temporary Buffs|shielded or invulnerable]], his familiars are also immune to damage.

children.text: Familiars also deal contact damage to enemies equal to 2× Isaac's damage per tick (4× Isaac's damage per second). They take contact damage.
children.raw: Familiars also deal contact damage to enemies equal to 2× Isaac's damage per tick (4× Isaac's damage per second). They take contact damage.

children.text: Isaac can have up to 26 familiars: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.
children.raw: Isaac can have up to 26 familiars: an inner counterclockwise ring of 6, a middle clockwise ring with 8, and an outer counterclockwise ring of 12.

children.text: Using Lemegeton while Isaac already has 26 causes the oldest one to be replaced.
children.raw: Using Lemegeton while Isaac already has 26 causes the oldest one to be replaced.

effects.text: Counts towards the Bookworm transformation.
effects.raw: {{transformation contribution|Bookworm}}

synergies.text: BFFS!: Doubles the damage of Wisps.
synergies.raw: {{i|BFFS!}}: Doubles the damage of Wisps.
{{Book of Virtues synergy|description=Lets Lemegeton's wisps shoot homing tears once per second that deal 3 damage.}}

children.text: Also applies to Tainted Bethany's Lemegeton, despite not being visually shown.
children.raw: Also applies to {{c|Tainted Bethany}}'s Lemegeton, despite not being visually shown.

synergies.text: Rock Bottom: Stat increases remain even after its wisp has been destroyed.
synergies.raw: {{i|Rock Bottom}}: Stat increases remain even after its wisp has been destroyed.

synergies.text: Satanic Bible: Using Lemegeton in a after activating the Satanic Bible on that floor will pull from the Devil Room item pool, even if the boss wouldn't normally drop an item after defeat.
synergies.raw: {{i|Satanic Bible}}: Using Lemegeton in a {{r|Boss Room}} after activating the Satanic Bible on that floor will pull from the [[Devil Room (Item Pool)|Devil Room item pool]], even if the boss wouldn't normally drop an item after defeat.

interactions.text: Box of Friends: Does not double the wisps spawned by Lemegeton.
interactions.raw: {{I|Box of Friends}}: Does not double the wisps spawned by {{I|Lemegeton}}.

interactions.text: Car Battery: Two wisps are created on use, only the name of the second item is displayed. If a Car Battery wisp is created, another wisp is summoned immediately.
interactions.raw: {{i|Car Battery}}: Two wisps are created on use, only the name of the second item is displayed. If a Car Battery wisp is created, another wisp is summoned immediately.

interactions.text: Chaos: Item wisps will be selected from random pools, regardless of the room Isaac is in.
interactions.raw: {{I|Chaos}}: Item wisps will be selected from random pools, regardless of the room Isaac is in.

interactions.text: Magic Skin: Can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run.
interactions.raw: {{I|Magic Skin}}: Can be spawned by Lemegeton if it has been used in the current run.

interactions.text: Sacred Orb: Generated wisps are affected by Sacred Orb.
interactions.raw: {{I|Sacred Orb}}: Generated wisps are affected by Sacred Orb.

interactions.text: Sacrificial Altar: Every wisp will be converted to a Half Soul Heart. Familiars created by Lemegeton are sacrificed normally.
interactions.raw: {{i|Sacrificial Altar}}: Every wisp will be converted to a {{E|Half Soul Heart}}. [[Familiar]]s created by Lemegeton are sacrificed normally.

name: Sumptorium
description: Removes half a heart and creates a Clot familiar that mimics Isaac's movements and tear effects. As Tainted Eve, passively converts health into Clots while firing. Activating returns all Clots to health.

effects.text: When used by any character other than Tainted Eve, removes half a heart of health upon use and creates a Clot familiar.
effects.raw: When used by any character other than {{c|Tainted Eve}}, removes half a heart of health upon use and creates a Clot familiar.

children.text: Blood clot familiars mimic Isaac's movement (including flight), firing, and tear effects.
children.raw: Blood clot familiars mimic Isaac's movement (including [[flight]]), firing, and tear effects.

children.text: Blood clot familiars will mimic all tear-altering effects, such as Spirit Sword.
children.raw: Blood clot familiars will mimic all tear-altering effects, such as {{I|Spirit Sword}}.

children.text: Holding down the swap button allows Isaac to move independently from the blood clots.
children.raw: Holding down the swap button allows Isaac to move independently from the blood clots.

children.text: The familiars have health and will be destroyed if they take enough damage. They start with a set amount of HP when spawned, and the health of Red Heart and Rotten Heart Clots will slowly decay down to 1 HP over time, while the health of the other clot types decay down to 5 HP.
children.raw: The familiars have health and will be destroyed if they take enough damage. They start with a set amount of HP when spawned, and the health of {{e|Red Heart}} and {{e|Rotten Heart}} Clots will slowly decay down to 1 HP over time, while the health of the other clot types decay down to 5 HP.

children.text: Their health decays at a rate of 1 HP per 2.5 seconds.
children.raw: Their health decays at a rate of 1 HP per 2.5 seconds.

children.text: They are immune to hazards such as spikes, Fire Places, and lasers.
children.raw: They are immune to hazards such as [[spikes]], {{e|Fire Place}}s, and lasers.

children.text: Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage to them when hit.
children.raw: Enemies deal 1 point of contact and projectile damage to them when hit.

children.text: Isaac's Bombs and Troll Bombs deal 2 points of damage.
children.raw: Isaac's {{e|Bomb}}s and {{e|Troll Bomb}}s deal 2 points of damage.

children.text: Draining health does not count as taking damage, so creating familiars will not trigger damage-activated effects.
children.raw: Draining health does not count as taking damage, so creating familiars will not trigger damage-activated effects.

effects.raw: Passively, holding down the fire button will create blood clot familiars every two seconds and drain half a [[Health|heart]].

effects.text: Upon activation, Sumptorium destroys any remaining blood clots and heals Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts that were used to generate them. The blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through as they return.
effects.raw: Upon activation, Sumptorium destroys any remaining blood clots and heals Tainted Eve for the same type of hearts that were used to generate them. The blood clots deal 3x Tainted Eve's damage to enemies they pass through as they return.

children.text: Should Tainted Eve have more blood clots than room in her health bar when doing this, all excess blood clots will drop next to her.
children.raw: Should Tainted Eve have more blood clots than room in her health bar when doing this, all excess blood clots will drop next to her.

effects.text: The charge time is only 1 second rather than 10 seconds.
effects.raw: The charge time is only 1 second rather than 10 seconds.

synergies.text: Baby-Bender: Gives the clots homing shots.

name: TMTRAINER
description: Causes all future items to be "glitched", granting them completely random effects.

effects.text: When picked up, all future items become "Glitched", causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items as well as effects that are not normally controlled by the player, such as enemy spawning and other behind-the-scenes effects.
effects.raw: When picked up, all future [[items]] become "Glitched", causing them to become random combinations of 2-3 effects based on other items as well as effects that are not normally controlled by the player, such as enemy spawning and other behind-the-scenes effects.

children.text: Quest items do not become glitched. This includes: The Polaroid, The Negative, Key Piece 1, Key Piece 2, Knife Piece 1, Knife Piece 2, Dad's Note.
children.raw: [[Item Tags quest|Quest items]] do not become glitched. This includes: {{i|The Polaroid}}, {{i|The Negative}}, {{i|Key Piece 1}}, {{i|Key Piece 2}}, {{i|Knife Piece 1}}, {{i|Knife Piece 2}}, {{i|Dad's Note}}.

children.text: Additionally, the currently playing music will fade out. The silence will remain until another music track plays.
children.raw: Additionally, the currently playing music will fade out. The silence will remain until another music track plays.

children.text: Any enemies in the room will also become simultaneously frozen and set on fire.
children.raw: Any enemies in the room will also become simultaneously frozen and set on fire.

effects.raw: "Glitched" items can be passive or active and are completely randomly generated with practically infinite possibilities. There is a 75% chance that the item will be passive.

effects.text: Random effects combine effects that exist on other items, and assign them to a random event (e.g. on enemy death, on room clear, on damage taken etc.).
effects.raw: Random effects combine effects that exist on other items, and assign them to a random event (e.g. on enemy death, on room clear, on damage taken etc.).

children.text: These effects may also be derived from installed modded items.
children.raw: These effects may also be derived from installed modded items.

effects.raw: Glitched items sold for money cost a random amount of pennies up to 99 pennies.

interactions.raw: {{T|'M}}: Rerolls glitched actives into other glitched actives.

interactions.raw: {{i|Bag of Crafting}}: Recipes are not glitched.

interactions.raw: {{i|Binge Eater}}: Functions as intended, cycling pedestals between a glitched item and an HP up item.

interactions.raw: {{I|Diplopia}}: Glitched items are copied normally. Pedestals spawned before acquiring TMTRAINER will duplicate into a glitched item.

name: Spindown Dice
description: Reduces the internal ID number of all items in the room by one, turning them into the item with that number.

effects.raw: Rerolls all pedestal items in a room by decreasing their internal ID number by one until a valid item is rolled. This effect occurs per item and is independent of any other items in the room.

name: Hypercoagulation
description: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, launches Red Hearts from Isaac that despawn after 1.5 seconds.

effects.raw: After Isaac takes damage from an enemy or donates health, he drops a {{e|Red Heart}} that despawns after 1.5 seconds.

children.text: The heart dropped depends on the source: half-hearts of damage taken drop Half Red Hearts, and full hearts of damage taken drop full hearts.
children.raw: The heart dropped depends on the source: half-hearts of damage taken drop {{e|Half Red Heart}}s, and full hearts of damage taken drop full hearts.

children.text: The hearts will get launched out of Isaac with momentum, making them difficult to pick up.
children.raw: The hearts will get launched out of Isaac with momentum, making them difficult to pick up.

synergies.raw: [[Cards and Runes#Playing Cards|Ace Cards]] / {{i|Diplopia}} / {{i|D1}} / {{P|Jera}}: Converted/duplicated hearts will not disappear.

synergies.raw: {{i|Cancer}} / [[Pills|Percs!]] pill / {{I|The Wafer}}: Damage sources that spawn full red hearts will still spawn a full red heart despite the cost being reduced to half a heart.

synergies.raw: {{i|Dull Razor}}: Can be used to spawn full red hearts for Isaac to pick up.

synergies.raw: {{i|Humbleing Bundle}}: {{e|Red Heart}} spawns can be converted to {{e|Double Heart}}s.

interactions.raw: {{i|Cambion Conception}}: By intentionally taking damage with something like a fire and grabbing the half-red hearts, Isaac can easily generate powerful familiars for free.

interactions.raw: {{i|Candy Heart}} / {{i|Immaculate Conception}}: The hearts will count toward gaining stat boosts/familiars.

interactions.raw: {{i|Compost}}: The temporary heart will be converted into a [[Familiar#Blue Flies|Blue Fly]][[Familiar#Blue Spiders|/Spider]].

interactions.raw: {{i|D20}} / {{i|GB Bug}}: Rerolled hearts will still disappear.

interactions.raw: {{i|Glass Cannon}}: Spawns two more full red hearts when Glass Cannon breaks, regardless of how much health was lost to it.

interactions.raw: {{i|Maggy's Bow}}: Doubles the healing received from the hearts spawned.

interactions.raw: {{i|Magneto}} / {{t|Super Magnet}}: Will immediately start pulling the dropped hearts to Isaac, breaking their momentum and making collection much easier.

name: IBS
description: Causes Isaac to throw poop, create buffing creep, or drop bombs while fighting enemies.

name: Hemoptysis
description: Double-tapping a fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. Affected enemies are cursed and take more damage from Brimstone-like attacks.

effects.text: Double-tapping the fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. The sneeze deals damage equal to 1.5x Isaac's damage, knocking enemies and projectiles back. Knocked back enemies take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) additional damage if they hit a wall or obstacle, and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.
effects.raw: Double-tapping the fire button causes Isaac to sneeze blood, dealing damage to enemies in front of him. The sneeze deals damage equal to 1.5x Isaac's damage, knocking enemies and projectiles back. Knocked back enemies take 10 + 2 * (floor - 1) additional damage if they hit a wall or obstacle, and deal that same damage to other enemies they collide with.

children.text: The sneeze has a cooldown of 1 second.
children.raw: The sneeze has a cooldown of 1 second.

children.text: The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage to enemies if it would have caused Isaac half a heart of damage, and 7 damage if it would have caused Isaac a full heart damage.
children.raw: The reflected projectiles deal 6 damage to enemies if it would have caused Isaac half a heart of damage, and 7 damage if it would have caused Isaac a full heart damage.

effects.text: The sneeze applies a curse to enemies. Enemies under the curse will take more damage from Brimstone-like laser attacks and violently explode on death, damaging and spreading the curse to nearby enemies. Any enemies spawned by those under the curse will also be cursed.
effects.raw: The sneeze applies a curse to enemies. Enemies under the curse will take more damage from {{I|Brimstone}}-like laser attacks and violently explode on death, damaging and spreading the curse to nearby enemies. Any enemies spawned by those under the curse will also be cursed.

name: Ghost Bombs
description: +5 Bombs. Bombs become spectral and spawn ghosts that deal contact damage to enemies and explode after 10 seconds.

effects.text: Gives Isaac 5 Bombs.
effects.raw: Gives Isaac 5 {{e|Bomb}}s.

effects.text: Isaac's bombs create ghosts when they explode, which rapidly chase and deal contact damage to enemies.
effects.raw: Isaac's bombs create ghosts when they explode, which rapidly chase and deal contact damage to enemies.

children.text: The ghost deals contact damage equal to half of Isaac's damage per tick (2× Isaac's damage per second).
children.raw: The ghost deals contact damage equal to half of Isaac's [[damage]] per tick (2× Isaac's damage per second).

effects.text: After 10 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3 times and destroying nearby projectiles. Isaac does not take damage from the explosion.
effects.raw: After 10 seconds, the ghost explodes, dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies up to 3 times and destroying nearby projectiles. Isaac does not take damage from the explosion.

children.text: If there are no enemies in the room, the ghost follows Isaac. However, it cannot follow Isaac between rooms.
children.raw: If there are no enemies in the room, the ghost follows Isaac. However, it cannot follow Isaac between rooms.

synergies.text: Dr. Fetus: Has a chance to shoot a Ghost Bomb that also has spectral properties and can travel through objects.
synergies.raw: {{i|Dr. Fetus}}: Has a chance to shoot a Ghost Bomb that also has spectral properties and can travel through objects.

synergies.text: Scatter Bombs: Split bombs create ghosts that instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, similar to Purgatory. They each deal 2× Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.
synergies.raw: {{I|Scatter Bombs}}: Split bombs create ghosts that instantly launch themselves at enemies and explode, similar to {{i|Purgatory}}. They each deal 2× Isaac's damage, up to 4 times.

synergies.raw: {{I|Mr. Mega}}: Ghosts appear larger and do extra damage only upon exploding.

interactions.raw: {{i|Libra}}: The ghosts ignore damage modification from Libra, both positive and negative: the actual unbalanced damage value is used.

name: Gello
description: Spawns a demon familiar for the current room attached to Isaac that moves and fires in the direction Isaac shoots, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.

effects.text: Spawns a demon familiar attached to Isaac by a cord for the current room, floating in the direction Isaac shoots. It automatically fires tears (whenever Isaac is shooting) in the direction of the closest enemy to it, using Isaac's damage, tears, range, shot speed, and special tear effects.
effects.raw: Spawns a demon [[familiar]] attached to Isaac by a cord for the current room, floating in the direction Isaac shoots. It automatically fires tears (whenever Isaac is shooting) in the direction of the closest enemy to it, using Isaac's [[damage]], [[tears]], [[range]], [[shot speed]], and [[Status Effects|special]] [[tear effects]].

children.text: The item is initially held over Isaac's head until he fires, which launches the familiar in the direction he shoots, dealing 3x Isaac's damage to all enemies it passes through.
children.raw: The item is initially held over Isaac's head until he fires, which launches the familiar in the direction he shoots, dealing 3x Isaac's damage to all enemies it passes through.

children.text: If Isaac has any tear modifier that requires him to charge his shots (i.e. Brimstone), Gello will automatically release its shot every time it is fully charged.
children.raw: If Isaac has any tear modifier that requires him to charge his shots (i.e. {{i|Brimstone}}), Gello will automatically release its shot every time it is fully charged.

children.text: Gello's tears deal 0.75x Isaac's damage.
children.raw: Gello's tears deal 0.75x Isaac's damage.

synergies.text: Tainted Azazel: Each time Gello starts charging an attack, he will "sneeze" just like Tainted Azazel does, cursing enemies in front of him. This allows Tainted Azazel to keep enemies cursed without needing to come up to a dangerously close distance to them.
synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Azazel}}: Each time Gello starts charging an attack, he will "sneeze" just like Tainted Azazel does, cursing enemies in front of him. This allows Tainted Azazel to keep enemies cursed without needing to come up to a dangerously close distance to them.

synergies.raw: {{c|Tainted Lazarus}}: The familiar persists when switching states.

synergies.raw: {{i|Uranus}}: When the baby is launched, any enemies it kills in its trajectory will freeze and any frozen enemies the baby is launched into slide if Isaac is moving, similarly to when kicked by Isaac.

synergies.raw: {{c|Lilith}} / {{c|Tainted Lilith}}: Gello's tears deal 1.0x of Isaac's damage instead.

effects.raw: Throws Isaac's head while allowing to shoot from the spot it lands, blocking enemy shots as well as dealing contact damage to nearby enemies. Meanwhile, Isaac's body can no longer shoot tears.

children.raw: The head does 24 damage on impact and 4 damage per tick (12 damage per second) on contact when it's on the ground.

children.raw: The head can return by picking it up with the body, or by using the item again without requiring charges. Both the throwing and retaking of the head can deal damage to enemies passing through.
